title: RHEL Systems Administrator (L2)
description:
RHEL Systems Administrator (L2)

Experience Required: 4–5 Years

Work Schedule: 24/7 Rotational Shifts (including weekends and on-call support)

Mandatory Certification: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced L2 Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Systems Administrator to manage, troubleshoot, and automate our enterprise Linux infrastructure. You will handle L2 production escalations, perform root cause analysis (RCA), manage large-scale patching, and ensure high availability, security, and performance across RHEL 7, 8, and 9 environments.

Key Responsibilities
L2 Production Support & Troubleshooting: Resolve escalated incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and troubleshoot boot failures, OS performance bottlenecks (CPU, memory, disk I/O), network issues, and SELinux/firewall blocks.

System Administration: Administer and maintain RHEL 7, 8, and 9 servers, including user/group management, permissions, systemd services, scheduled tasks, and OS upgrades/migrations.

Storage Management: Configure and manage Logical Volume Manager (LVM), XFS/EXT4 filesystems, NFS shares, iSCSI targets/initiators, and SAN LUNs with multipathing.

Automation & Scripting: Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks and Bash/Shell scripts to automate repetitive administrative tasks, configuration management, health checks, and bulk deployments.

Enterprise Patching: Plan, schedule, and execute monthly security and errata patching across Linux servers using Red Hat Satellite (managing Content Views, Repositories, and Lifecycle Environments), including pre-patch checks and rollbacks.

Security & OS Hardening: Implement OS hardening standards (such as CIS benchmarks), manage SSH/firewall policies, and remediate security vulnerabilities.

Cross-Platform & Tooling Support: Provide basic administrative support for Windows Server environments and utilize ManageEngine tools for monitoring, ticketing, and endpoint management.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience: 4–5 years of hands-on experience in enterprise Linux administration and L2 production support.

Operating Systems: Deep working knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7, 8, and 9).

Storage: Strong practical experience with LVM, XFS, EXT4, NFS, SAN, and iSCSI.

Automation: Proven ability to write Bash/Shell scripts and build Ansible playbooks for infrastructure automation.

Patch Management: Hands-on experience managing and patching enterprise environments using Red Hat Satellite.

Security: Familiarity with Linux hardening practices, SELinux, and firewalld/iptables.

Additional Skills: Working knowledge of Windows OS administration and ManageEngine suites.

Operational Readiness: Willingness and ability to work in a 24/7 rotational shift model, including weekend coverage and on-call rotations.

Certifications
Mandatory: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)

Preferred: Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)

title: Audience Growth Associate
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Senior KYC Insti Analyst
description:
About the job

We are looking to expand our Institutional KYC Team and set new quality standards in our work.

As a Senior KYC Analyst, you will be part of a specialized team working with onboarding and ongoing due diligence of complex and high-risk clients within the funds and correspondent banking space.

The role is focused on conducting in-depth due diligence, identifying and mitigating financial crime risks, and ensuring compliance with regulatory expectations across onboarding and ongoing due diligence across our global footprint. You will play a key role in handling complex ownership structures, cross-border risks, and institutional setups while maintaining a strong client experience.

You will work closely with stakeholders across Financial Crime Prevention, Institutional Business, and other stakeholders in Saxo Group to ensure a robust, compliant, and efficient onboarding journey for complex clients.

Responsibilities

  • Operational handling of clients in accordance with KYC procedures and Saxo Group’s Risk Appetite.
  • Perform end-to-end assessment of institutional clients, including funds, financial institutions, and correspondent-like setups.
  • Conduct enhanced due diligence (EDD) on complex structures, including layered ownership, cross-border activities, and high-risk jurisdictions.
  • Analyse business models, transaction flows, and source of wealth/funds for institutional clients.
  • Build and share knowledge within the team on institutional onboarding, AML risks, and regulatory expectations.
  • Ensure high quality and timely delivery in line with SLAs and internal controls.
  • Identify risks, gaps, and areas for improvement in processes, controls, and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders across compliance, risk, and front office to ensure aligned and consistent decision-making.

Your profile
You have solid experience within AML/KYC, with a strong focus on institutional clients such as financial institutions, funds, or correspondent banking relationships or equivalent clients.

You understand complex ownership structures, fund setups, and cross-border risk exposures, and you are comfortable applying a risk-based approach in high-complexity cases. You are used to working with enhanced due diligence and can independently assess AML risks and make well-argued recommendations.

We Expect

  • Experience with AML and KYC of institutional clients, preferably from banking, asset management, insurance or funds.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory requirements related to financial institutions and complex client types.
  • Ability to analyse and document complex cases in a clear and structured way.
  • Relevant certifications such as CAMS (ACAMS), ICA or equivalent are an advantage.

You are detail-oriented, structured, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment. At the same time, you are a strong team player who can work across functions and challenge stakeholders when needed.
You can communicate clearly and professionally in English. Additional languages are an advantage.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!


How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

title: Product Director
location: Jakarta, Indonesia; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Singapore, Singapore
description:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

About the Job

We are looking for an experienced Product Director to lead our core payment portfolios, encompassing Payments Acceptance (Cards & LPMs) and Payouts. In this role, you will define the long-term product vision, set the strategic roadmap, and drive the evolution of our B2B payments infrastructure. We are seeking a visionary product leader who has a deep understanding of the payments industry, knows what best-in-class looks like, and can elevate our product offerings to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions across multiple regions.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Define and own the long-term product strategy and comprehensive roadmaps for large-scale payment portfolios, focusing on future growth and innovation.
  • Drive product performance and take ownership of key commercial and technical metrics, including authorization/success rates, total payment volume (TPV), cost of acceptance, and margin optimization.
  • Build and scale robust B2B payment products and infrastructure across multiple regions and complex regulatory jurisdictions.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams, utilizing your technical background to guide how payment systems, connections, and integrations work together seamlessly.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of Product Managers and Senior Product Managers, fostering a culture of strategic thinking paired with hands-on product ownership.

What you’ll need in this role:

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proven track record of leading product teams and owning end-to-end strategy.
  • Deep knowledge of card acquiring and/or local payment methods, specifically gained from working at a Payment Service Provider (PSP) or a dedicated payments technology company.
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing large B2B payment portfolios rather than just individual features.
  • Highly metrics-minded and analytical, with direct experience managing payments economics and performance indicators.
  • Technical fluency necessary to understand and navigate complex payment architectures and integrations.
  • Preferred: Experience with payouts/disbursements, Southeast Asia or emerging market payment methods (e-wallets, QR, etc.), multi-acquirer routing, and fraud/risk management.

title: Enterprise Reporter
description:
State Affairs is the nation’s leading news and policy intelligence platform focused on state governments. We combine nonpartisan coverage of Statehouses across the country alongside state government data and AI-native tools into a singular platform.

We inform and empower decision makers, policy professionals and citizens through our award-winning journalism and data – delivering profound insights to help our customers decode and act on state politics and policy. We’re building a category-defining business that will reshape America as we strengthen visibility into what’s happening and why at the state level.

We are hiring a Enterprise Reporter to join our Pluribus News team located in Washington, DC.

As the Enterprise Reporter, you will:

  • Report on the people, power and policies shaping America’s state legislatures in technology and transportation.
  • Produce regular scoops, analysis, Playmaker Profiles and explainers for an engaged, insider audience.
  • Develop sources across the political spectrum and across the nation.
  • Help the Pluribus News/State Affairs remain the go-to source for smart, reliable and fearless statehouse news.
  • Contribute to special series, newsletters and public-facing events.
  • Collaborate with other State Affairs journalists to break silos and elevate coverage nationwide.

Essential Qualifications for this position include:

  • 5+ years of professional work experience as a reporter
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, or related field
  • Ability to write clean, compelling, and accurate stories
  • Ability to be nonpartisan and commit to fact-based journalism
  • Ability to work independently

Preferred Qualifications for this position include:

  • Prior professional work experience as a reporter covering politics, government, or public policy
  • Skilled in audio, video or data journalism

This is a onsite work opportunity and our teams operate from the Washington, DC office (located at L and 15th St. NW) 5 (five) days per week. State Affairs offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package to employees.

The annual salary range for this role as it is posted is $90,000 - $100,000 for candidates working from Washington, DC. The final job level and annual salary will be determined based on the education, qualification, knowledge, skills, ability, and experience of the final candidate(s), and calibrated against relevant market data and internal team equity. Benefits listed in this posting may vary depending on the nature of your employment with State Affairs.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future company sponsorship.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Location Details: India, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.

Join Our Team

GoDaddy empowers everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools they need to succeed online. Our mission is to give customers the tools, insights, and people they need to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. We’re seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join the Commercial Intelligence team within Care Commercial Success. This senior individual-contributor role helps Care leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities and risks, and make better commercial decisions through rigorous analytics.

You’ll independently lead complex analyses, develop executive-ready dashboards and reporting, evaluate commercial and marketing performance, and translate large, varied datasets into clear recommendations. You’ll partner closely with Care leadership, Finance, Marketing, Commercial Performance, Strategic Modeling, and data enablement partners to turn business questions into actionable insights that improve revenue, productivity, customer outcomes, and overall Care performance.

What you'll get to do...

  • Lead complex analyses of commercial and operational performance to identify risks and opportunities and recommend actions grounded in data and business context
  • Build trusted, executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, and run-the-business reporting using Amazon QuickSight or comparable BI tools, while taking ownership of recurring analytical deliverables
  • Develop scalable analytical solutions using advanced SQL and Python and/or R for analysis, validation, automation, and repeatable workflows, including improving existing processes using AI tools
  • Partner cross-functionally to clarify business questions, investigate problems, and align on analytical requirements and solutions
  • Communicate insights confidently to senior leaders, clearly explaining what the data shows, why it matters, and what actions are recommended

Your experience should include...

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in business analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, revenue operations, finance analytics, marketing analytics, or a related field, with strong experience working with large datasets
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, multiple data sources, troubleshooting, and validation
  • Proficiency in Python and/or R for data manipulation, automation, statistical analysis, or repeatable analytical workflows
  • Experience with Amazon QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or comparable BI tools, including developing executive-facing dashboards and reporting
  • Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex or ambiguous business problems, influence senior stakeholders, and improve analytical processes through AI or automation

You might also have...

  • Experience supporting contact centers, customer care, sales, revenue operations, or performance marketing
  • Experience presenting to C-suite, VP-level, or other senior leaders, or supporting recurring executive business reviews
  • Experience with experimentation, statistical analysis, metric governance, or scalable self-service analytics
  • Experience with AWS Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or SaaS/subscription-based businesses
  • Hands-on experience using Claude to improve analytical workflows, automate processes, or solve analytical problems

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

We've got your back... We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

About us... GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy.

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

title: Fullstack Developer – ECO Application (Java / React)
description:
Location: Bucharest, Romania

About the Role:


We are looking for a Fullstack Developer – ECO Application (React and JAVA)


The ECO application is an internal Thales tool used for environmental risk assessment and the generation of regulatory documentation. It is developed by TGS/TCE and deployed on-premise within Thales entities.


In this role, you will ensure the operational maintenance, enhancement, and performance optimization of the ECO application supporting both ongoing delivery and production stability for a business-critical platform.


Why Join?

Work on an internal, high-impact application supporting regulatory documentation and environmental risk processes contributing to continuous improvement in an Agile delivery environment.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and fix application defects, incidents, and operational issues
  • Develop new features and enhancements based on priorities from the Business Owner and Product Owner
  • Optimize and refactor code to improve performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Participate in technical design, development, testing, and validation activities
  • Prepare deployment documentation and release instructions for corrective patches
  • Support deployment and production rollouts when required
  • Contribute to Agile/Kanban ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives


Technical Skills:


  • Frontend (mandatory): HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ReactJS (nice to have)
  • Backend (core): Java, ORM, SOAP, REST, SQL, PL/pgSQL, PostgreSQL, Spring Boot (nice to have)
  • Operating System: Linux Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
  • Methodology: Agile / Kanban


Candidate Profile:

  • Experienced Full Stack Developer with Java expertise
  • Solid database knowledge and experience maintaining business-critical applications
  • Strong ability to understand and analyze functional requirements and constraints
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with the expected autonomy for the role


📢 Connect with Andreea Burcea, Talent Acquisition Partner #LI-BA1 , she’d be happy to talk with you about this position.

title: Regional Service Coordinator
description:
Regional Service Co-ordinator

Location: Elland
Reporting to: Service Control Supervisor

Join Terberg DTS as a Regional Service Coordinator.

We are looking for a highly organised and customer-focused Regional Service Co-ordinator to support the efficient delivery of maintenance, repair and breakdown services across our customer network.
This is a fast-paced and varied role where you will work closely with customers, Mobile Service Engineers, Regional Service Controllers and Breakdown Controllers to ensure service requests are managed efficiently from initial enquiry through to completion. If you thrive in a busy environment, enjoy solving problems and take pride in delivering exceptional customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Regional Service Co-ordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring all service and maintenance activities are accurately planned, coordinated and communicated. title: Senior Optical Test Engineer
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Position Title: Senior Optical Test Engineer

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: San Jose CA (On-Site)

About Lumentum


At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

Why You’ll Love This Role


Lumentum is seeking an experienced Photonic Test Engineer to characterize and test photonics integrated circuits (PICs) at die-level and wafer-level testing, and to develop test platforms for both R&D use as well as for manufacturing. This position will be primarily responsible for test infrastructure development and design verification testing on novel electro-optic devices.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, self-directed, independent, and adept in the lab. Of particular importance to us are the ability and desire to learn, and the drive to work very hard with similarly motivated people.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a key contributor to our Design Verification & Characterization Team, you’ll play an essential role in bringing revolutionary optical products to life. Specifically, you’ll:

  • Engineer with impact: Design and implement advanced optical test methodologies and verification strategies to transition breakthrough products from the design phase to full-scale production.
  • Develop automated die-level testers: Develop automated die-level test systems by specifying equipment, designing fixtures, writing test software, and debugging integrated systems to ensure accurate and reliable operation.
  • Characterize cutting-edge optics: Analyze test data from design of experiments (DOEs) to identify which optical design parameters drive performance and guide targeted improvements.
  • Dive into advanced analysis: Apply statistical methods and use software tools to analyze large datasets, identify wafer-to-wafer variation and spatial patterns within wafers, and use these findings to guide design changes that improve yield.
  • Innovate with AI: Collaborate on integrating AI tools into test and characterization workflows to unlock new levels of efficiency and accuracy.
  • Collaborate for success: Work closely with R&D, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to align product requirements.
  • Deliver excellence: Create scalable, well-documented test solutions and validate products using Agile methodologies.
  • Learn from the best: Gain hands-on experience and mentorship from seasoned experts in optical testing, characterization, and advanced data analysis, setting the foundation for a successful career.

What We’re Looking For

Education:

  • A graduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field.

Experience:
The ideal candidate will have:

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in product development for optical components, photonics, or telecommunications systems
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency in software development and test instrumentation

Skills:

  • Experience in the design and/or testing of optical components and subsystems for optical communications.
  • Hands-on experience with electrical and optical test and measurement equipment
  • Expertise in test automation, including interaction with devices under test and test equipment.
  • Experience in any (or more) of the following: Python, VB.NET, C#, JMP, SQL
  • Experience leveraging packages and frameworks in a software development context
  • Familiarity with Agile software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git)

Perks You’ll Love

  • Flexible time off
  • Health and wellness benefits (physical and mental)
  • Tuition reimbursement and career growth support
  • A workplace built for you: free gym, games room, prayer room
  • Subsidized meals, free coffee/tea
  • Employee stock options and incentive plans
  • A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture

Join a Team That’s Shaping the Future

At Lumentum, we’re more than just a workplace—we’re a launchpad for creativity and innovation. We’re committed to celebrating your unique talents and helping you grow. Our guiding principles—Innovate, Engage, Deliver, Excel, and Win—aren’t just words; they’re the heart of what we do.

Your uniqueness makes us stronger, sparks creativity, and drives our success.

Join us—your future starts here!

title: Back-End Developer Gegevensboekhouding
description:
For this assignment, we are looking for candidates who have excellent communication skills in Dutch (spoken and written)

Omschrijving

De CDO van JenV legt primair de focus op het vormgeven van gegevensdelings- en gegevenstyperingsbeleid. Dit komt voort uit de behoefte om data op een efficiënte en transparante wijze over de diverse onderdelen van het ministerie met elkaar te kunnen delen. Hiervoor is het essentieel dat er sprake is van eenheid van taal wanneer wordt gesproken over data. De CDO heeft om die reden de ambitie om van gegevensdeling een organisatorische vaardigheid te maken. JenV-brede standaarden voor het definiëren van beleid en metadata worden vastgelegd in het JenV Afsprakenstelsel Gegevens & Algoritmes (JAGA). De metadata zelf wordt op een systematische manier opgenomen in een Gegevensboekhouding.

Voor de Gegevensboekhouding wordt gebruik gemaakt van een open source oplossing die draait in een Azure omgeving. Als Back-end Developer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van robuuste en schaalbare REST API’s met Python en Flask, conform de OpenAPI-specificatie (2.0 of hoger). Je implementeert de SOLID-principes en best practices om hoogwaardige, herbruikbare en onderhoudbare code te schrijven.

We zoeken een ervaren applicatieontwikkelaar (geen data engineer) die vanaf de start snel zelfstandig kan meekomen in een dynamische, complexe omgeving. Iemand die zelf uitstekende code schrijft, documenteert en test (middels unit tests), maar ook sterk is in code reviews en architecturale keuzes onderbouwt.
Je werkt nauw samen met cross-functionele teams zoals de Technical Lead, Front-end Developers en het Product Team om technische vereisten te begrijpen en elegante, duurzame oplossingen te ontwerpen. Je bent bekend met Azure Cosmos DB, Redis, Elasticsearch, NoSQL en Graph databases (zoals Neo4j), en begrijpt hoe deze componenten samenkomen in een moderne cloud-native architectuur. Je bouwt mee aan een enterprise SaaS-backend die straks door honderden gebruikers wordt gebruikt en integreert met meerdere interne en externe systemen. Passend bij deze fase is ook een goede communicatieve vaardigheid en een proactieve, oplossingsgerichte en positieve werkhouding. Tot slot moet je in staat zijn flexibel mee te bewegen met keuzes die gaandeweg op basis van opgedane ervaring worden
gemaakt.
Omdat we nieuwe software opbouwen gaan we uit van veel onderlinge samenwerking en dus vragen we 3 dagen fysieke aanwezigheid op locatie (Utrecht) waarbij kandidaat wordt geacht gebruik te maken van eigen bedrijfsmiddelen zoals laptop, telefoon, vervoer, etc.

Eisen:
  • De kandidaat heeft een HBO werk- en denkniveau. (Dit staat duidelijk en onderbouwd beschreven in het cv middels opsomming of arcering).
  • De kandidaat heeft minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbare en bewezen ervaring als Applicatie Back-end Developer (geen data engineering) in een professionele en complexe omgeving. (Dit staat duidelijk en onderbouwd beschreven in het cv middels opsomming of arcering).
  • De kandidaat heeft minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbaar en bewezen ervaring met Python. (Dit staat duidelijk en onderbouwd beschreven in het cv middels opsomming of arcering).
  • De kandidaat heeft minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met Microsoft Azure. (Dit staat duidelijk en onderbouwd beschreven in het cv middels opsomming of arcering).
  • De kandidaat heeft minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met het ontwerpen van REST API’s conform OpenAPI Spec 2.0 of hoger. (Dit staat duidelijk en onderbouwd beschreven in het cv middels opsomming of arcering).
  • De kandidaat scoort minimaal een voldoende op het ingeleverde assessment om in aanmerking te komen voor gunning. (Hiervoor wordt voorafgaand aan het gesprek een kort assesment toegestuurd met het verzoek deze voor het gesprek terug te sturen).
  • De kandidaat scoort minimaal een voldoende (>6) op ieder interviewcriterium om in aanmerking te komen voor gunning.

  • Kandidaat weet snel de kernvraag in complexe materie boven tafel te krijgen.
  • Kandidaat laat zien dat hij de diverse belangen in een complex veld kan overzien en ondanks de tegenstellingen in die belangen kan acteren.
  • Kandidaat is deskundig en in staat zijn kennis en (werk)ervaring snel in te zetten.

  • Kandidaat past binnen het team: Communicatief vaardig (ideeën en oplossingen kunnen overbrengen en klantgericht zijn), Secuur, Aanpassingsvermogen (zelfstandig en binnen team, zowel gestructureerd als improviserend kunnen werken), Stressbestendig (meerdere prioriteiten tegelijk aankunnen), Flexibel (kunnen omgaan met wijzigingen in prioriteiten).

  • De kandidaat heeft X jaar aantoonbare en bewezen ervaring met Python (bij voorkeur Flask) en het ontwerpen en bouwen van REST API's conform OpenAPI Spec 2.0 of hoger van robuuste systemen (geen data engineering) in een professionele en complexe omgeving. (Dit staat duidelijk en onderbouwd beschreven in het cv middels opsomming of arcering).

  • De kandidaat heeft ervaring met authenticatie- en autorisatiemechanismen (OAuth2, JWT, Azure AD).
  • De kandidaat heeft ervaring met NoSQL-databases (zoals Cosmos DB, MongoDB) en Graph databases (zoals Neo4j).
  • De kandidaat is bekend met SOLID principes en best-practices.

title: Strategic Client Research Manager, Expert Insights - ECS
description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the Team:

At Tegus by AlphaSense, we work directly with some of the world’s most well-respected institutional investors, corporations, and consultancies each day by providing real-time industry experts so they can make investment decisions faster. We are persistent, have a strong work ethic, and make decisions with our customer’s top of mind.

Join a dynamic and results oriented team, responsible for managing and growing a book of business within our Expert Call Services department.

About the Role:

The Strategic Client Research Manager is responsible for owning and driving client growth, with a clear mandate to expand expert call volume and deepen client engagement quarter over quarter.

This is a client-facing role suited for individuals who combine consultative problem-solving with a strong “hunter” mentality. You will proactively identify opportunities, challenge clients to think differently about how they leverage our services, and translate insights into tangible growth.

You will partner with a team of Analysts to execute against your strategy, but your primary focus is building, expanding, and retaining high-value client relationships.

Who You Are:

  • 3+ years of experience in client-facing, account management, operational, or consultative roles with a strong track record of driving client growth and engagement.
  • Strong commercial instincts: you naturally identify opportunities, push for more, and are uncomfortable with stagnant accounts.
  • A “hunter” mindset: proactive, persistent, and energized by uncovering and closing growth opportunities.
  • Experience working with, operating, or selling into institutional investors, private equity, hedge funds, banks, or broader financial services is a strong plus.
  • Highly strategic thinker who can connect client needs to scalable opportunities across a portfolio.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and ownership; you don’t wait for direction, you create it.
  • Strong communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive action.
  • Collaborative but assertive; you can partner cross-functionally while still pushing for outcomes.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

What You'll Do:

  • Own growth outcomes across your client portfolio, with clear accountability for increasing expert call volume, user adoption, and overall engagement.
  • Develop and execute account growth strategies, identifying whitespace, new use cases, and expansion opportunities within existing clients.
  • Proactively engage clients to uncover unmet needs, challenge assumptions, and position new ways of leveraging our platform.
  • Act as a commercial operator - identifying stalled accounts, reactivating dormant users, and driving urgency around underutilized opportunities.
  • Build senior-level relationships and influence key stakeholders through strategic conversations, not just service delivery.
  • Translate client objectives into actionable research strategies, guiding Analysts to deliver against high-impact priorities.
  • Identify and drive upsell opportunities by connecting client needs to broader platform capabilities.
  • Partner cross-functionally to remove friction, accelerate execution, and unlock growth across accounts.
  • Lead regular business reviews focused not just on performance, but on future growth opportunities and expansion strategy.

Total Cash Compensation Range: $90,000 - $108,000 (Base: $75,000 - $90,000 + 20% Bonus)

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

$75,000—$90,000 USD

title: AI Specialist
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Unity AI
description:
The opportunity

At Unity, we’re shaping the future of real-time 3D development by enabling creators to harness intelligent, autonomous systems. Our next-generation agentic AI - goal-directed, adaptive, and capable of reasoning and planning in dynamic environments - is transforming how games and simulations come to life.

We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to develop these foundational AI systems within the Unity engine, empowering creators to build better games. Your work will directly drive innovation, allowing developers and designers to integrate sophisticated AI behavior seamlessly into their worlds. You’ll also apply data-driven AI to game tuning, using gameplay data and simulation to help creators balance their games and improve the player experience.

This role is perfect for someone passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI, and agentic systems, and intelligent decision-making in complex, real-time environments.



What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, implement, and scale AI agents that assist in generating game code and executing goal-directed behaviors.
  • Define orchestration logic for single- and multi-agent systems
  • Develop reusable agentic frameworks - planning modules, memory systems, or policy adaptation layers - for creator extensibility.
  • Lead high-impact initiatives, including AI training for scalable behaviors, AI planning and goal inference frameworks, and agent memory and world modeling systems for persistent, believable behavior.
  • Build data-driven AI solutions for game tuning, using player telemetry, simulated playtesting, and automated playtesting agents to analyze and improve difficulty, pacing, game economy, and level balance.
  • Develop models that predict player engagement, frustration, and churn from gameplay data, and turn those predictions into concrete tuning recommendations for designers.
  • Develop recursive self-improvement in agentic systems.
  • Collaborate across internal and external teams to unlock innovative use cases in gaming, simulation, and interactive storytelling.
  • Contribute to the long-term vision and roadmap for Unity’s agentic AI offerings, ensuring modularity, usability, and performance across platforms.
  • Establish and champion best practices for model quality, simulation-based evaluation, and ML/AI safety within real-time systems.


What We're Looking For

  • Advanced degree (MS or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
  • 3+ years (1+ year with Ph.D.) of hands-on experience developing ML systems in production, ideally within real-time or interactive environments.
  • Experience with agentic systems, orchestration, or AI tool integration.
  • Strong background in one or more of the following: LLM training and evaluation, decision-making under uncertainty, AI planning, or agentic systems.
  • Experience applying data-driven methods such as player modeling, Bayesian optimization, simulation-based evaluation, or causal inference to tune and optimize complex systems.

title: Staff Engineer I, DevOps and Assurance
description:
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the number one consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

What makes us a great place to work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the number one consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

Who you'll work with

You will be part of a team building Bain's integrated suite of agentic decisioning tools that gives large organizations always-on intelligence across their most important growth decisions. The role sits at an intersection few organizations can offer: the analytical depth and client access of a top-tier consultancy, the technical ambition of a product company, and engineering work at the frontier of applied AI.

You will work inside Bain's standing product team, building software that helps the world's largest companies answer the questions that drive their business: where to invest, where to focus, and how to win. The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release.

The platform has two layers working together: an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient.

This is a startup inside an established company. You get genuine early-stage ownership and real influence over architecture and product direction, backed by Bain's global scale, client relationships, and leadership commitment; the pace of a startup with the runway of a global firm.

We are looking for DevOps engineers who see how to make the platform more reliable and resilient and bring that instinct to every sprint without being asked, and who are comfortable with problems that do not have a known answer. The work involves cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD for a multi-service platform, and observability problems with no off-the-shelf answer. Experience supporting agentic systems matters: how AI backend services and agentic workflows are deployed and monitored, evaluation pipelines, and the operational demands of production LLM workloads. This is applied AI in production, at scale, with real users depending on what you build. The field is moving quickly and the team is built to move with it, so the willingness to keep learning counts for as much as what you already know.

Where you'll fit within the team

The Senior DevOps Engineer owns the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and platform observability for the entire Growth AI Performance System platform: the foundation that every AI service, product interface, data pipeline, and agentic workflow runs on. This is a hands‑on platform engineering role: you will design, provision, and operate the infrastructure that real client deployments depend on, and you will own the CI/CD and release engineering processes that allow the engineering team to ship reliably and safely at pace.

DevOps for an AI platform has requirements that go beyond conventional software infrastructure. You will build observability tooling for agentic execution, tracing multi-step agent workflows, monitoring LLM API latency and cost, and surfacing the kinds of failures that only become visible when agents interact with real client data in production. This is a frontier area of platform engineering, and this role is expected to develop and own it.

You will work closely with the Security Engineer on infrastructure hardening, IAM, secrets management, and the security controls embedded in the CI/CD pipeline. You will work with the AI Engineering team on how AI services are deployed, scaled, and monitored. And you will own the local development environment and deployment documentation that keeps a globally distributed engineering team productive.

This role is based in Warsaw or Sao Paulo, working as part of a globally distributed platform team. You will mentor the g6 DevOps Engineer, providing technical direction without formal people‑management responsibility, set platform engineering standards, and be the senior technical voice on infrastructure architecture decisions.

What you'll do Infrastructure design and provisioning

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud-based distributed infrastructure for the Growth AI Performance System platform across Azure or AWS (including compute, networking, storage, managed databases, container orchestration, and API management), applying infrastructure-as-code practices throughout
  • Maintain full environment parity across development, staging, and production; ensure that the infrastructure engineers develop against is the infrastructure that client deployments run on, and that promotions between environments are automated, auditable, and reliable
  • Design infrastructure for the specific requirements of AI platform services: variable and spiky compute demand for LLM API calls, low‑latency requirements for agentic workflow steps, and the storage and retrieval patterns of knowledge graph and vector database workloads
  • Work with the Security Engineer to ensure infrastructure is hardened against the threat model relevant to an AI platform serving enterprise client data: network segmentation, IAM, secrets management, and security controls embedded in infrastructure-as-code
  • Stay current with cloud infrastructure tooling and AI infrastructure patterns; evaluate and adopt new platform capabilities that improve reliability, reduce cost, or enable engineering team velocity

CI/CD and release engineering

  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines for all Growth AI Performance System platform services (AI backend services, frontend applications, data pipelines, and infrastructure changes), embedding automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates that make deployment safe and fast
  • Own release engineering and deployment sequencing across the platform: coordinate releases across services with dependencies, manage rollback procedures, and ensure that platform and product module releases remain aligned in production and client‑facing environments
  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code for all platform environments using modern IaC tooling; ensure infrastructure changes are versioned, reviewed, and deployed through the same pipeline discipline as application code
  • Maintain the local development environment and developer tooling: onboarding documentation, local service configuration, and the developer experience infrastructure that keeps a globally distributed engineering team productive without infrastructure friction

Observability and AI platform monitoring

  • Implement observability across all platform services: structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting that gives the engineering team visibility into service health, API latency, pipeline reliability, and agentic execution behavior
  • Build specialized observability tooling for agentic AI workloads: tracing multi‑step agent execution, monitoring LLM API usage and cost, surfacing context passing failures, and detecting the kinds of agentic system failures that conventional monitoring does not capture
  • Monitor platform performance proactively: identify degradation before it affects live client deployments, diagnose root causes across distributed services, and drive the engineering improvements that resolve them
  • Define and maintain SLOs and alerting thresholds for all platform services; lead incident response for infrastructure and platform failures and conduct structured post‑incident reviews that improve platform reliability over time

About you Technical

  • Strong cloud infrastructure engineering experience across Azure or AWS: compute, networking, storage, managed databases, container orchestration, and API management at production scale
  • Deep proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tooling; experience provisioning and managing complex, multi‑environment cloud infrastructure through code rather than manual configuration
  • Strong CI/CD engineering experience: building and operating deployment pipelines for multi‑service platforms including AI backend services, frontend applications, and data pipelines
  • Practitioner‑level Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting containerized workloads in production environments with real latency and reliability requirements
  • Experience building observability for distributed systems: structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting using modern observability platforms; growing expertise in AI and agentic system observability
  • Experience with MLOps and AI infrastructure patterns: how LLM API services are deployed, scaled, and monitored; familiarity with the infrastructure requirements of vector databases, knowledge graph workloads, and agentic execution
  • Understanding of security and compliance requirements for cloud‑native platforms serving enterprise client data: IAM, secrets management, network security, and the DevSecOps practices that embed security into the deployment pipeline
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and scripting for infrastructure automation; disciplined use of version control for infrastructure codebases
  • Active use of AI‑assisted tooling to accelerate infrastructure development, diagnose issues faster, and develop AI infrastructure expertise as the platform scales

Experience

  • 5 or more years in DevOps, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering roles with hands‑on responsibility for production cloud infrastructure
  • Track record of owning CI/CD and infrastructure for a multi‑service platform end‑to‑end, not just contributing to pipelines, but designing, building, and operating them with real reliability requirements
  • Experience with MLOps or AI platform infrastructure (supporting LLM services, agentic systems, or ML pipelines in production) is a strong advantage
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and setting platform engineering standards within a team
  • Experience working in agile, cross‑functional product or consulting‑adjacent environments; strong troubleshooting and incident response skills
  • Based in or able to work from Warsaw or Sao Paulo near a Bain office

Education

  • Associate’s degree / bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
The Team

The Information Security Team is responsible for protecting the company’s infrastructure, intellectual property and digital assets. The team has a broad scope of responsibilities and tackles projects in different security verticals (IAM, GRC, Cloud Security, Application Security, Detection and Response, etc.)

The Security Operations capabilities will be continuously improved so there is a requirement to build new and improve existing capabilities, not just operate and run the existing tools, processes and services.


The Role

The Security Operations Senior Engineer is a senior in-house position within Brevan Howard’s hybrid SOC, accountable for the end-to-end management of security incidents, proactive threat hunting, and the ongoing maturity of the firm’s Security Operations Programme. Operating across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud environments, the engineer is expected to bring both analytical depth and technical breadth — including cloud security (AWS/GCP), scripting, and IaC tooling — to a high-trust, low-latency trading environment.


The role focuses on independent, high-judgement investigation of escalated threats across endpoint, cloud, and identity attack surfaces. They are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, own escalated cases, and contribute directly to improving the organisation’s detection and response capabilities in a demanding, high-performance, low-latency regulated financial environment. Where an MSP or more junior SOC analyst is involved, they must collaborate effectively and provide appropriate feedback for improvement.


  • Lead triage, investigation, and response for incidents across trading infrastructure, endpoints, cloud environments (AWS/GCP), and identity platforms
  • Own complex incident response end-to-end: scoping, containment, forensic analysis, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review
  • Perform advanced threat analysis and multi-source correlation across SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and cloud telemetry to identify sophisticated attack patterns
  • Design, build, and continuously tune detection rules, use cases, and SOAR playbooks; manage rule lifecycle via version-controlled repositories (GitHub/Terraform)
  • Own and drive vulnerability management programme outcomes, including prioritisation, remediation tracking, and integration with threat intelligence
  • Author and maintain advanced incident response playbooks, threat models, and response procedures; lead tabletop exercises where required
  • Conduct deep-dive log analysis and forensic investigation across endpoint, cloud (AWS/GCP), application, and network telemetry
  • Lead proactive threat hunting initiatives using hypothesis-driven methodologies, leveraging EDR, SIEM, and threat intelligence feeds
  • Produce high-quality incident reports, executive-level summaries, and lessons-learned documentation suitable for senior stakeholders
  • Develop, maintain, operate and manage relevant security services and tools

Work Experience


Essential

  • Proven hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Exabeam) including query development, dashboarding, and alert tuning
  • Detection engineering experience: authoring, testing, and lifecycle management of detection logic across SIEM and EDR platforms
  • Experience detecting and investigating insider threats, abnormal user behaviour, and identity-based attacks using UEBA and related tooling
  • Significant experience owning escalated security incident response end-to-end: triage, scoping, containment, forensic analysis, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review
  • Background in an in-house SOC or dedicated incident response function at Tier 2 or above; experience on the client side rather than MSSP preferred

Desirable

  • Background in financial services, trading firms, or other high-value, low-latency data environments
  • Experience with data loss prevention (DLP), information protection controls, and insider risk programmes
  • Experience working in small, high-trust security teams
  • Led or contributed to structured threat hunting programmes using hypothesis-driven or TTP-based methodologies (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK)

Technical Skills


Essential


  • Strong scripting and automation capability (Python, PowerShell) for rapid response, tooling development, and workflow automation via SOAR
  • Deep alert investigation and incident response capability; comfortable leading multi-stream investigations autonomously
  • Advanced EDR proficiency (e.g. CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Defender for Endpoint) including policy management, telemetry analysis, and response actions
  • Strong understanding of Windows internals, Entra ID, and enterprise security architecture including AD, Group Policy, and identity attack paths
  • Solid grounding in endpoint and identity-focused security: EDR, IAM, MFA, PAM, and privileged access controls
  • Hands-on cloud security experience across AWS and/or GCP: understanding of cloud-native logging, IAM, security services (e.g. GuardDuty, Security Command Center), and attack patterns specific to cloud workloads
  • Working knowledge of network security fundamentals; ability to analyse packet captures, NetFlow, and proxy logs as part of broader investigations
  • Practical experience consuming and applying threat intelligence (STIX/TAXII, TIPs, OSINT) to enrich investigations and inform detection logic
  • Hands-on experience with vulnerability management solutions (e.g. Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7); able to own prioritisation, remediation tracking, and risk reporting

Desirable


  • Experience building and operating SOAR playbooks and automation workflows (e.g. Palo Alto XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Tines)
  • CSPM experience (e.g. Wiz, Prisma Cloud, AWS Security Hub) including misconfiguration detection and cloud posture remediation
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management data into SIEM or SOAR workflows for automated prioritisation and remediation tracking
  • Familiarity with offensive security techniques and penetration testing outputs; able to contextualise findings and drive remediation prioritisation
  • Exposure to Red/Purple Team activity and structured adversary emulation exercises
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and version control tooling (Terraform, GitHub) to manage and deploy security configurations at scale

Key Competencies


Essential


  • High signal-to-noise judgement; able to rapidly prioritise and contextualise alerts without over-escalating or under-triaging
  • High degree of discretion and data sensitivity awareness, commensurate with operating in a regulated financial services environment
  • Clear, concise communication under pressure; able to produce executive-level incident summaries as well as technical deep-dives for engineering peers
  • Pragmatic, risk-based approach to security decision-making; understands the trade-offs between security posture and business continuity in a trading environment
  • Comfortable operating autonomously on escalated cases with minimal process overhead; self-directing and outcome-focused
  • Strong collaborative instinct; willing to mentor junior analysts and contribute to broader team capability, whilst maintaining individual delivery at senior level

title: Go-To-Market Analyst
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Innovations Manager in Medical Devices
description:
Position Details

  • Full-Time | Fixed term until May 2031
  • Professional HEO8 | $116,349 - $128,806
  • Location: Tonsley / Kaurna Country
  • View Position Description

About the Role

As the Innovations Manager, you will be the key point of contact for clients engaging with FORGE Medical Devices, guiding innovators from initial enquiry through to project delivery. This role combines client relationship management, commercial assessment and project management to help progress promising medical device innovations, while contributing to the continued growth and development of the FORGE Medical Devices program.


In this role, you will:

  • Manage client enquiries and guide innovators through the FORGE Medical Devices process, connecting them with relevant expertise and capabilities.
  • Assess the commercial viability of innovations and prepare detailed commercial and market analysis to support project and funding decisions.
  • Manage selected projects from assessment through to completion, working collaboratively with clients, research staff and key stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships while contributing to the strategic development, growth and promotion of FORGE Medical Devices.

This position makes a significant contribution to the University’s strategic plan to changing 10 million lives, Every One Matters, by 2035 through directly contributing to Research that Matters and strengthening Industry and Enterprise Partnerships to help transform promising medical device innovations into real-world solutions.

About You

You are an experienced and commercially minded professional with a background in medical technologies, research commercialisation or a related field. You combine strong analytical and project management skills with the ability to build effective relationships across industry, government and university environments. With excellent communication skills and sound judgement, you are comfortable working independently while collaborating with a diverse range of stakeholders to progress innovative ideas.


To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate:

  • Experience in the research and commercialisation of medical technologies or a related field, supported by relevant qualifications and/or equivalent experience.
  • Strong commercial and strategic analysis skills, including experience preparing market analysis, commercial reports and/or business plans.
  • Highly developed stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with internal and external partners, including senior leaders.
  • Well-developed project management and organisational skills, with strong attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to manage competing priorities.

FORGE Medical Devices

FORGE Medical Devices is a Flinders University initiative helping transform promising medical device ideas into real-world solutions. Building on nearly two decades of experience through the Medical Device Partnering Program (MDPP), FORGE brings together researchers, clinicians, industry, manufacturers and end-users to accelerate innovation and support the development of technologies with commercial and clinical potential.


Delivered through Flinders Factory of the Future, FORGE provides a connected pathway for innovators and emerging companies—from early-stage concept validation through to product development, manufacturing readiness, quality systems, regulatory planning and trial-ready preparation. Through its programs, FORGE is helping great ideas become products that improve lives and deliver meaningful impact.


Life at Flinders

They say know your place. We say you've found it right here.


Flinders University was founded on the belief that learning should open minds, celebrate individuality and give people the freedom to pursue their own point of view. That spirit lives on in our community of thinkers, doers and changemakers who challenge convention, and each other, to shape what comes next.


Rising to a challenge is nothing new for Flinders. During our first 60 years, we’ve navigated revolutionary changes in social and cultural norms, and have responded to transformative economic, environmental and technological developments. Through it all, we’ve continued to deliver for our students and community, innovating in learning and research to prepare graduates for the changing world they help create.


Reaching beyond the limits of buildings, borders, and backgrounds, ours is an inclusive culture that believes absolutely in equality and opportunity for all. We don't just accommodate differences; we embrace and celebrate them.


So, why work at Flinders?

  • 17% Superannuation + salary packaging options
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Awarded the AHEIA Higher Education Award for Workplace Culture Excellence due to our commitment to wellbeing through our Thriving@Flinders staff wellbeing program
  • Wide range of professional development activities and services, including exclusive staff study offers
  • We embrace diversity and promote equity and inclusion for all students and staff, as shown through our three SAGE Cygnet Awards.
  • Vibrant campus life and amenities including on campus health care services, gym and childcare centre (Bedford Park, South Australia).
  • Recognised as a Veteran Employer of Choice

Our Commitment to Reconciliation and Indigenous Employment

Flinders University is proud to be an organisation that is committed to our Reconciliation Action Plan and Indigenous Workforce Strategy. Our vision is to be a preferred employer for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples. We are committed to progressing Indigenous advancement in education, research, employment, and wellbeing, and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples for all Flinders vacancies.


  • Please see here for our Reconciliation Action Plan
  • Please see here for our Indigenous Workforce Strategy

The contract of Employment is conditional upon the receipt of these completed compliance checks. A disclosable outcome will not automatically disqualify a candidate from consideration. Each case will be assessed on its individual merits and relevance to the inherent requirements of the role.


How to Apply and Information

You are required to submit a CV, along with a cover letter as a separate document, telling us a little about yourself, and why you feel you are suited to this role.

30 Nov 2026
