title: NOC Manager
description:
What we’re all about:

Any company can tell you about how they are a multi award winning, market leading business and yes, we are both of those things in the world of IoT connectivity! But we’re more than that. 🌍✨ Our mission? To make IoT management a breeze for any device, anywhere. With over 10 million IoT subscriptions active in 165 countries and direct partnerships with 50 mobile networks, we connect you to more than 750 networks worldwide, delivering unmatched value across the IoT connectivity chain.

Innovation is in our DNA, and we have an insatiable hunger to ‘wow’! 🚀 While we may not always get it right, our drive to collaborate, innovate, and achieve top-notch customer satisfaction never wavers. We offer industry expertise, stellar service support, and the most flexible, resilient, and secure connectivity solutions on the market. Our expertise spans across various sectors, including industry, agriculture, healthcare, security, transport, utilities, and smart cities.

IoT… a fancy acronym or a secret code?

The Internet of Things (IoT) is like the magical glue that keeps the world connected! 🌐✨ From ordering your favourite takeaway to the ANPR technology that helps you find a parking spot, IoT is everywhere—even if you don’t realize it. At Wireless Logic, we provide cutting-edge connectivity solutions and technologies to ensure a vast array of devices stay seamlessly connected.

About the role
We are building a new 24x7 Network Operations Centre in Bucharest from the ground up, and we need a NOC Manager to lead it.

You will be the single operational contact for production monitoring, first response, escalation and major incident coordination. You will build the team, define how it works and make it better every month.

What you will do

  • Build and lead a team of Senior NOC Engineers, including recruitment, onboarding, coaching and training
  • Design the NOC operating model: shift rotas, escalation paths, runbooks, handovers and support boundaries
  • Act as senior escalation for P0/P1 incidents, supporting incident command without taking over from the technical teams
  • Cut alert noise and improve monitoring across PRTG, Grafana and platform tools
  • Own NOC performance reporting and run regular service reviews
  • Set the criteria that new services must meet before the NOC agrees to support them
  • Work with L2, L3, Engineering, Service Operations and suppliers

What you will bring

  • Experience leading a 24x7 NOC, network operations or production support team
  • Proof that you have personally designed or improved processes such as runbooks, escalation paths or ITSM workflows, ideally with measurable results
  • Experience building or significantly changing an operating model, team or monitoring setup
  • Strong incident, problem and change management, plus SLA management
  • Working knowledge of monitoring tools such as PRTG and Grafana, and ITSM tools such as Zendesk
  • Broad understanding of IP networking, mobile connectivity, infrastructure, virtualisation, operating systems and databases
  • Proven major incident leadership, with clear communication to engineers, suppliers and senior stakeholders
  • ITIL Foundation or equivalent practical experience
  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Nice to have

  • Experience leading teams across countries or time zones
  • Advanced ITIL, SIAM, SRE, networking or infrastructure certifications

We know the world has changed, and we want to offer our employees the chance to collaborate at our unique office spaces, whilst enjoying the convenience of working from home. We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. You'll find out more about what this means for this role during the recruitment process, but we are currently excited to have our employees experience our office culture as much as possible.

Wireless Logic Group unites and brings people together. We accomplish this when we lead with a lens of diversity, equity, and inclusion in everything we do. As a global company that drives culture we aim to reflect the world’s diverse voices both internally and externally to ensure success in our mission.

By applying for this role, you are consenting for us to hold and process your data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulations. If you have any questions or wish to exercise your right to access, erase or restrict the holding or processing of your data please contact us (recruitment@wirelesslogic.com) and we will respond to your query as soon as possible.

title: Principal / Staff Engineer, Global Quality Package Design and Development Quality Assurance
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

The Staff or Principal Engineer leads quality and reliability for advanced packaging technologies, including HBM, 2.5D/3D integration, and wafer-level packaging. The role partners across engineering and customer-facing teams to identify package reliability risks, define qualification strategies, resolve complex quality issues, and support technology release decisions. At the Principal level, the role provides broader technical leadership and influences package quality strategy.


Main Responsibilities

  • Lead technical risk assessments and New, Unique, Different, Difficult (NUDD) analyses for new package designs, materials, processes, and design rules; define and drive risk-mitigation actions.
  • Develop holistic package qualification and characterization strategies covering package-level and board-level reliability, sampling, acceleration models, and relevant customer requirements.
  • Coordinate qualification execution across Technology Development, Product Engineering, Packaging, Quality, and other stakeholders; analyze results and identify gaps requiring additional learning.
  • Provide technical recommendations for release of new package technologies based on test evidence, failure-mechanism understanding, and residual risk assessment.
  • Lead or support root cause investigations for package-related quality and reliability issues and drive effective corrective and preventive actions using structured problem-solving methods.
  • Evaluate chip-package interaction risks, including thermomechanical and hygroscopic stress effects, material interactions, assembly processes, and board-level use conditions.
  • Collaborate with customer-facing teams to develop and present accurate technical content for customer qualifications, inquiries, and issue resolution.

Other Responsibilities

  • Mentor engineers and strengthen technical capability in package quality, reliability, risk assessment, and failure analysis.
  • Document qualification strategies, technical decisions, investigation results, and lessons learned for reuse in future technology generations.
  • Contribute to technical innovation through new methodologies, internal or external publications, patents, and technical forums, where applicable.
  • Provide clear program status, technical risk, and release-readiness updates to engineering and leadership stakeholders.

AI Responsibilities

  • Integrate AI-assisted tools and insights into engineering work to improve analysis efficiency, quality, problem solving, and productivity, while exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements.
  • Identify, test, and share AI-enabled enhancements within the role’s scope to support continuous improvement in qualification planning, data analysis, technical documentation, and knowledge reuse.

Minimum Qualifications / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or a related field.
  • Over 5 years of relevant experience in semiconductor package design, manufacturing, quality, or reliability.
  • Experience with advanced packaging technologies, such as HBM, 2.5D/3D integration, wafer-level packaging, or similar package architectures.

Technical Skills

  • Experience in package and board-level reliability testing, qualification planning, and reliability assessment.
  • Good understanding of chip-package interactions, material behavior, and package reliability failure mechanisms.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor packaging, assembly processes, PCB assemblies, and advanced packaging integration.
  • Proficiency in quality and problem-solving methods, including SPC, FMEA, 8D, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Ability to interpret reliability and characterization data and translate technical evidence into risk assessments and technology release recommendations.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical problem solving and disciplined, evidence-based decision making.
  • Ability to lead through influence and collaborate effectively across global, cross-functional engineering and customer-facing teams.
  • Clear written and verbal technical communication skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail, and mentor other engineers.

Highly Desirable / Preferred

  • Experience developing fundamental understanding of package failure mechanisms and applying learning across technology generations.
  • Record of technical innovation through methodologies, publications, patents, or contributions to technical forums.

Embody Micron’s Core Values

  • People - Respect, develop and empower others
  • Innovation - Drive continuous improvement and breakthrough thinking
  • Tenacity - Show grit and determination
  • Collaboration - Build trust and foster teamwork
  • Customer Focus - Deliver excellence and value
  • Speed - Act with purpose and set the pace

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers

title: Interior Designer
description:

title: Talent Specialist
description:
About this role

As Talent Specialist, you will take ownership of the end-to-end recruitment process, connecting the right people with opportunities where they can contribute, grow and thrive. From understanding the hiring need to securing an accepted offer, you will ensure every step is well managed, fair and people focused.


You will combine a passion for people with strong execution, sound judgement and attention to detail, helping us make informed hiring decisions while ensuring every applicant feels respected and valued.


This position will be based at Hangar 2, Kempton Park, Johannesburg and will report to the Group Head of People.


About the Opportunity

Global Airways brings together diverse teams across aircraft maintenance, scheduled airline operations and commercial ACMI with over 600 staff members across multiple geographies.


Working closely with hiring managers, you will manage recruitment across the business and build talent pipelines that support our current needs and future growth. You will be accountable for keeping recruitment moving within agreed service levels, coordinating everyone involved and proactively resolving any delays. Hiring managers retain responsibility for the final hiring decision, supported by your guidance and a consistent, evidence-based selection process.


In this role you’ll

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, clarify role requirements and agree selection criteria, recruitment plans and timelines. Coordinate job profiles, job grading and requisitions, ensuring the necessary approvals are in place before recruitment begins.
  • Develop engaging job adverts that reflect our culture and opportunities. Use advertising, direct sourcing, referrals and talent networks to attract diverse, suitably qualified applicants, while building pipelines for recurring and scarce-skill roles.
  • Together with the hiring manager, screen applications and conduct initial screening calls against agreed criteria. Develop competency-based interview questions, recruitment scorecards, case studies and coordinate assessments, and guide selection panel discussions to support fair, consistent and informed decisions.
  • Create a welcoming, professional experience from first contact to outcome. Keep applicants informed, prepare them for each stage and communicate decisions with care, including timely feedback to unsuccessful applicants.
  • Manage vacancies against agreed recruitment service levels, maintaining clear visibility of progress, responsibilities and next steps. Work closely with the People Operations Coordinator on interview scheduling, application forms, consent documentation and background screening administration, following through to ensure completion.
  • Conduct employment references and coordinate role-appropriate background screening with the relevant team members. Ensure applicant consent, required approvals and offer conditions are properly managed, records are complete, and concerns are escalated before appointments are finalised.
  • Coordinate approval to offer and contract requests, communicate offers and manage acceptance within agreed timelines. Acknowledge acceptance, notify the hiring manager and initiate a clear handover into onboarding. Ensure outstanding screening requirements are tracked, unsuccessful applicants are informed and vacancies are closed.
  • Maintain accurate recruitment records and data in BambooHR (HRIS) and relevant tracking systems. Report on vacancy progress, turnaround times, sourcing effectiveness and bottlenecks, using insights and feedback to improve recruitment delivery and the applicant experience.


Key Requirements


Education

  • A diploma or degree in Human Resources, Industrial Psychology or a related field is advantageous.


Experience

  • Demonstrated experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment across multiple disciplines, across junior to senior levels.
  • Hands-on experience in direct sourcing, screening, competency-based interviewing, reference checking and offer management.
  • Experience partnering with hiring managers and coordinating recruitment stakeholders.
  • Experience recruiting for technical and operational roles in aviation.


Knowledge & Skills

title: Audience Growth Engineer
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Senior Engineer, DevOps and Assurance
description:
What makes us a great place to work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the number one consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

Who you'll work with

You will be part of a team building Bain's integrated suite of agentic decisioning tools that gives large organizations always-on intelligence across their most important growth decisions. The role sits at an intersection few organizations can offer: the analytical depth and client access of a top-tier consultancy, the technical ambition of a product company, and engineering work at the frontier of applied AI.

You will work inside Bain's standing product team, building software that helps the world's largest companies answer the questions that drive their business: where to invest, where to focus, and how to win. The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release.

The platform has two layers working together: an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient.

This is a startup inside an established company. You get genuine early-stage ownership and real influence over architecture and product direction, backed by Bain's global scale, client relationships, and leadership commitment; the pace of a startup with the runway of a global firm.

We are looking for DevOps engineers who see how to make the platform more reliable and resilient and bring that instinct to every sprint without being asked, and who are comfortable with problems that do not have a known answer. The work involves cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD for a multi-service platform, and deployment problems with no off-the-shelf answer.

Experience supporting agentic systems matters: how AI backend services are deployed and monitored, evaluation pipelines, and the operational demands of production LLM workloads. This is applied AI in production, at scale, with real users depending on what you build. The field is moving quickly and the team is built to move with it, so the willingness to keep learning counts for as much as what you already know.

Where you'll fit within the team

The DevOps Engineer works directly under the DevOps Engineering Senior Manager, within the Growth AI Performance System Platform and Security team, contributing to the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability systems that the entire platform runs on. This is a hands-on implementation role: you will build and maintain the infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and developer tooling that the engineering team depends on, working under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer and developing progressively more ownership as you grow.

You will get broad exposure to the full platform stack: from the infrastructure that hosts AI services and data pipelines through to the deployment workflows that get product changes into the hands of real users on live engagements. This cross-cutting view makes it an excellent role for an engineer who wants to develop deep expertise in cloud-native platform engineering and AI infrastructure in a fast-moving, production environment.

You will work across the platform and product modules focused on marketing ROI, brand, and pricing strategy, contributing to the infrastructure and deployment systems that keep those modules running reliably for enterprise clients. When something goes wrong in a live client deployment, the DevOps team is in the room.

This role is based in Warsaw or Sao Paulo, working as part of a globally distributed platform team alongside the Senior DevOps Engineer. You will develop the infrastructure engineering skills and platform knowledge to take on increasing ownership over time, with a clear path toward the Senior DevOps Engineer role.

What you'll do

Infrastructure and environment management

  • Contribute to the provisioning and management of cloud infrastructure for the Growth AI Performance System platform on Azure or AWS (including compute, networking, storage, and managed services), using infrastructure-as-code practices under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer
  • Support the maintenance of environment parity across development, staging, and production; contribute to environment provisioning, configuration management, and the automation that keeps environments consistent and reliable
  • Build and maintain infrastructure automation scripts and configuration management tooling; learn and apply infrastructure-as-code practices to all infrastructure changes, ensuring changes are versioned, reviewed, and deployed through code
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of infrastructure for AI platform workloads: container orchestration, API management, and the storage and compute patterns that LLM services and agentic workflows require

CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipeline components for Growth AI Performance System platform services (including AI backend services, frontend applications, and data pipelines), implementing automated testing steps, deployment stages, and quality gates under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer
  • Maintain the local development environment and developer onboarding tooling; keep documentation current, resolve developer environment issues quickly, and contribute to the developer experience improvements that keep a distributed engineering team productive
  • Support release engineering operations: contribute to deployment coordination, monitor deployments in progress, and participate in rollback and incident response procedures
  • Learn and develop fluency with the full CI/CD toolchain and deployment workflow; take on progressively more ownership of specific pipeline areas as your expertise grows

Observability, monitoring and incident support

  • Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for platform services: set up structured logging, metrics collection, and alerting thresholds that give the engineering team visibility into service health and surface issues before they affect live client deployments
  • Contribute to the build of AI and agentic observability tooling under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer: implementing tracing for agentic execution, monitoring LLM API usage and latency, and structured logging for multi-step agent workflows
  • Support incident response for infrastructure and platform failures: monitor alerts, participate in diagnosis, contribute to remediation, and document findings in a form that supports post-incident review and platform improvement
  • Develop familiarity with the platform's SLOs, alerting thresholds, and reliability standards; learn to read platform health dashboards accurately and understand what degradation signals require escalation

About you

Technical

  • Solid foundation in cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS: compute, networking, storage, and managed services; growing proficiency with provisioning and managing cloud resources through infrastructure-as-code
  • Working experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation: able to build, maintain, and debug pipeline stages including automated testing, artifact management, and deployment steps
  • Proficiency with Docker and containerized deployments; working familiarity with Kubernetes-based orchestration in a production environment
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and scripting (Python and Bash) for infrastructure automation tasks; disciplined use of version control for infrastructure codebases
  • Working knowledge of monitoring and alerting tooling: able to set up structured logging, configure metrics collection, and create alerting rules that surface meaningful signals
  • Exposure to or genuine interest in MLOps and AI infrastructure patterns, how LLM services are deployed and monitored, and what the infrastructure requirements of agentic systems look like in production
  • Understanding of security fundamentals for cloud-native infrastructure: IAM, secrets management, network security, and the DevSecOps practices that embed security into deployment workflows
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools to accelerate infrastructure work, diagnose issues faster, and develop AI infrastructure skills

Experience

  • 3 or more years in DevOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering roles with hands‑on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure
  • Track record of contributing to production infrastructure and deployment systems that real services and users depend on, not just development or test environments
  • Experience with or strong interest in MLOps and AI infrastructure; exposure to LLM service deployment, agentic system infrastructure, or vector database workloads is a strong advantage
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams; strong troubleshooting skills and comfort debugging infrastructure issues across distributed systems
  • Based in or able to work from Warsaw or Sao Paulo near a Bain office

Education

  • Associate’s degree / bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

description:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Description: Evaluates commercial loan requests by reviewing applicants' credit histories and analyzing financial statements in order to approve or deny loan applications.

What you will do:

•Reviews the credit history, profitability and liquidity of clients to assess the risk level involved in credit extension or money lending.

•Consults with customers to verify financial and credit transactions; responds to customer inquiries and resolves customer complaints.

•Communicates with credit associations and other relevant authorities about the credit history of customers.

•Analyzes financial data to determine customers' risk profile for commercial loans; recommends approval or denial of loan applications.

What you will have:

Finance and Accounting: Knowledge of finance and accounting practices, financial analysis, and reporting; ability to apply finance knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.

Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Credit Analysis and Verification: Knowledge of credit analysis and verification; ability to utilize tools and techniques to determine the credit-worthiness of an applicant.

Financial Statement Analysis: Knowledge of financial statement and balance sheet; ability to analyze financial statement data and determine the credit-worthiness of a business enterprise.

Loan Origination: Knowledge of the skills, methods and technologies used to process new loan applications; ability to perform loan origination activities while adhering to established policies and procedures.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience in Credit.
  • Basic English.

Top candidates will also have:

This is a hybrid role based in our Raleigh office. Our hybrid model means you’ll work from the office at least two days each week. This setup helps us stay connected, work more closely together, and keep making progress as a team.

title: Head of Insight, Data & Technology (media agency)
description:
We're looking for a senior Insight, Data & Technology leader to join a leading media agency in the Middle East.

This is an opportunity for someone who understands how data, consumer insight, analytics and technology come together to deliver smarter media strategies and better business outcomes for clients.

We're not looking for someone who simply produces reports or builds dashboards. We want someone who can see the bigger picture, challenge conventional thinking and turn complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.

You'll work closely with senior agency leadership, strategy, planning, investment and client teams to build a stronger, more connected insight and data offering across the business.

It's a role that combines strategic thinking, technical understanding, commercial awareness and strong leadership.

What You'll Be Doing

Insight & Strategy

  • Lead the agency's insight, data and analytics capabilities, ensuring they play a central role in how the business develops strategies and delivers work for clients.
  • Turn consumer, market, media and business data into meaningful insights that influence strategic decisions.
  • Work closely with strategy and planning teams to identify audience opportunities, understand consumer behaviour and develop more effective communications strategies.
  • Challenge assumptions, ask the right questions and bring fresh thinking to client challenges.
  • Help clients understand not just what their data is telling them, but what they should actually do with it.

Data, Analytics & Measurement

  • Develop and strengthen the agency's approach to measurement, marketing effectiveness and advanced analytics.
  • Lead thinking around attribution, marketing mix modelling, audience segmentation, campaign effectiveness and performance optimisation.
  • Bring together multiple data sources to provide a clearer understanding of consumer behaviour and media performance.
  • Establish consistent measurement frameworks that connect media investment to tangible business outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, automation and data accessibility across the agency.

Technology & Innovation

  • Help shape the agency's data and technology roadmap, identifying platforms, tools and solutions that improve the quality and effectiveness of its work.
  • Understand the evolving marketing technology landscape, including AI, automation, data platforms and emerging analytics capabilities.
  • Work with internal teams and external technology partners to develop practical, scalable solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to make better use of first-party data, audience intelligence and connected technology.
  • Ensure technology is being used to solve real business problems rather than simply adding complexity.

Clients & Commercial Leadership

  • Build strong relationships with senior clients, becoming a trusted advisor on insight, data and technology.
  • Translate complex technical subjects into clear, commercially relevant conversations.
  • Play an active role in new business pitches, helping demonstrate the agency's capabilities and strategic thinking.
  • Identify opportunities to develop new services, strengthen existing client relationships and create additional commercial value.
  • Work collaboratively across agency disciplines to ensure data and insight are embedded in the wider client offering.

People & Leadership

  • Lead, develop and inspire a team of insight, data and analytics specialists.
  • Build a collaborative culture where technical expertise and strategic thinking work together.
  • Identify capability gaps and help develop the skills, tools and resources needed for future growth.
  • Work closely with regional and global teams to share knowledge, best practices and new approaches.
  • Be a visible leader within the agency, someone who can influence people beyond their immediate team.
What We're Looking For
  • Significant experience in insight, data, analytics or marketing technology, ideally within a media agency, holding company, marketing consultancy or related business.
  • A strong understanding of the media landscape, including how data and technology influence planning, activation, measurement and effectiveness.
  • Experience leading teams and developing data, analytics or insight capabilities.
  • A proven ability to work with senior clients and translate complex information into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Strong knowledge of audience intelligence, measurement frameworks, marketing effectiveness and data-driven decision-making.
  • A good understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem, including analytics platforms, data management, AI and automation.
  • Commercial awareness, with the ability to identify opportunities that deliver value for clients and the agency.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to challenge and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working across multiple clients, sectors or markets would be advantageous.
  • Experience in the Middle East would be beneficial, although we're equally interested in people who can bring relevant experience and fresh thinking from other markets.
The Person

We're looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded and comfortable operating at a senior level.

Someone who understands the technical side of data and analytics but doesn't get lost in it.

You should be equally comfortable discussing measurement frameworks with specialists, developing strategic recommendations with planners and presenting business opportunities to a CMO.

You'll need to be collaborative, confident and proactive, with the ability to build relationships across different teams and disciplines.

Most importantly, we want someone who can make insight, data and technology a genuine competitive advantage for the business.

Why This Role?

This is a chance to play a significant role in shaping how a leading media agency approaches insight, data and technology in one of the industry's most dynamic regions.

You'll have the opportunity to influence senior leadership, work with major clients, develop talent and help build capabilities that make a real difference.

We're interested in people who want to lead, build and make an impact, rather than simply maintain what's already there.

title: VP/SVP, Electrophysiology (EP) Catheter Manufacturing
description:
Pulse Biosciences (Nasdaq: PLSE): Join the Future of Bioelectric Medicine

Pulse Biosciences is a novel bioelectric medicine company committed to health innovation that has the potential to improve the quality of life for patients. The Company’s proprietary CellFX® nsPFA™ (nanosecond Pulsed Field Ablation) technology delivers nanosecond pulses of electrical energy to non-thermally ablate cells while sparing adjacent noncellular tissue.

The Company is actively pursuing the development of its CellFX nsPFA technology for use in the surgical treatment of atrial fibrillation and percutaneously in a select few other markets where it could have a profound positive impact on healthcare for both patients and providers. Visit pulsebiosciences.com to learn more.

Why Join Us?

At Pulse Biosciences, we are driven by purpose and innovation.

  • Our Mission: To build a viable Company that designs, produces, and commercializes nano-pulse technology to improve and extend the lives of patients. To solve the needs of patients, physicians, and healthcare providers with high quality and high reliability products and services, developed in accordance with rigorous scientific, engineering, and clinical standards. We exist to make a positive difference in the lives of patients, physicians, healthcare providers, shareholders and our Pulse Biosciences team members.
  • Our Culture: A community of creative, forward-thinking individuals tackling challenges with ingenuity and collaboration.
  • Our Commitment: Hiring the best and brightest minds to advance our world-class organization.

What You Will Experience:

  • Culture and Purpose - Purposeful and rewarding work collaborating with bright and curious minds brings us together!
  • Innovative Environment - An environment that fosters innovation to take products from concept to human use quickly!
  • Growth Opportunities - Learning culture focusing on professional and personal growth and development that you can only get in a startup-like environment!
  • Comprehensive Benefits - A variety of health insurance plans and supplemental insurance options, and 401k retirement savings plan.
  • Ownership and Rewards - Stock options awards and Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) to share in our success.
  • Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid time off, paid holidays, flexible work schedule and wellness program, including onsite gym and mindfulness classes.
  • Diversity & Inclusion - A commitment to providing a respectful work environment to our diverse workforce.

About the Role

The Vice President/Senior Vice President of Electrophysiology (EP) Catheter Manufacturing will lead the development, production transition, and global scale-up of a next-generation EP catheter manufacturing organization. This executive leader will be responsible for defining and executing the end-to-end manufacturing strategy, building a high-performing team, and ensuring successful commercialization through scalable, cost-effective, and reliable manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cardiac catheter or EP device manufacturing, demonstrated success scaling production from launch to high-volume commercialization, and extensive experience managing contract manufacturers and manufacturing transfers across global regions.

To Make an Impact, You Will:

  • Develop and execute the long-term manufacturing strategy for EP catheter products from product launch through high-volume commercialization.
  • Build, lead, and mentor a world-class manufacturing, operations, supply chain, and quality organization.
  • Serve as the executive leader responsible for manufacturing readiness, production scale-up, operational excellence, and capacity planning.
  • Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, and Commercial teams to support product development and market expansion.
  • Define and implement a manufacturing scale-up roadmap supporting growth from approximately 50,000 units annually to 500,000+ units annually.
  • Evaluate, establish, and optimize the appropriate manufacturing model, including:
    • Strategic partnerships with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs)
    • Hybrid manufacturing approaches
    • Internal manufacturing capabilities
  • Drive manufacturing process development, validation, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, yield, and quality.
  • Select, qualify, and manage global contract manufacturing partners.
  • Establish robust supplier and supply chain strategies to support commercial growth and business continuity.
  • Build and qualify a scalable supply network for critical components, materials, and assemblies.
  • Negotiate and manage key manufacturing and supplier relationships to achieve operational, quality, and cost objectives.
  • Own product cost strategy and achieve planned reductions in COGS from launch pricing to mature commercial targets.
  • Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Develop manufacturing KPIs and operating metrics to ensure predictable execution and performance.
  • Lead manufacturing transfers and site expansions, including transfers between domestic and international manufacturing locations.
  • Establish manufacturing capabilities that support global commercialization requirements while maintaining regulatory compliance and product quality.
  • Ensure successful technology transfer, process validation, and operational readiness at receiving sites.

To Excel, You Will Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in medical device manufacturing and operations.
  • Experience at the Vice President or Senior Vice President level leading manufacturing organizations.
  • Proven success scaling complex catheter-based or electrophysiology medical device manufacturing from development through high-volume commercialization.
  • Demonstrated expertise in cardiac catheter, EP catheter, or related interventional medical device manufacturing.
  • Direct experience with electrophysiology (EP) catheters, cardiac mapping catheters, ablation catheters, or related cardiovascular devices.
  • Experience scaling manufacturing through multiple commercialization phases, including launch, growth, and mature production.
  • Track record of delivering substantial COGS reductions through process optimization, automation, and supply chain strategy.

title: AI Strategist Analyst
description:

AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media () focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.

  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.

  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

We need a strategic finance leader who can turn a lean finance team into a public-company-grade FP&A function. You will own planning, forecasting, and performance management, and you will be a central voice in how FORT allocates capital and drives its financial story.
This is not a maintain-the-model role. You will design the operating cadence, build the team, select the FPA tools, and partner with the CFO and executive team on the de-SPAC transaction and life after listing: long-term planning, guidance, and earnings.
Key responsibilities
Strategic planning and business partnership
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the CFO, CEO, and executive team on growth strategy, pricing, product investment, and capital allocation.
  • Lead the long-range plan (3–5 years) and annual operating plan, connecting strategy to resource decisions.
  • Build scenario and sensitivity analyses that inform major decisions, including market expansion, hiring pace, and new product lines.
  • Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders to translate business drivers into financial outcomes.
Build the FP&A function
  • Design and stand up FP&A from the ground up: processes, calendar, operating cadence, and governance.
  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing team of direct reports; define roles and a scalable org plan.
  • Select and implement planning and BI tools (e.g., Adaptive, Pigment, Anaplan or similar) integrated with the ERP and CRM.
  • Establish a single source of truth for KPIs, including ARR or recurring revenue, bookings, gross margin by product line, unit economics, etc.
De-SPAC and public-company readiness
  • Own the financial projections underpinning the de-SPAC transaction, including the model used in investor presentations and proxy/registration statement materials.
  • Support the CFO in diligence with the SPAC sponsor, PIPE investors, bankers, auditors, and legal counsel.
  • Build public-company forecasting rigor: monthly and quarterly forecasts with variance analysis tight enough to support external guidance.
  • Help establish investor relations processes: guidance framework, earnings preparation, consensus tracking and board/investor materials.
  • Work with Accounting and Controllership to support SEC reporting, SOX readiness, and controls around forecasting and projections.
Performance management and reporting
  • Deliver monthly and quarterly business reviews, executive dashboards, and board reporting.
  • Lead budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual analysis with clear drivers and recommended actions.
  • Own cash forecasting and runway planning
  • Drive cost discipline, including headcount planning, vendor spend, and operating leverage.
Qualifications
Required
  • 12+ years of progressive finance experience, with 5+ years leading FP&A teams.
  • Track record of building or substantially scaling an FP&A function at a growth-stage company.
  • Direct experience taking a company public (IPO, de-SPAC, or direct listing) or leading FP&A at a public company.
  • Strategic mindset: comfortable shaping decisions, not only reporting on them, and able to push back with data.
  • Expert financial modeling skills: three-statement, driver-based, and scenario models built to withstand investor and auditor scrutiny.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills; able to present clearly to boards, investors, and non-finance leaders.
  • Proven people leader who can recruit, coach, and retain talent in a remote environment.
  • AI-first culture: hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., LLM assistants, AI-enabled planning and BI platforms) to automate reporting, improve forecasting and analysis with sound judgment on accuracy, data security and controls
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.
Preferred
  • Experience in robotics, industrial technology, hardware-plus-software or IoT businesses with mixed hardware, SaaS and services revenue.
  • Familiarity with SEC reporting, SOX controls, and public-company guidance practices.
  • Experience implementing planning platforms and ERP integrations.
  • MBA and/or CPA or CFA.
  • Background in investment banking, private equity, or corporate development.

Base salary range: $170,000-$280,000

Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; stock options; 3% 401(k) match, paid holidays, and parental leave.

Application window: Applications accepted through the end of December 2026. This date will be updated if the window is extended.

title: Materials Assistant

En roll där du får vara med och bidra till ett effektivt materialflöde och en välfungerande leveransförmåga. Du arbetar tvärfunktionellt i nära samarbete med flera delar av verksamheten, i en miljö som präglas av flexibilitet och samarbete.

Låter detta som nästa steg i din karriär? Välkommen med din ansökan och bli en del av vår fortsatta utveckling mot en mer effektiv lager- och materialhantering. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Rubrik's Renewals & Quoting Strategy & Operations team sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, systems, and execution, translating go-to-market priorities into the operational infrastructure that drives predictable, scalable business outcomes.

The team spans renewal operations and quoting, and works closely with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Product so that every renewal and new business deal is handled with speed, accuracy, and strategic intent. You will take our India-based Renewal Operations, Data Assurance and Quote Desk teams to the next level of scale, rigor, and impact.. This role is ideal for someone with a consulting, strategy, or operations background who wants to own solutions in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

Build the Foundations of the Renewals Business

  • Design and implement the systems, policies, and processes that enable renewals to scale, with clear rules of engagement, strong governance, and a great experience for sales and customers.
  • Develop quoting frameworks and standards for multi-year, co-term, and mid-term expansion scenarios that maximize ARR retention.
  • Partner with IT, RevOps, and Finance to define requirements for system enhancements, integrations, and automation.
  • Create playbooks, guidelines, and standard operating procedures that make excellence repeatable across regions.

Evolve and Lead Our Data Quality Function

  • Define the next chapter for the team responsible for the accuracy and integrity of the data powering global renewals operations, supporting a large global base of account executives and renewal sales professionals.
  • Raise the standard of the function through clear data definitions, quality metrics, audit rhythms, and governance controls across CRM and renewal systems.
  • Shift the team from reactive clean-up to proactive, preventive, and increasingly automated data quality.
  • Turn data insights into action for sales leadership, and partner with Business Intelligence so reporting meets business needs.

Lead the Quote Desk Center of Excellence

  • Own the strategy, service standards, and quality bar of our India-based Quote Desk, which serves sales teams worldwide, and scale it into a recognized center of excellence.
  • Drive adoption of the Quote Desk and build trusted relationships with the sales leaders who rely on it.
  • Streamline end-to-end workflows from opportunity identification to quote to close, reducing cycle times and improving accuracy.

Influence and Partner Across the Business

  • Partner with India renewals sales leadership and senior stakeholders across Sales and Finance globally, bringing structure, data, and a clear point of view.
  • Navigate high-stakes conversations and competing priorities with poise, and align leaders around trade-offs and decisions.
  • Present renewal performance, forecasts, and operational insights to senior leadership in partnership with the Senior Director.

Build and Inspire the Team

  • Attract and hire exceptional talent, and set a higher bar for what great looks like across roles.
  • Coach and develop high-potential people into future leaders, building clear career paths and strong succession.
  • Raise the overall caliber, capability, and culture of the India team over time.

Desired Skills & Experience

Required

  • 12+ years of experience in Management Consulting, Strategy & Operations, Sales/Renewal Operations, or Business Operations, ideally within a high-growth technology or SaaS business.
  • 5+ years of people leadership, including hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

title: Trave Rule Compliance Associate
description:
Blockchain is connecting the world to the future of finance. As the most trusted and fastest-growing global crypto company, it helps millions of people worldwide safely access cryptocurrency. Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Travel Rule professional to drive and scale our global Travel Rule compliance programme. In this role, you will drive the operational, regulatory, and technical execution of virtual asset transfer compliance across key jurisdictions (including the UK, EU, US, and APAC). You will act as the primary subject matter expert bridging our legal, product, engineering, and financial crime operations teams to ensure seamless, compliant digital asset transactions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Programme Ownership: Design, implement, and maintain global Travel Rule policies, procedures, and controls aligned with FATF Recommendation 16, the EU Transfer of Funds Regulation (TFR), UK FCA rules, and FinCEN requirements.
  • Vendor & Protocol Management: Manage day-to-day operations and integrations with Travel Rule solution providers and messaging protocols (e.g., Notabene, TRUST, TRP, Sygna, Sumsub).
  • Counterparty VASP Due Diligence: Oversee onboarding, risk assessment, and ongoing due diligence for counterparty Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs), resolving interoperability and data-sharing gaps.
  • Transaction Monitoring & Escalations: Establish workflows for handling missing, incomplete, or mismatched originator and beneficiary information. Manage exception queues, rejected transfers, and Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) escalations.
  • Self-Hosted Wallet Verification: Implement and refine risk-based controls and ownership verification processes for transfers involving unhosted/self-custodied wallets.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to automate data transmission, reduce user friction, and troubleshoot API or protocol failures.
  • Regulatory & Audit Readiness: Maintain comprehensive audit trails, produce regular compliance metrics for senior leadership, and lead responses to regulatory examinations and external audits.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in AML/CTF compliance, financial crime operations, or regulatory risk within the cryptocurrency, digital assets, or payments sector.
  • Practical understanding of global Travel Rule frameworks and cross-border VASP obligations.
  • Hands-on experience working with Travel Rule messaging tools, blockchain analytics platforms (e.g., Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs), and API-driven compliance workflows.
  • Ability to interpret complex regulatory guidance and translate it into scalable operational and product requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate clearly with engineers, external VASP partners, and internal partners.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Experience working with Notabene.
  • Relevant compliance certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), CGSS, or ICA diplomas.
  • Direct experience managing Travel Rule interoperability challenges (the "sunrise issue") across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Familiarity with SQL, data analytics tools, or product management methodologies.

COMPENSATION & PERKS

  • Competitive full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company
  • This is a role based in our Palermo office, with a mandatory in-office presence four days per week.
  • The opportunity to be a key player and build your career at a rapidly expanding, global technology company in an exciting, emerging industry.
  • Performance-based bonuses
  • Apple equipment provided by the company
  • Work from Anywhere Policy: You can work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days per year.
  • Health insurance reimbursement

title: AI Growth Enablement Specialist
description:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media () focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

12-month Extendable Contract

On-site in Dubai UAE

title: AI Full Stack Engineer – Service Technology
description:
Career Area:

Technology, Digital and Data

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Description

Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable enterprise applications using modern full-stack technologies.
Apply an AI-first engineering approach, leveraging approved AI coding harnesses and agents throughout requirements, design, development, testing, review, and troubleshooting.
Develop secure, reliable applications, APIs, integrations, and distributed processing systems for internal platforms such as Remote Service.
Own solutions from Design through production, ensuring quality, performance, security, and maintainability.

This is not a prompt-engineering-only role. You'll write production code, make architectural decisions, and set engineering patterns that move AI-enabled systems from concept to production. All this work must meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, performance, and responsible AI. Caterpillar will equip this role with modern AI engineering tools, including GitHub Copilot and current models and platforms from Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, and other leading providers, based on enterprise approval and fit for purpose.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Stack Development: Design and develop responsive web applications using modern technologies such as Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java/Spring Boot.
  • AI-First Engineering: Effectively use AI coding Agentic systems to accelerate requirements analysis, solution design, code development, refactoring, debugging, documentation, and modernization.
  • Agentic Development: Decompose engineering work into features that AI agents can execute, provide appropriate application and architectural context, and critically review and validate AI-generated solutions.
  • API & Integration Engineering: Design and develop secure REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous/event-driven integrations, batch processing, and enterprise system integrations required by applications such as FIDS2.0.
  • Data Engineering: Develop efficient data-access solutions using Oracle, SQL DB, and query optimization.
  • Quality Engineering: Build comprehensive unit, integration, API, UI automation, regression, and performance tests, leveraging AI to improve test coverage and accelerate defect identification.
  • Production Engineering & Observability: Build applications for production reliability using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, monitoring, performance analysis, and AI-assisted root-cause analysis.
  • AI-Enabled Applications: Develop AI capabilities into the target application, where appropriate using LLMs, RAG, context engineering, agentic workflows, evaluation, grounding, and guardrails, while maintaining enterprise security and governance.

Required

  • Bachelor's/master’s degree in computer science, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of professional software development experience as a full stack developer, with at least 2 years hands on experience with AI/Gen AI/Agentic AI systems.
  • Strong full-stack development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one enterprise backend technology.
  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and modern UI framework experience.
  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
  • Strong SQL/database fundamentals.
  • Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices.
  • Experience with automated software testing.
  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants or coding agents as part of normal software development.
  • Demonstrated ability to review, debug and validate AI-generated code.

Considerations for Top Candidates:

  • Experience building large enterprise or distributed applications.
  • Experience with high-volume asynchronous or batch processing.
  • Experience integrating LLM/AI capabilities into production applications.
  • RAG/vector-search experience.
  • Agentic AI development experience.
  • Experience building or configuring specialized AI software-engineering agents.

Posting Dates:

November 16, 2026 - November 29, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Airline Services Technician-Engineer
description:
Let Your Career Take Flight!


We're committed to being a global aviation leader driving innovation, regional growth and prosperity by investing in our employees, customers, airlines, and partners


The ACAA’s Airline Services Technician – Engineer will report to the Manager, Airline Services and assumes responsibility for preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of the conveyor systems and its ancillary equipment. Perform unscheduled repairs and major overhauls to the baggage system. This job requires the Engineer to work as a member of a composite crew in conjunction with Electricians and Mechanics.

Here is how the Airline Services Technician – Engineer will help:

  • Work safely and abide by all ACAA safety guidelines.
  • Develop or participate in the job safety analysis procedures.
  • Perform conveyor preventive maintenance in accordance with the OEM's recommendations or ACAA preventive maintenance program.
  • Perform unscheduled repairs to conveyor systems, including but not limited to repair and replacement of: conveyor belting, conveyor belt lacing, head and tail pulleys, carrying rollers, snub rollers, return rollers, conveyor structure, all associated shafts and bearings, baggage pusher assemblies, baggage diverters including horizontal and vertical units, power turn assemblies both chain-driven and belt-driven, tip chutes, fixed chutes, makeup and claim units including flat plate units as well as pallet support devices.
  • Occasionally will be required to make major and minor structural repairs due to damage caused to equipment.
  • Perform light fabrication of components.
  • Perform overhaul of components including but not limited to: gear boxes, cycloidal, helical and worm –driven models, belt assemblies, cog-type, power turn type and merge type.
  • Air filter replacements on passenger boarding bridges.
  • May be required to participate in the job safety analysis program administered by the Authority.
  • Perform other related tasks as assigned or required.

Qualifications

Requirements to apply for role of Airline Services Technician – Engineer are:

  • High School diploma or GED.
  • Five years’ experience in Industrial Maintenance
  • Completion of a recognized apprenticeship in the craft or equivalent training at an accredited trade or technical school, or military training.
  • Current, valid Pennsylvania Class C driver’s license or ability to obtain the same; and
  • Must provide his/her own personal hand tools.

We also expect that candidates will demonstrate the following knowledge, skills, and abilities in most cases:

  • Considerable knowledge in the practices, methods, tools and materials of the Stationary Engineer trade with a concentration on conveyor maintenance.
  • Knowledge in occupational hazards and techniques of safety precautions and injury prevention programs.
  • Knowledge in standard practices of welding, steel, aluminum and stainless steel, including ARC, MIG, and TIG type welding.
  • Proficient at using acetylene torches for burning purposes.
  • Proficient use of "Clipper-type" belt lacers.
  • Basic understanding of three phase power including voltages of 480 VAC along with single phase 110 VAC.
  • Proficient understanding of ladder logic circuitry for troubleshooting.
  • Ability to replace and set up variable frequency drives.
  • Ability to take direction from ACAA management personnel, and/or Foreman.
  • Ability to work well with others.

Don’t meet every requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don’t meet every single qualification. As a Smarter Airport, we recognize that talent is not always related job history and skills come from valuable experiences that aren’t always shown on a resume. If you are excited to make a positive change for our region, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for our organization, whether it be this role or another.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit and taste or smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds with assistance.

Conditions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee frequently works in hot/cold weather conditions and is frequently exposed to vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually very loud. Employee may be assigned or scheduled to work all shifts at a 24/7 operation, seven days a week including holidays. Subject to remain on duty beyond assigned working hours to provide assistance during extenuating circumstances.

Medical Examination

Employment is contingent upon the results of a post-offer (initial employment or promotion) physical examination performed by the Authority's examining physician.

Drug Testing

Employment is contingent upon the results of a post-offer (initial employment or promotion) drug screening. Continued employment may be subject to drug and alcohol testing conducted without advance notice and without individualized suspicion.

Pre-Employment Investigation

Must pass a thorough investigation, consisting of a criminal history check (including but not limited to the requirements of CRF 1542.209 and 1542.3), verification of prior employment and performance, reference and credentials checks.


Caring For Our Crew

At ACAA, we’ve got you covered. That applies to how we equip, empower, and enable our people to do their jobs. It also applies to our benefits, which are broader and more valuable than what many other employers offer:

  • We offer two plan options for healthcare coverage from high-quality insurance carriers, as well as an ACAA-funded Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) that will help offset the cost of many medical expenses.
  • ACAA employees pay almost $1,200 less per year in healthcare payroll contributions than the average employee in other companies, according to market surveys.
  • When HRA funding is included, the health-plan deductibles paid by ACAA employees are about $1,200 lower on average than the costs paid by employees of other companies.
  • ACAA does not require that employees meet a separate deductible for pharmacy expenses before prescription-drug coverage kicks in.
  • ACAA’s dental plans (included with healthcare coverage) offer an option covering children’s orthodontia.
  • Employees also can take advantage of a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) to help pay for health care and dependent care expenses on a pre-tax basis.
  • All eligible full-time ACAA employees participate in the Allegheny County Employees Pension Plan, a defined-benefit plan that vests after 10 years of service.
  • Employees also may participate in a Deferred Compensation Plan, which allows them to contribute part of their pay on a pre-tax basis into long-term retirement investments.
  • A robust Employee Assistance Program (including access to free counselling sessions, financial guidance, and care coordination), life insurance options, a wellness program, and eligibility for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program round out ACAA’s exemplary benefits.

About Allegheny County Airport Authority

The Allegheny County Airport Authority, which manages Pittsburgh International Airport (PIT) and Allegheny County Airport (AGC), is committed to transforming Pittsburgh’s airports to reflect, connect and serve the community, inspire the industry and advance the region’s role as a world leader.

Pittsburgh International Airport serves nearly 10 million passengers annually to 63 direct routes. PIT’s CEO Christina Cassotis has been recognized for numerous leadership awards. In 2025, she was named Pittsburgher of the Year by Pittsburgh Magazine.

PIT recently opened a new, modernized pre-security terminal and Terminal Garage, designed for and by the people of the Pittsburgh region. This new airport represents more than a decade of planning, preparation and work from the ACAA team. It serves as the region’s front door to the world, connecting the world to Pittsburgh and Pittsburgh to the world.

ACAA is an equal-opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, disability, and veteran status.

Hard work, innovation and fun. You’ll find all three in our corporate culture where working hard and working smart go hand in hand. We have a number of events, programs and initiatives that enhance our employees’ experiences and provide opportunities for recreation and recognition.
