title: Senior Director, Team Lead, CDK4/6 Portfolio, US Breast Cancer
location: United States - New York - New York City
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Pfizer Commercial Oncology is introducing the world to the next era of cancer care. With a growing portfolio of novel therapies, industry-leading R&D, and a goal of delivering eight breakthroughs by 2030 across major cancer types, we're translating cutting-edge science into market-shaping impact. Here, you'll partner with exceptional colleagues across scientific, medical, and manufacturing teams, backed by advanced digital and AI-enabled infrastructure and the authority to accelerate medicines from discovery to delivery. Guided by our values of courage, excellence, equity, and joy, you'll have the opportunity to stretch your skills and build a career that evolves with you—across teams, roles, and the Pfizer enterprise. Join us to make history — for patients, for their families, for the future.


Breast cancer is the most common cancer affecting women in the US, and IBRANCE, our first-in-class CDK 4/6 inhibitor, has been prescribed to ~200,000 patients in the US since launch. In 2026, IBRANCE contributed >$2B in net revenue to Pfizer Oncology and continues to be a market leader despite intensifying competition. With the June 2026 FDA approval of the PATINA HER2+ indication, IBRANCE is now the only CDK4/6 inhibitor indicated for HR+ metastatic breast cancer regardless of HER2 status.


The next three years are the most consequential in the history of Pfizer’s breast cancer business. IBRANCE faces IRA effectuation and LOE in 2027, and atirmociclib, our CDK4-selective inhibitor, is the portfolio’s planned successor. Phase 2 randomized results from the FOURLIGHT-1 study of atirmociclib, plus fulvestrant in patients with hormone receptor-positive (HR+), human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2-) advanced or metastatic breast cancer (MBC) who had received prior CDK 4/6 inhibitor-based treatment were presented at ESMO. These results further support atirmociclib as a potential first-in-class cell cycle inhibitor backbone for HR+, HER2- MBC and Pfizer’s development strategy in earlier lines of therapy. A Phase 3 study in frontline MBC is ongoing and an additional Phase 3 study in early breast cancer is planned to evaluate atirmociclib in combination with giredestrant, an investigational oral selective oestrogen receptor.


The same oncologists, accounts and treatment decisions are involved in both. This is a P&L and people-management leadership role that demands a strong enterprise leader. The colleague who leads this team will set a multi-year strategic vision, make thoughtful trade-off and resource prioritization decisions for both brands, and influence senior leadership across the wider organization. The role leads that transition as one integrated strategy: maximizing IBRANCE value through the PATINA launch/10 year heritage campaign, IRA and LOE while building the market, evidence and organization that atirmociclib will need.


The IBRANCE and atirmociclib commercial leader will pave the way internally and guide the cross functional team to innovate in all aspects of engagement across all stakeholder groups.



ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

This Senior Director, Team Lead role reports to the VP, US Breast Cancer Franchise Lead and is an excellent opportunity for an experienced, collaborative and strategic leader to own the IBRANCE P&L and the atirmociclib pre-launch investment plan: own forecasting, OpEx and resource allocation, manage the revenue and expense trade-offs of LOE, and ensure every dollar released from IBRANCE is redeployed deliberately against portfolio priorities. The role leads a team of 6-8 HCP & patient marketers at the Director and Sr. Manager level. Atirmociclib is a critical launch for the Oncology portfolio over the next 5 years.


1. Optimize ~2B IBRANCE net revenue through 10 year heritage, IRA and LOE

  • Define and manage IBRANCE strategy and tactical execution through LOE, including identifying and executing incremental growth opportunities.
  • Lead the LOE plan: scenarios, customer and account communication, partnerships, patient marketing and generic-entry readiness, in partnership with Market Access, Trade, Legal and Medical.
  • Directly accountable for P&L Management and driving performance of marketing tactics and set investment levels against a clear profit-optimization framework, maximizing ROI through thoughtful trade-offs and redirecting savings to franchise priorities on an agreed timeline.

2. Build atirmociclib launch readiness & set a multi-year strategy

  • Launch excellence in frontline MBC and early breast cancer indications with a potential multibillion dollar revenue as a preferred next-generation backbone.
  • Set a multi-year strategic vision to anticipate the shifts in the HR+ve / HER2 -ve competitive landscape, evolving standards of care, and shape the brand strategy today to launch this multi-indication brand over the next 3 years.
  • Strategize proactively with Market Access, Pricing and Trade to shape the atirmociclib pricing and contracting strategy, channel and distribution model, and gross-to-net plan, ensuring the launch is positioned for durable access and profitability
  • Lead US HCP and account strategy for atirmociclib: positioning against generic CDK4/6 inhibitors, segmentation, target customers and the launch plan.
  • Shape the first-line market before approval with disease-state education and pre-launch engagement, in partnership with Medical Affairs and Clinical Development.
  • Define launch-readiness milestones, evidence needs and the investment case in partnership with Global, Market Access, Commercial Insights and Sales.
  • Continuously own the measurement and impact of marketing initiatives — using advanced analytics to generate learnings and drive continuous improvement against brand objectives.
  • Ensure marketing materials are compelling, compliant and appropriate across all channels, including AI-enabled and omnichannel touchpoints.
  • Identify strategic customer insights through collaboration with Medical, Market analytics, AI/data-science, field force and prescribers, and translate them into actionable strategies.

3. Own the integrated patient and advocacy strategy for HR+ve disease

  • Develop an integrated patient strategy & partner with enterprise patient support functions towards an intentional, end-to-end patient experience that removes barriers to starting and staying on therapy, leverages learning from Ibrance, and is scalable to future launches
  • Lead patient marketers focused on direct to patient, patient support and adherence programs, to protect patient continuity for Ibrance and set up a launch strategy for atirmociclib.
  • Connect the patient journey — build the operating model, metrics and feedback loops that connect field sales and marketing execution directly to patients and hold both accountable to shared commercial outcomes.

4. Run the transition as one strategy

  • Define how customers, accounts and field effort move from IBRANCE to atirmociclib, including the customer segments, messages and timing for each stage.
  • Align closely with BC Sales and Key account director leadership on annual sales meetings that incorporate Customer facing colleagues feedback, grow the CDK class, maintain IBRANCE class leadership and re-weight field focus as the portfolio changes.
  • Lead the development of the customer insight plan in partnership with analytics and Customer facing colleagues, and use it to evolve the strategic and tactical approach and anticipate how HCPs will choose among CDK inhibitors during the transition & in preparation for atirmo.
  • Work with the leads of other franchise assets (for example KAT6i/prifetrastat in the post-CDK4/6 setting and TUKYSA) so patient journeys connect and messages are consistent.

4. Lead people and the CDK4/6 portfolio

  • Directly lead and develop a talented team of director- and senior-manager-level marketers to achieve high performance and maximize potential.
  • Manage, engage and coach the team to achieve high performance and maximize team potential, and plan roles, development and succession as the work moves from IBRANCE to atirmociclib.
  • Actively foster a positive team culture and collaboration across the broader US BC marketing team.
  • Member of the BC franchise leadership team & broader Oncology Business extended leadership team.



BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, and oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

  • Bachelor’s degree required, and 12+ years of pharmaceutical industry experience required, or Master's degree and 10+ years
  • Pharmaceutical/biotech commercial experience, including US brand management & P&L accountability.
  • Deep understanding of US market dynamics including specialty channels, oncology organized customers and payers
  • INNOVATION & AI FLUENCY: Demonstrated use of AI and advanced analytics to sharpen customer insight, targeting, forecasting and investment decisions, and a track record of championing innovative solutions that change how the team works
  • Demonstrated success developing, executing and measuring complex marketing programs and championing innovative solutions
  • COMMERCIAL EXCELLENCE: Proven track record of identifying customer needs and extracting and translating key insights into meaningful strategies and tactics
  • LEADERSHIP: 5+ years of direct or matrix management or coaching of marketing colleagues at all levels (Manager to Director) and commitment to fostering team engagement, team culture and developing people
  • INTERNAL AMBASSADOR: Collaborative team player with demonstrated ability to engage experts from a wide range of cross-functional areas to improve business performance and find a path forward
  • Strong analytical skills; detail and action oriented, creative, flexible, self-motivated
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for a wide range of audiences including senior level executives
  • Is a role model for the Pfizer Values



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Oncology marketing experience
  • Experience managing a brand through loss of exclusivity
  • Experience leading a US oncology or specialty product launch, from pre-launch market shaping through first-line commercialization
  • Experience designing, piloting or scaling new go-to-market models (e.g., omnichannel or AI-enabled customer engagement, hybrid field/digital coverage, account-based approaches) and applying them through a brand lifecycle transition
  • Experience leading patient marketing, including DTC/DTP strategy, patient support and adherence programs, and advocacy engagement, with the ability to integrate patient and HCP strategies into one customer plan



Non-Standard Work Schedule, Travel or Environment Requirements

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment and making complex decisions quickly
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze complex data and understand trends and mathematical calculations
  • Ability to work on a computer for extended periods using common applications (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed for congresses, sales meetings and customer interactions
  • Pending Pfizer policies, travel is required: International & domestic travel of up to 25%



Other Job Details:

Last Date to Apply for Job: November 30th, 2026

Additional Location Information: New York, NY; Collegeville, PA

Eligible for Relocation Package: No

Position is hybrid and will require to work 2 to 3 days per week on site

#LI-PFE

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $230,900.00 to $384,800.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 25.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. title: Director of Learning & Talent Development
location: Montgomery, Alabama, United States; Woodstock, Georgia, United States
description:
Job Title – Director of Learning & Talent Development

Location – Montgomery, AL, Woodstock

Resumes will be reviewed continually.

Rewards of Working at Caddell – Paid vacations, company-paid holidays, company-funded medical insurance. Company joint funding of dental and vision insurance, life and disability plans to full-time employees, 401k match, gym membership reimbursement, and use of company condominiums.

Job Summary

  • The Director of Learning & Talent Development leads Caddell’s enterprise learning and talent development strategy, aligning workforce capabilities, leadership development, career growth, and business objectives. The Director establishes consistent learning standards and development pathways while maintaining business unit ownership of specialized technical training and operational decisions. Working closely with HR and business leaders, this role develops scalable programs, strengthens leadership readiness, supports succession development, and measures the impact of learning initiatives. The Director also leads the learning team and coordinates internal subject matter experts, facilitators, and external partners.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Strategy & Workforce Development

  • Develop and execute a multi-year learning strategy aligned with company goals, business unit needs, and The Caddell Way.
  • Partner with HR and business leaders to identify workforce capability gaps, critical roles, and future development needs.
  • Establish enterprise learning priorities, standards, budgets, and governance while identifying opportunities to improve training consistency and efficiency.

Technical & Operational Development

  • Establish a Technical & Operational Development Council with business unit, Safety, Quality, and functional representatives.
  • Partner with operational leaders to define technical competencies, role-based training, and proficiency standards while maintaining operational ownership of technical content and approvals.
  • Support field training, coaching, internal SME instruction, and consistent documentation of technical development.

Leadership Development & Career Growth

  • Oversee leadership development programs, executive development, and high-potential employee initiatives.
  • Establish career and competency pathways that incorporate technical skills, leadership capabilities, and The Caddell Way.
  • Create development opportunities through mentoring, cross-functional assignments, and expanded business exposure.

Performance, Talent & Succession Development

  • Partner with the CHRO and HR leaders to align learning with performance management, talent reviews, career development, and succession planning.
  • Develop consistent talent assessment tools and readiness criteria to support objective development decisions.
  • Translate talent review outcomes into actionable development plans and monitor progress, internal mobility, and leadership

Learning Programs & External Partnerships

  • Oversee instructor-led, virtual, blended, and on-demand learning programs for field, office, and international employees.
  • Develop internal facilitators and subject matter experts through training resources and train-the-trainer programs.
  • Manage external training providers, educational partnerships, certifications, and learning tools, evaluating quality, cost, and business value.
  • Measure learning effectiveness through participation, skill development, application, and business outcomes.

Team Leadership, Systems & Administration

  • Lead and develop the Senior Learning Experience & Development Specialist, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, and growth opportunities.
  • Oversee learning technology, employee experience, reporting, and governance in partnership with IT.
  • Manage learning budgets, vendors, resources, and program implementation.
  • Partner with HR, Communications, and business leaders to support learning communications and organizational change.
  • Provide executive updates on program effectiveness, workforce development progress, resource needs, and recommended improvements.

Knowledge, skills and abilities

  • Knowledge of organizational development, adult learning, instructional design, competency frameworks, leadership development, talent reviews, succession planning and training evaluation.
  • Understanding of project-based construction operations, workforce capability planning, technical learning governance and the distinction between training completion and demonstrated proficiency.
  • Ability to translate business strategy and staffing forecasts into measurable development priorities and career pathways.
  • Ability to facilitate executive conversations and talent calibration, influence without direct authority, and build productive relationships with field and corporate leaders.
  • Skill in program governance, vendor evaluation, budget management, learning analytics, change enablement and communicating actionable recommendations.
  • Sound judgment with confidential talent information; ability to balance consistency, operational autonomy and a geographically dispersed workforce.

    Travel - Plan and participate in business-related travel, including industry conferences, professional events, and organizational presentations to support employee development, knowledge sharing, and Caddell’s strategic objectives.

    Reliability - Demonstrate reliability and accountability by consistently attending, preparing for, and serving as the designated presenter or facilitator for scheduled training activities, conferences, and employee development sessions. Ensure timely communication and follow-through to support effective program delivery.

Education and experience

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, organizational development, learning and development, business, education or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in learning, organizational development, talent management or closely related work.
  • Three or more years leading programs, cross-functional initiatives or teams with accountability for outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience developing leadership programs, competency frameworks or role-based pathways and partnering with senior leaders.
  • Working experience with LMS and performance management platforms, instructional design practices, facilitation and evaluation of learning effectiveness.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in a related discipline; experience in construction, engineering or other complex project-based environments.
  • Experience linking workforce planning, technical capability standards, talent calibration and succession development.
  • Relevant credentials such as DiSC, CPTD, SHRM-SCP, SPHR, change management or facilitation certifications.

Salary Range: $112,000 – $168,000 annually

Applicants are encouraged to share their compensation expectations as part of the application process. Caddell considers prior experience, education, qualifications, and other relevant factors when determining competitive offers.

Your career matters at Caddell, where there is a strong emphasis on the growth and development of every employee! We’re large enough to take on the most complex construction projects, but we know the contribution of each individual is the key to our success.

description:

Management of data governance process in Maconomy business systems and related platforms. Review the
Master Data creation and Modification. Adept in managing & leading teams for running successful process
operations.

title: Head of Department Maintenance Control Centre
description:
About this Role

We are looking for an experienced and solutions-driven Head of Department – Maintenance Control Centre (MCC) to lead and manage the MCC function, ensuring effective oversight, coordination and support of maintenance control activities.



This is a key leadership position responsible for managing the MCC team, driving efficient decision-making and fault management processes, monitoring departmental performance, and continuously improving procedures to support safe, compliant and reliable aircraft operations.



The successful candidate will provide strong technical and managerial leadership while promoting a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork and operational excellence.



In this role you’ll:

  • Lead, manage and supervise the day-to-day activities of the Maintenance Control Centre (MCC).
  • Provide leadership, guidance and support to MCC personnel.
  • Develop and maintain effective shift rosters to support operational requirements.
  • Develop and streamline MCC procedures relating to decision-making, fault analysis, defect rectification and reporting.
  • Monitor individual and team performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one performance discussions with direct reports.
  • Analyse departmental performance and implement recommendations to improve effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Prepare and distribute quarterly reliability analysis reports to relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure activities are performed in accordance with established Company standards, procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Identify and report hazards, safety and security concerns, procedural gaps and deviations through the Company's established reporting systems.
  • Promote and uphold Company values, standards and a strong safety culture.
  • Attend management meetings and contribute to broader operational and departmental objectives.
  • Complete required training and support other reasonable operational requirements when necessary.



Minimum Requirements

Qualifications & Experience:

  • National Senior Certificate
  • Valid Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (AME) licence with Airbus A320 Type Rating.
  • Experience within a Maintenance Control Centre (MCC) environment
  • Experience in the operational aircraft maintenance environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in aircraft defect management, troubleshooting and maintenance decision-making.
  • Previous supervisory, team leadership or management experience within an aviation maintenance environment.
  • Experience in reliability monitoring, technical performance analysis and maintenance reporting.



Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong technical knowledge of aircraft maintenance and continuing airworthiness requirements.
  • Sound understanding of applicable aviation maintenance regulations, airworthiness requirements and Company procedures.
  • Ability to interpret and apply aircraft technical documentation and maintenance data.
  • Proficiency in relevant maintenance systems and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong commitment to safety, regulatory compliance and operational standards.



Competencies:

  • Leadership & People Management - Ability to lead, motivate and develop the MCC team while maintaining accountability and high performance standards.
  • Technical Decision-Making & Problem Solving - Strong technical judgement and analytical ability to assess defects, troubleshoot problems and make sound decisions in time-critical situations.
  • Planning & Organising - Ability to effectively manage resources, shift requirements, priorities and operational demands within a fast-paced maintenance environment.
  • Safety & Regulatory Compliance - Strong commitment to airworthiness, safety and regulatory compliance, with the ability to identify and appropriately address risks and procedural deviations.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management - Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively with MCC personnel, Maintenance, Engineering, Operations and other relevant stakeholders.

title: Growth Strategy Analyst
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

Binnen Dienst Toeslagen gaat er na aanleiding van een nieuwe aanbesteding conform de aanbestedingswet een migratie plaatsvinden van het huidige data storage platform (DSP) Teradata naar een nieuwe DSP IBM DB2. Om dit te bewerkstelligen hebben we hulp nodig met de migratie van de bestaande Teradata SQL-code en de resulterende tabellen die de data-fundamenten vormen voor de data-analisten en scientisten die deze gebruiken voor de ontwikkeling van waardevolle dataoplossingen die bijdragen aan een rechtvaardige dienstverlening en effectief toezicht bij de directie Toeslagen. Specifiek zijn wij op zoek naar data engineers die hun vakgebied kennen, maar ook niet vies zijn van de handen uit de mouwen te steken. De klus is hands-on. Uitdagingen bij de migratie zijn onder andere het omzetten van Teradata specifieke code naar IBM DB2 SQL-code. Wij zoeken personen die bekend zijn met grote concepten als clean code en CI/CD. Details zijn belangrijk. Uiteindelijk willen we een basis structuur zetten die toekomstbestendig is (clean code met uitstekende performance).De migratie data engineers zullen gaan samenwerken met de huidige vijf data engineers in het Data Fundament team van Dienst Toeslagen. De beoogde startdatum is begin september 2025 (liever eerder dan later). We zullen dan de groep migratie data engineers gedurende een maand opleiden zodat we begin oktober 2025 kunnen starten met de daadwerkelijke migratie.

Eisen:
  • De aangeboden kandidaat beschikt over minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau. Aantoonbaar door diploma's.
  • De aangeboden kandidaat heeft ervaring met structureel testen en de daarmee gepaard gaande testmethodieken.
  • De aangeboden kandidaat scoort minimaal 60 punten van het totaal aantal te behalen punten op kwaliteitswensen en competenties (=100).
  • De aangeboden kandidaat heeft minimaal vijf jaar ervaring met data-engineering. (Bewezen aantal jaar: 5)

Wensen:
  • De aangeboden kandidaat heeft ervaring met DB2-warehousing.
  • De mate waarin de kandidaat ervaring heeft met clean code.
  • De mate waarin kandidaat ervaring heeft met data-warehouse concepten (Kimball, Inmon, etc.) De mate waarin kandidaat ervaring heeft met de Agile werkmethodiek (SAFe en scrum).
  • De mate waarin kandidaat ervaring heeft met Teradata.
  • De mate waarin kandidaat ervaring heeft met DB2.

Competenties:

title: Deputy Director, Solutions, K-12
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

Education is one of the strongest drivers of economic opportunity, yet millions of learners in the United States encounter barriers that prevent them from reaching their full potential. The Gates Foundation's U.S. Program (USP) is focused on helping millions more learners earn credentials of value that lead to economic mobility by improving outcomes at the critical milestones that shape long-term success.

The K-12 Teaching and Learning team works collaboratively across USP to deliver on the foundation's efforts to help more students build strong mathematical foundations and successfully complete Algebra I by 9th grade—an important milestone that opens pathways to advanced learning, postsecondary success, and future careers. Building on decades of partnership with educators, researchers, school systems, and developers, the team invests in evidence-based instructional approaches, high-quality instructional materials, professional learning, tutoring, responsible AI-enabled tools, and implementation supports that help teachers accelerate learning and enable students to catch up, keep pace, and get ahead. The team works across the education ecosystem to identify, develop, evaluate, and scale an integrated and coherent set of these solutions to improve mathematics teaching and learning for millions of students.

Read more about our updated strategy here:
https://docs.gatesfoundation.org/documents/usprogramoverview.pdf

The Gates Foundation is partnering with Spencer Stuart to support the search for this role. To share nominations or expressions of interest, please send an email with any supporting materials to our confidential email address: GatesDDK12@spencerstuart.com.

Application Deadline: Saturday, November 28, 2026


Your Role

The Deputy Director, Solutions provides strategic leadership for the Foundation's portfolio of investments that develop, validate, and scale AI-enabled solutions to improve K-12 mathematics learning. The role is accountable for advancing four core objectives of the foundation's K-12 strategy: expanding the availability of AI-enabled products, enabling instructional systems that are coherent, strengthening the field’s focus on curriculum and product quality and performance, and increasing access to modern high school mathematics courses.

This leader will bring deep edtech product, technology, and market expertise to refine and evolve the foundation’s strategy and work with the team to shape and evaluate investments that enable the development, improvement, and scaling of partner solutions. This includes assessment of technology architectures, product roadmaps, evidence plans, implementation and partnership models, and business and go-to-market strategies – ensuring that these are aligned with the foundation’s student-learning goals.

Reporting to the Director of K-12 Teaching and Learning, the Deputy Director leads and develops a team with expertise spanning product development, market dynamics, AI-enabled learning, instructional design, and partnerships – managing a portfolio of strategic investments, and building partnerships across education, technology, philanthropy, and research. Working closely with colleagues across the K-12 team, the AI & Data Infrastructure team, the Postsecondary Learning & Navigation team, the Advocacy & System Improvement team, and others, the Deputy Director helps ensure that innovative products evolve into scalable, evidence-based solutions that accelerate student learning and prepare the field for broad adoption of AI-enabled instructional systems. The role requires both the technical credibility to engage product and technology leaders and the people leadership to build trust, develop team capabilities, and lead through a significant evolution in strategy in an environment of rapid change and uncertainty.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the foundation's K-12 Solutions strategy and manage a team of investors (program and strategy staff) with portfolios focused on increasing the availability of high-quality AI-enabled instructional products for K-12 mathematics that deliver learning acceleration. Support the continued improvement of that strategy as a reflection of field context, data and evidence on progress and impact, and foundation competitive advantage.
  • Advance coherent learning systems by supporting solutions that integrate curriculum, assessment, tutoring, AI-enabled instructional supports, and district infrastructure into seamless classroom experiences.
  • Engage in understanding and supporting curriculum product and technology investments in the portfolio, including clear theses for AI capabilities, AI safety, product architecture, roadmaps, evidence of learning impact, implementation requirements, and pathways to market adoption and scale.
  • Drive quality and coherence across the market for AI-enabled mathematics solutions by partnering with developers, publishers, researchers, districts, and investors to improve product quality, efficacy, adoption, and scale.
  • Build field alignment around quality and performance by advancing common quality signals, implementation frameworks, procurement approaches, and other conditions that enable districts to confidently adopt AI-enabled instructional solutions that drive measurable outcomes for students.
  • Lead the foundation's strategy to expand availability and access to modern high school mathematics pathways by working with publishers, states, districts, and other partners.
  • Identify emerging technologies, market opportunities, and strategic partnerships that validate and strengthen the K-12 AI ecosystem and improve student learning outcomes.
  • Manage a significant portfolio of grants, contracts, and strategic partnerships, ensuring investments generate evidence, achieve measurable impact, and inform continuous product improvement.
  • Collaborate across K-12 Teaching & Learning, Postsecondary Learning & Navigation, AI & Data Infrastructure, and Advocacy & System Improvement to align product development, implementation, policy, and market adoption strategies.
  • Continuously attend to contextual, progress, and impact data and evidence to inform tradeoffs for resource allocation and investment management.
  • Serve as a member of the K-12 Teaching & Learning leadership team, contributing to strategy development, portfolio planning, budgeting, organizational effectiveness, culture building, and cross-foundation priorities.
  • Represent the foundation with senior leaders across education, technology, philanthropy, and government, helping shape the national conversation on AI-enabled teaching and learning.

Your Experience

Education product and market expertise

  • Senior product and technology leader who understands education markets (including incentives across supply and demand side actors), can evaluate AI-enabled products in depth, and can influence sophisticated partners. Deep knowledge of curricula, interventions, and assessment markets, publishers, and developers, ideally in the mathematics space.
  • Understands opportunities and risks related to AI Safety (from multiple vantage points- students, teachers, districts, parents) and how to translate those perspectives into investments that influence the field

Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

  • Commitment to a vision of product efficacy and quality centered on the assets of students – ensuring equitable outcomes progress including for Black and Latino students and students experiencing poverty
  • Demonstrated experience in prioritizing approaches (e.g. targeted universalism) -- particularly to team leadership and partnership development -- that maximize progress on equitable outcomes.

Strategic Thinking

  • Enacts and continuously evolves a Solutions strategy that increases the availability and supports the adoption of high-quality instructional materials and supports. Demonstrates superior skills in strategic planning and implementation, leveraging a systems-thinking approach.
  • Masterfully plans, organizes, and prioritizes work of self and others in fast-paced environment with multiple and competing demands (both internal and external), which requires ability to see the critical path, measure and mitigate risk, and make trade-offs.
  • Leads the team to structure and manage high-return, well-risk-mitigated grants, with clear milestones and outcomes.

Collaborating and Influencing

  • Skillfully communicates complex information and data in written and oral formats; advocates and communicates effectively with a broad and diverse audience.
  • Builds and leads collaborative, trust-based efforts with key stakeholders from diverse sectors including non-profit organizations, school districts, and the private sector.
  • Works in productive collaboration with diverse teams with high technical acumen within a complex organization.
  • Demonstrates curiosity and comfort in areas beyond current areas of expertise with proven ability to rapidly acquire knowledge and execute good judgment in a variety of areas.

Leading People

  • Demonstrated experience leading teams with diverse cultural and professional backgrounds to develop and work towards clear metrics and outcomes
  • Leads with empathy, curiosity, and compassion to bring together and inspire team members with diverse backgrounds, approaches, and beliefs to pursue a coherent long-term direction, and collaborates with the team on how to achieve it.
  • Delegates objectives with clear and explicit intent to a team with high technical acumen, allowing the freedom to be creative in devising strategies.
  • Sets up practices to reinforce independent and open communication among team members and other groups within the K-12 team and broader foundation that contribute to the team’s work.
  • Holds people accountable for their commitments, providing clarity and assisting when barriers arise; maintains the team’s focus on results, integrity, and impact.

Academic credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience is required. Advanced degree highly preferred.

*Must have unrestricted work authorization in the country where this position is located. The Foundation does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (eg: H-1B, O-1, L-1, E, OPT, STEM-OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.).

title: Application Support Engineer (L2) – Freelance – Milan, Italy
description:
About the role

Our client, an international group in digital mobility services, is expanding its platform to a new European market. The migration of around 40,000 customers will take place in 2027. To support it, it is looking for an L2 Support Engineer to join its Support Operations team and be the technical point of contact for the local customer care teams.

You will investigate and resolve complex application, integration and customer-impacting issues. You will act as the bridge between local Level 1 customer care, Product, Engineering and external partners. This is a hands-on role in a critical, high-visibility programme.

Key responsibilities

  • Investigate and troubleshoot complex production incidents.

  • Analyze logs, API responses, database records and monitoring tools to identify root causes.

  • Manage incidents according to business impact and SLAs.

  • Coordinate major incident communications and stakeholder updates.

  • Diagnose issues across web and mobile applications, backend services, APIs, authentication systems and third-party integrations.

  • Run data analysis using SQL and API testing tools.

  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams, write detailed bug reports and support release validation.

  • Train and coach local Level 1 teams on the ticketing process and basic troubleshooting. Collect their feedback and act as their L2 point of contact.

  • Maintain knowledge articles and drive continuous improvement.

Success criteria

  • Independently manage L2 investigations and escalations.

  • Reduce MTTR for operational incidents.

  • Improve documentation and knowledge sharing.

  • Drive root cause analysis and preventative actions.

Process

Two interviews, then a decision.

Profil recherché

Required qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Technical Support, Application Support, SRE or a similar role.

  • Fluent Italian and English, written and spoken.

  • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases.

  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP status codes, OAuth, JWT and SSO.

  • Experience with Postman, Swagger or similar tools.

  • Experience analyzing application logs and distributed systems.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one or two investigation tools such as Azure DevOps, Elasticsearch or Kibana.

Preferred skills

  • Jira, Confluence, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, Azure or AWS.

  • Previous experience in a Level 1 support role, to understand the customer-facing side and the impact of incidents.

  • Understanding of Agile methodologies and the software development lifecycle.

  • Experience supporting mobile apps and customer-facing platforms.

  • French.

Soft skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to bridge business and technical teams.

  • Customer-focused mindset.

  • Ownership, accountability and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Calm and effective under pressure, in a critical programme.

  • Long-term commitment to the mission.

title: Director, Regional HR Operations - EMEA
description:

Establish & Lead Regional HR Operations

Continuous Improvement & Digital Enablement

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate HR processes.
  • Support the introduction of digital tools, workflows, and AI-enabled solutions that enhance efficiency and employee experience.
  • Contribute to global HR Operations projects, pilots, and technology deployments.

Data & Insight

Leadership & Culture

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, inclusion and continuous learning within the regional team.

Essential

  • Broad HR Operations or Shared Services experience across multiple countries.

  • Familiarity with automation or AI-enabled HR solutions.
  • Exposure to global service delivery models or shared service environments.

Key Competencies:

  • Collaborative and delivery-focused mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Ability to synthesize information quickly and communicate clearly across different audiences.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic fast-paced environment while balancing multiple priorities.
  • Curious about technology and confident adopting new tools, automation, and AI to simplify work.

title: Value Creation Analyst
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Manager, Platform Engineering
description:
Business Unit Automation is the home of AutoMine® - the world-leading solution for autonomous mining - and Newtrax – the world leader in collision avoidance and operations management solutions for underground mining – and Universal Field Robots UFR, a fast-growing Australia-based provider of autonomous interoperable solutions for the surface mining and underground mining markets.

Our hubs are located in Tampere (Finland), Montreal (Canada) and Brisbane (Australia) where we focus on developing fully automated and robotic mining technologies for mobile machinery, and safety solutions including collision avoidance system. Our overriding aim is to make mining safer and more sustainable for the future. We work closely together with our Sandvik Mining sales areas to serve our customers across the globe, striving for the highest level of service and support.

We are now looking for a self-driven and collaborative Platform Engineering Manager to join Business Unit Automation and help shape the shared technology foundations of our AutoMine® product family. You will build and lead the platform engineering team, develop a strong Finnish supplier network and bring internal teams and external partners together around a common roadmap. You will report directly to Olli Snellman, Head of Product Development, AutoMine®. The position is based in Tampere, Finland at our home office in Tulli Business Park located in the city center.

Your role is to turn platform ambitions into practical engineering execution. You will drive shared capabilities, reusable technology foundations and common development and verification practices that reduce duplication across products. Working closely with R&D teams, technical product owners, architects and other stakeholders, you will align priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments. You will build an effective partner ecosystem in Finland and collaborate with other external parties to complement internal capabilities. Your roadmap will connect technology choices and architecture with automated testing and a path to continuous delivery. A central expectation is to embed AI into every process step—from requirements and planning to design, implementation, testing, documentation, release and maintenance—with appropriate human oversight and attention to quality, safety and cybersecurity.

Your key responsibilities

  • Build and lead the platform engineering team, defining roles, recruiting and developing talent.
  • Build supplier network and set clear collaboration practices with partners.
  • Align internal stakeholders across R&D, product management and technical teams on priorities and dependencies.
  • Own the platform engineering roadmap, translating product needs into prioritized work and technology decisions.
  • Unite development and verification through test automation, simulation and virtualization.
  • Drive AI adoption at every process step, coaching teams and partners while retaining engineering accountability.

Your Profile

You have a relevant technical education, for example a bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, and experience leading software or platform engineering work. You can connect technical direction with practical execution and understand architecture, reusable software capabilities, modern development practices and continuous delivery. You understand interfaces between software and automation systems, including their technical constraints, limitations and integration dependencies, and can translate these into realistic platform decisions. You have the ability to build and develop an engineering team, bringing together the skills needed to deliver the platform roadmap. You bring experience in supplier or partner collaboration and can build an effective Finnish engineering network. You are comfortable creating roadmaps, managing dependencies and bringing stakeholders together around clear priorities. Experience with automation, autonomous industrial equipment or software-intensive products is an advantage.

You have a strong practical interest in AI-assisted engineering and can turn that interest into everyday ways of working across the full lifecycle. You combine a systematic approach with curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to challenge established practices. You build trusted relationships across functions and organizations, communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, and work proactively and independently in a changing environment. Finnish language is considered an advantage. You enjoy helping teams and partners learn, take ownership and deliver together.

What is in it for you?

We offer you an engaging role in an international business environment, extraordinary products, great colleagues, and opportunities for professional development.

At Sandvik, we believe in finding the right balance between work, family life, and personal interests, and we actively support our employees in achieving this. We offer a hybrid office/home working environment and an open-minded culture where diversity and inclusion are part of how we work.

Sandvik’s HR Services Finland, tel. +358 800 1 44444 (weekdays at 9-11 and at 12-15 EET).

Want to join our team?

Submit your application at home.sandvik/careers by Wednesday, December 9th, 2026.

Applications are processed in order of arrival, and the position may be filled before the deadline.

Your application should consist of an introductory letter including your salary request and a CV. If you wish to add a cover letter to your application, please make sure to attach the file when uploading your CV. Please note that we don’t accept applications by email.

About our company

Sandvik is a global, high-tech engineering group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability, and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. We are at the forefront of digitalization and focus on optimizing our customers’ processes. Our world-leading offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation, and rock processing. In 2025, the group had approximately 42.000 employees, sales in more than 150 countries and revenues of about SEK 121 billion.

title: Industrial / Occupational Hygiene Specialist
description:
Job Description

Organon is hiring an Industrial / Occupational Hygiene Specialist to join our world class manufacturing site in Cramlington, Northumberland. In this role, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team in conjunction with Safety, Health & Environment (SHE), Manufacturing Operations, Engineering, Occupational Health and HR to identify, assess and evaluate solutions to control workplace health hazards and manage associated risk to health. This covers chemical, physical and biological agents and forms a pivotal role in helping the organisation understand health hazards and how they affect the health of workers.

The role includes management and development of the site Occupational Hygiene Programmes in line with Company Standards and UK legislation, development & delivery of the occupational hygiene field assessment strategy and evaluation of exposures to hazardous agents within the workplace to determine the level of risk.

This role will also support business projects on the design concepts for engineering controls and support commissioning activities and verification of effective controls where required.

Role responsibilities:

  • Undertake measurements for chemical agents, noise, vibration, thermal environment and non-ionising radiation and interpret results with respect to established criteria.
  • Plan and organise surveys, develop sampling strategies in accordance with established guidance and protocols.
  • Identify reasonably practicable control measures for non-complex situations.
  • Use of qualitative and quantitative assessment methods for assessing exposures.
  • Ensure reports are documented and communicated to key stakeholders.
  • Evaluate risk and any need for action to prevent or reduce exposures
  • Advise on containment solution options for exposure prevention.
  • Advise on the range of methods for exposure control.
  • Advise on appropriate selection and use of personal protective equipment.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement in control strategies and working with key stakeholders to enhance the end user’s knowledge and understanding of risk.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience:


  • BOHS Certificate of Competence in Occupational Hygiene (or working towards) or equivalent.
  • Degree in Science/Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • Health & Safety qualification, eg NEBOSH General Certificate (desirable).
  • Demonstrable relevant professional experience, ideally in a manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to identify potential Health & Safety risks.
  • Thorough understanding of local and regional legislation regarding workplace Health & Safety.
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team.

We are a $6.5 billion global healthcare company focused on making a world of difference for women, their families and the communities they care for. title: Lead Engineer, DevOps Platform & Security
description:
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the number one consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

What makes us a great place to work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the number one consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

Who you'll work with

You will be part of a team building Bain's integrated suite of agentic decisioning tools that gives large organizations always-on intelligence across their most important growth decisions. The role sits at an intersection few organizations can offer: the analytical depth and client access of a top-tier consultancy, the technical ambition of a product company, and engineering work at the frontier of applied AI.

You will work inside Bain's standing product team, building software that helps the world's largest companies answer the questions that drive their business: where to invest, where to focus, and how to win. The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release.

The platform has two layers working together: an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient.

This is a startup inside an established company. You get genuine early-stage ownership and real influence over architecture and product direction, backed by Bain's global scale, client relationships, and leadership commitment; the pace of a startup with the runway of a global firm.

We are looking for DevOps engineers who see how to make the platform more reliable and resilient and bring that instinct to every sprint without being asked, and who are comfortable with problems that do not have a known answer. The work involves cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD for a multi-service platform, and observability problems with no off-the-shelf answer. Experience supporting agentic systems matters: how AI backend services and agentic workflows are deployed and monitored, evaluation pipelines, and the operational demands of production LLM workloads. This is applied AI in production, at scale, with real users depending on what you build. The field is moving quickly and the team is built to move with it, so the willingness to keep learning counts for as much as what you already know.

Where you'll fit within the team

The Senior DevOps Engineer owns the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and platform observability for the entire Growth AI Performance System platform: the foundation that every AI service, product interface, data pipeline, and agentic workflow runs on. This is a hands‑on platform engineering role: you will design, provision, and operate the infrastructure that real client deployments depend on, and you will own the CI/CD and release engineering processes that allow the engineering team to ship reliably and safely at pace.

DevOps for an AI platform has requirements that go beyond conventional software infrastructure. You will build observability tooling for agentic execution, tracing multi-step agent workflows, monitoring LLM API latency and cost, and surfacing the kinds of failures that only become visible when agents interact with real client data in production. This is a frontier area of platform engineering, and this role is expected to develop and own it.

You will work closely with the Security Engineer on infrastructure hardening, IAM, secrets management, and the security controls embedded in the CI/CD pipeline. You will work with the AI Engineering team on how AI services are deployed, scaled, and monitored. And you will own the local development environment and deployment documentation that keeps a globally distributed engineering team productive.

This role is based in Warsaw or Sao Paulo, working as part of a globally distributed platform team. You will mentor the g6 DevOps Engineer, providing technical direction without formal people‑management responsibility, set platform engineering standards, and be the senior technical voice on infrastructure architecture decisions.

What you'll do Infrastructure design and provisioning

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud-based distributed infrastructure for the Growth AI Performance System platform across Azure or AWS (including compute, networking, storage, managed databases, container orchestration, and API management), applying infrastructure-as-code practices throughout
  • Maintain full environment parity across development, staging, and production; ensure that the infrastructure engineers develop against is the infrastructure that client deployments run on, and that promotions between environments are automated, auditable, and reliable
  • Design infrastructure for the specific requirements of AI platform services: variable and spiky compute demand for LLM API calls, low‑latency requirements for agentic workflow steps, and the storage and retrieval patterns of knowledge graph and vector database workloads
  • Work with the Security Engineer to ensure infrastructure is hardened against the threat model relevant to an AI platform serving enterprise client data: network segmentation, IAM, secrets management, and security controls embedded in infrastructure-as-code
  • Stay current with cloud infrastructure tooling and AI infrastructure patterns; evaluate and adopt new platform capabilities that improve reliability, reduce cost, or enable engineering team velocity

CI/CD and release engineering

  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines for all Growth AI Performance System platform services (AI backend services, frontend applications, data pipelines, and infrastructure changes), embedding automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates that make deployment safe and fast
  • Own release engineering and deployment sequencing across the platform: coordinate releases across services with dependencies, manage rollback procedures, and ensure that platform and product module releases remain aligned in production and client‑facing environments
  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code for all platform environments using modern IaC tooling; ensure infrastructure changes are versioned, reviewed, and deployed through the same pipeline discipline as application code
  • Maintain the local development environment and developer tooling: onboarding documentation, local service configuration, and the developer experience infrastructure that keeps a globally distributed engineering team productive without infrastructure friction

Observability and AI platform monitoring

  • Implement observability across all platform services: structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting that gives the engineering team visibility into service health, API latency, pipeline reliability, and agentic execution behavior
  • Build specialized observability tooling for agentic AI workloads: tracing multi‑step agent execution, monitoring LLM API usage and cost, surfacing context passing failures, and detecting the kinds of agentic system failures that conventional monitoring does not capture
  • Monitor platform performance proactively: identify degradation before it affects live client deployments, diagnose root causes across distributed services, and drive the engineering improvements that resolve them
  • Define and maintain SLOs and alerting thresholds for all platform services; lead incident response for infrastructure and platform failures and conduct structured post‑incident reviews that improve platform reliability over time

About you Technical

  • Strong cloud infrastructure engineering experience across Azure or AWS: compute, networking, storage, managed databases, container orchestration, and API management at production scale
  • Deep proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tooling; experience provisioning and managing complex, multi‑environment cloud infrastructure through code rather than manual configuration
  • Strong CI/CD engineering experience: building and operating deployment pipelines for multi‑service platforms including AI backend services, frontend applications, and data pipelines
  • Practitioner‑level Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting containerized workloads in production environments with real latency and reliability requirements
  • Experience building observability for distributed systems: structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting using modern observability platforms; growing expertise in AI and agentic system observability
  • Experience with MLOps and AI infrastructure patterns: how LLM API services are deployed, scaled, and monitored; familiarity with the infrastructure requirements of vector databases, knowledge graph workloads, and agentic execution
  • Understanding of security and compliance requirements for cloud‑native platforms serving enterprise client data: IAM, secrets management, network security, and the DevSecOps practices that embed security into the deployment pipeline
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and scripting for infrastructure automation; disciplined use of version control for infrastructure codebases
  • Active use of AI‑assisted tooling to accelerate infrastructure development, diagnose issues faster, and develop AI infrastructure expertise as the platform scales

Experience

  • 5 or more years in DevOps, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering roles with hands‑on responsibility for production cloud infrastructure
  • Track record of owning CI/CD and infrastructure for a multi‑service platform end‑to‑end, not just contributing to pipelines, but designing, building, and operating them with real reliability requirements
  • Experience with MLOps or AI platform infrastructure (supporting LLM services, agentic systems, or ML pipelines in production) is a strong advantage
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and setting platform engineering standards within a team
  • Experience working in agile, cross‑functional product or consulting‑adjacent environments; strong troubleshooting and incident response skills
  • Based in or able to work from Warsaw or Sao Paulo near a Bain office

Education

  • Associate’s degree / bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

• Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

• Participates in developing consulting opportunities or assignments.

Candidates who do not complete and attach the application form will NOT be considered. You can download the Word version of the Application Form here: Undergraduate Vacancies | Pfizer UK and find instructions as to how to complete your application and more about eligibility criteria.


To learn more about this exciting opportunity, please see below.


Explore Clinical Operations & Clinical Study Team Leads (CSTLs) at Pfizer

Are you curious about the role of clinical trials in drug and vaccine development? Would you like to learn more about how studies are designed and implemented? Join our Clinical Operations (ClinOps) team and discover how we shape the future of medicine through precision, partnership, and innovation.

What is ClinOps?

ClinOps is the engine behind Pfizer’s clinical trial execution. We ensure that every study—from early design to final reporting—is conducted with scientific rigor, operational excellence, and patient safety at the forefront. Our work spans process development, compliance, training, and strategic planning across therapeutic areas.

Who are CSTLs?

Clinical Study Team Leads (CSTLs) are the orchestrators of clinical studies. They direct cross-functional teams, manage timelines and budgets, and ensure that every aspect of a trial—from site selection to data collection and reporting —is aligned with global standards and best practices. CSTLs are central to delivering high-quality, efficient, and compliant studies.

What Will You Learn and Do?

As an undergraduate joining our team, you’ll be working alongside skilled CSTLs to gain hands-on exposure to:

· Study Planning & Execution: Support the development of study plans, timelines, and operational strategies.

· Process Innovation: Help identify and improve clinical processes, tools, and systems used across global studies.

· Training & Education: Contribute to onboarding guides, toolkits, and forums that support CSTLs and study teams.

· Data & Metrics: Assist in analysing study metrics and trends to drive quality and efficiency.

· Partnership: Work with diverse teams and across different functions contributing to clinical trial delivery

Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a dynamic, mission-focused team that values learning, innovation, and impact. Whether you're shadowing study meetings, contributing to process improvements, or helping a CSTL plan and manage a study, your work will matter—and you’ll grow every step of the way.

What can I achieve and what will I be accountable for whilst completing a placement at Pfizer?

In this role the successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop an in-depth knowledge of the key elements of the clinical study lifecycle. During your time in Clinical Operations, you will get hands-on experience of many aspects of clinical trials, across one or more therapeutic areas. You may have the opportunity to work on process improvement initiatives within the Clin Ops organization.

All successful applicants will support one or more multiple projects and will develop a comprehension of the key clinical trial deliverables. Applicants will have the opportunity to work within both cross-functional study teams and supporting dedicated process and standards projects. The opportunity to work within the following therapeutic areas will also be offered:

· Oncology

· Inflammation and Immunology

· Internal Medicine

· Vaccines

What other opportunities and benefits do Pfizer offer?

ClinOps partners closely with other functions within Pfizer, and as such the successful candidate could have the opportunity to gain insights into other core clinical development functions including:

· Global Site & Study Operations

· Project Management

· Clinical and Clinical Sciences

· Clinical Data Sciences

· Global Regulatory Sciences

· Contracts and Legal

· Commercial

· Medical

· Supply Chain

· Biostatistics

· Statistical Data Sciences

· Quality

· Translational Oncology

· Finance

· Research & Development China

· Research & Development Japan

· Medical Writing

· Vaccines Research and Development

· Partnership with other Interns

We aim to facilitate an awareness of other areas of the business across the course of the placement, to provide a rounded awareness of the pharmaceutical business.

Successful applicants will also gain access to an extensive library of training tools and participate in regular educational sessions.

Candidates will be offered participation in voluntary events such as STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths) supported activities and are actively encouraged to get involved in delivering science demonstrations to school pupils as part of the Pfizer STEM outreach programme, at events like Science Fairs.

We also encourage membership of a Colleague Resource Group to promote diversity initiatives and influence our culture.

When can I start?

Placements will start on 1st September 2027 and will run for 12 months. This date is fixed due to the 2- week Induction and Onboarding program that all new starters must complete.


PERSON SPECIFICATION

Type of person we are looking for, in relation to ‘Skills’, ‘Knowledge’ and ‘Motivation’:

· Completing placement as part of University Degree either through Year in Industry/Industrial Placement or Gap Year

· On target for a relevant Life Sciences Degree Classification

· Self-motivated with ability to work freely

· Demonstrated effectiveness working as part of a team

· Strong verbal and written communication skills

· Detail focused

· Solution oriented and problem-solving abilities

· High IT literacy (e.g. Microsoft 365 applications, Artificial Intelligence)

As a reminder…….

Applicants must be completing placement as part of a degree course at a UK University, either through Year in Industry/Industrial Placement or Gap Year.

This position will close for applications on 6th December 2026.

What you will do

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.

  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
