title: Associate Strategy Officer, Foundation Strategy Office (2 yrs LTE)
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The Foundation Strategy Office is the primary function supporting the creation and evolution of our program level strategies as well as exploring new paths to impact that align with our mission. This includes supporting the CEO, CFO, and Chief Strategy Officer in key accountabilities like strategy development, strategy revision, strategy performance measurement, portfolio management, and special initiatives to accelerate the impact of the foundation.

We are a close-knit team that places a significant emphasis on maintaining and growing our positive, humble, and intellectually curious culture. We believe that small groups of deeply committed team members can do phenomenal things. We encourage debate and discussion of tough issues and are committed to the success of our clients. We invest proactively in each other’s personal and professional growth.

Your Role
As an Associate Strategy Officer, you will work in a hybrid arrangement and will report to the Deputy Director, Foundation Strategy Office. You will support critical strategy projects within the foundation by crafting and implementing qualitative and quantitative analyses, synthesizing and communicating key insights to partners, and managing clients.

You will support the development, prioritization, and launch of new foundation strategies and initiatives for Global Education, Gender Equality, Malaria, Family Planning, MNCH, Nutrition, Philanthropic Partnerships, K-12 Education, Executive Leadership Team, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and many more.


*This role is a 2-year limited-term role.

Job Description:

Responsibilities:


  • Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models, canonical models, and reusable architecture patterns across core business domains, including Client, Project, Engagement, People, and Finance.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data architecture solutions, applying reference architectures for data lakehouses, warehouses, MDM, Golden Records, streaming, and API-based services while evaluating design alternatives, risks, and dependencies.
  • Define and implement Master Data Management (MDM), Golden Records, reference data, matching, survivorship, synchronization, and distribution patterns, ensuring consistent enterprise data definitions and authoritative sources.
  • Design enterprise integration architectures using ETL/ELT, APIs, batch processing, event-driven integration, and streaming, ensuring seamless data movement, reuse, scalability, and interoperability across platforms.
  • Establish data ingestion, transformation, and promotion standards across landing, curated, and consumer layers, incorporating data quality, observability, metadata, lineage, security, and operational requirements.
  • Define and enforce enterprise data architecture standards covering modeling, naming, metadata, classification, lineage, data quality, and data products while conducting design reviews and ensuring governance compliance.
  • Architect and optimize data flows across Workday, Salesforce, analytics platforms, and service line applications, supporting system-of-record decisions, source-of-truth alignment, and application/data deprecation strategies.
  • Collaborate with Data Governance, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Privacy teams to incorporate data access, retention, classification, privacy, and security controls into solution designs, ensuring policy compliance, risk mitigation, and escalation of architecture exceptions.
  • Develop and maintain data models, architecture diagrams, data dictionaries, lineage records, integration designs, data flows, and architecture decision records, ensuring documentation remains accurate, accessible, and updated throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Serve as the Data Architecture point of contact for assigned initiatives, partnering with business stakeholders, engineering, analytics, application teams, and the Senior Manager – Data Architecture to guide solution design, validate technical feasibility, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and advance enterprise architecture standards and strategic initiatives.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Analytics Architecture, or Enterprise Integration, with proven experience designing solutions across multiple systems, domains, and platforms.
  • Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, physical, dimensional, domain, and canonical data modeling, including enterprise data structures and reusable architecture patterns.
  • Hands-on experience designing enterprise data integration solutions using ETL/ELT, APIs, batch processing, event-driven integration, and streaming technologies.
  • Experience architecting modern cloud-based data and analytics platforms, including data lakehouses and enterprise data warehouses; exposure to Databricks and/or Snowflake preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Master Data Management (MDM), Golden Records, reference data, authoritative data domains, and system-of-record/source-of-truth architecture.
  • Experience with Data Governance, metadata management, data catalogs, lineage, classification, data quality, observability, ownership, and data lifecycle management, including enterprise standards and frameworks.
  • Knowledge of data privacy, security, retention, classification, compliance, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP), with the ability to incorporate governance and risk controls into architecture designs.
  • Experience evaluating architecture alternatives, technical trade-offs, risks, and recommendations, and maintaining architecture diagrams, data models, integration designs, data flows, and decision records; familiarity with Workday, Salesforce, reusable data products, and domain-oriented architectures preferred.
  • Strong technical problem-solving, analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate across business and technology teams, explain complex architectural concepts, and guide cross-functional solution delivery.

title: Director, Public Partnerships
description:
About Understood

Understood is a nonprofit helping millions of people navigate the realities of neurodivergence. We translate trusted knowledge about ADHD, dyslexia, and dyscalculia into clear guidance, practical tools, and community support — so people don’t just feel informed, they feel understood.

Having a shared commitment to our values is a key factor in any hire we make. We have five core values:

  1. Continuously learn.
  2. Act with intention.
  3. Champion difference.
  4. Inspire change.
  5. Grow together.

Come be part of an organization with an entrepreneurial spirit that’s working toward a future where people can navigate neurodivergence with clarity, in a world that truly understands them.

To learn more about Understood, please visit:

Who you are

To advance our mission and deepen our impact, we’re hiring a Director of Public Partnerships, reporting to the VP, Advancement.

Understood can’t reach everyone who needs us on our own. To be a leading voice in the neurodiversity movement, we need mission-aligned partners who extend our reach, add credibility, and help shape how neurodivergence is understood. This role leads that work, building partnerships and coalitions that move the field forward. Success is measured by influence and collective impact, not revenue.

The ideal candidate is an experienced coalition builder who knows the education, public sector, and nonprofit landscape. You know how to bring different stakeholders together, turn shared goals into coordinated action, and build partnerships that change how a field thinks and works. You’re as comfortable setting strategy and representing an organization externally as you are leading a small team to deliver.

This is a hybrid role that requires a minimum of three (3) days a week in our NYC office, with a focus on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. This role also requires 10%–20% travel, primarily for partner meetings. We are a Mac-based environment, and team members are provided a Mac laptop for their work. Some travel may be required.

What you'll do

  • Set the partnership strategy: Decide which public partnerships will do the most to advance our mission and position Understood as a trusted leader in the field. This includes deciding where public partnerships can do the most to deepen the reach and impact of our existing products, tools, and content. Use an equity lens to find which communities we’re not yet reaching, and give priority to partners who can help close those gaps. Use clear criteria to decide which partnerships to pursue, and which to decline or hand to Marketing when they’re mainly about visibility.
  • Build and sustain partnerships: Cultivate relationships with public institutions, school systems, government agencies, and nonprofits around shared priorities.
  • Lead a teacher’s council: Partner with one of our Experts, who will lead the council, to convene teachers to help shape our resources, tools, and strategy for classroom teachers. Own recruitment, planning, logistics, and follow-through, and make it a council teachers want to join because it values their expertise and their time.
  • Support a narrative coalition: Partner with the VP, Advancement, to build and run a new coalition of mission-aligned organizations. Help develop shared messaging about neurodivergence, manage partner relationships and coordination, and help organize rapid narrative responses to emerging issues.
  • Turn commitments into action: Negotiate multiyear agreements and oversee joint programs that deliver value for partners and the people we serve.
  • Measure what matters: Track whether partnerships change practice and public conversation, such as institutions adopting shared practices, along with partner and coalition engagement. Track who partnerships help us reach, including growth in communities we haven’t served well before. Report progress to leadership.
  • Work across Understood: Partner with Marketing, Creative, Expert, and Product teams to bring joint work to life, and with Development when a partner is also a potential funder.
  • Represent Understood: Build trusted relationships with partners’ senior leaders and represent us at key convenings.
  • Lead the team: Manage and develop one direct report, and own the team’s resources and budget.

Minimum qualifications

In this role, you bring leadership experience and the ability to set direction across development. You own team-level priorities, manage multiple direct reports, including hiring and resourcing decisions, own the team budget, and communicate directly with the leadership and executive leadership teams.

We don't expect a perfect match across every category. What matters is relevant experience, genuine interest in the work, and a mindset for growth

Leadership and people

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in partnerships, coalition building, or field-building, including 3+ years leading teams or business functions and driving organization-wide impact. Direct experience engaging classroom teachers, understanding their needs, and building trusted relationships.
  • People leadership and development: You have managed direct reports. You make decisions on hiring, team structure, and resourcing for the team. You coach and develop people. You build a culture where people feel they belong, stay engaged, and hold themselves accountable. You keep the team motivated through change and resistance.
  • Stakeholder and cross-functional partnership: You work effectively with leaders in other functions, with senior leaders, with direct reports, and with leaders at partner organizations. You make tradeoffs across teams when priorities compete. You build strong working relationships up, down, and across the organization, including in a hybrid setting.

Strategy, execution, and data

  • Domain expertise: Deep expertise in building and sustaining mission-aligned partnerships and coalitions with public institutions, nonprofits, and field organizations. Recognized as a go-to source on partnerships and increasingly known in the field.
  • Strategic thinking and execution: You turn company strategy into clear plans and priorities. You balance long-term thinking with getting work done day-to-day. You adjust the plan when conditions change.
  • Data and analytics: You develop insights to shape strategy and priorities. You decide what data is needed, including how to measure influence and credibility, not only revenue. You use analysis to test ideas and make better decisions.
  • Project management: You plan and run multiple projects across the team, other functions, and partner organizations. You set clear milestones, manage risk, and keep the team on track to deliver.

Communication, collaboration, and technology fluency

  • Communication: You communicate clearly and confidently with leadership and executive leadership teams, peer leaders, direct reports, and external partners. You adapt the message to the audience. You build trust through consistent, inclusive communication.
  • Collaboration and ways of working: You work collaboratively without letting hierarchy or personal credit drive decisions. You work with integrity, emotional awareness, and resilience through change. You advocate for the people we serve, employees, and the organization in decision-making.
  • AI fluency: You use AI tools to improve the team’s output, speed, or decisions. You know where AI adds value at the team and function level. You set expectations for how the team uses it responsibly.

Nice-to-haves

  • Knowledge of learning and thinking differences, neurodivergence, or disability inclusion, through professional or lived experience.
  • Experience in narrative change, strategic communications, or rapid-response campaigns.
  • Established relationships in public policy, or the neurodiversity field.
  • Familiarity with public funding, such as government grants or co-funded public programs.

The base salary range for this role is minimum $215,000–$235,000 maximum, depending on years of experience and qualifications. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports wellness for our team members and their families. You can learn more about our benefits and offerings.

Understood.org does not sponsor applicants for work visas or legal permanent residence, including providing assistance with OPT extensions.

Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

Understood encourages individuals of all learning styles and ethnic, racial, and socioeconomic backgrounds, including those whose life experiences may include the challenge of access due to a disability, to apply for this position. We are committed to maximizing the diversity of our organization, as we want to engage all those who can contribute to supporting this work.

title: AI Value Creation Associate
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Senior Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a well-established, diversified investment and holding group headquartered in the UAE, with investments and business interests spanning multiple sectors. They are looking for a Senior Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer to build and operate the Group's Microsoft Fabric data foundation, integrating enterprise application data into dependable, governed datasets for reporting, analytics and AI. The role will establish reusable engineering practices that improve data availability, quality and consistency while respecting business ownership and entity access boundaries.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement Fabric pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse structures and curated data layers aligned with the approved Group architecture and agreed business priorities.
  • Integrate ERP, Oracle EPM, HR, procurement and other approved sources using supported interfaces and controlled extraction methods, coordinating source-system capacity and change windows.
  • Develop transformations, reusable models and analytical datasets. Agree definitions, reconciliation rules and acceptance criteria with Finance and entity business data owners.
  • Implement data validation, reconciliation, quality monitoring and exception handling so failed loads and material discrepancies are detected, assigned and resolved promptly.
  • Establish lineage, documentation, access controls and retention arrangements with data owners and cybersecurity; preserve entity and source-system access boundaries in shared data products.
  • Optimise pipeline performance, refresh schedules and Fabric capacity consumption while maintaining agreed service availability and recovery arrangements.
  • Implement source control, deployment processes, monitoring, recovery procedures and operational documentation; support live pipelines and resolve recurring reliability issues.
  • Provide governed data products for Power BI and AI applications, coordinating semantic models, business definitions and access requirements with application consumers.
  • Reduce unnecessary manual extracts and spreadsheet reconciliation. Improve source-data quality with application and entity owners, and document reusable pipelines and engineering standards.
  • Operate within the Group's federated technology model under the Head of Data and AI. Provide shared data capabilities and apply approved standards; business owners retain data-definition and quality accountability, while entity leadership retains local execution and line management. Escalate unresolved data and access exceptions through agreed governance.
Education Level

Bachelor's degree in computing, engineering, information systems or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Relevant Microsoft Fabric, data engineering or Azure certifications preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 6+ years in data engineering or enterprise data platforms, including hands‑on Microsoft Fabric delivery. Experience integrating ERP and finance data and supporting production pipelines is strongly preferred.

Technical Competencies
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • OneLake
  • SQL
  • Python/PySpark
  • Data pipelines
  • Dimensional modelling
  • Lakehouse and warehouse design
  • Power BI semantic models
  • Reconciliation and data quality
  • Data lineage
  • Access controls
  • Deployment automation
  • Capacity optimisation

title: Program Manager
description:
The MongoDB Customer Organization Portfolio Management Office (PMO) orchestrates strategic initiatives and programs that advance customer experience, functional excellence, and technology innovation. Through comprehensive portfolio governance, the PMO optimizes investments and drives value realization across MDB’s Customer priorities to accelerate enterprise growth and enable customer success.

As trusted advisors to leadership, the PMO implements data-driven frameworks that strengthen decision-making and cross-functional alignment of our most business-critical initiatives. This systematic approach to benefit tracking and resource optimization positions MongoDB to capture emerging market opportunities, maximize stakeholder value, and set new industry benchmarks.

About The Role

As "Program Manager, Customer Strategy & Operations" you’ll play a critical role as part of our PMO in the scaling of our Customer Organization.

In this role, you'll be the driving force behind a portfolio of programs and strategic initiatives, each aimed at realizing customer value, optimizing our operations, and advancing our capabilities. You'll thrive on complexity and make swift, thoughtful, data-driven decisions that balance outcomes across the function and our customer org. Your ability to anticipate obstacles, work through developing problem spaces, influence cross-functional alignment, and realize strategic outcomes will be crucial in maximizing our collective impact.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The working model for this role can be in office (3 days a week) or flexible (2 days a week).

The ideal candidate will:

  • Be a Leader: Driven by an attuned sense of priority and urgency to deliver on the right things at the right time. Orchestrate multiple, interconnected projects, programs, and portfolios to maximize long term benefits. Drive high-level decision-making that aligns program objectives with organizational goals and customer needs
  • Own the Strategy: Establish the strategic vision and maintain comprehensive governance structures for your programs. Oversee all plans, timelines, and resources to ensure cohesive delivery across the entire portfolio
  • #BuildTogether: Build credibility and earn trust in all your interactions. Lead your teams, stakeholders organizations toward simple, coherent approaches. Facilitate high-level communications and strategic forums to align your programs and portfolio across all organizational levels
  • Have a knack for looking around corners: Recognize patterns in a sea of information and take action accordingly. Anticipate program-wide risks and opportunities. Develop strategies to mitigate issues across multiple projects and programs, manage interdependencies, and capitalize on synergies within the portfolio
  • Follow the data: Understand how data contributes to better story telling. Devise compelling program-wide metrics and analytics frameworks. Leverage cross-program data to inform strategic decision-making and drive continuous improvement across the entire portfolio
  • Detest surprises: Sweep nothing under the rug. Establish clear program objectives, scope, deliverables, and roadmaps in partnership with senior leadership and key stakeholders that account for dependencies, constraints, and conflicts. Ensure alignment between individual programs and overarching portfolio goals
  • Live in the future: Take a long term position in all that you do and help others see the big picture. Develop long-term program strategies that anticipate evolving business needs. Implement scalable frameworks and best practices that elevate program management capabilities across the organization
  • Be a good human: Leave your ego at the door. Model accountability and create the structures that help cultivate it in others. Provide mentorship and guidance to teams across your programs. Foster a culture of ownership, integrity, and collaboration that spans multiple teams and departments

Requirements

  • Experience: At least 5+ years in a program or portfolio management role overseeing a portfolio of complex, interdependent programs in a technical environment. Proven track record of delivering strategic outcomes through multi-program initiatives across various methodologies
  • Communication & Consensus: Exceptional ability to articulate program vision, status, and impact to diverse audiences. Orchestrate collaboration between senior leaders, cross-functional teams, and external stakeholders to ensure program outcomes align with organizational strategy and customer needs. Skilled at influencing without authority and facilitating high-level strategic discussions to drive results
  • Adaptability: Navigate complex, evolving program landscapes. Ability to pivot program direction in response to changing business priorities while maintaining overall strategic alignment across the portfolio
  • Improvement: Implement program-wide continuous improvement initiatives. Foster a culture of innovation and efficiency across multiple programs and portfolio teams
  • Optimization: Develop and execute strategies for optimal resource allocation across the program portfolio. Balance competing priorities and interdependencies to maximize overall program impact
  • Change: Lead large-scale organizational and structural changes through strategic program and portfolio initiatives. Ensure smooth adoption of new processes, tools, or methodologies across multiple teams and departments

Success Measures

  • In 3 months you will have gained a comprehensive understanding of MongoDB's ecosystem, fully integrated into Customer and PMO processes, and begun developing a strategic roadmap for your programs and portfolio
  • In 6 months you'll have established robust program governance structures, aligned multiple projects and programs with our organizational goals, and demonstrated initial strategic impact across your portfolio
  • In 9 months you'll have identified opportunities for program-wide operational improvements, built consensus among senior stakeholders for these initiatives, and begun implementing changes that enhance overall program and portfolio effectiveness to materialize organizational value

What's In It For You

  • Mentorship & Career Growth: Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we celebrate knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to help you achieve your goals
  • Work-Life Harmony: Our team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that benefits both parts of your life. We offer flexibility and encourage you to find your own balance
  • Empowerment & Autonomy: Our team believes in empowering you to #OwnWhatYouDo and #MakeItMatter. You'll receive the support you need to achieve a high level of independence
  • Location & Flexibility: MongoDB provides multiple working model options for our employees, including the flexibility to work from home to opportunities for collaboration and social interaction in a MongoDB office. These working models may be dependent on specific roles and are mutually agreed upon between employees and their managers
  • Generous compensation package: MongoDB believes in the value our employees add to the company and we pay in the top 95th percentile. Salary is just one part of MongoDB's total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. Compensation at the time of offer is unique to each candidate based on a variety of factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location

Should I apply?

If you’re passionate about building things for the long term, are eager to learn, and willing to tackle new challenges, we encourage you to apply – even if you don't meet all the criteria listed. We value diversity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Deputy Director, People Global Operations
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

In the People function, we are inspired by our mission and are compelled by the opportunity to make an impact. Along with our partners, we take on complex challenges, continually test new approaches, and embrace change where it will facilitate the best outcome. We are on a mission to evolve how we work by pushing for greater transparency so people have access to information they need to make decisions, creating energy to support a thriving workforce, and showing respect so everyone can bring their best, authentic self to work every day.

This position will be based out of Seattle, Washington

Your Role:


As Deputy Director, People Global Operations, you will lead the delivery and continuous improvement of core People operations and services across the foundation’s global workforce. You will be accountable for ensuring that HR processes, systems, and services are efficient, consistent, compliant, and responsive to employee and organizational needs.


You will lead a team responsible for critical People operations, including employee lifecycle processes, HR systems administration, compensation operations, recruiting operations, and service delivery. Working with People leadership, IT, Legal, and regional partners, you will strengthen operational effectiveness, clarify accountability, and deliver a high-quality employee experience.


You will also lead the modernization of People operations by simplifying processes, strengthening systems, and responsibly leveraging automation and emerging technologies, including AI. Through data-informed decisions and effective change management, you will build a scalable, sustainable operating model that supports the foundation’s global mission. In a fast-changing environment where priorities and needs will continue to evolve, you will bring agility and adaptability to help your team navigate ambiguity and change.


What You'll Do:


  • Lead global People operations across employee lifecycle transactions, HRIS administration, compensation operations, recruiting operations, and related services, ensuring quality, timeliness, and clear accountability.
  • Establish service standards, service-level agreements, performance indicators, and continuous improvement practices; use operational insights and employee feedback to improve service delivery.
  • Ensure People policies, procedures, controls, and operational documentation remain current and are implemented consistently, in partnership with Legal and relevant regional and functional experts.
  • Oversee recruiting operations processes and enabling technology, including consistent workflows, platform enhancements, and vendor relationships.
  • Set priorities for People operations modernization, identifying and implementing process improvements, automation, and appropriate AI-enabled solutions with measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with IT, security, privacy, and governance stakeholders to evaluate technologies and ensure responsible use of AI and employee data.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives and change management across global locations, balancing common standards with local regulatory and operational needs.
  • Advise People and organizational leaders on operational risks, tradeoffs, resources, and decisions; anticipate downstream effects across interconnected People processes.
  • Lead, develop, and coach the team; set expectations, manage capacity, address escalated issues, and foster inclusive collaboration and accountability.
  • Oversee implementation and adoption of improvements, monitoring results and adjusting approaches to sustain service quality and organizational impact.

Your Experience:


  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, including leading teams and delivering complex operational improvements or large-scale change; global or multi-location experience strongly valued.
  • Demonstrated leadership of HR operations, shared services, HR technology-enabled service delivery, or related enterprise functions.
  • Experience working with senior leaders to evaluate options, communicate risks and tradeoffs, and support consequential decisions.
  • Experience overseeing HRIS and service management platforms; familiarity with Workday and Zendesk or comparable enterprise systems preferred.
  • Demonstrated success improving processes and implementing technology-enabled solutions, including automation; experience evaluating AI use cases and responsible adoption valued.
  • Strong understanding of HR operations, compliance considerations, and how systems, policies, and employee experiences intersect across geographies.
  • Excellent strategic problem-solving, analytical, program leadership, and change management skills, with the ability to prioritize resources and measure results.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and lead effectively across functions, cultures, and organizational levels.
  • Demonstrated adaptability and versatility in fast-changing environments; ability to guide a team through ambiguity, reset priorities when needed, and keep people energized and focused on outcomes.

Must have unrestricted work authorization in the country where this position is located. The Foundation does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (eg: H-1B, O-1, L-1, E, OPT, STEM-OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.).


The salary range for this role is $212,800 - $329,800 We recognize high-wage market differences in Seattle and Washington D.C., where our offices are located. The range for this role in these locations is $234,000 - $362,800. As a mission-driven organization, we strive to balance competitive pay with our mission. New hires salaries are typically between the range minimum and the salary range midpoint. Actual placement in the range will depend on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, and expertise, as evaluated during the interview process.

Candidate Accommodations

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you have a disability or medical condition and need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process—such as an ASL interpreter, alternative interview format, or physical accessibility support—we’re happy to help. title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

We are looking for a Senior Business Systems Analyst to join our Enterprise Business Applications – Finance, Travel, Events, and Legal Applications team within IT. The mission of our team is to unleash the power of digital platforms to better support the core work of the foundation, accelerate the achievement of our goals and amplify the impact Gates Foundation can have on the world. This specific position will focus on supporting the foundation’s Strategic Sourcing and Procurement and Finance business capabilities and related business applications.

This role will be posted 11/12/2026 to 11/30/2026.
This is a full-time position based in Seattle, WA.

Your Role
As the Senior Business Systems Analyst, you will report to the Senior Manager, Information Technology, Enterprise Business Applications and be able to work in a hybrid remote work arrangement from our Seattle, WA office. You are a curious, analytical problem solver and trusted business partner who brings hands-on Coupa expertise to design and configure solutions to support finance and procurement solutions. You will partner with Global Payments, Strategic Sourcing, and Procurement Operations to turn business needs into end-to-end solutions across Coupa and connected applications, while also serving as service desk support for our finance applications. By documenting common issues and acting on the trends you see, you will prevent problems before they start and continuously improve how our finance platforms serve the business, supporting IT’s Technology Innovation and Operational Excellence objectives in a dynamic environment.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Global Payments, Strategic Sourcing, and Procurement Operations to understand their processes, pain points, and goals, and turn them into clear requirements and end-to-end solutions that span Coupa, Microsoft D365 Finance & Operations, and Salesforce.
  • Design and configure Coupa across the source-to-pay lifecycle ([requisitions, purchase orders, invoicing, supplier management, sourcing events, contracts, and payments]), including workflows, approval chains, custom fields, forms, reports/analytics and roles and permissions.
  • Architect how data and transactions flow between Coupa and upstream and downstream applications. This includes data mapping, master data alignment (such as suppliers, accounts, and chart of accounts values), error handling, and reconciliation.
  • Own solutions from start to finish: requirements, design, configuration, integration testing across systems, user acceptance testing, release, and post-launch support.
  • Serve as service desk support for our finance applications, triaging and resolving requests and incidents in Service Now, answering user questions, and escalating to vendors or other teams when needed, with a focus on timely, clear communication to the business.
  • Act as the escalation point for complex issues that cross application boundaries, tracing a problem through the full transaction path to find the root cause and drive a durable fix rather than a workaround.
  • Document recurring issues, common questions, and known errors in a searchable knowledge base, and turn them into user guides, FAQs, and runbooks that reduce repeat tickets.
  • Analyze support trends to spot patterns early, then proactively recommend and deliver fixes such as configuration changes, workflow improvements, data cleanup, training, or process updates before small issues become big ones.
  • Evaluate the impact of Coupa release cycles on connected processes, and recommend what to adopt and when, including emerging automation and AI capabilities.
  • Help keep our controls strong by supporting segregation of duties, access reviews, and audit evidence across the connected applications.
  • Create and maintain clear documentation, including configuration records, integration designs, data flow diagrams, test scripts, and runbooks.
  • Mentor teammates and share Coupa, integration, support, and business analysis best practices across the team.


Your Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, finance, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience, plus 10+ years of experience as a business systems analyst or similar role supporting finance or procurement platforms.
  • Hands-on technical experience with Coupa. You’ve configured and designed solutions, not just administered them.
  • Experience designing solutions across integrated enterprise applications alongside Coupa, and an understanding of how a change in one system affects the others.
  • Experience providing application or service desk support for business users, including triaging requests, troubleshooting, and working with ticketing tools.
  • Communicates clearly with partners from different backgrounds, translating business needs into technical designs and technical tradeoffs into plain language.
  • Strong working knowledge of source-to-pay and payment processes and how they connect to financial accounting, and to customer and account data, along with the controls that go with them.
  • Technical depth in integrations and data (APIs, file-based interfaces, middleware, data mapping, and troubleshooting data issues across systems).
  • Analytical and proactive. Notices patterns in support requests and data, documents what you find, and acts on it to prevent problems rather than only reacting to them.
  • Strong initiative and organizational skills. Works autonomously and cross-functionally while staying flexible as priorities change.
  • Models professional courage by engaging in trust-based debate, asking hard questions, and being willing to say no.
  • Skilled at writing clear, testable user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria that capture business intent and gives the technical team what they need to deliver. Uses Jira to break down, prioritize, and track work, keeping backlogs, statuses, and dependencies current and visible to stakeholders.
  • Preferred but not required: Coupa certifications; experience administering or configuring D365 Finance & Operations or Salesforce; familiarity with integration platforms such as Boomi, global payments or bank connectivity, and audit or internal control requirements.

*Must have unrestricted work authorization in the country where this position is located. The Foundation does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (eg: H-1B, O-1, L-1, E, OPT, STEM-OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.).

The salary range for this role is $143,000 to $214,400 USD. We recognize high-wage market differences in Seattle and Washington D.C., where our offices are located. The range for this role in these locations is $157,300 to $235,900 USD. As a mission-driven organization, we strive to balance competitive pay with our mission. title: GTM Analyst
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Director, Global Total Rewards and HR Operations
description:
Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.

Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Director of Total Rewards & HR Operations to lead executive compensation, global total rewards programs, and core HR operational infrastructure for a publicly traded medical device company listed on both the U.S. Nasdaq and Australian Securities Exchange (ASX). Reporting to the VP of Human Resources, this leader will own executive compensation administration and program execution, design and oversee global merit and incentive processes, and drive operational excellence across HR systems, compliance, and employee experience platforms. This role will ensure that all compensation and HR programs are accurate, compliant, scalable, and executive-ready. This position manages a small HR operations team and works closely with executive compensation consultants, external counsel, Finance, Legal, and senior leadership.

At Anteris Technologies, you’ll join a mission-driven team dedicated to improving the lives of patients with aortic stenosis through breakthrough structural heart technologies — and help build the organizational foundation supporting that impact.

  • Oversee annual equity grant programs and new hire equity administration

  • Oversee U.S. 401(k) program administration and vendor management

  • Support development of global attendance & handbook related policies and workforce compliance records
  • Oversee US Payroll (in partnership with Finance)

Compliance & Global Employment

  • Ensure compliance across U.S. multi-state employment and international locations
  • Partner with Legal and/or Finance on employment and payroll regulatory matters
  • Maintain operational documentation and controls, SOX & employee personnel records, etc.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop 1–2 HR team members
  • Provide quality control and oversight for compensation and HR operations deliverables
  • Build bench strength and scalable processes

Skills, Knowledge, Experience & Qualifications

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or similar field
  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience with 6+ years in compensation or total rewards
  • Direct experience supporting executive compensation for a publicly traded company strongly preferred
  • Experience partnering with executive compensation consultants and securities counsel
  • Knowledge of equity administration and incentive plan design
  • Strong understanding of U.S. multi-state employment law; international exposure preferred

title: AI Commercial Strategy Associate
description:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media () focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience

  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

The Transcript Analyst II, under general supervision, plays a key role in the evaluation and processing of academic records for admissions purposes. This position involves reviewing transcripts from colleges, universities, and military sources to determine transferability of coursework and eligibility for admission. The role also includes assessing residency status and other admissions-related criteria. The analyst collaborates with academic departments, ensures compliance with institutional policies, and supports the integrity and efficiency of the admissions process through detailed documentation and communication.


The assignment for this position is expected to last approximately 12 months, with a reevaluation for extension or permanent placement at the end of the 12-month period.


A Presidential Proclamation issued on September 19, 2025, imposes a $100,000 fee on all new H‑1B petitions filed after September 21, 2025, and Texas A&M University–Central Texas will not pay this fee. Additionally, a moratorium issued by Governor Abbott on January 27, 2026, restricts the filing of new H‑1B petitions unless approved by the Texas Workforce Commission. Accordingly, if you will now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status this moratorium may affect our ability to employ you should you be selected as the final candidate. Applicants must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer.


Essential Duties and Tasks:

  • Makes initial analysis of transcripts and other admissions documentation to validate and determine eligibility for course transfer/credit.
  • Determines authenticity and viability of academic records used for admissions applications.
  • Reviews transcripts and course requirements and criteria to determine student applicant eligibility.
  • Examines, evaluates, and enters student academic records to determine admissions eligibility.
  • Performs in-depth analysis of specific application types for review by academic colleges and/or departments.
  • Provides detailed coordination with colleges on quality assurance of application packages.
  • Prepares admissions-related documents and liaises with academic colleges for review of applications.
  • Resolves complex administrative matters surrounding applicants for admissions via Email and Teams
  • Management of shared admissions inbox for applicant inquiries and document retrieval.
  • Generates and maintains reports related to admissions processing and transcript evaluation.
  • Reviews, processes, and completes or returns dynamic forms related to admissions processes. These include, but are not limited to, residency forms, general admission forms, articulation forms, and military evaluation forms.
  • Ensures accuracy and compliance with institutional policies and procedures when handling forms and reports.
  • Completes high priority admissions-related tasks according to supervisor instructions.
  • Participates in the cross-training of coworkers when needed according to supervisor instructions.
  • Participates in training to gain knowledge and stays abreast of the most current practices and policies related to undergraduate, graduate, and international admissions.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, and database applications.
  • Ability to organize work effectively, prioritize objectives, and manage time with a high level of discretion and independent judgement.
  • Excellent written communication and analytical, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently once given a project.
  • Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others.
  • Ability to work with sensitive information and maintain confidentiality.

Minimum Education and Experience:

  • Associate’s degree in applicable field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Four years or related experience.

title: Product Lead, Operational World Model
description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen, permanent resident, Asylee, or Refugee.



Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Please review the job details below.

Product Lead,
Operational World Model

Location: Westminster, CO or Herndon, VA


Vantor is shaping the future of spatial intelligence by evolving the TensorGlobe platform with an Operational World Model—a next-generation capability that creates a persistent, high-fidelity representation of the physical world by bringing together One World Terrain-grade geospatial content, high-fidelity simulation, synthetic sensor modeling, and real-time operational context. This capability provides a common environment where humans and AI can train, plan, simulate, and operate from the same shared understanding of the world.


As Product Lead, you will set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for this transformative TensorGlobe capability and lead its evolution from concept to scaled product. You will bring together terrain, simulation, autonomy, and mission systems into a scalable foundation for mission rehearsal, AI development, operational planning, and multi-domain decision making. You will shape the product strategy, build alignment across teams and customers, and guide the choices that turn an emerging capability into a differentiated product and durable business.


Working across Engineering, Go to Market, Communications, and customers, you will shape TensorGlobe’s evolution to address emerging defense priorities while expanding opportunities across international government and commercial markets. You will define a new generation of operational world modeling capabilities that bridge today’s geospatial intelligence with tomorrow’s AI-enabled operational environments.


We’re looking for a product leader with an entrepreneurial mindset and a track record of turning an emerging opportunity into a product customers value, from shaping the initial concept through launch and adoption. Experience founding a venture, building a new product line, or creating a new product within an established organization is especially valuable. We’re particularly interested in leaders from robotics, autonomy, industrial automation, or other fields where data and models of the physical world help people and machines make decisions and take action. Experience in geospatial or Earth observation brings a valuable perspective to this work.


This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET U.S. Government security clearance.

First 90 Days

Your first 90 days will focus on establishing a clear, evidence-based product thesis for the Operational World Model: which customers and missions it should serve, what problems it should solve, how it will create distinctive value, and it evolves TensorGlobe. You’ll build the understanding and alignment needed to turn that thesis into focused product priorities.

  • First 30 days: Build a grounded view of TensorGlobe’s capabilities, technical direction, customer commitments, product portfolio, and market opportunities. Listen to customers and internal teams across Product, Engineering, Go to Market, Capture, and Program Management.
  • By 60 days: Develop and test an initial product thesis with customers and stakeholders. Clarify priority users and missions, unmet needs, the roles of terrain, simulation, sensor modeling, and operational context, and the assumptions that need validation. Survey emerging technologies in world modeling, simulation, synthetic data, autonomy, and AI, and assess how they could shape product differentiation and roadmap choices.
  • By 90 days: Align stakeholders on the product thesis and its implications: target customers, priority use cases, differentiated value, initial capability priorities, and a practical plan to validate demand and guide the roadmap.

Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for TensorGlobe’s Operational World Model, evolving the platform beyond geospatial data into a persistent operational representation of the physical world. Identify the technologies, markets, and strategic partnerships that can extend it into new domains, and develop the business case, target customer segments, and adoption paths.
  • Lead the convergence of One World Terrain, simulation, synthetic sensor modeling, autonomy, and operational context into a unified capability that enables humans and AI to train, plan, and operate from a common world model.
  • Translate operational challenges from defense, international government, and commercial customers into scalable product capabilities, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
  • Drive product requirements for world modeling capabilities, including terrain and 3D content, dynamic world state, sensor modeling, simulation fidelity, interoperability, and real-time services.
  • Partner with Raptor, Forge, Operational Terrain, Go to Market, and Capture teams to align on customer and mission needs, prioritize high-value use cases, and support customer engagements, demonstrations, proposals, and product positioning. Translate those opportunities into roadmap-aligned capabilities for mission rehearsal, digital engineering, AI development, operational planning, and multi-domain decision making.
  • Represent the product vision with executive leadership, customers, industry partners, and government stakeholders, serving as the internal and external champion for TensorGlobe’s Operational World Model.
  • Lead product development from opportunity discovery and customer validation through product definition, launch, adoption, and continued evolution. Establish clear outcomes, make tradeoffs, and keep teams focused on delivering customer value.
  • Build and align a cross-functional product effort across engineering, design, data, operations, Go to Market, and program teams; influence senior stakeholders and create the conditions for teams to move quickly through ambiguity.
  • Create a practical path from world-model concepts to real operational use, including how physical-world data, changing conditions, simulation, and sensor representations support planning, training, evaluation, and action by people and autonomous systems.
  • Use customer evidence, operational workflows, and real-world performance to validate product direction and guide iteration, including the relationship between simulated environments and the systems or settings they represent.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Substantial experience leading products or product portfolios, with a track record of setting strategy and delivering outcomes across complex, cross-functional organizations.
  • Experience in one or more domains where digital representations, sensor data, simulation, or models of the physical world inform decisions or actions by physical systems. Relevant backgrounds include robotics, autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, aerospace, maritime, logistics, energy, or defense technology. Experience in geospatial intelligence or Earth observation is welcome but not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex operational or customer requirements into product strategy, roadmaps, and technical requirements.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing engineering, business, and customer stakeholders without direct authority; able to align senior leaders around priorities and tradeoffs.
  • Strong understanding of modern software platforms, cloud-native architectures, APIs, and data-driven product development.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive presentations and customer engagement.
  • Ability to travel up to approximately 20–30% in support of customers, partners, and industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance; U.S. citizen with clean background.
  • Strongly preferred: a demonstrated record of entrepreneurial product creation, such as founding a company or taking a new product, product line, or business from concept through launch and adoption. Comparable 0-to-1 ownership within a larger company is also valued.
  • Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, industrial automation, digital twins, simulation, sensor modeling, or AI-enabled systems that interact with or operate in the physical world.
  • Experience with One World Terrain, geospatial production pipelines, 3D visualization, game engines, or modeling and simulation technologies.
  • Familiarity with AI, autonomy, robotics, synthetic sensor modeling, digital engineering, or operational AI workflows.
  • Knowledge of interoperability standards and defense simulation ecosystems, including DIS, HLA, OGC standards, or related technologies.
  • Experience working with U.S. Department of Defense, allied and international government organizations, or commercial organizations applying geospatial and operational technologies.
  • Experience launching platform capabilities that serve multiple products, markets, or customer segments.
