title: Director of Development
description:
About Understood

Understood is a nonprofit helping millions of people navigate the realities of neurodivergence. We translate trusted knowledge about ADHD, dyslexia, and dyscalculia into clear guidance, practical tools, and community support — so people don’t just feel informed, they feel understood.

Having a shared commitment to our values is a key factor in any hire we make. We have five core values:

  1. Continuously learn.
  2. Act with intention.
  3. Champion difference.
  4. Inspire change.
  5. Grow together.

Come be part of an organization with an entrepreneurial spirit that’s working toward a future where people can navigate neurodivergence with clarity, in a world that truly understands them.

To learn more about Understood, please visit:

Who you are

Advancement at Understood brings together two complementary capabilities: Development, which leads revenue-generating partnerships across Major Giving, Institutional Giving, Corporate Partnerships, and Community Giving, and Public Partnerships, which builds strategic relationships that expand our reach, credibility, and impact.

Reporting to our Vice President of Advancement, the Director of Development leads the Development capability with accountability for its strategy, revenue growth, team performance, and operations. As Understood works to significantly expand outside funding, you'll translate organizational priorities into an integrated fundraising strategy, strengthen and diversify revenue streams, and build the capabilities needed for sustainable growth.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned fundraising leader with experience across multiple revenue pathways and particular expertise in scaling digital fundraising and corporate partnerships. You bring a track record of growing revenue, converting audience engagement into donor support, growing recurring giving and developing high performing teams.You combine strategic judgment with operational discipline and know how to turn ambitious goals into measurable results.

This is a hybrid role that requires a minimum of three (3) days a week in our NYC office, with a focus on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. We are a Mac-based environment, and team members are provided a Mac laptop for their work. Some travel may be required.

What you'll do

  • Lead day-to-day fundraising across four revenue pathways. Lead five (5) direct reports across Major Giving, Institutional Giving, Corporate Partnerships, Community Giving, and Development Operations.
  • Set and execute an integrated Development strategy: Coach revenue leads as they develop and execute pathway-specific strategies. . Provide oversight and connect those strategies into one development plan that moves donors across pathways, using events and activations to deepen relationships and drive revenue.
  • Build a diversified, growing revenue base: Grow funding that helps Understood scale its reach and impact, not just cover operating costs. Guide revenue leads in delivering results across four pathways:
    • Major Giving: Grow the pipeline of prospects; strengthen donor cultivation and stewardship; and launch a planned giving program.
    • Institutional Giving: Deepen institutional funder relationships, develop compelling cases for support across issue areas, and strengthen proposal quality.
    • Corporate Partnerships: Scale revenue-generating corporate and brand partnerships that leverage Understood's reach and expertise across workplace initiatives, sponsorships, universal design and entertainment. Establish criteria for evaluating partnership opportunities and investment priorities.
    • Community Giving: Scale digital fundraising by converting Understood's audience into donors, strengthening acquisition, conversion, and retention, and building a robust recurring giving program. In collaboration with the Head of Community Giving, partner with Digital, Product, Content, Engineering, and Marketing to test and expand what works, as needed.
  • Build and lead a high-performing Development team: Directly manage pathway leads with varied experience levels. Set clear expectations, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and make staffing, structure, and resourcing decisions aligned with Development priorities.
  • Strengthen donor pipeline and relationship management: Establish consistent approaches to prospecting, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship. Guide high-value funding opportunities and strengthen coordination across pathways to advance donor relationships.
  • Strengthen Development operations and effectiveness: Set priorities for CRM and giving platforms, data quality, and operational practices. Use performance insights and relevant benchmarks to improve donor retention, conversion, fundraising efficiency, and decision-making.
  • Own Development financial planning and performance: Own Development budgeting, revenue forecasting, and performance management. Use financial and pipeline data to evaluate progress, anticipate risks, allocate resources, and inform strategic decisions.
  • Partner across a matrixed organization: Work closely with Marketing, Content, Product, Programs, and Finance to build compelling cases for support and reach the people we serve. Influence cross-functional priorities, connect fundraising opportunities to organizational strategy, and foster a culture of philanthropy across Understood.

Minimum qualifications

In this role, you bring leadership experience and the ability to set direction across development. You own team-level priorities, manage multiple direct reports, including hiring and resourcing decisions, own the team budget, and communicate directly with the leadership and executive leadership teams.

We don't expect a perfect match across every category. What matters is relevant experience, genuine interest in the work, and a mindset for growth

Leadership and people

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in nonprofit fundraising, including 3+ years leading a fundraising team or area of the business in a fast-moving or complex environment. You have owned team-level revenue goals and delivered results that had an impact across the organization.
  • People leadership and development: You manage multiple direct reports. You make decisions on hiring, team structure, and resourcing for the team. You coach and develop people. You build a culture where people feel they belong, stay engaged, and hold themselves accountable. You keep the team motivated through change and resistance.
  • Stakeholder and cross-functional partnership: You work effectively with leaders in other functions, with senior leaders, and with direct reports. You make tradeoffs across teams when priorities compete. You build strong working relationships up, down, and across the organization, including in a hybrid setting.

Strategy, execution, and data

  • Fundraising expertise: You know the fundamentals of Major Giving and Institutional Giving, with deep expertise in digital fundraising and corporate partnerships. You are fluent in moves management, prospecting, pitching, and giving platform optimization. You are recognized as a go-to source on fundraising within your organization and increasingly known in the field.
  • Fundraising events and activations: You have experience planning and executing events that attract new donors, deepen existing relationships and drive revenue.
  • Strategic thinking and execution: You turn company strategy into clear plans and priorities. You balance long-term thinking with getting work done day-to-day. You adjust the plan when conditions change.
  • Project management: You plan and run multiple projects across the team and functions. You set clear milestones, manage risk, and keep the team on track to deliver.
  • Data and analytics: You develop insights to shape strategy and priorities. You decide what data is needed. You use analysis, including nonprofit industry benchmarks, to test ideas and make better decisions.

Communication, collaboration, and technology fluency

  • Communication: You communicate clearly and confidently with leadership and executive leadership teams, peer leaders, direct reports, and external partners, including funders. You adapt the message to the audience. You build trust through consistent, inclusive communication.
  • Collaboration and ways of working: You work collaboratively without letting hierarchy or personal credit drive decisions. You work with integrity, emotional awareness, and resilience through change. You advocate for users, employees, and the organization in decision-making.
  • AI fluency: You use AI tools to improve the team’s output, speed, or decisions. You know where AI adds value at the team and function level. You set expectations for how the team uses it responsibly.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience at a large nonprofit (50+ staff) with multiple funding streams
  • Corporate experience, such as in corporate social responsibility, partnerships, or business development
  • Experience leading in a matrixed organization, where you influence teams you don’t directly manage
  • A track record of scaling a fundraising program, such as launching a new revenue pathway or significantly growing an existing one
  • Hands-on experience with a fundraising CRM and digital giving platforms
  • Personal or professional connection to the neurodivergent community, or to disability, education, or workforce causes

The base salary range for this role is minimum $215,000–$235,000 maximum, depending on years of experience and qualifications. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports wellness for our team members and their families. You can learn more about our benefits and offerings.

Understood.org does not sponsor applicants for work visas or legal permanent residence, including providing assistance with OPT extensions.

Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

Understood encourages individuals of all learning styles and ethnic, racial, and socioeconomic backgrounds, including those whose life experiences may include the challenge of access due to a disability, to apply for this position. We are committed to maximizing the diversity of our organization, as we want to engage all those who can contribute to supporting this work.

Understood is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applications without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, alienage or citizenship status, marital or familial status, domestic partnership status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, change of sex or transgender status, genetic information, medical condition, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, physical or mental disability (where the applicant or employee is qualified to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation), any protected military or veteran status, or status as a victim of domestic or dating violence, sexual assault or offense, stalking, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local law or that of persons with whom that individual associates, or any other legally protected characteristics.

For additional information on learning and thinking differences, including ADD/ADHD, dyslexia, dyscalculia, dysgraphia, dyspraxia, executive function challenges, nonverbal learning disabilities, processing issues, and more, please visit .

title: Patient Services Liaison
location: HM Texas Medical Center - Scurlock Tower
description:
At Houston Methodist, the Patient Services Liaison (PSL) position serves as the foundational intake and coordination role within Houston Methodist Global Patient Services, supporting international patients and special constituencies at the entry point of their care journey. This position is primarily responsible for managing initial inquiries, conducting intake assessments, gathering required clinical and administrative documentation, and ensuring accurate and timely case creation within internal systems.
The PSL position triages incoming requests, identifies service needs, and coordinates the collection of medical records, insurance information, and authorization requirements. This position creates and maintains patient charts, verifies basic demographic and insurance information, and ensures intake materials are complete and ready for clinical review and coordination.
Working as a support to the Patient Services Specialist (PSS), the PSL position provides structured case preparation and handoff support, facilitating access to care and initiating scheduling processes, complex coordination, care navigation, and barrier resolution which are escalated to the PSS and Medical Director, who provides advanced oversight and decision-making. This position serves as a key communication link between patients, brokers, in-country liaisons, physicians, guarantors, and internal teams during the intake phase, ensuring timely responses and efficient case progression. The PSL position supports insurance verification, financial clearance preparation, and initial appointment coordination. In addition, this position ensures accurate data entry, maintains compliant documentation standards, and organizes all intake materials for seamless transition to the PSS. The PSL position enables efficient downstream coordination and supports a high-quality patient experience through structured intake and preparation of cases for advanced management.

FLSA STATUS
Exempt

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION
  • Bachelor’s degree or an additional four years of relevant experience (in addition to the minimum experience required below) in lieu of degree

EXPERIENCE
  • Three years of experience in a hospital setting, preferably within a patient services environment

KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES
  • Demonstrates the skills and competencies necessary to safely perform the assigned job, determined through ongoing skills, competency assessments, and performance evaluations
  • Sufficient proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing the English language necessary to perform the essential functions of this job, especially with regard to activities impacting patient or employee safety or security
  • Ability to effectively communicate with patients, physicians, family members and co-workers in a manner consistent with a customer service focus and application of positive language principles
  • Proficiency in oral and written Spanish or Arabic
  • Good medical/clinical assessment skills and proficient medical terminology
  • Comprehensive knowledge of physician referral protocol and hospital policies and procedures


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for patients, families, physicians, guarantors, embassies, government agencies, referral sources, and internal stakeholders, ensuring a professional, compassionate, culturally sensitive, and service-oriented experience.
  • Maintains ongoing communication and collaboration with clinic leadership, physicians, nursing staff, ancillary departments, third-party payors, and international stakeholders to support timely case review, care coordination, continuity of care, and patient satisfaction.
  • Provides patient orientation, education, and ongoing guidance throughout the continuum of care, ensuring patients and families understand processes, expectations, available resources, and care plans.

SERVICE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Manages incoming patient inquiries and service requests by assessing medical and non-medical needs, triaging cases, collecting required documentation, and facilitating timely coordination and resolution of services.
  • Coordinates intake, scheduling, and expedited access for consultations, appointments, procedures, ancillary services, and specialized transportation or travel-related logistics, including air ambulance arrangements when applicable.
  • Initiates and maintains patient records by creating charts, obtaining medical records and authorizations, verifying insurance information, and ensuring clinical documentation and imaging are accurately uploaded into the electronic medical record.
  • Collaborates with the Medical Director, physicians, and multidisciplinary clinical teams to review complex cases, coordinate services, and ensure seamless patient care delivery.
  • Serves as a liaison for government-sponsored and internationally funded patients by coordinating approvals, sponsorship documentation, authorizations, and communication with embassies, government agencies, guarantors, insurance brokers, and third-party payors.

QUALITY/SAFETY ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Ensures accuracy, completeness, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance of patient records and documentation in accordance with organizational policies, departmental workflows, and HIPAA requirements.
  • Identifies, communicates, and escalates patient concerns, barriers to care, urgent clinical matters, and operational issues to appropriate leadership and care teams in a timely manner.
  • Supports safe, efficient, and high-quality care coordination by ensuring all required records, imaging, approvals, authorizations, and documentation are available prior to appointments and procedures.

FINANCE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Verifies insurance eligibility, benefits, financial clearance requirements, and sponsorship approvals to support timely reimbursement.
  • Supports operational and financial efficiency through proactive case management, scheduling coordination, resource utilization, and completion of required financial and clinical documentation prior to services.

GROWTH/INNOVATION ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Contributes to process improvement, workflow development, and service initiatives designed to enhance patient access, care coordination, operational efficiency, and patient experience for international patients and special constituents.
  • Supports department growth and continuous improvement through relationship building, cross-functional collaboration, training participation, adoption of evolving technologies and processes, and promotion of best practices in patient services.


SUPPLEMENTAL REQUIREMENTS
    WORK ATTIRE
    • Uniform: No
    • Scrubs: No
    • Business professional: Yes
    • Other (department approved): No

    ON-CALL*
    *Note that employees may be required to be on-call during emergencies (ie. Disaster, Severe Weather Events, etc) regardless of selection below.
    • On Call* No

    TRAVEL**
    **Travel specifications may vary by department**
    • May require travel within the Houston Metropolitan area No
    • May require travel outside Houston Metropolitan area No



Work Shift:

1 - Day (United States of America)



Job Category:

Non-clinical

Houston Methodist is one of the nation’s leading health systems and academic medical centers. The health system consists of eight hospitals: Houston Methodist Hospital, its flagship academic hospital in the Texas Medical Center, seven community hospitals and one long-term acute care hospital throughout the Greater Houston metropolitan area. Houston Methodist also includes a research institute; a comprehensive residency program; international patient services; freestanding comprehensive care clinics, emergency care and imaging centers; and outpatient facilities. Come lead with us!


Houston Methodist is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Commercial Finance Business Partner
description:
Job Description:

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Finance Business Partner to join our Finance team, with primary responsibility for supporting the Creative business.

You will work closely with the CEO, COO and senior stakeholders to help them understand financial performance, identify risks and opportunities and make better commercial decisions. You will also need to be comfortable getting into the details, understanding what sits behind the numbers and solving problems when something does not look right.

Alongside your core business partnering responsibilities, you will support wider Finance priorities. These could include financial control, operational finance, process improvement, automation or finance transformation.

There will be regular responsibilities and deadlines, but also projects and problems that we cannot predict today. We are looking for someone who enjoys that variety, takes ownership and is willing to get involved.


What you'll be doing

As Finance Business Partner, you will:

· Partner with the Creative business, building strong relationships with senior leaders and other key stakeholders.

· Lead budgeting and forecasting and provide clear insight into business performance.

· Help stakeholders understand revenue, costs and profitability, including the underlying drivers behind performance.

· Identify financial risks and opportunities and work with the business to address them.

· Provide financial and commercial challenge to support better decision-making.

· Support business cases, commercial decisions and ad hoc financial analysis.

· Play an active role in month-end, working with the wider Finance team to ensure financial performance is accurately reported and understood.

· Investigate financial issues and work across teams to get them resolved.

· Translate financial information into clear, practical insight for non-finance stakeholders.

· Support improvements to financial processes, reporting and controls.

· Contribute to wider Finance projects, including operational finance, financial control, automation and finance transformation.


What we're looking for

We are looking for someone with meaningful practical finance experience who is already comfortable operating independently in a commercial environment.

You will ideally:

· Be a fully qualified accountant, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent.

· Have significant practical experience in commercial finance, business partnering, FP&A or a similarly broad finance role.

· Possess strong accounting fundamentals combined with good commercial judgement.

· Be comfortable working directly with senior stakeholders and constructively challenging their assumptions.

· Be able to move between detailed financial analysis and the bigger commercial picture.

· Understand a P&L and be curious about the operational and commercial drivers behind it.

· Be comfortable managing regular deadlines alongside ad hoc requests and changing priorities.

· Take ownership of problems and follow them through to resolution.

· Be proactive and naturally curious.

· Look for ways to improve tasks and processes rather than simply accepting existing processes.

· Have strong Excel and financial analysis skills.


What will make you successful?

Experience matters in this role.

We do not expect you to know everything on day one, but we do expect you to have enough experience to know what questions to ask, where to look and when something does not make sense.

You will be comfortable working independently, but equally comfortable working across teams and functions to help the business achieve its goals.

Most importantly, you will combine strong financial fundamentals with commercial curiosity and a willingness to get involved. You should be as comfortable getting into the details of an issue as you are discussing the bigger picture with a senior stakeholder.


What does dentsu offer?

  • A culture of Innovation and Radical Collaboration;
  • At dentsu media, we are passionate about fostering a culture of innovation, where creativity, exploration, and experimentation are encouraged. We believe that by pushing the boundaries of what's possible, we can deliver groundbreaking solutions for our clients and shape the future of media and marketing;
  • Immerse yourself in a dynamic and inspiring environment where modern media solutions, innovation and radical collaboration are at the heart of everything we do;
  • Not only is it an incredibly fun place to work but as part of a multinational organization there are many opportunities to advance your career within the wider business once you have proven yourself.
  • Hybrid Work Model: Work from home (40%) and join us in our buzzing Amsterdam office (60%) with coffee, water views and good vibes;
  • Career Path: Clear growth opportunities within a global agency network;
  • People-First Culture: Be part of a diverse, supportive team that values authenticity, curiosity, and collaboration;
  • Fun and Culture: At dentsu we believe in being a force for good! This includes volunteering days and offsites, to team celebrations. We believe in building strong connections while doing great work together;
  • 30 paid days off per year, including 25 flexible days and 5 fixed dentsu holidays. This also includes 3 mental well-being days, as we prioritize your mental health and personal balance. Plus, you get 2 additional days off for volunteering, so you can give back to causes that matter to you.

And if you don’t tick every box just yet, no worries, let’s have a chat and explore how we can support your growth through learning and development.

Inclusion and Diversity

At dentsu, we strive for an inclusive and empowering workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive. Where everyone is welcome and safe to bring their full authentic self to work and feel empowered to speak out.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
United States of America (Exempt)

POSITION SUMMARY

Under general direction of the City Engineer, plans, directs, and supervises engineering staff in the planning, design, and construction oversight of the City's Capital Improvement Program (streets, drainage, water, and wastewater). Manages professional engineering personnel and consulting firms; serves as a key technical liaison to internal departments, regulatory agencies, City Council, and the public; assists in departmental budget preparation; and provides leadership in maintaining and optimizing City infrastructure systems.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Management reserves the right to add, modify, change, or rescind the work assignments of different positions and to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Supervises, manages, and mentors professional and technical engineering staff; assigns project portfolios, conducts performance evaluations, and supports ongoing professional development.
  • Oversees the development, design, and execution of municipal infrastructure projects (paving, drainage, water, and wastewater) to ensure compliance with City standards, schedules, and budgets.
  • Manages the procurement, negotiation, and administration of professional services agreements, consultant contracts, and construction contracts; monitors consultant performance and deliverables.
  • Directs and conducts reviews of construction plans, engineering studies, technical specifications, and bid documents for conformance with City ordinances, NCTCOG standards, and sound engineering principles.
  • Monitors construction activities, reviews pay estimates, evaluates proposed change orders, resolves field design conflicts, and facilitates final project acceptance and warranty closeout.
  • Conducts public meetings and engages with property owners, neighborhood groups, and external stakeholders regarding project impacts, right-of-way/easement acquisitions, and capital improvements.
  • Represents the City before regulatory and partner agencies including TxDOT, TCEQ, USACE, FEMA, and Denton County for permitting, interlocal agreements, and project alignment.
  • Prepares agenda items, staff reports, and technical recommendations; delivers presentations to the City Council, Planning and Zoning Commission, and advisory boards.
  • Assists the City Engineer with annual department budgeting, long-range infrastructure master planning, and capital forecasting.
  • Regulatory & Annexation Support: Oversees special municipal engineering studies, hydraulic analyses, and boundary/mapping reviews for annexation and de-annexation proceedings.
  • Performs all other related duties as assigned.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor of Science degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET-accredited college or university.

Experience: Ten (10) years of progressively responsible civil engineering or municipal construction management experience, including at least three 3 years in a supervisory or project team leadership role.

Any combination of related, education, experience, certifications, and licenses that will result in a candidate successfully performing the essential functions of the job is an acceptable substitute for the above specified education and experience requirements.


Licenses and Certifications: Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) in the State of Texas (or possession of a valid out-of-state PE license with the ability to obtain Texas licensure within six (6) months of hire); Certified Floodplain Manager (CFM) certification preferred; Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.

Conditions of Employment: Must submit to and pass a criminal background and pre-employment drug test.

Other Requirements: Must possess a valid State of Texas Driver’s License Class “C” and good driving record as defined by City policy. This position is required to drive. This position is subject to emergency operations. The individual holding this position will be required to work as usual or as needed: during emergency operations, in preparation for prolonged emergency operations and/ or during recovery from prolonged emergency operations as directed by their direct supervisor, Department Head or designee, or the City Manager or designee.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

Knowledge of: Advanced civil engineering principles, design practices, and construction management techniques related to municipal roadways, traffic, drainage, water, and wastewater infrastructure; supervisory principles, performance management, workload allocation, and team development; federal, state, and local laws, codes, and standards, including TxDOT design specifications, NCTCOG Public Works standards, TDLR/ADA accessibility guidelines, and FEMA floodplain regulations; public procurement, professional service contract negotiation, and construction dispute resolution; and the Texas Open Meetings Act and Public Information Act requirements relevant to municipal operations.

Skilled in: Analyzing complex civil engineering data, and making sound engineering determinations; Working collaboratively and respectfully with diverse populations, community partners, and municipal stakeholders; Leading, mentoring, and coordinating professional and technical staff; interpreting and applying City requirements of development ordinances; communicating tactfully and effectively with the general public, City employees at all levels of the organization, and a wide variety of people; technical fields related to design of roads, drainage, and water and sewer facilities; using a personal computer including Microsoft Office, Open Office or similar word processing programs, e-mail and the internet; accepting responsibility for his/her actions; performing work accurately and thoroughly; following instructions, safety practices, and standard operating procedures in performing assigned tasks; communicating effectively, clearly, and concisely both orally and in writing; being punctual and attending work regularly; and working effectively with people regardless of their race, sex, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetics, or job type.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions: This is primarily a sedentary office classification although standing in work areas and walking between work areas may be required. Finger dexterity is needed to access, enter, and retrieve data using a computer keyboard or calculator and to operate standard office equipment; vision to read printed materials and a computer screen; hearing and speech to communicate in person and over the telephone. Positions in this classification occasionally bend, stoop, kneel, reach, push, and pull drawers open and closed to retrieve and file information. Employees must possess the ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and objects weighing up to 25 pounds.

Employees work in an office environment with moderate noise levels, controlled temperature conditions, and no direct exposure to hazardous physical substances. Employees may interact with upset staff and/or public and private representatives in interpreting and enforcing departmental policies and procedures. Employees work partially in the field and may be exposed to loud noise levels, cold and/or hot temperatures, inclement weather conditions, road and/or land hazards, confining workspace, chemicals, mechanical and/or electrical hazards, and hazardous physical substances and fumes.


The City of Lewisville has reviewed this job description to ensure that essential functions and basic duties have been included. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills, and abilities, which may be required. title: Product Manager - Cards
location: India; Jakarta, Indonesia; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Singapore, Singapore
description:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

About the Job

At Xendit, we are seeking a Product Manager - Cards to help shape and scale our card acquiring product. You will join our growing cards team, working closely with our existing Cards product lead and reporting to the Product Director, Payments Acceptance. In this role, you will own card acquiring initiatives end to end, from authorisation and processing flows to connections with acquirers and card schemes, and help define our acquiring strategy, including licensing and acquirer partnerships. You will also work to improve authorisation rates and manage chargebacks and settlement.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, or a strong track record in card products, with a strong focus on execution and strategy
  • Hands-on card acquiring experience, ideally at a card acquirer processing Visa and Mastercard transactions
  • Ability to independently own card acquiring initiatives from day one
  • Technical fluency to understand how payment systems work together (e.g. APIs, authorisation and settlement flows)
  • Experience working across multiple regions and regulatory jurisdictions
  • Metrics-minded, having owned key metrics for your product area (e.g. authorisation rate, TPV, margin)
  • Experience building B2B products or integrating B2B offerings

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience launching global products
  • Clear understanding of card economics (e.g. interchange, scheme fees, acquiring margin)
  • Experience partnering with card schemes (Visa, Mastercard) from the acquirer side
  • Experience with card licensing or connecting to new acquirers

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve card acquiring and processing flows, including authorisation, capture and refunds
  • Manage and expand Xendit's connections to acquirers and card schemes (Visa, Mastercard)
  • Help shape Xendit's acquiring strategy, including licensing and acquirer partnerships
  • Improve authorisation rates and manage chargeback and settlement performance
  • Define and own key metrics for your area, such as authorisation rate, TPV and margin
  • Spend time with merchants to understand their card payment needs and turn them into clear product requirements
  • Partner with Engineering, Risk, Finance and commercial teams to deliver card products on time and to a high standard

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer with strong AWS and banking sector experience to join its engineering team in the UAE. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimising scalable Lakehouse data architectures and pipelines that support enterprise analytics and machine learning applications. This role requires strong expertise in AWS data services, Databricks, distributed data processing, and modern data engineering practices, alongside an understanding of financial datasets, banking regulations, and enterprise data governance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Data Architecture: Design, develop, and maintain scalable Lakehouse architectures using Databricks and Delta Lake on AWS.
  • Data Pipeline Development: Build and optimise batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, PySpark, SQL, and Apache Kafka to process financial and transactional data.
  • AWS Infrastructure: Develop and manage data solutions using AWS services, including S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, and Athena.
  • Performance Optimisation: Improve data processing efficiency, query performance, and storage utilisation through partitioning, indexing, and distributed processing techniques.
  • Machine Learning Integration: Collaborate with data science and MLOps teams to develop feature engineering pipelines, manage experiments using MLflow, and support model deployment through AWS SageMaker.
  • Data Governance and Security: Implement data access controls, encryption, monitoring, and audit mechanisms in line with banking security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Apply Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform and manage CI/CD pipelines through GitHub Actions or AWS CodePipeline.
  • Software Engineering Practices: Develop clean, maintainable, and well-tested Python code while following version control and development best practices.
  • Client Collaboration: Engage with client stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand technical requirements, present proposed solutions, and communicate architectural decisions effectively.
Required Qualifications and Experience
  • Proven experience in data engineering within banking, financial services, or fintech environments.
  • Strong understanding of financial datasets, transactional systems, and banking data governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with AWS data services, particularly S3, Glue, EMR, and Redshift.
  • Strong experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, and Apache Kafka for large-scale data processing.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Lakehouse architectures using Databricks and Delta Lake.
  • Solid understanding of data modelling, schema evolution, ACID transactions, and data warehousing principles.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience with Scala is an advantage.
  • Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), Terraform, and Git-based workflows.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
  • AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Data Engineer or AWS Solutions Architect.
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer certification.
  • Experience with real-time data processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Spark Structured Streaming.
  • Exposure to streaming analytics use cases, including fraud detection and trade processing.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or Prefect.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining production-grade data and machine learning solutions.
Core Competencies
  • Client-Facing Communication: Confidence in engaging with senior stakeholders and presenting technical solutions.
  • Business Acumen: Ability to understand business challenges and connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes.
  • Solution Ownership: Ability to take ownership of technical deliverables and advocate for effective engineering approaches.
  • Collaboration: Strong ability to work across engineering, data science, and business teams.
  • Presentation Skills: Confidence in explaining, demonstrating, and articulating the value of proposed technology solutions.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

What do we promise:

We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups. At InMobi, you get food for your body, soul, and mind with daily meals, gym, and yoga classes, cutting-edge training and tools. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.

What will you be doing?

  • Analyze and interpret complex datasets to derive insights that improve product performance and advertiser outcomes
  • Support product decision-making by providing data-driven insights and recommendations.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify new features and signals that improve the DS models
  • Develop and implement performance measurement frameworks for A/B testing, feature rollouts, and model evaluations
  • Partner with Product, Data science, Engineering & Business teams and ensure we drive actual business value
  • Build AI-based/agentic frameworks for recurring analyses and drive their adoption within Product & Analytics teams

What are we looking for?
Skills and Attributes:

  • Exceptional ability to collaborate with stakeholder teams ( Product, DS, Engineering, Business) to prioritize and deliver innovative solutions across projects.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information and analysis results effectively to technical and less technical stakeholders
  • Have an interest in data, metrics, analysis, and trends from the mindset of helping a customer-centric business. Know when to apply statistical measurement vs 80-20 analysis for business growth.
  • Strong foundation in statistics and predictive modeling, including A/B testing.
  • 4+ years of overall work experience within a Tech/Analytics/Start ups
  • 3+ years of relevant experience as a product analyst, business analyst or statistical analyst role
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, Advanced Excel, and proficiency with AI/agentic tool building

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

title: Go-To-Market Consultant

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: IT and Admin Officer, SHOTORKO project
description:
POSITION TITLE: IT and Admin Officer, SHOTORKO project

LOCATION: Dhaka, Bangladesh

DEPARTMENT: Human Rights and Empowerment

STATUS: Full-time; contingent upon continuation of donor funding

REPORTS TO: Grants, Procurement, and Operation Manager

GENERAL

Winrock International is a nonprofit organization that works with people in the United States and around the world to empower the disadvantaged, increase economic opportunity, and sustain natural resources. Since the 1980s, Winrock has been working, in partnership with the government of Bangladesh, to strengthen agriculture, aquaculture, trade, safe migration, and natural resource management sectors. Its work also protects human rights and expands inclusive access to economic opportunities.

The U.S. Department of State-funded Strengthening Anti-Human Trafficking Responses for Online Recruitment into Criminal Operations (SHOTORKO) will address trafficking in persons for forced criminality in Bangladesh by strengthening capacities to investigate and prosecute online scamming crimes; improving survivor protection; increasing victim identification and support services to prevent re-victimization; combatting fraudulent recruitment raising awareness and improving online safeguards; and facilitating private-sector partnerships.

Winrock International is recruiting an IT and Admin Officer (IAO) for the SHOTORKO project. The IAO will support the project’s overall objective to combat trafficking of Bangladeshis for forced criminality (FC) in online scam operations (OSOs). The project will do so by:

  • Strengthening Bangladeshi stakeholder capacities and institutions to investigate and prosecute trafficking in persons (TIP) for FC in OSOs;
  • Improving the identification, support, and referrals of TIP for FC in OSOs survivors to tailored protection care reinforcing repatriation, reintegration, and avoiding revictimization;
  • Combatting and preventing fraudulent, deceptive employment recruitment for OSOs, increasing awareness of TIP OSO, improving online safeguards; and
  • Building effective, durable partnerships that disrupt TIP and reduce OSO expansion.

This is a local/national position and is not eligible for international allowances or relocation allowances.

POSITION SUMMARY

The IAO will manage information technology (IT) and overall administration for the SHOTORKO project to support the SHOTORKO team and the project’s outcomes. The IAO will work under the supervision of the Grants, Procurement, and Operation Manager and closely with the Senior Accountant and the Director of Finance, Grants, and Administration.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The IAO will oversee all IT and administrative services and support basic programmatic functions. The IAO will also maintain organized records and documentation in line with the policies and procedures of Winrock International, the US Department of State, and local laws and regulations. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

IT Support

  • Develop, implement, and maintain IT systems, networks, and databases;
  • Manage Web-based MIS database, ensure the quality of data, and report on them in coordination with the Head of MERL, Communication, and Partnership;
  • Prepare automated dashboard as needed using Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Excel), Power BI, and other software;
  • Assist in developing automated reports and databases using MS Excel and MS Access;
  • Coordinate high level web-based meetings using MS Teams;
  • Maintain computer networks, IT administration, and Internet troubleshooting;
  • Set up cloud services including OneDrive, SharePoint, Outlook, and MS Teams;
  • Maintain and manage the local shared file server and backup regularly;
  • Set up email accounts and profiles for new users and resolve password issues;
  • Support field staff and clients, in person or by phone, to set up systems and resolve issues;
  • Assist in managing virus threats applying anti-virus server policies;
  • Assist Program Units with basic programmatic functions;
  • Ensure operation and service of desktop, laptop, scanner, photocopier, printer, Wi-fi router, etc.; and
  • Perform all other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Administrative Support

  • Organize local and international travel arrangements, including procurement of tickets (road, rail, and air) and coordination of visas for staff;
  • Arrange/contract local transport for field activities and ensure timely functioning of office vehicle as per staff requisition;
  • Monitor and take timely action to ensure proper office maintenance;
  • Identify and address security and safety of the office, staff, and equipment in compliance with Winrock policies and standards;
  • Coordinate office logistics, including procurement of goods and services, transportation, store management, and use of supplies in a transparent and accountable manner, as per the donor policies and local regulations;
  • Conduct annual physical verification of assets held by Winrock International and local partners;
  • Conduct periodic visits to partner offices and project offices; and
  • Plan and implement project closeout related activities.

Human Resources

  • Ensure compliance with Winrock’s HR policies and procedures, and advise senior management on strategic HR issues and risks;
  • Assist the Director of Finance, Grants, and Administration in completing recruitment process and related issues
  • Handle the complaints mechanisms, grievance and disciplinary procedures;
  • Address equality issues, particularly relating to gender considerations;
  • Maintain HR files and documentation in compliance with Winrock’s policies;
  • Ensure staff compliance with the US Department of State, Winrock’s Code of Conduct and employee handbook; and
  • Any other tasks as assigned by the supervisor.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, or in a related field, from a reputed university.

Work Experience:

  • A minimum of three years of experience in IT, HR, and Administration for international development organizations or reputed local organizations.
  • Experience in a US government-funded project is preferred.

Skills/Knowledge:

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and teamwork.
  • Fluency in oral and written English.
  • Willingness to travel regularly within Bangladesh.
  • Interest in and enthusiasm for the mission of the SHOTORKO project.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal oversight and manage multiple competing priorities and activities.

Applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible but no later than 30 November 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Winrock is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal treatment for all people. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by law.

At Winrock we have a clear mission: Empower the disadvantaged, increase economic opportunity and sustain natural resources through unwavering dedication to accountability, equity, innovation, integrity and transformation.

title: Program Specialist
description:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


Role Summary

Step into a role where you will shape how complex programs take form, from the first plan through final delivery. You will lead cross-functional teams, bring together application, business, and project resources, and guide work using Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid approaches. Your business acumen and steady direction will keep projects on schedule, within scope, and on budget, while your clear reporting keeps leadership informed and confident in the results.



What You Will Do (Job Duties)


  • Manage the planning and execution of complex programs.
  • Provide direction and oversight to project team members.
  • Coordinate across application, business, and cross-functional resources.
  • Manage the project charter, communications, metrics, reporting, and overall project plan.
  • Facilitate Waterfall, Agile, and/or Hybrid activities and project execution.
  • Use a combination of knowledge and business acumen to guide cross-functional teams.
  • Drive projects toward successful completion against schedule, scope, and budget commitments.



What You Will Have (Core Skills)


Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Effective planning techniques support operational (short-term), tactical (1–2 years), and strategic (3–5 years) plans that advance the overall business plan. With extensive experience, this includes developing and communicating tactical plans, linking them to strategy, and allocating resources in line with unit goals.


Analytical Thinking

Analytical tools and techniques help identify the root cause of organizational problems and shape alternative solutions. With extensive experience, this means breaking complex problems into parts, weighing costs, benefits, and risks, and choosing the right analytical approach for each situation.


Flexibility and Adaptability: Successful approaches to change make it possible to adapt comfortably to a shifting environment. With extensive experience, this includes building processes that accommodate change, helping others adjust to new situations, and continuing to make progress amid ambiguity and uncertainty.


Influencing: Effective influencing tactics and strategies make it possible to impact decisions within and outside your own organization. With working knowledge, this includes building persuasive arguments, using active listening to surface opportunities to influence, and knowing who the decision makers are and how they receive information.


Managing Multiple Priorities: Managing multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities calls for sound judgment about priorities and time allocation. With extensive experience, this means shifting focus as priorities change, addressing conflicts that affect delivery commitments, and re-prioritizing work while keeping regularly scheduled work on track.


Relationship Management: Relationship management techniques establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers. With extensive experience, this includes setting expectations with clients, helping negotiate the terms of business relationships, reviewing progress regularly, and empowering others to build collaborative relationships.


Project Management: Effective project management strategies plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, using technical and administrative resources efficiently to achieve project objectives. With extensive experience, this includes estimating project cost and time, identifying risks and creating contingency plans, running regular project reviews, and keeping all participants informed.



Top Candidates Will Have

  • PMP certification
  • 7 plus years of direct industry experience

Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.

title: INTERNAL: Senior Cabin Crew
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:
About the opportunity

We have several Senior Cabin Crew opportunities at our Cape Town base. These positions are open exclusively to employees currently working as Cabin Crew with Global Airways | LIFT.


About the job

As a Senior Cabin Crew Member (SCCM), you’ll lead the Cabin Crew team onboard our narrow-body fleet, taking responsibility for the coordination of cabin safety, security, service, and emergency procedures.

You’ll lead by example, support your crew, and ensure our passengers receive a safe, professional, and memorable travel experience.


In this role, you’ll

  • Lead, supervise, and coordinate the Cabin Crew team throughout all phases of flight.
  • Conduct pre-flight briefings and ensure crew members understand their assigned duties, safety responsibilities, and emergency procedures.
  • Take overall responsibility for the coordination of cabin safety, security, and emergency procedures, reporting directly to the PIC.
  • Ensure all required safety, security, and cabin checks are completed in accordance with Company procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain effective communication with the flight deck, including reporting irregularities, malfunctions, and cabin readiness.
  • Lead and oversee the delivery of a professional, customer-focused in-flight service.
  • Manage passenger concerns and support Cabin Crew in resolving onboard challenges professionally and effectively.
  • Coordinate operational and service requirements with the flight deck and relevant ground teams.
  • Ensure required catering, equipment, passenger documentation, and flight documentation are onboard and correctly managed.
  • Complete and oversee required flight, customs, border control, and Company documentation.
  • Ensure all post-flight cabin and crew responsibilities are completed before leaving the aircraft.
  • Carry out additional operational duties as delegated by the Cabin Crew Manager or PIC.

Key Requirements


Qualifications & Licences

  • Hold a valid and current SACAA Cabin Crew Licence issued in accordance with Part 64 of the Civil Aviation Regulations and applicable Technical Standards.
  • Hold a valid and current aviation medical as required for Cabin Crew operations.
  • Hold the required qualification on an aircraft type/variant operated by the Company.

Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years’ active operating experience as Cabin Crew.
  • Current employee of Global Airways | LIFT (Essential).
  • Minimum of 1,500 operating hours on type or a similar aircraft type.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead by example and maintain high standards of safety, professionalism, conduct, and service.
  • Strong working knowledge of Company procedures, standards, operational manuals, and documentation.
  • Previous experience supporting, guiding, or mentoring Cabin Crew Members is advantageous.

Skills & Expertise

  • Strong leadership and crew coordination skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Sound knowledge of cabin safety, security, and emergency procedures.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Effective conflict resolution and problem-solving ability.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
  • Ability to work effectively with Cabin Crew, Flight Crew, and operational teams.
  • Flexibility and resilience to operate within a dynamic rostered environment.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Team Coordination
  • Safety & Regulatory Compliance
  • Communication
  • Customer Centricity
  • Decision-Making & Accountability


Other

  • South African citizen or legally eligible to work in South Africa.
  • Reliable transportation 24 hours a day
  • Willing and able to operate domestic and international flights and assignments in accordance with Company operational requirements.
  • Expected to consistently demonstrate professional conduct and serve as a positive example to fellow Cabin Crew Members.


Closing Date

The closing date for applications is midday Friday 20th November 2026.

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Software Engineer, Super Intelligence
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SUPER INTELLIGENCE

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate on algorithms, data, and hardware co-design necessary to train the worlds best model
  • Design, build, and implement a large-scale distributed system that powers one of the world's largest supercomputing clusters
  • Dive into the low-level stack to profile, debug, and optimize performance across diverse systems, including GPUs, Linux kernel, networking, and filesystems, to achieve peak efficiency
  • Maintain and innovate on our codebase to ensure scalability and reliability
  • Develop tools to enhance team productivity and streamline workflows

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years of systems programming experience in C, C++, or Rust

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Computer systems fundamentals with a grasp of how computers execute code from transistors to high-level applications
  • Collaborate in a fast-paced, open environment to design and foundational systems
  • Strong debugging skills across the full stack — from kernel and OS up through container orchestration layers
  • Solid understanding of computer networks and the TCP/IP stack
  • Experience working with Linux kernel concepts or systems-level debugging tools (e.g., perf, gdb, strace, Wireshark)

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$140,000 - $225,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: (Aankomend) Partner | Accountancy | MKB | Brabant
description:
Ondernemers verder helpen begint bij begrijpen wat er speelt én wat er nodig is. Als (Aankomend) Partner MKB Accountancy bij Newtone zit je zelf aan tafel bij ondernemers en geef je richting aan onze accountancy- en adviespraktijk. Je bouwt aan duurzame klantrelaties, ziet commerciële kansen en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de verdere ontwikkeling van de praktijk én Newtone.

Jouw rol als (Aankomend) Partner MKB Accountancy

Als (Aankomend) Partner MKB Accountancy ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor onze accountancy- en adviespraktijk in de regio Eindhoven. Je bent strategisch sparringpartner voor MKB-ondernemers en combineert vaktechniek, leiderschap en ondernemerschap.
Je beheert een eigen cliëntportefeuille en bouwt actief aan bestaande en nieuwe klantrelaties. Je herkent kansen, neemt initiatief en draagt bij aan acquisitie en de groei van de praktijk. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de cijfers. Je doorgrondt wat er bij ondernemers speelt en zet jouw vakkennis en ervaring in om hen gericht verder te helpen.Ook binnen Newtone pak je een actieve rol. Je geeft richting aan de ontwikkeling van de accountancy- en adviespraktijk, brengt jouw eigen visie in en neemt collega’s mee in verandering en groei.
Je werkt daarbij samen met verschillende disciplines binnen Newtone en verbindt kennis en expertise waar dat waarde toevoegt voor de ondernemer.Newtone is ontstaan uit de fusie van gerenommeerde accountants- en advieskantoren en telt inmiddels ruim 1.100 collega’s verdeeld over meerdere vestigingen. We combineren lokale betrokkenheid met landelijke slagkracht en werken dagelijks aan oplossingen voor ondernemers die vooruit willen.
We staan daarnaast aan de vooravond van de lancering van Newtone One, een toekomstgericht en transparant concept voor ondernemerschap. Als (aankomend) partner ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de succesvolle adoptie en verdere ontwikkeling hiervan.Je bent zichtbaar, commercieel, benaderbaar en koersvast. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, maakt onderbouwde keuzes en geeft richting aan klanten, collega’s en de verdere ontwikkeling van de praktijk.
Jij begrijpt wat nodig is.

Daarnaast:

  • Geef je inhoudelijk én commercieel richting aan de AA-praktijk
  • Signaleer je kansen, bouw je nieuwe klantrelaties op en verdiep je bestaande relaties
  • Denk je vooruit en vertaal je ontwikkelingen naar concrete oplossingen voor ondernemers
  • Adviseer je ondernemers als strategisch sparringpartner over financiële, bedrijfskundige en governance-vraagstukken
  • Draag je eindverantwoordelijkheid voor kwaliteit, klanttevredenheid en praktijkresultaten
  • Verbind je disciplines binnen Newtone en zet je ons brede dienstenaanbod integraal in
  • Ontwikkel en coach je managers en AA-accountants in hun professionele én persoonlijke groei
  • Draag je actief bij aan de strategie, cultuur en verdere ontwikkeling van Newtone als partnerorganisatie
  • Ben je zichtbaar en actief binnen het MKB-netwerk van regio Eindhoven

Wie wij zoeken

Wij zoeken een inspirerend leider met een vakinhoudelijke basis, stevig ondernemerschap en een bewezen positie in de regionale MKB-markt. Een generalist met overzicht die energie krijgt van bouwen, verbinden en impact maken. Het mag een ervaren Partner óf een ervaren AA‑accountant zijn met een duidelijke ambitie om door te groeien naar partnerniveau.

Jij herkent jezelf verder in het volgende profiel:
  • Afgeronde AA‑opleiding en actuele vaktechnische kennis
  • Ruime ervaring binnen de AA‑praktijk, inclusief eindverantwoordelijkheid
  • Een sterk en relevant netwerk binnen het MKB in regio Eindhoven
  • Natuurlijk leiderschap en het vermogen om mensen te ontwikkelen en te inspireren
  • Sterke commerciële drive en adviesvaardigheden als ondernemende sparringspartner
  • Een ondernemend en verbindend profiel
  • Het vermogen om Newtone’s kernwaarden actief uit te dragen

Wat wij jou bieden

Omdat jouw welzijn voorop staat hechten wij veel waarde aan een gezonde werk-privébalans. Hybride werken, thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden. Jij bepaalt welke toon het beste bij jou past!

Verder krijg je:
  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris
  • Een winstdeling en/of variabele beloning
  • Een netto internetvergoeding van € 30,- en een kostenvergoeding van € 95,- per maand
  • Vele ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden op zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk vlak
  • 30 vrije dagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om 10 extra dagen bij te kopen
  • Laptop en telefoon (recente I-phone of premiumtoestel naar keuze)
  • NS-business card in combinatie met een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding of een elektrische auto
  • Een premievrij pensioen, WIA-verzekering en Anw-hiaatverzekering
  • Jaarlijks € 300,- voor jouw persoonlijke benefitsprogramma, waarmee je extra’s kunt kiezen op het gebied van lifestyle, reizen, sport, vitaliteit en meer
  • Een hecht, gedreven en multidisciplinair team waarin de lijnen kort zijn, we veel van elkaar leren en je vanaf de eerste werkdag direct impact maakt

title: Baseball Assistant Coach
location: Athletics-Hampton County High School, South Carolina
description:
GENERAL SUMMARY
Under limited supervision, works to assist each participating student to achieve a high level of athletic skills, an appreciation for the values of discipline and sportsmanship, and an increased level of self-esteem. Reports to the Athletic Director, Head Coach and Principal(s).

Education and Experience:
South Carolina Teacher Certification preferred, some coaching and/or physical education experience or equivalent combination of education and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities. Must possess a valid SC driver's license.

Knowledge:
Knowledge in the development, planning, organization, implementation and management of coaching athletic programs and practices designed to meet educational objectives and requirements. Knowledge of the standards, regulations, and laws relating to the position. Knows how to keep abreast of changes in policy, standards, procedures, and regulations pertinent to the program. Strong knowledge of word processing, e-mails, spreadsheets, electronic file management, the internet, and reporting and presentation software.

Skills/Efforts:
Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with school, District staff, parents and community. Ability to instruct others through explanation, demonstration and supervised practice, and/or make recommendations on the basis of technical disciplines. Ability to complete, process, and maintain required records, reports, and other information. Ability to develop and maintain effective communications with school and District employees, the school principal, and the general public. Ability to operate general office equipment including a computer, calculator, copier, etc. Ability to create electronic reports and presentations, use the internet efficiently, communicate electronically via e-mail, and manage electronic data and files in an organized manner.

Working Conditions:
School environment with significant exposure to environmental conditions, to include loud environment and exposure to sun-light. Requires ability to work under a degree of stress related to duties that require considerable attention and working with students. Physical demands are activities requiring movement/lifting items weighing up to 75 pounds. Frequent travel required; occasional overnight travel required.

Responsibility:
Assists in the supervision of students and assistants as assigned.

DISCLAIMER STATEMENT
This job description is not intended as a complete listing of job duties. The incumbent is responsible for the performance of other related duties as assigned/required.

Stipend Amount: $1,000.00

title: Condition Monitoring Advisor
description:
Career Area:

Product Support

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Provide condition monitoring and asset management expertise by analyzing equipment health data and delivering recommendations that improve asset reliability, equipment availability, and customer operational performance.

Responsibilities

• Analyze equipment health data using condition monitoring hardware and software to identify asset issues, recognize trends, and provide recommendations that improve reliability, availability, and equipment performance.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, dealers, and customers to understand operational needs, support problem resolution, and deliver condition monitoring recommendations aligned with customer priorities.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives by sharing best practices and participating in condition monitoring meetings, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing forums.

• Develop and share condition monitoring knowledge to support capability development and the consistent application of best practices.

Skill Descriptors

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

• Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.

• Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.

• Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.

• Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.

• Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

• Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.

• Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.

• Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.

• Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.

• Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

Level Working Knowledge:

• Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.

• Researches and verifies customer needs and expectations.

• Solicits customer satisfaction feedback and acts on improvement opportunities.

• Helps link organizational objectives to customer needs and expectations.

• Meets regularly with customers to understand their wants, needs and expectations.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

Level Working Knowledge:

• Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.

• Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.

• Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.

• Differentiates the roles and responsibilities in a business relationship.

• Works with clients to address critical issues and resolve major problems.

Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.

Level Working Knowledge:

• Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent.

• Resolves common customer problems.

• Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action.

• Provides direct service to internal or external customers.

• Documents customer complaints in a timely manner.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

• Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.

• Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.

• Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.

• Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.

• Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Consulting: Knowledge of techniques, roles, and responsibilities in providing technical or business guidance to clients, both internal and external; ability to apply consulting knowledge appropriately.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Explains the roles and responsibilities of a consultant.

• Lists the typical phases of a consulting assignment or project.

• Presents a professional image, especially when dealing with customers.

• Describes the consulting process and relationship with clients.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

• Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.

• Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.

• Participates in gathering and analyzing an organization's data based on requirements.

• Documents data from various sources and in various formats.

• Utilizes basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.


Posting Dates:

November 16, 2026 - November 29, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
