title: Data Engineer I
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Data Engineer I to join our Data Services team at Kaseya. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, Apache Airflow, and AWS cloud services, with a strong understanding of data engineering concepts and ETL/ELT processes.

The role involves developing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines, integrating data from multiple source systems, and building reliable and scalable datasets using Medallion Architecture.

The candidate will work extensively on developing Silver and Gold-layer datasets, implementing data transformations, data cleansing, standardization, validation, and business logic to deliver high-quality, business-ready datasets for reporting, analytics, and downstream applications.

The candidate should have strong problem-solving skills, attention to data quality, and the ability to work collaboratively with team members to deliver reliable data engineering solutions

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Pipeline Development

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance data pipelines using Python, SQL, Snowflake, and Apache Airflow.
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows to ingest data from multiple source systems.
  • Develop data extraction, transformation, and loading processes to support enterprise data requirements.
  • Implement incremental data loading and data processing mechanisms.
  • Write reusable and efficient Python scripts and SQL transformations.
  • Ensure data pipelines are reliable, scalable, and maintainable.

2. Medallion Architecture - Silver & Gold Layer Development

  • Work with Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) to build and maintain structured data pipelines.
  • Develop Silver-layer datasets by implementing data cleansing, standardization, deduplication, validation, and transformation logic.
  • Build Gold-layer datasets by applying business rules, joins, aggregations, and transformations to create curated, business-ready datasets.
  • Develop and maintain Fact and Dimension tables to support reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Implement data quality checks and validation rules across Silver and Gold datasets.
  • Ensure data consistency, accuracy, completeness, and reliability across different data layers.
  • Support the development of reusable data models and transformation frameworks.
  • Optimize SQL queries and data transformations for efficient dataset processing.

3. Snowflake Development

  • Develop and maintain Snowflake tables, views, and SQL-based transformation workflows.
  • Write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and data transformation logic.
  • Work with Snowflake features such as Streams, Tasks, and Dynamic Tables.
  • Perform basic query optimization and troubleshoot performance-related issues.
  • Support data loading, transformation, and data validation activities.
  • Follow Snowflake security and access management best practices.

4. Python & Apache Airflow

  • Develop Python scripts and modules for data processing, integration, and automation.
  • Create and maintain Apache Airflow DAGs for data pipeline orchestration.
  • Configure task dependencies, scheduling, retries, and error-handling mechanisms.
  • Monitor Airflow workflows and troubleshoot pipeline failures.
  • Develop reusable components to improve pipeline efficiency and maintainability.

5. AWS Cloud Services

  • Utilize AWS cloud services for data storage, integration, and processing.
  • Work with AWS services such as:
  • Amazon S3
  • AWS Lambda
  • Amazon SQS and SNS
  • AWS IAM
  • Amazon CloudWatch
  • AWS Glue (preferred)
  • Support integration between AWS services and Snowflake data pipelines.
  • Follow cloud security and data access best practices.

Required Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 3-7 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Development, or a related technical role.
  • Good hands-on experience with SQL, including complex queries, joins, analytical functions, and data transformations.
  • Hands-on experience with Python for data processing, automation, and pipeline development.
  • Working experience with Snowflake, including:
  • Tables, views, and SQL transformations.
  • Data loading and unloading.
  • Data modelling and schema design.
  • Query optimization and performance tuning fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow, including DAG development, scheduling, task dependencies, and workflow monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (Mandatory), preferably S3, Lambda, SQS, SNS, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Understanding of Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers).
  • Practical experience developing Silver and Gold-layer datasets, including data cleansing, standardization, business transformations, joins, and aggregations.
  • Good understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing concepts, and data integration.
  • Understanding of dimensional modelling concepts, including Fact and Dimension tables, Star Schema, and Snowflake Schema.
  • Basic understanding of incremental data loading, CDC, and historical data handling.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a collaborative engineering team

Preferred Qualification

  • Familiarity with Snowflake Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, and Stored Procedures.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions.
  • Familiarity with data governance, data security, and data quality practices.
  • Exposure to data observability and pipeline monitoring frameworks.
  • Experience working with large datasets and optimizing data transformation workflows.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: AI Engineering, Growth
description:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media () focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Deputy Director, Campaign Planning & Channels Management
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The Communications Division, led by the Chief Communications Officer, oversees the foundation’s global communications strategy. The division brings together internal and external communications to advance the foundation’s mission to create a more equitable world.

This role sits within the Global Content & Campaigns team, which leads the foundation's public engagement strategy by bringing together brand, campaigns, creative production, storytelling, channels, and audience engagement to build trust in the foundation and inspire more people to care about our mission. Working closely with regional communications teams and partners around the world, the team ensures the foundation's communications are audience-centered, creatively ambitious, and grounded in evidence, continually testing and evolving approaches that strengthen public trust and engagement.

Your Role
The Deputy Director, Campaign Planning & Channels Management is a key member of the Communications leadership team and will work with colleagues across the foundation's nine global offices to develop integrated campaign strategies and implement digital channel strategies that drive the communications division’s key goals. Reporting directly to the Director of Content and Campaigns, you will be responsible for leading campaign planning, digital channel strategy, audience engagement, and managing a team of campaign strategists and channel management experts. Key channels under your purview will include GatesFoundation.org, The Optimist newsletter, brand and leadership social media channels, creators, and paid media.


Success in this role looks like empowering a talented team so they can deliver their best work; fostering new approaches that can make impact against our goals; managing productive relationships across a highly matrixed and geographically dispersed organization; and helping more priority audiences trust the foundation and care about the issues we tackle.


What You'll Do

Campaign Strategy & Planning:

  • Design and lead campaign strategies that support the foundation’s brand and key initiatives, working closely with regional offices, advocacy and program colleagues and external partners to amplify impact and drive outcomes.
  • Direct campaign strategists in the implementation of campaigns across offline and digital platforms, including proactive strategies to enhance the foundation's news relevance and manage risks to reputation.
  • Partner with the Global Brand Experience team to develop creative briefs and content strategies that reflect audience insights, channel best practices, and historical performance data.
  • Partner with the Analytics and Insights team as well as vendors to ensure rigor and accuracy in measurement, insights, and reporting.

Channel Strategy & Management

  • Develop and implement long-term digital channel strategy for audience engagement, acquisition, and retention across owned channels, including approach to global and regional digital channel expansion, and integration with global campaigns.
  • Manage multi-tiered network of digital and social media channels, consistently engaging target audiences with meaningful content and delivering on key moments and campaigns, through an aligned content strategy and calendar.
  • Lead audience development and engagement strategies for brand and leadership social media channels, GatesFoundation.org, the Optimist newsletter, creators, and paid media.
  • Articulate how channel strategy drives engagement with key audiences, including developing and maintaining audience segment definitions and personas using audience research and digital channel metrics.
  • Manage strategic acquisition model to scale and grow channels to new audiences, driving follower growth and audience reach within priority audience segments.
  • Develop measurement frameworks with clear critical metrics and targets to evaluate ongoing channel health.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:

  • Effectively manage, lead and foster growth in an agile, inclusive, diverse, and successful team of campaign planning and channel management professionals.
  • Manage the team budget and ensure all relevant agency partners are effective and cost efficient.
  • Play an active role as a member of the Global Content & Campaigns Leadership team.
  • Develop strong relationships with internal collaborators and external partners that support integrated efforts across teams and global offices.
  • Collaborate closely with Global Brand Experience, Strategic Comms, Editorial, advocacy, program, and regional communications teams to develop integrated approaches that support strategic objectives.


Your Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in communications, Marketing, Journalism, or related field with 10+ years of progressive professional experience in a similar leadership role, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong expertise in campaign planning, digital channel strategy, audience engagement, and content marketing. Deep knowledge of digital channel landscape, digital marketing trends, social media management, CRM and email marketing, web strategy, audience segmentation, and paid media.
  • Excellent people management skills with demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and lead diverse teams. Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in dynamic, matrixed environments.
  • Demonstrated excellent written and oral communication skills. Ability to offer creative solutions to complex problems and navigate effectively with internal and external partners.
  • Experience working in nonprofit, public health, government, communications agency, or private sector organization strongly preferred. International experience and cultural proficiency a plus.
  • Strong teammate with curiosity, excellent judgment, and passion for the foundation's mission.
  • Ability to travel up to 15% domestic and internationally

Must have unrestricted work authorization in the country where this position is located. The Foundation does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (eg: H-1B, O-1, L-1, E, OPT, STEM-OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.).


The salary range for this role is $212,800 to $329,800 USD. We recognize high-wage market differences in Seattle and Washington D.C., where our offices are located. The range for this role in these locations is $234,000 to $362,800 USD. As a mission-driven organization, we strive to balance competitive pay with our mission. title: Technical Customer Experience Lead
description:
About Hark

Hark is an artificial intelligence company building advanced, personalized intelligence. One that is proactive, multimodal, and capable of interacting with the world through speech, text, vision, and persistent memory.

We're pairing that intelligence with next-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world.

To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next-generation AI hardware together - designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems.

About the Team

You'll be the first person our users meet when something matters, and the person who makes sure it never happens twice. As our Technical Customer Experience Lead, you own every customer's success with Hark across our app, our agent, and our devices. You'll solve the hard cases yourself, then use AI and AI coding agents to build the systems that solve the next thousand automatically. You'll sit close to engineering and product, and what you learn from customers will shape what we ship. This is a founding role: you'll define how Hark takes care of people, and eventually build the team that does it.

Responsibilities

  • Own customer outcomes end to end. Work directly with users, get to the real root cause, and leave them better off than when they reached out.
  • Build AI-powered customer systems. Design the triage, routing, drafting, knowledge retrieval, and automated resolution that make every answer faster and better than the last.
  • Ship your own tools. Use AI coding agents to build the scripts, integrations, dashboards, and workflows behind customer success, without waiting on engineering.
  • Be the technical bridge to engineering. Reproduce bugs, read logs, and hand engineering clear, actionable reports.
  • Turn signal into product. Spot patterns across customer conversations and turn them into product feedback, help center content, and fixes that prevent the next issue.
  • Own the numbers. Response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction, with a constant loop to improve them.
  • Build the function. The playbook, tooling, escalation paths, and eventually the team, as Hark scales.

Requirements

  • Customer Experience: 1–5 years in customer experience, customer support, or support operations, ideally at a consumer tech or software company, with hands-on customer work.
  • Genuine Care for Customers: You care about the person on the other side and take pride in getting them to a real answer.
  • AI-First Mindset: You use AI to raise the quality and speed of how you help customers, and you can point to ways you've already done it.
  • Comfort with AI Coding Agents: You build what you need with AI coding tools, whether that's a script, an integration, or an internal tool.
  • Technical Depth: You troubleshoot software issues, read logs, and explain technical problems clearly to both users and engineers.
  • Strong Communication: Your writing is clear, warm, and precise, and you adjust your tone for a frustrated customer, an engineer, or a leadership update.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience building or scaling a customer function at an early-stage startup.
  • Experience supporting consumer software and hardware products.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or Front, and their APIs.
  • Experience with AI or LLM-powered products.

Compensation

The US base salary range for this full-time position is between $120,000 - $170,000 annually.

The pay offered for this position may vary based on several individual factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package may also include additional components and benefits depending on the specific role. This information will be shared if an employment offer is extended.

title: AI Engineer, DevOps Platform & Security
description:
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the number one consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

Who you'll work with

You will be part of a team building Bain's integrated suite of agentic decisioning tools that gives large organizations always-on intelligence across their most important growth decisions. The role sits at an intersection few organizations can offer: the analytical depth and client access of a top-tier consultancy, the technical ambition of a product company, and engineering work at the frontier of applied AI.

You will work inside Bain's standing product team, building software that helps the world's largest companies answer the questions that drive their business: where to invest, where to focus, and how to win. The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release.

The platform has two layers working together: an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient.

This is a startup inside an established company. You get genuine early-stage ownership and real influence over architecture and product direction, backed by Bain's global scale, client relationships, and leadership commitment; the pace of a startup with the runway of a global firm.

We are looking for DevOps engineers who see how to make the platform more reliable and resilient and bring that instinct to every sprint without being asked, and who are comfortable with problems that do not have a known answer. The work involves cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD for a multi-service platform, and deployment problems with no off-the-shelf answer.

Experience supporting agentic systems matters: how AI backend services are deployed and monitored, evaluation pipelines, and the operational demands of production LLM workloads. This is applied AI in production, at scale, with real users depending on what you build. The field is moving quickly and the team is built to move with it, so the willingness to keep learning counts for as much as what you already know.

Where you'll fit within the team

The DevOps Engineer works directly under the DevOps Engineering Senior Manager, within the Growth AI Performance System Platform and Security team, contributing to the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and observability systems that the entire platform runs on. This is a hands-on implementation role: you will build and maintain the infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and developer tooling that the engineering team depends on, working under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer and developing progressively more ownership as you grow.

You will get broad exposure to the full platform stack: from the infrastructure that hosts AI services and data pipelines through to the deployment workflows that get product changes into the hands of real users on live engagements. This cross-cutting view makes it an excellent role for an engineer who wants to develop deep expertise in cloud-native platform engineering and AI infrastructure in a fast-moving, production environment.

You will work across the platform and product modules focused on marketing ROI, brand, and pricing strategy, contributing to the infrastructure and deployment systems that keep those modules running reliably for enterprise clients. When something goes wrong in a live client deployment, the DevOps team is in the room.

This role is based in Warsaw or Sao Paulo, working as part of a globally distributed platform team alongside the Senior DevOps Engineer. You will develop the infrastructure engineering skills and platform knowledge to take on increasing ownership over time, with a clear path toward the Senior DevOps Engineer role.

What you'll do

Infrastructure and environment management

  • Contribute to the provisioning and management of cloud infrastructure for the Growth AI Performance System platform on Azure or AWS (including compute, networking, storage, and managed services), using infrastructure-as-code practices under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer
  • Support the maintenance of environment parity across development, staging, and production; contribute to environment provisioning, configuration management, and the automation that keeps environments consistent and reliable
  • Build and maintain infrastructure automation scripts and configuration management tooling; learn and apply infrastructure-as-code practices to all infrastructure changes, ensuring changes are versioned, reviewed, and deployed through code
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of infrastructure for AI platform workloads: container orchestration, API management, and the storage and compute patterns that LLM services and agentic workflows require

CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipeline components for Growth AI Performance System platform services (including AI backend services, frontend applications, and data pipelines), implementing automated testing steps, deployment stages, and quality gates under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer
  • Maintain the local development environment and developer onboarding tooling; keep documentation current, resolve developer environment issues quickly, and contribute to the developer experience improvements that keep a distributed engineering team productive
  • Support release engineering operations: contribute to deployment coordination, monitor deployments in progress, and participate in rollback and incident response procedures
  • Learn and develop fluency with the full CI/CD toolchain and deployment workflow; take on progressively more ownership of specific pipeline areas as your expertise grows

Observability, monitoring and incident support

  • Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for platform services: set up structured logging, metrics collection, and alerting thresholds that give the engineering team visibility into service health and surface issues before they affect live client deployments
  • Contribute to the build of AI and agentic observability tooling under the direction of the Senior DevOps Engineer: implementing tracing for agentic execution, monitoring LLM API usage and latency, and structured logging for multi-step agent workflows
  • Support incident response for infrastructure and platform failures: monitor alerts, participate in diagnosis, contribute to remediation, and document findings in a form that supports post-incident review and platform improvement
  • Develop familiarity with the platform's SLOs, alerting thresholds, and reliability standards; learn to read platform health dashboards accurately and understand what degradation signals require escalation

About you

Technical

  • Solid foundation in cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS: compute, networking, storage, and managed services; growing proficiency with provisioning and managing cloud resources through infrastructure-as-code
  • Working experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation: able to build, maintain, and debug pipeline stages including automated testing, artifact management, and deployment steps
  • Proficiency with Docker and containerized deployments; working familiarity with Kubernetes-based orchestration in a production environment
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and scripting (Python and Bash) for infrastructure automation tasks; disciplined use of version control for infrastructure codebases
  • Working knowledge of monitoring and alerting tooling: able to set up structured logging, configure metrics collection, and create alerting rules that surface meaningful signals
  • Exposure to or genuine interest in MLOps and AI infrastructure patterns, how LLM services are deployed and monitored, and what the infrastructure requirements of agentic systems look like in production
  • Understanding of security fundamentals for cloud-native infrastructure: IAM, secrets management, network security, and the DevSecOps practices that embed security into deployment workflows
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools to accelerate infrastructure work, diagnose issues faster, and develop AI infrastructure skills

Experience

  • 3 or more years in DevOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering roles with hands‑on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure
  • Track record of contributing to production infrastructure and deployment systems that real services and users depend on, not just development or test environments
  • Experience with or strong interest in MLOps and AI infrastructure; exposure to LLM service deployment, agentic system infrastructure, or vector database workloads is a strong advantage
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams; strong troubleshooting skills and comfort debugging infrastructure issues across distributed systems
  • Based in or able to work from Warsaw or Sao Paulo near a Bain office

Education

  • Associate’s degree / bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical field; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

Työnkuvasi sisältää monipuolisia työtehtäviä. Sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä kehittämään osaamistasi vaihtelevien ja vaativienkin asennusten parissa. Omaat ajatuksen, että homma hoidetaan kerralla kuntoon ja osaat itsenäisen työskentelyn. Hitsaustaito (rosteri) katsotaan eduksi. Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian sopimuksen mukaan.

  • Käyttövesi- ja viemäriputkistojen asennus sekä liitostyöt
  • Kalusteasennukset
  • Työskentelyä piirustusten ja työohjeiden mukaisesti

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Palkka kokemus ja osaaminen huomioiden noin 16-20 e/h, jonka lisäksi saat TES mukaiset korvaukset, kuten ateria- ja matkakorvaukset
  • Ammattikäyttöön soveltuvat työvaatteet ja tarvittavat suojaimet
  • Oman henkilöstkonsultin
  • ja etenin hyvälle tekijälle työtä pitkäksikin ajaksi, oman toiveen mukaan

  • LVI-alan koulutusta ja aikaisempaa kokemusta LVI-asennuksista
  • Itsenäistä ja oma-aloitteista työskentelyotetta
  • Asiakaslähtöisyyttä ja hyvää suomen kielen taitoa
  • Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

title: SAP GRC Access Control Consultant (Functional & Technical)
company: SAM Manpower and Career Services LLP
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an SAP GRC professional with a blend of functional and technical expertise to manage and strengthen our SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance framework. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in SAP GRC Access Control, risk mitigation and Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflict management. They should also have a solid understanding of SAP functional modules and role design. You will help ensure our SAP environment is secure, compliant and aligned with internal control and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, EAM/Firefighter, BRM), including access risk rulesets, mitigating controls and remediation workflows.
  • Analyse and resolve SoD conflicts at user and role level. Create, assign and monitor mitigating controls with business control owners.
  • Design, review and maintain SAP roles and role assignments across key modules (MM, FI, SD, PP, QM, PM), ensuring least-privilege access.
  • Manage emergency (Firefighter) access, including ID setup, owner/controller assignment and periodic log reviews.
  • Perform periodic user access reviews, privileged access reviews and role certifications across procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and user access management cycles.
  • Assess IT general controls (ITGC) and application controls within SAP and related environments, benchmarking against frameworks such as NIST.
  • Partner with IT and business stakeholders to investigate audit findings, track remediation and improve control effectiveness.
  • Support internal and external audits for SAP-based systems, including evidence preparation, walkthroughs and issue follow-up.
  • Review third-party assurance reports (ISAE 3402 / SOC) for outsourced IT functions.
  • Train key users, auditors and auditees on GRC processes, tools and controls, and maintain audit issue tracking workflows.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting or a related field.
  • CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) certification – required.
  • 4–6 years of experience in IT audit / SAP security, with a strong focus on access controls and GRC.
  • Proven hands-on experience in SAP GRC Access Control: access risk analysis, ruleset configuration, mitigating control assignment and SoD conflict management.
  • Strong understanding of SAP functional modules (MM, FI, SD, PP, QM, PM), role design, role assignment and conflict mitigation.
  • Working knowledge of ITGC, application controls and access governance processes.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn technical findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint).

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP GRC certification (Access Control).
  • Experience with MSMP workflow configuration and SAP GRC 10.x / 12.0.
  • Exposure to IAM / PAM tools (e.g., CyberArk) and audit analytics tools (e.g., ACL, TeamMate).
  • ITIL Foundation; experience with vulnerability assessment tools (e.g., Nmap, Nessus).
  • Big 4 or large-scale internal audit exposure.
  • Experience delivering GRC or access-control training.
  • Fluency in English.

We’re on a mission to change the future of
clinical research. At Perceptive, we help the
biopharmaceutical industry bring medical
treatments to the market, faster.
Our mission is to change the world

WEALTH:

- Salary structure and Flexi basket

Job Summary:

Responsible for performing quality control (QC) review of clinical research imaging across a range of therapeutic areas and imaging modalities, verifying compliance with trial-specific protocol parameters, and ensuring data is of suitable quality for assessment and quantitative analysis. This review includes verification of compliance with trial and site-specific imaging requirements, review of anatomical coverage, identifying the presence of artifacts which may prevent accurate image interpretation and analysis, and imaging data reconstruction and processing. The Imaging Quality Control & Processing Specialist role is critical as this team optimizes imaging data received by Invicro and ensures data integrity before read for eligibility and/or analysis is performed.


Job Duties

• Perform technical quality review of medical imaging (e.g., PET, SPECT, MRI or CT).

• Imaging data reconstruction and processing.

• Completion of quality control (QC) documentation according to good clinical practice and regulatory guidelines.

• Collaborates across functional groups within the Core Lab to ensure high standards of data collection are maintained and project deliverables are successful.


Education:

Preferably, certified medical imaging technologist (NMTCB, ARRT, etc.) in Nuclear Medicine, PET, MRI and/or CT and/or Bachelor of Science degree.


Experience:

Certified medical imaging technologist (NMTCB, ARRT, etc.) in Nuclear Medicine, PET, MRI or CT and/or background in biomedical imaging.


Qualifications:

• Strong understanding of radiological imaging

• Must possess strong written and verbal skills for effectively communicating with departmental staff and research centers

• Strong computer skills including competency across a variety of computer applications and systems

• Ability to work collaboratively with customers and team members

• Relevant experience should exhibit organizational capabilities and strong attention to detail

title: Sourcing Associate (Fresh Graduate)
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

title: AI Specialist
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Process Automation & Workflow Design Lead
description:
Why this role matters

Own the common method for identifying, redesigning, instrumenting and scaling AI-enabled workflows, and the capability system required to embed them. The role connects domain expertise, market users, Champions, product teams and specialist talent so adoption is designed from prototype and the work changes, not simply the technology.


Reports to: VP, AI Adoption & Scale

Location / scope: Above-market, International; across domains, solutions and market workflows

People leadership: Approximately 6-9 AI-native specialists / flexible bench

Role type: Workflow design, experience design, automation and capability change


Key accountabilities

Own the workflow transformation method

· Define the end-to-end method: baseline, pain points, prioritization, future-state design, automation opportunity, embedding and evidence.

· Create facilitation guides, standards, templates, quality criteria and practitioner certification.

· Ensure methods are practical across markets and can be applied with limited central dependence.


Lead experience design and co-creation

· Translate user, market and domain insight into clear experience briefs.

· Co-design with representative users from prototype onward and test usability, behavioural friction, hand-offs and local fit.

· Bring workflow, service design and automation expertise into product and domain discussions.


Build instrumentation and evidence

· Define baselines, success measures and instrumentation before scale.

· Work with product, data and technical teams to build adoption, behaviour and outcome events into solutions.

· Create before-and-after evidence and package validated redesigns for reuse.


Build capability and behaviour change

· Define role-based capabilities and observable behaviors required for new workflows.

· Develop curriculum architecture, facilitator certification, playbooks and applied learning experiences.

· Ensure learning is connected to priority workflows and reinforced in the operating rhythm.


Manage the specialist bench and reusable library

· Deploy specialist capacity against priority domains, products and markets with explicit outcomes and hand-offs.

· Curate workflow patterns, reusable assets and validated case studies.

· Continuously improve quality standards based on evidence and practitioner feedback.


What success looks like

· Priority workflows have clear baselines, future states, ownership, instrumentation and embedded use.

· Friction, steps and unnecessary hand-offs are reduced.

· Priority products have agreed behavioural and outcome events before scale.

· Markets and domains can apply the method with limited central dependence.

· Validated workflow patterns and assets are reused across products and markets.


Candidate profile

Basic qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, commercial operations, transformation, technology, analytics, healthcare or a related field.

· Significant experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation in a global, regional or multi-market environment.

· Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and deliver through matrix teams without relying solely on formal authority.

· Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear decisions and practical action.

· Working understanding of AI, responsible AI, data, digital products and workflow transformation.

· Deep experience in workflow design, service design, process improvement, user research, automation, experience design or behavior change.

· Strong facilitation skills and experience translating insight into practical methods and measurable designs.

· Ability to design measurement with product, engineering, data and analytics teams.


Preferred qualifications

· Experience in biopharma, healthcare, regulated industries or similarly complex global organizations.

· Track record scaling capabilities across markets or business units and using evidence to improve adoption and value.

· Experience working across cultures and balancing enterprise standards with local market needs.


Leadership capabilities

· Enterprise mindset with strong judgment on where to standardize, configure or adapt.

· Customer and colleague centricity, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguity.

· Bias for action, disciplined follow-through and willingness to surface risks early.

· Commitment to integrity, quality, compliance and inclusive leadership.


Key partnerships

· Domain Transformation Leads and Business Product Owners

· Product, design, engineering, automation and data teams

· AFLs, Champions, market users and in-market facilitators

· Fluency & Scaling Lead, KPI teams and Enterprise AI Fluency

· Legal, Compliance, PX and Responsible AI


Role boundaries

· Does not own engineering, the build backlog, technical delivery or production support.

· Is not a generic training function disconnected from priority workflows.

· Does not design without market users or wait until after MVP to consider adoption.

· Does not own market adoption; AFLs embed and diagnose locally.


Purpose

Breakthroughs that change patients' lives... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives.

Digital Transformation Strategy

One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. We are leading the way in adopting new data, modelling and automated solutions to further digitize and accelerate drug discovery and development with the aim of enhancing health outcomes and the patient experience.

Flexibility

We aim to create a trusting, flexible workplace culture which encourages employees to achieve work life harmony, attracts talent and enables everyone to be their best working self. Let’s start the conversation!

Equal Employment Opportunity

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to building a successful business. As an employer, Pfizer is committed to celebrating this, in all its forms – allowing for us to be as diverse as the patients and communities we serve. Together, we continue to build a culture that encourages, supports and empowers our employees.

DisAbility Confident

title: Senior Officer, Life Sciences, Strategic Investment Fund (SIF)
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

Established in 2009, the Foundation’s Strategic Investment Fund (SIF) advances the Foundation’s philanthropic mission through the use of investment tools including equity, debt, guarantees, and other innovative financing structures. SIF partners closely with the Foundation’s Program Strategy Teams to identify opportunities where investment capital, private-sector capabilities, and market-based approaches can accelerate progress toward the Foundation’s strategic objectives. SIF operates at the intersection of philanthropy, science, technology, and private capital. The team works with entrepreneurs, biotechnology and healthcare companies, investors, research institutions, and other partners to develop and finance solutions capable of delivering meaningful and sustainable impact for populations that have historically been underserved by commercial markets.

This role will be based out of Seattle, Washington

Your Role
The Strategic Investment Fund is seeking a Senior Officer, Life Sciences to help identify, develop, execute, and manage investments and strategic partnerships that advance the Foundation’s global health priorities. This individual will serve as a senior life-sciences investor and strategic partner to teams across the Foundation, bringing together deep scientific understanding, investment judgment, company-building experience, and knowledge of the biotechnology and healthcare ecosystem.

The Senior Officer will work closely with Foundation scientists, program officers, investment colleagues, legal partners, entrepreneurs, academic researchers, biotechnology companies, and investors to identify areas where investment capital and private-sector innovation can accelerate the development and delivery of technologies with the potential for significant global health impact.

The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between scientific and investment discussions—from evaluating emerging biology and technology platforms to developing investment theses, assessing companies, structuring transactions, working with management teams and boards, and helping translate promising innovations into sustainable products and companies.

Importantly, this role will be highly collaborative and opportunity-oriented. The Senior Officer will work proactively with teams across the Foundation to understand their strategies and scientific priorities, identify opportunities where SIF can add value, and help translate those opportunities into actionable investment or company-creation strategies

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Foundation teams to develop investment strategies. Work closely with Program Strategy Teams and technical experts to understand their scientific and impact objectives; identify areas where private-sector investment, company creation, or strategic partnerships could accelerate progress; and translate those opportunities into actionable investment theses.
  • Originate and develop high-impact partnerships. Build relationships with biotechnology and healthcare companies, venture investors, academic medical centers, research institutions, entrepreneurs, and other ecosystem participants to identify technologies and investment opportunities aligned with Foundation priorities.
  • Evaluate emerging science and technology. Apply deep scientific and industry knowledge to assess early-stage therapeutic, vaccine, diagnostic, platform, and other health-related technologies, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Foundation scientists and external experts to evaluate scientific differentiation, development risk, translational potential, and potential global health impact.
  • Lead investment evaluation and execution. Lead or play a senior role in sourcing, diligence, financial analysis, valuation, investment structuring, negotiation, and execution of transactions. Work across a range of investment instruments, including preferred equity, convertible securities, debt, and other structures appropriate to achieving the Foundation’s charitable objectives.
  • Help create and build companies. Evaluate Foundation-supported science, technologies, and other opportunities to identify where the creation of a new company, spinout, or other organizational structure could accelerate development and impact. Where appropriate, proactively help translate these opportunities into viable new ventures—working alongside Foundation teams, scientific founders, entrepreneurs, venture investors, accelerators, and other partners to develop company strategies, assess business and financing models, assemble founding teams and capabilities, attract capital, and facilitate company formation and launch. Bring an entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset and a willingness to roll up your sleeves to help promising Foundation-supported innovations progress from scientific concept through company formation, financing, and early development.
  • Drive value creation across the portfolio. Partner with CEOs, management teams, boards, co-investors, and Foundation colleagues to advance portfolio company objectives, address strategic and operational challenges, facilitate partnerships, and maintain alignment between company development plans and the Foundation’s impact objectives.
  • Support portfolio governance. Represent the Foundation as appropriate in interactions with portfolio company leadership and potentially serve as a board member or board observer. Proactively identify strategic, scientific, financial, governance, and execution risks and opportunities and ensure that SIF leadership and the Investment Committee remain appropriately informed.
  • Serve as a life-sciences thought partner. Act as a trusted internal resource on biotechnology, healthcare innovation, venture formation, and relevant scientific and market trends. Bring external perspectives and emerging opportunities into Foundation strategy discussions while helping external partners understand the Foundation’s objectives and capabilities.
  • Build and activate networks. Develop and maintain a strong network of scientific founders, biotechnology executives, investors, academic leaders, technologists, and company builders who can be mobilized around global health challenges and Foundation priorities.
  • Bring global health considerations into investment decisions. Evaluate opportunities not only through a scientific and commercial lens but also with an understanding of affordability, access, delivery, regulatory pathways, manufacturing, and other constraints affecting adoption in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Contribute to SIF strategy and team development. Share investment and sector insights across the SIF team, contribute to portfolio and strategy reviews, mentor more junior colleagues, and help strengthen SIF’s capabilities and reputation as a leading mission-oriented investor.


Your Experience

We anticipate that the successful candidate will bring a distinctive combination of life-sciences expertise, investment experience, entrepreneurial orientation, and strategic judgment, along with the ability to work effectively across scientific, investment, and business communities.

Ideal qualifications include:

  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience, with a demonstrated track record at the intersection of life-sciences investing, scientific innovation, and company building. Relevant backgrounds may include life-sciences venture capital, biotechnology investing, corporate or business development, company creation, or closely related fields. Exceptional candidates from life-sciences operating or strategy consulting roles with substantial investment, transaction, and company-building experience will also be considered.
  • Advanced scientific training is strongly preferred, including a Ph.D., M.D., PharmD, Master’s degree, or equivalent training in a life-sciences, biomedical, engineering, or related discipline. Candidates with equivalent demonstrated scientific depth and relevant experience will also be considered.
  • Strong scientific and technical judgment, with the ability to identify and evaluate promising technologies and engage credibly with leading scientists, physicians, scientific founders, entrepreneurs, and R&D executives.
  • Demonstrated investment experience across sourcing, diligence, valuation, transaction structuring, negotiation, and portfolio management. Familiarity with a range of investment structures—including preferred equity, convertible securities, debt, and other structured approaches—is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with early-stage biotechnology or healthcare companies, ideally including board or board-observer experience and direct engagement with senior management teams.
  • Company-building and entrepreneurial experience strongly preferred, including direct, hands-on operating experience within an early-stage company and/or meaningful involvement in the formation and launch of new ventures. Relevant experience may include founding or helping build a start-up, working alongside scientific founders and management teams during company formation, spinning technologies out of academic or corporate environments, or creating companies through accelerators, venture studios, or similar models. The ideal candidate will understand firsthand the practical realities and challenges of building an early-stage life-sciences company and bring both practical judgment and empathy for the founders and management teams undertaking that journey.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a highly collaborative, matrixed organization, working across disciplines and organizational boundaries and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific, investment, and strategic concepts for senior executives, technical experts, investors, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and comfort making decisions amid scientific uncertainty and incomplete information.

title: Senior Director, AI FinOps & Platform Economics
description:
Role summary

The Senior Director defines and runs Pfizer’s AI FinOps strategy: the practice, data and governance that make AI consumption and cost transparent, predictable and linked to value. The role owns the enterprise view of token consumption, AI tooling spend and adoption, surfaced today through the PAIM dashboard, and extends it across the eight foundational platforms of the AI backbone (Spark, Pennyworth, Forge49, MemX, Loom, Sentinel, Shield and Sunset).

The leader builds a team that blends finance, data engineering and AI cost optimization, and becomes the trusted voice on AI economics for the ELT, Finance and division leaders.

Key responsibilities

Strategy and leadership

  • Define and execute the multi-year AI FinOps strategy, operating model and roadmap, and represent AI economics to the ELT and the AI FinOps Steering Group.
  • Develop a cross-functional team, phasing roles against platform rollout and the data available.
  • Set decision rights with Finance, Procurement, IT and platform owners so standards, budgets and accountability are clear.

Transparency, cost visibility and allocation

  • Own the AI cost taxonomy, allocation methodology and metric dictionary (for example activated, active, adopted, $ per activated user, cost per million tokens), under change control with a published assumptions page.
  • Deliver showback by division and function with a defined path to chargeback, reconciled to Finance and to invoices.
  • Provide self-service, role-based views for the ELT, division leaders, product owners and engineers.

Platform and data layer

  • Own the internal AI cost and usage data layer and its interfaces (dashboards, governed API, alerts, exports and natural-language access), aligned to the FinOps FOCUS specification where practical.
  • Partner with the owners of the eight foundational platforms to embed metering, tagging, identity and lifecycle signals at source, with Forge49 as the primary meter and Sentinel as the billing and tagging point.
  • Evolve PAIM from a reporting dashboard into a decision tool: budget vs. actual, forecast, unit economics and waste indicators.

Forecasting and optimization

  • Run forecasting, budgeting and scenario planning by tool, model and division, including new model launches, agentic workloads and price changes.
  • Lead the optimization pipeline: license rightsizing, model routing, caching and token efficiency, anomaly detection for runaway workloads and tool consolidation, and track realized savings.
  • Extend the economics to the compute foundation, including HPC capacity commitments and utilization, with the EPMO5 hardware program.

Vendor, value and governance

  • Partner with Procurement on enterprise agreements, committed-spend strategy and model and price lifecycle monitoring, and secure telemetry and transparency terms in vendor contracts.
  • Link spend to outcomes with a lightweight, consistent method for benefits tracking.
  • Establish intake and approval for new AI tools and high-spend use cases, and guardrails (budgets, quotas, rate limits, approved models) managed as code through the platform and DevSecOps pipelines.
  • Safeguard the data: usage data is for adoption and cost analysis only, with purpose limitation, access tiers and audit logging agreed with Privacy, Legal and PX/HR.out 90 days, with wave 2 planned against platform rollout

Basic qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Typically 12+ years of experience in technology finance, FinOps, technology business management, or cloud or data platform management, including 5+ years leading teams.
  • Experience building cost allocation, showback or chargeback models for consumption-based services at enterprise scale (cloud, SaaS or AI).
  • Working knowledge of the FinOps Framework and the practices of forecasting, unit economics and optimization.
  • Proven ability to partner credibly with Finance, Procurement, Engineering and senior executives, and to deliver difficult messages with data.
  • Experience owning data products or dashboards, including metric definitions, data quality and stakeholder adoption.

Preferred qualifications

  • MBA, CPA or FinOps Certified Practitioner or Professional.
  • Hands-on understanding of LLM economics: token pricing, model routing, caching, gateways, and agentic workload cost patterns.
  • Experience in a regulated industry such as pharma, and with privacy-aware analytics on workforce usage data.
  • Vendor negotiation experience, including committed-spend and enterprise agreements.
  • Experience in a federated operating model with shared platforms and divisional ownership.


Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Additional Information

  • In order to be considered for this position in Ireland you need to be legally eligible to work in Ireland.

  • Please note there is no relocation support available for this position

​

How to apply

  • Make a difference today, all suitable candidates should apply with CV below. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

​

Purpose

Breakthroughs that change patients' lives... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives.

Digital Transformation Strategy

One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. We are leading the way in adopting new data, modelling and automated solutions to further digitize and accelerate drug discovery and development with the aim of enhancing health outcomes and the patient experience.

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to building a successful business. As an employer, Pfizer is committed to celebrating this, in all its forms – allowing for us to be as diverse as the patients and communities we serve. Together, we continue to build a culture that encourages, supports and empowers our employees.

Our mission is unleashing the power of all our people and we are proud to be a disability inclusive employer, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all candidates. We encourage you to put your best self forward with the knowledge and trust that we will make any reasonable adjustments to support your application and future career. Your journey with Pfizer starts here!

title: AI Growth Analyst
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Co-op, mRNA Process Development
description:
Company Overview:

Strand Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering programmable mRNA therapeutics to unlock the full potential of genetic medicines. Strand is applying its proprietary Signal Stack platform, which integrates EverScript circular RNA, AmpliScript self-replicating RNA, SignalPath targeted delivery, and logic-driven SignalLock genetic circuits to enable precise control of therapeutic activity across tissues and cell types and overcome foundational limitations in targeting, durability, and safety.

Strand is advancing a pipeline with an initial focus on oncology and autoimmune disease. Its initial program, STX-001, an intratumorally delivered LNP-encapsulated self-replicating RNA expressing IL-12, has demonstrated preliminary evidence of systemic immune activation and anti-tumor activity in patients with advanced solid tumors who have progressed on prior therapies. Building on this early clinical validation, intravenously delivered STX-003 is designed for tumor-targeted expression and avoidance of off-target expression. STX-003, which is expected to enter the clinic in mid-2026, has the potential to be a major step forward for the fields of genetic medicine and oncology. Strand is also advancing STX-005, an in vivo CAR-T program designed to enable controlled, durable expression and repeat dosing. Founded by MIT synthetic biology pioneers, Strand has raised over $250 million and is headquartered in Boston, MA.

Become the next standout single strand!

Job Summary:

Strand is looking for people who have the enthusiasm and motivation to be a highly contributing member of a small but extremely productive team. This opportunity will offer the employee the ability to work in a matrix-based environment and be a part of the future strategy of the company.

We are looking for a highly motivated candidate to join as Co-op of the mRNA Process Development team at Strand Therapeutics to support the development, optimization, and scale-up of manufacturing processes for high-quality mRNA therapeutics. This role will provide hands-on experience with mRNA production, purification, analytical characterization, and process improvement activities in a collaborative and fast-paced biotechnology environment.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Execute experiments related to the advancement of Strands mRNA manufacturing and/or process optimization platforms.
  • Carry out the production of IVT synthesized mRNA.
  • Support screening, optimization, and scale-up efforts for enzymatic reactions, chromatographic separations and filtration processes - including ultrafiltration, diafiltration, and sterile filtration.
  • Perform analytical assays and characterization studies to evaluate mRNA quality and process performance.
  • Analyze experimental data and contribute to technical presentations, reports, and team discussions.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed experimental records in electronic laboratory notebooks.
  • Work effectively to support the group's development activities in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Molecular Medicine, Genetics or related field. Experience in the biotechnology space is a plus.
  • Experience with nucleic acid workflows, chromatography, filtration processes, or biological analytic techniques is preferred, but not required
  • Ability to follow standard operating procedures, make careful observations, maintain clear and complete records of lab work.‪
  • Strong collaboration and inter-personal skills. Ability to present scientific context, experimental set up, data interpretation, and big-picture conclusions to a diverse audience.

Strand Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, national or ethnic origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other basis protected by applicable law. Strand does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from candidates.

Job Type: Co-op

Hourly Rate: $25 - $28 / hour
