title: Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)
description:
Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3) Platform & Reliability Engineering

Location: Dubai, UAE |Function: Engineering| Type: Full-Time| Experience: 7–10 years

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are building one of the region's most ambitious e-commerce platforms: high-traffic, multi-region, and engineered for scale. Our platform — around fifteen backend services, a web storefront and native mobile apps — handles thousands of orders every day, and every one of them depends on infrastructure that is fast, observable, and always on.

This is a founding role for our DevOps & SRE function. You will move our platform off a managed commerce PaaS onto infrastructure we own, set the reliability bar for every engineering squad, and build the team that keeps it there.

ABOUT THE FUNCTION

DevOps & SRE sits at the centre of Lulu's e-commerce engineering. We own the platform every squad ships on: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data stores, networking, security and observability. We run on-call and incident response, define SLOs with product squads, and make sure peak sales events are boring. Over the next 12–18 months our biggest goal is migrating our workloads from a vendor-managed platform onto our own cloud footprint. We are deliberately keeping the team lean and AI‑first: we expect AI agents and assistants to take on a large share of the toil — writing infrastructure‑as‑code and pipelines, triaging alerts, drafting runbooks and postmortems — so a small team can run a large platform.

Core ownership: Cloud infrastructure & Kubernetes, CI/CD & release engineering, observability stack, data‑store operations, on‑call & incident management, platform migration

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
  • Lead the migration of our e-commerce platform from a vendor‑managed PaaS onto our own cloud infrastructure: discovery, target architecture, migration waves, cutover and decommissioning
  • Design and run production Kubernetes for ~15 Python/Django services (DRF, Celery workers and beat), a Next.js storefront and supporting APIs, with Helm and GitOps‑based delivery
  • Operate and scale the stateful core of the platform: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — HA, backups, point‑in‑time recovery, upgrades and capacity planning
  • Build an open‑source observability stack across metrics, logs, traces and profiles (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) that every squad uses day to day
  • Define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product squads for checkout, order management, delivery promise and storefront APIs, and alert on what customers actually feel
  • Modernise CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines: build and release standards, progressive delivery (canary, blue‑green), automated rollbacks and idempotent release scripts
  • Codify everything as infrastructure‑as‑code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including networking, IAM, secrets management and environment provisioning
  • Prepare the platform for peak events — load testing, autoscaling, capacity reviews and game days — so sale days run without incident
  • Run incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive the reliability fixes that come out of them
  • Own cloud cost visibility and optimisation (FinOps), making sure we spend where it buys reliability or speed
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Scope & Impact
  • Own multi‑quarter, multi‑team infrastructure and reliability goals, with the migration programme as the headline deliverable
  • Make independent technical decisions on open‑ended problems — build vs buy, managed vs self‑hosted, which tool and when — grounded in business context and cost
  • Drive cross‑team initiatives across backend, frontend, mobile and data squads, optimising for the platform as a whole rather than any one team
Technical Craft
  • Design infrastructure that meets its reliability, security and cost objectives and stays simple enough for a small team to run
  • Debug non‑deterministic production issues across the stack — kernel, network, container runtime, database, application — that escape less experienced engineers
  • Automate toil relentlessly; treat runbooks, dashboards and alerts as code that is reviewed, versioned and tested
  • Identify and retire technical risk early: single points of failure, untested backups, unpatched dependencies, end‑of‑life runtimes
  • Champion an AI‑first engineering culture — use AI tools and assistants to speed up infrastructure work, incident analysis and documentation
Leadership & Strategy
  • Build the DevOps & SRE function: define its charter, roadmap and operating model, and how it works with product squads (platform‑as‑a‑product, paved roads, self‑service)
  • Hire, coach and grow DevOps and SRE engineers; set the hiring bar and run interview loops for the function
  • Keep the team lean by design — build automation and AI‑assisted workflows that let a small team operate the whole platform, and measure the efficiency gains they deliver
  • Design a sustainable on‑call rotation with clear escalation paths, severity levels, incident command roles and stakeholder communication
  • Establish reliability practices across engineering: SLO reviews, production‑readiness reviews, postmortem culture, change management and DR drills
  • Measure and report engineering health with DORA metrics, SLO attainment and cost dashboards; present them to engineering and business leadership
  • Manage vendor relationships and infrastructure budget, and make the case for investment with data
  • Act as a Culture Leader — partner with engineering leadership to set the tone, foster psychological safety and champion inclusive practices
MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

These are non‑negotiable. We need engineers who can hit the ground running with our stack and ways of working.

  • 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading or acting as technical lead for an infrastructure or reliability team
  • Expert‑level Kubernetes in production — cluster design, networking, ingress, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler), upgrades and troubleshooting
  • Deep experience with at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable): VPC design, IAM, load balancing, managed databases and cost optimisation
  • Strong infrastructure‑as‑code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux)
  • Set up end‑to‑end observability and monitoring from scratch using open‑source tools — metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), logs (Loki or ELK/OpenSearch), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with Tempo or Jaeger) and error tracking (self‑hosted Sentry) — covering infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, queues and application code, with dashboards, alert routing and on‑call integration that teams rely on
  • Practical SRE experience: defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, symptom‑based alerting, incident command and blameless postmortems
  • CI/CD expertise (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) with deployment strategies such as canary and blue‑green
  • Strong Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, CDN, load balancers) and scripting skills in Python, Go or Bash — able to read and debug Python/Django application code
  • Experience running Python web services and async workers (Celery or similar) in production, ideally in e‑commerce, retail or other high‑traffic consumer platforms
NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

These will set you apart and accelerate your impact, but aren't required on day one.

  • Hands‑on leadership of at least one production migration between cloud providers (e.g. AWS to GCP, Azure to AWS) or from a managed PaaS to self‑managed infrastructure — planning, data migration, cutover and rollback
  • Proven experience migrating stateful systems with minimal downtime: PostgreSQL (logical replication, CDC), Kafka (MirrorMaker 2), Elasticsearch (snapshot/restore, reindexing) and Redis
  • Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi), PostgreSQL operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, Patroni) and the Elastic operator (ECK)
  • Long‑term metrics storage and scale‑out observability: Thanos, Mimir or VictoriaMetrics; continuous profiling with Pyroscope; self‑hosted Sentry
  • Platform security and supply chain: HashiCorp Vault or External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper, Falco, image signing and SBOMs
  • Chaos engineering and load testing with LitmusChaos or Chaos Mesh, and k6 or Locust
  • Cost tooling and FinOps practice: OpenCost or Kubecost, rightsizing, committed‑use and spot strategies
  • Building an internal developer platform or portal (e.g. Backstage) for service templates and self‑service environments
  • Familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Pub/Sub) and supporting data‑platform workloads
  • Certifications such as CKA/CKS, Google Professional Cloud Architect or DevOps Engineer, or AWS DevOps Professional
  • Public contributions: conference talks, technical blog posts or open‑source maintainership
TECH STACK Application stack

Python 3.9–3.12 (Django, DRF), Celery, Next.js / React, React Native

Data stores

PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch

Messaging

Kafka

Cloud

GCP (GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) — target for platform migration; AWS / Azure exposure valued

Containers

Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD

IaC

Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible

CI/CD

Bitbucket Pipelines

Observability

Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, Sentry

Security

Vault / External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno, WAF

Reliability

SLOs & error budgets, k6, Chaos Mesh, OpenCost

OUR VALUES

At Lulu, our values aren't wall decorations — they guide how we work, hire, and grow.

Be Customer Obsessed — Every decision in service of the customer's success. Speak & Act Courageously — Challenge the status quo, take calculated risks, and advocate for new ideas. Take Extreme Ownership — Nothing is someone's problem. Uphold excellence and accountability. Learn Voraciously — Growth mindset, curiosity, and continuous improvement. Move with Focus & Urgency — Identify the highest‑impact work and move fast. Win as One Team — Celebrate wins, lend a hand, and invest in each other's growth.

We believe great engineering is about judgment, ownership, and craft — not just code.

If that resonates, we would love to hear from you.

title: Commercial Strategy Associate
description:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media () focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Client Care Team Supervisor - Part Time, Weekends from 11:00 pm to 7:00 am
company: Montgomery County Coalition for the Homeless
description:
General Description: The Client Care Team Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily shift operations to ensure the effective delivery of services and that clients’ basic needs are consistently met. This position provides leadership and support to the Client Care Team during each shift. Full-time positions are available for 1st, 2nd and 3rd shifts Monday through Friday, and part-time positions are available for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd shifts Saturday and Sunday.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide direct supervision to assigned Client Care Aides, including conducting individual and group supervisions, facilitating training, completing performance evaluations, and participating in hiring, and termination processes.
  • Oversee the efficient operations of the Main Control and the staff on the floor, including monitoring and approving timecards for Client Care Aides and facilitating team meetings.
  • Serve as an active member of the shelter’s leadership team, participating in regular meetings and maintaining consistent communication to ensure alignment and efficient operations.
  • Provide emergency intervention in response to crisis situations, utilizing approved skills.
  • Maintain detailed communication logs and incident documentation, ensuring all incident reports are accurate, promptly submitted to management and supported by security camera reviews when applicable.
  • Supervise and coordinate pack ups, supplies and inventory.
  • Supervise the timely processing of incoming mail.
  • Supervise the organization and regular disposal of client storage.
  • Submit maintenance requests and the weekly DFM.
  • Enter data into HMIS and Apricot 360 systems.
  • Arrange transportation for clients.
  • Responsible for accurate tracking of postage stamps, bus tokens and petty cash.

description:

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Technology Team Leader
description:
Career Area:

Engineering

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

CATERPILLAR REMANUFACTURING
Do you have a passion for helping customers and supporting a sustainable solution? Since 1973, Cat Reman has helped bring the value at the core of every Cat product back to life. Customers look to us to provide a high-quality solution that is good for their business - and promotes sustainability. It's important to us to deliver. Our team is full of industry leaders. Together, following common values, we share a passion for delivering sustainability benefits that help the company contribute to a circular economy. It’s rewarding to work, with an inspiring team, where every contribution matters.

Job Summary

Caterpillar's Remanufacturing Division is seeking a Technology Team Leader to join the Smart Factory & Lean Center of Excellence in Mossville, IL. This role will provide technical leadership for the development, integration, and deployment of connected manufacturing technologies across the global Remanufacturing network. The Technology Team Leader will serve as a technical subject matter expert in manufacturing connectivity, industrial data integration, and visualization, helping establish the digital foundation required to improve safety, quality, velocity, and cost.

The position will partner closely with manufacturing engineering, operations, IT, and facility leadership to connect manufacturing assets, automate the collection of production data, develop scalable visualization solutions, and transform manufacturing information into actionable insights.

A key focus of this position will be developing and scaling Caterpillar's Device Wise capability across Remanufacturing while ensuring solutions are repeatable, sustainable, and aligned with the broader Modern Manufacturing strategy.

What You Will Do:

  • Identifying, defining, leading implementation of integrated supply chain solutions and performance improvements, including building internal and external alliances to explore opportunities.
  • Establishing and strengthening effective linkages, partnerships, and best practices with business partners and internal functions.
  • Investigating and incorporating industry benchmarks, metrics and best practices to develop optimal supply chains for suppliers and/or product sets.
  • Leads the development and analyzes data and information to identify and prioritize opportunities for improving performance and creating more cost-effective supply chains, inventory utilization, and business partnerships.

What You Will Have


Technical Leadership & DeviceWise Connectivity

  • Provide technical leadership for Smart Factory connectivity, data integration, and visualization across Remanufacturing facilities, serving as the escalation point for complex connectivity challenges.
  • Serve as DeviceWise subject matter expert, developing and deploying solutions that connect PLCs, machine controls, test equipment, sensors, and other manufacturing assets.
  • Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication across PLCs, industrial networks, databases, and enterprise systems.
  • Establish technical standards and repeatable approaches that reduce the time and effort needed to connect additional equipment and replicate solutions across facilities.

Data Integration & Visualization

· Enable reliable flow of manufacturing data from equipment and shop-floor systems into MES, ERP, SAP/QAD, databases, and visualization platforms.

  • Support automated collection and visualization of operational metrics including OEE, throughput, downtime, cycle time, quality, yield, and equipment performance.
  • Partner with manufacturing and operations teams to turn production data into trusted information that enables faster problem solving and decision making.

Innovation & Future Capability

· Support advanced manufacturing analytics and AI-enabled use cases that use equipment and process data to predict losses, improve quality, increase asset utilization, and reduce unplanned downtime.

  • Develop proof-of-concept solutions and lead successful concepts through pilot, standardization, and replication.
  • Stay current on emerging industrial IoT, edge computing, analytics, and automation technologies, recommending solutions based on business value, scalability, and operational requirements.

Project & Cross-Functional Leadership

· Lead technical workstreams and projects across multiple facilities and functions, coordinating with manufacturing engineering, operations, IT, and suppliers.

  • Develop technical project plans, identify risks, resolve technical barriers, and communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Partner directly with facility manufacturing engineering teams to deploy solutions without long-term dependency on the central COE.
  • Coach and mentor engineers and technical resources in DeviceWise and connected-manufacturing technologies, building stronger digital manufacturing capability throughout Remanufacturing.


Who Will Be Great for This Role!

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing manufacturing technology, industrial automation, Industrial IoT, or connected-factory solutions.
  • Experience integrating manufacturing equipment with PLCs, industrial networks, databases, MES, ERP, or other manufacturing information systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technical projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capability in manufacturing or industrial technology environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced experience with DeviceWise Workbench and DeviceWise Viewer.
  • Experience connecting and troubleshooting Allen-Bradley and/or Siemens PLCs.
  • Strong understanding of OT/IT integration and industrial networking.
  • Experience with SQL databases and data integration.
  • Experience with Power BI or comparable manufacturing visualization platforms.
  • Experience integrating manufacturing systems with MES, SAP, QAD, ERP, SCADA, or other enterprise systems.
  • Experience with edge computing and Industrial IoT architecture.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing metrics including OEE, throughput, cycle time, downtime, yield, SPC, and Cp/Cpk.
  • Experience developing technical standards and replicating solutions across multiple manufacturing facilities.
  • Experience coaching or training engineers and technical professionals.
  • Experience working across multiple manufacturing facilities and global organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate manufacturing problems into scalable technical solutions with measurable business impact.

Additional Information

  • This position will support manufacturing facilities across Caterpillar Remanufacturing.
  • Up to 50% travel to Remanufacturing facilities will be required to support deployment, troubleshooting, training, and replication activities.
  • The successful candidate will work extensively across manufacturing engineering, operations, IT, Modern Manufacturing, and other technical organizations.

What You Will Get!

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world.

Here you earn more than just an hourly wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of annual bonuses.

Additional benefits include paid vacation days and paid holidays (prorated based upon hire date).

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holiday, Volunteer, Etc.)

• 401k savings plan

• Health savings account (HSA)

• Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)

• Short and long-term disability coverage

• Life Insurance

• Paid parental leave

• Healthy Lifestyle Programs

• Employee Assistance Programs

• Voluntary Benefits (Ex. Accident, Identity Theft Protection)


All eligible candidates MUST pass the following pre-employment screenings before they can be hired to any Caterpillar position:

• Background Screening

• Drug & Alcohol Screening

Please ensure you frequently sign into your candidate home for any updates or correspondence for positions that you have applied for.

Keep a frequent check on emails as correspondence will be sent to the email that you used to apply with. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

Visa sponsorship is NOT available for this position.

This employer is not currently hiring foreign national applicants that require or will require sponsorship tied to a specific employer, such as, H, L, TN, F, J, E, O. As a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers

Domestic relocation assistance is offered for this position.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

$112,710.00 - $169,060.00

Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.

Benefits:

Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.

  • Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)*

  • 401(k) savings plans*

  • Disability benefits

  • Parental leave

  • Adoption benefits

  • Tuition Reimbursement

* These benefits also apply to part-time employees

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Relocation is available for this position.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Posting Dates:

November 16, 2026 - November 28, 2026

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.

title: Software Engineer, Backend (채용전환형) - 커뮤니티
description:
당근 팀 합류 여정에 오르신 것을 진심으로 환영해요

당근은 회사의 성장에 맞춰 개인이 함께 성장할 수 있는 환경을 만들기 위해 노력을 하고 있어요.

멋진 동료들과 행복한 고민을 하는 그 순간이 올 수 있도록 당근 채용팀이 도와드릴게요.

>> 2027 당근 프로덕트 빌더 인턴십 페이지 바로 가기

2027 당근 프로덕트 빌더 인턴십은 당근의 실제 지면과 문제를 직접 맡아 풀어 보는 채용전환형 인턴십이에요.

팀의 실무를 맡아 진행하는 동시에, 팀이 열어 둔 실제 지면과 문제를 푸는 역할을 해내요. 가설을 세워 직접 개발하고, 출시한 뒤 유저 반응으로 검증해요.

커뮤니티 홈팀을 소개해요

중고거래로 시작한 당근은 국내 최대 지역 커뮤니티 서비스로 나아가고 있어요. 커뮤니티실은 당근모임, 당근카페, 당근아파트, 동네생활 등 이웃이 알려 주는 진짜 동네 정보부터 소소한 일상과 취미까지 나누는 커뮤니티 서비스를 만들어요.

커뮤니티 홈팀은 커뮤니티실의 다양한 서비스와 이웃들의 이야기가 만나는 커뮤니티 탭을 만들어요. 모임, 카페, 아파트, 동네생활에 쌓이는 수많은 이야기와 활동 중에서 각자에게 의미 있는 것을 발견할 수 있도록 도와요. 처음 방문한 사람도 자신의 관심사에 맞는 이야기와 커뮤니티를 쉽게 찾고 자연스럽게 참여할 수 있도록, 커뮤니티 탭이 우리 동네에서 일어나는 일을 가장 먼저 발견하는 곳이 되도록 만들고 있어요.

합류 후 풀어 갈 문제

특정 관심사를 가진 이웃들이 매일 쓰게 되는 기능을 만들어요

당근 커뮤니티에는 육아, 러닝, 반려동물 같은 관심사별 채널이 있고, 이웃들이 매일 글을 올려요. 그런데 글에는 비슷한 질문이 계속 반복돼요. “이 동네 어린이집 자리 나는 데 있나요?”, “강아지랑 같이 갈 수 있는 식당 어디예요?” 같은 것들이에요.

이런 질문은 글로 묻고 답하는 것보다 기능 하나로 해결하는 것이 더 좋다고 생각해요. 이 팀에서는 다른 관심사에서도 이렇게 “글로 반복되는 질문”을 찾아 기능으로 만들고, 이웃들이 실제로 계속 쓰는지 확인해요.

맡게 될 지면 − 커뮤니티 탭 › 관심사 채널

육아 채널의 어린이집 찾기·대기 알림 기능으로 먼저 시작했어요. 어떤 관심사에서 어떤 기능을 맡을지는 합류 시점에 함께 정해요.

이런 임팩트를 기대해요

  • 유저에게 − 관심 있는 글을 읽다가 생긴 필요를 그 자리에서 해결해요. 반려동물 채널이라면 강아지 동반 가능한 식당을 조건으로 바로 찾고, 다녀온 이웃의 후기까지 같이 봐요.
  • 당근에게 − 육아, 러닝, 반려동물처럼 일상 속의 관심사마다 당근을 매일 켜는 이유가 하나씩 생겨요. 커뮤니티가 글을 읽는 곳에서 실제로 일을 해결하는 곳으로 넓어져요.

이렇게 일해요

인턴십 기간 동안 팀의 엔지니어로 실무를 맡으면서, 팀이 열어 둔 문제를 직접 풀어요.

  • 팀의 실무 − 팀 엔지니어들과 함께 기능을 개발하고, 코드 리뷰를 주고받고, 운영 대응까지 맡아요. 이 과정에서 팀의 제품과 코드, 데이터를 익혀요
  • 직접 푸는 문제 − 하나의 관심사와 그 사용자를 맡아, 문제 발견부터 제품 개발과 운영까지 진행해요. 사용자 인터뷰와 행동을 바탕으로 첫 제품을 정하고, 필요한 화면과 서버를 직접 구현해 실제 사용자에게 선보여요. 반응에 따라 개선하거나 방향을 바꾸며 PMF를 탐색해요

목표

어떤 사용자에게 어떤 문제를 해결해 주는 제품인지 설명할 수 있고, 그 사용자가 실제로 쓰고 필요할 때 다시 찾는 모습을 확인하는 것을 목표로 해요.

만드는 제품에 맞춰 핵심 행동의 완료, 반복 이용, 사용자 피드백을 함께 살펴봐요. 예를 들어 장소 찾기라면 화면 방문에 그치지 않고 원하는 장소를 찾는 데 도움이 됐는지, 다음 외출 때도 사용하는지를 확인해요.

무엇을 유지하고 바꾸거나 중단할지 근거를 가지고 판단하며 제품과 사용자 수요가 맞는 지점, PMF를 찾아가는 과정을 중요하게 봐요.

커뮤니티실은 동네에서 일어나는 일을 더 쉽게 즐기고 나눌 수 있는 방법이라면 무엇이든 도전하고 실행에 옮겨요. 만드는 사람이 불편할수록 쓰는 사람은 편하다는 믿음으로, 홈팀의 여러 직군 동료들과 한 팀이 되어 문제를 풀어요.

이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요

  • 직접 개발한 서비스를 배포·운영하여 실제 사용자를 확보해 본 분
  • 서버 애플리케이션을 설계하고 구현·운영해 본 분
  • 인턴십 기간(2027.1.25(월) – 5.4(화)) 중 주 5일 풀타임 근무가 가능한 분
  • 입사 시점 기준 병역필 또는 병역 면제자, 해외여행에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 분이면 더 좋아요

  • 내가 만든 서비스를 직접 사용자로 쓰며 느낀 불편으로 제품을 발전시켜 본 분
  • 서버앱에 머물지 않고 웹앱, 데이터, 운영 도구까지 필요한 곳이면 손을 뻗어 제품을 완성해 본 분
  • Claude Code, Codex 같은 코딩 에이전트로 자신만의 AI 워크플로를 만들어 일하는 분

팀에서 사용하는 기술이에요

서버앱이 중심이지만, 제품을 끝까지 책임지다 보면 웹앱과 데이터, AI까지 넘나들게 돼요.

  • 서버앱: Kotlin, Spring with Jakarta Servlet, Exposed
  • 웹앱: TypeScript, React with Streaming SSR, TanStack Query
  • API와 통신: OpenAPI, gRPC with Protocol Buffers
  • 메시징: Kafka, RabbitMQ
  • 데이터 저장소: MySQL, Redis, BigQuery
  • 검색과 임베딩: OpenSearch, Gemini
  • 관찰성: Datadog, Grafana, Sentry
  • AI: Spring AI와 OpenAI SDK 기반 LLM 연동, AI 에이전트(Node.js, TypeScript), Python과 Go 기반 추천 엔진
  • 인프라와 운영: 사내 배포 플랫폼, GitHub Actions

우리는 자율과 책임의 문화를 중요하게 생각해요. 스스로 상황에 맞게 필요하거나 도입하고 싶은 기술이 있다면 언제든지 적용할 수 있어요.

기술은 문제를 해결하는 수단이라고 생각해요. 위 기술을 써 보지 않았더라도 괜찮아요.

이렇게 지원해요

  • 자유 양식 이력서 (PDF)
  • 포트폴리오 (PDF) − 직접 개발해 운영한 서비스를 소개하는 자료예요. ‘포트폴리오’ 항목에 첨부해 주세요. 링크는 PDF 파일에 주소를 적어 제출해 주세요. 이력서와 포트폴리오에 아래 내용을 담아 주세요
    • 팀 구성과 본인이 맡은 부분
    • 이용자 수·트래픽·운영 기간 같은 지표
    • 사용자의 문제를 어떻게 발견하고 무엇을 바꿨는지
    • 어떤 기술을 왜 선택했는지
  • 서비스 링크와 레포 링크 − ‘서비스 링크’·‘레포 링크’ 항목에 각각 적어 주세요. 운영을 종료했다면 시연 영상을, 레포가 비공개라면 핵심 코드 일부를 볼 수 있는 링크를 남겨 주세요

참고해 주세요

  • 인턴십 기간은 2027년 1월 25일(월) – 5월 4일(화)이에요
  • 인턴십 기간 중 정규직 전환 인터뷰 기회를 드려요. 인터뷰 결과에 따라 정규직 입사 여부를 최종 결정해요
  • 인터뷰 시기를 포함한 전체 절차는 필요 시 일부 조정될 수 있어요. 각 단계의 세부 일정은 합격자에게 개별 안내해요
  • 지원서 내용이 사실과 다를 경우 합격이 취소될 수 있어요
  • 커뮤니티, 나의당근, 피드 인프라 중 한 팀에만 지원할 수 있어요. 여러 팀에 지원하시면 가장 먼저 제출한 지원서만 검토해요
  • 서류는 12월 6일(일) 23시 59분 마감 예정이에요
  • 맡게 될 문제는 팀 상황에 따라 변경될 수 있어요
  • ‘장애인고용촉진 및 직업재활법’, ‘국가유공자 등 예우 및 지원에 관한 법률’에 따라 장애인 및 보훈대상자는 채용 전형 시 우대하고 있어요

이렇게 합류해요

1. 서류 전형 → 2. 화상 인터뷰(라이브 코딩 테스트 포함) → 3. 직무 인터뷰(대면) → 4. 최종 합격 및 입사

당근 전형 소개

서류 전형

당근은 자유형식의 지원서를 받고 있어요.

본인의 강점이 잘 드러나는 다양한 정보를 자유롭게 활용해 이력서를 작성해 주세요.

  • 문서 형식은 hwp(한글) 파일을 제외하고 word, pdf, 웹 링크 등 자유롭게 선택해주시면 돼요.
  • 웹 링크(노션, 구글드라이브 등)로 서류를 제출해주실 때는 접근 권한을 꼭 열어주세요.
  • 평가와 상관 없는 사진, 주소 등의 개인정보는 제외해주세요.

화상 면접

지원해주신 직무와 업무 연관성이 높은 당근 팀원과 화상으로 직무와 관련된 기본적인 지식에 대해 이야기를 나누는 단계예요.

과제 전형

직무에 따라 과제 전형이 있어요. 과제는 직무 능력과 연관된 내용으로 출제돼요. 과제 전형을 별도로 운영하는 직무도 있고, 화상 면접 또는 직무 면접에서 과제가 함께 출제되는 경우도 있어요.

직무 면접

지원하신 직무와 업무 연관성이 높은 당근 팀원들과 직무 역량, 경험에 대해 화상 면접보다 심층적인 이야기를 나누는 단계예요.
과제가 출제되었을 경우 과제에 대한 질문을 드려요.

컬쳐핏 면접(정규직 공통)

당근은 면접을 단순히 회사에 사람을 뽑는 자리로 생각하지 않아요. 당근과 지원자가 서로 추구하는 가치관과 생각을 교환하는 시간이라고 생각하고 있어요. 컬쳐핏 단계는 당근이 추구하는 문화와 일하는 방식과 잘 어울릴 수 있는 분인지 확인하는 단계예요. 또한 포지션에 대한 전문성을 다시금 확인하는 이야기를 나눠요.

안내사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있어요.
  • 전형 절차는 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있다는 점 참고해 주세요.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우 합격이 취소될 수 있어요.
  • 보훈대상자 및 장애인 여부는 채용 과정에서 불이익이 없어요.
  • 경력 기간에 따라 추가 역량 검증을 위해 최대 3개월 계약직으로 근무할 수 있어요.
  • 정규직 채용의 경우 입사 후 3개월의 수습 기간이 있어요.
    평가 결과에 따라 수습 기간이 연장되거나 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.

당근 채용에 대해 궁금한 점이 있으면 언제든지 편하게 문의 주세요 :)

title: Research Assistant in Molecular Memory Research
description:
Position Details

  • Full-Time | Fixed term until 31 December 2027
  • Higher Education Officer Level 5 | $84,599 - $93,366
  • Location: Bedford Park / Kaurna Country
  • View Position Description

About the Role

Join Flinders University's Flinders Health and Medical Research Institute (FHMRI) Neuroscience as a Research Assistant in Molecular Memory and contribute to exciting research exploring the mechanisms of learning and memory and the molecular processes underlying memory loss in dementia. Working within a dynamic research laboratory, you will provide experimental, technical and operational support across a range of research activities.

In this role, you will:

  • Assist in planning, conducting and analysing laboratory experiments involving molecular biology, protein biology, cell biology and tissue samples.
  • Support research using rodent models, including animal welfare monitoring and behavioural and memory testing.
  • Contribute to research outputs, including data documentation, manuscripts, reports and grant applications.
  • Support the day-to-day running of the laboratory, including equipment and inventory management, ordering supplies and assisting with student and staff training.

This position makes a significant contribution to the University’s strategic plan of “Changing 10 million lives, Every One Matters”, by 2035 through advancing research that improves our understanding of learning, memory and the molecular processes underlying memory loss in dementia. By supporting innovative, high-quality neuroscience research, this role contributes to the strategic driver of Research that Matters, helping generate new knowledge and insights that have the potential to inform future approaches to dementia research and improve health outcomes for individuals and communities.

About You

You are a motivated and adaptable research professional with a strong interest in biomedical and molecular life sciences. You enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced research environment and bring practical laboratory experience, a proactive approach and a commitment to supporting high-quality research.

You will demonstrate:

  • A degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Neuroscience or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of qualifications and experience.
  • Practical experience in molecular, protein and cell biology techniques, as well as laboratory research and handling laboratory mice, ideally including stereotaxic procedures and behavioural or memory testing.
  • Strong organisational, administrative and laboratory management skills, including experience with ordering, inventory management and research documentation.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, the ability to work independently and collaboratively, and flexibility to support the research team, including occasional weekend duties if required.

College of Medicine and Public Health

At the College of Medicine and Public Health, we deliver clinical, population and lab-based research, integrated teaching programs and high-quality clinical services. Our footprint reaches out from our world class teaching hospital at the Flinders Medical Centre in South Australia to multiple rural clinical locations all the way to Darwin in the Northern Territory. Our research and teaching equip the next generation of leaders and innovators with the skill, commitment, and vision to protect vulnerable communities and truly advance health outcomes. It is at the heart of everything we do.

Life at Flinders

They say know your place. We say you've found it right here.

Flinders University was founded on the belief that learning should open minds, celebrate individuality and give people the freedom to pursue their own point of view. That spirit lives on in our community of thinkers, doers and changemakers who challenge convention, and each other, to shape what comes next.

Rising to a challenge is nothing new for Flinders. During our first 60 years, we’ve navigated revolutionary changes in social and cultural norms, and have responded to transformative economic, environmental and technological developments. Through it all, we’ve continued to deliver for our students and community, innovating in learning and research to prepare graduates for the changing world they help create.

Reaching beyond the limits of buildings, borders, and backgrounds, ours is an inclusive culture that believes absolutely in equality and opportunity for all. We don't just accommodate differences; we embrace and celebrate them.

So, why work at Flinders?

  • Ranked in the top 2% of universities worldwide.
  • 17% Superannuation + salary packaging options.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Awarded the AHEIA Higher Education Award for Workplace Culture Excellence due to our commitment to wellbeing through our Thriving@Flinders staff wellbeing program
  • Wide range of professional development activities and services, including exclusive staff study offers.
  • We embrace diversity and promote equity and inclusion for all students and staff, as shown through our three SAGE Cygnet Awards.
  • Vibrant campus life and amenities including on campus health care services, gym and childcare centre (Bedford Park, South Australia).
  • Recognised as a Veteran Employer of Choice.


Our Commitment to Reconciliation and Indigenous Employment


Flinders University is proud to be an organisation that is committed to our Reconciliation Action Plan and Indigenous Workforce Strategy. Our vision is to be a preferred employer for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples. We are committed to progressing Indigenous advancement in education, research, employment, and wellbeing, and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples for all Flinders vacancies.

  • Please see here for our Reconciliation Action Plan
  • Please see here for our Indigenous Workforce Strategy

Prescribed Conditions for Employment


Appointment to this role is conditional on the completion of required pre-employment checks and declarations, each of which must be satisfactory to the University.

These include:

  • Flinders University will require a current completed Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check and Gender Based Violence Declaration which is satisfactory to the University. The contract of Employment is conditional upon the receipt of these completed compliance checks. A disclosable outcome will not automatically disqualify a candidate from consideration. Each case will be assessed on its individual merits and relevance to the inherent requirements of the role.
  • Staff working in a health care setting are strongly recommended to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19 in line with the SA Health policy.

How to Apply and Information

  • You are required to submit a CV, along with a Suitability Statement as a separate document. This should be no more than 3 pages and address the Key Position Capabilities of the position description.
  • Flinders University is committed to providing an environment where staff with disability are valued, supported and encouraged to participate fully and independently in the life of the University. If you require any reasonable adjustments to assist you in the selection process, please contact the Recruitment Team so that we can make appropriate arrangements through recruitment@flinders.edu.au or call 08 8201 2383.
  • For more information regarding this position, please contact Arne Ittner

Important Notice: Recruitment Activity During University Shutdown
Please note that recruitment activity will be paused during the Flinders University shutdown period. No updates or progress on applications will be available between 24 December 2026 and 4 January 2027.

Recruitment processes will resume from 4 January 2027, and application statuses will be communicated from that date onward.

We appreciate your understanding and patience during this time.


Certification

Applications to be submitted before 10.00pm:

30 Nov 2026

At Flinders we embrace and celebrate diversity and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities.

Flinders. Fearless.

title: AI Implementation Analyst
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Engineer-PLC SW Design
description:
Career Area:

Engineering

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


Role Summary

The Controls Engineer will maintain and support industrial gas turbine control systems and packaged auxiliary equipment. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Allen-Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix platforms and Rockwell Automation Studio 5000, combined with sound understanding of turbine sequencing, protection, instrumentation, industrial networks and field troubleshooting. The engineer will collaborate with global engineering, manufacturing, field service, suppliers and customers across the product lifecycle. The incumbent will be working as a part of Solar PRU (Product Refurbishment & Upgrades) team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain PLC application software using Studio 5000 / RSLogix 5000, including Ladder Diagram, Function Block Diagram and Structured Text.
  • The incumbent will maintain or update standard structure and existing product through Engineering Change Requests (ECR).
  • Design gas turbine and package logic for start-up, shutdown, purge, crank, ignition, acceleration, warm-up, synchronization, loading, unloading, cooldown and emergency stop sequences.
  • Implement permissive, interlocks, alarms, trips, first-out diagnostics, fail-safe behavior and equipment protection consistent with approved control narratives and safety requirements.
  • Develop or review functional specifications, control narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, I/O lists, alarm lists, network architecture, panel interfaces and software design documentation.
  • Integrate turbine controls with fuel, lube oil, starting, ventilation, fire and gas, generator, compressor, anti-surge and balance-of-plant systems.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve availability, reliability, operability, maintainability, safety, quality and execution.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline.
  • 5-10 years of relevant experience in industrial controls, turbomachinery, power generation, oil and gas, process plants or rotating equipment packages.
  • Demonstrated programming and troubleshooting experience with Allen-Bradley ControlLogix or CompactLogix and Studio 5000 / RSLogix 5000.
  • Working knowledge of electrical and instrumentation drawings, P&IDs, loop diagrams, wiring schematics, I/O systems, sensors, actuators and control panels.


Core Technical Competencies

  • PLC software architecture, reusable modules, tag/database management, online diagnostics, change control and code review.
  • Gas turbine operating principles and control concepts including speed, temperature, fuel, load, acceleration, protection and shutdown control.
  • HMI / SCADA configuration, alarm rationalization, trending, operator interfaces and diagnostic visualization.
  • Verification and validation using simulators, test benches, emulators or hardware-in-the-loop environments.

Preferred Experience

  • Controls engineering experience with a gas turbine OEM, rotating-equipment OEM, EPC, system integrator or industrial power / oil and gas organization.
  • Experience with gas turbine packages, gas compressors, generators and related auxiliary systems.
  • Exposure to FactoryTalk View, Rockwell GuardLogix, safety PLCs, Bently Nevada systems, generator controls or compressor anti-surge controls.

title: Metsäasiakasvastaava
description:
Would you like to join a global, growing company that innovates for a more sustainable tomorrow? UPM could be the team for you. We are frontrunners in developing renewable alternatives to fossil-based materials. Besides enabling both businesses and consumers make more sustainable choices, we strive to create a positive UPM experience for all our employees around the world. We live by our values – trust and be trusted, achieve together, renew with courage. Together we can renew the everyday, for a future beyond fossils!

Learn more about us as a workplace

Haemme nyt metsäasiakasvastaavaa UPM Metsän Jämsän toimipisteelle. Työsuhde on määräaikainen 30.11.2027 asti.

Terveiset tulevalta esihenkilöltä

“Oletko etsimämme metsän tulevaisuuden tekijä? Meillä pääset työskentelemään lähellä asiakkaita ja näkemään oman työsi vaikutukset käytännössä. Metsäasiakasvastaavan työssä tärkeintä ovat ihmiset – luottamuksen rakentaminen, asiakkaiden tarpeiden ymmärtäminen ja pitkäjänteisten asiakassuhteiden kehittäminen. Tarjoamme sinulle itsenäisen ja monipuolisen roolin sekä osaavan tiimin tuen matkalla kohti onnistumisia. Tiimissämme vallitsee hyvä yhteishenki ja tekemisen meininki. Jos haluat tehdä merkityksellistä työtä metsänomistajien kanssa, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinua varten.” – Jani Nuijanmaa, Metsäasiakaspäällikkö

Mitä teet

  • Vastaat asiakkuuksien hoidosta, puunostosta ja metsäpalveluiden myynnistä omalla palvelualueellasi
  • Hankit aktiivisesti uusia asiakkaita sekä johdat ja kehität olemassa olevia asiakkuuksia tavoitteellisesti ja pitkäjänteisesti
  • Tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeet, autat heitä hyödyntämään metsänsä mahdollisuuksia ja tarjoat ratkaisuja heidän tavoitteidensa saavuttamiseksi
  • Hyödynnät tehokkaasti dataa ja digitaalisia työkaluja työssäsi
  • Työn luonne on itsenäistä ja liikkuvaa sisältäen asiakas- ja metsäkäyntejä
  • Turvallisuus on arvo, joka ohjaa kaikkea toimintaamme. Edistät sitä päivittäisessä työssäsi huolehtimalla itsestäsi, toisista ja työympäristöstäsi



Kuka olet

  • Sinulla on aito halu oppia uutta ja kiinnostus työskennellä metsäalalla. Koet vastuullisen ja pitkäjänteisen metsäomaisuuden hoitamisen tärkeäksi
  • Tehtävän menestyksekäs hoitaminen edellyttää metsätalouden osaamista. Metsäalan koulutus katsotaan eduksi
  • Nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja asiakassuhteiden rakentamisesta. Haluat ymmärtää asiakkaiden tarpeita ja löytää heille sopivia ratkaisuja
  • Innostut myynnistä ja olet tavoitteellinen. Työskentelet suunnitelmallisesti sekä kannat vastuun asiakkuuksiesi metsävarallisuuden pitkäjänteisestä hoidosta ja kehittämisestä
  • Olet kiinnostunut ja kyvykäs omaksumaan uusia järjestelmiä ja hyödyntämään metsäistä dataa työssäsi
  • Pystyt käymään sopimusneuvottelut suomeksi. Sujuva englannin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi

Tarjoamme sinulle

  • Merkityksellinen työ: Toimintamme tarkoitus inspiroi meitä ‘Uudistamme arkea yhdessä kohti fossiilisista raaka-aineista riippumatonta tulevaisuutta!’ Työmme on vaikuttavaa ja tukee muutosta.
  • Välittävä yhteisö: Yhteisömme perustuu hyvään tiimihenkeen ja yhteiseen päämäärään. Välitämme toisistamme ja toistemme hyvinvoinnista. Tuemme työ- ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamista.
  • Kehittymismahdollisuudet: Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuksia oppimiseen ja kasvamiseen koko työurasi aikana. Olemme kansainvälinen, monialainen organisaatio ja tarjoamme runsaasti mahdollisuuksia henkilökohtaiseen kasvuun.
  • Vastuullinen työnantaja: Vastuullisuus on kaiken toimintamme ytimessä. Olemme sitoutuneet kunnianhimoisiin, tieteeseen perustuviin kestävän kehityksen tavoitteisiin kaikilla alueilla ilmastonmuutoksen hillitsemisestä luonnon monimuotoisuuden edistämiseen. Vaalimme monimuotoisuutta ja inklusiivisuutta tarjoamalla työympäristön, jossa jokainen voi olla oma itsensä.

Tutustu myös palkitsemiseen ja kulttuuriimme nettisivuillamme.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä

Tehtävään valittu henkilö raportoi metsäasiakaspäällikölle. Työ sisältää liikkumista toimialueella, joten tehtävä edellyttää ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Jani Nuijanmaa, metsäasiakaspäällikkö, jani.nuijanmaa@upm.com tai puh. +358407166473.

Hakeminen

Lähetä hakemuksesi 7.12.2026 mennessä. Liitäthän hakemuksesi oheen myös ansioluettelosi ja hakemuskirjeesi. Huomioithan, että hyväksymme vain hakemukset, jotka on lähetetty verkkohakemusjärjestelmämme kautta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi hakuajan aikana ja saatamme kutsua hakijoita haastatteluun jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä.

Rekrytointijärjestelmään liittyvissä kysymyksissä ota yhteyttä HR-palveluihin: careers@upm.com tai puh. +358204146600.

Lisätietoja hakemisesta löydät urasivuiltamme.

Maakohtaiset tiedot

UPM:n työpaikkoihin valittaville henkilöille suoritetaan turvallisuusselvitys yhtiön rekrytointiohjeen ja turvallisuusselvityslain 726/2014 mukaisesti.

UPM Metsä
Metsän tulevaisuuden tekijät – kasvu, monimuotoisuus, hyvinvointi. Metsä on meille hintaansa arvokkaampi. Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme luotettava tuki, joka auttaa säilyttämään metsäomaisuuden arvon myös tulevaisuudessa. Varmistamme metsien kestävän kasvun niin omissa kuin asiakkaidemme metsissä edistämällä hiilensidontaa ja luonnon monimuotoisuutta, kun hankimme kestävästi raaka-ainetta puupohjaisiin tuotteisiin. www.upmmetsa.fi

title: Head of Accessibility
description:
About the job

Do you want to make investing accessible to everyone, and be the driving force behind how a global bank achieves this? We are looking for a Head of Accessibility to lead accessibility across Saxo, from strategy and regulation to the screens our clients use every day.

This is a new role with a real mandate, visibility and impact. In this role, you will shape how Saxo approaches accessibility across every market we serve, work with senior leaders across the bank, and help make investing more inclusive for clients around the world. You will have the overall ownership of accessibility within Saxo.


The role is placed in our Platforms & AI (Journey 2) area within Saxo. In Journey 2, we build and develop Saxo's online trading and investing platforms. In this role you will report directly to the Head of Platform Management.


We offer a competitive salary package and have a hybrid working model from our headquarters in Hellerup.

Responsibilities

You'll be responsible for ensuring that Saxo meets accessibility requirements in the EU, Switzerland, the UK, Singapore, MENA and Japan. You will ensure this by working closely with our Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams. Furthermore, you will:

  • Establish Saxo's accessibility governance framework within your first six months, including policy, standards, decision forums and controls
  • Translate regulations in each market into clear requirements for the business
  • Build and run a reporting framework that shows exactly where Saxo stands
  • Create and own the roadmap, with clear dates for when compliance will be achieved
  • Help teams build accessibility in from the start, through training, standards and tooling
  • Get involved in design reviews to testing with assistive technologies

Your profile

  • Several years of experience working with digital accessibility, including WCAG, EN 301 549 and assistive technologies
  • Experience from the financial sector ideally with regulatory compliance or regulatory change
  • Experience working with regulation requirements across several markets and an IAAP certification is a plus
  • Strong stakeholder manager skills
  • Ability to set up governance that works in practice
  • Strong delivery mindset and a track record of landing complex, cross-organisational initiatives
  • Hands-on and pragmatic approach
  • Fluent in English

Apply via the link with your CV and a few lines about an accessibility or compliance initiative you've led and what it achieved. We review applications on an ongoing basis. For questions about the role, contact Casper Blücher Brun, Head of Platform Management, at cabr@saxobank.com.

title: Clinical Specialist
description:
AtriCure, Inc. provides innovative technologies for the treatment of Afib and related conditions. Afib affects more than 33 million people worldwide. Electrophysiologists and cardiothoracic surgeons around the globe use AtriCure technologies for the treatment of Afib and reduction of Afib related complications. AtriCure’s Isolator® Synergy™ Ablation System is the first medical device to receive FDA approval for the treatment of persistent Afib. AtriCure’s AtriClip® Left Atrial Appendage Exclusion System products are the most widely sold LAA management devices worldwide. AtriCure’s Hybrid AF™ Therapy is a minimally invasive procedure that provides a lasting solution for long-standing persistent Afib patients. AtriCure’s cryoICE cryoSPHERE® probe is cleared for temporary ablation of peripheral nerves to block pain, providing pain relief in cardiac and thoracic procedures. For more information, visit AtriCure.com or follow us on Twitter @AtriCure.

We foster a culture of inclusion by embracing diverse experiences and individuals where everyone’s authentic self is welcome. We offer supporting programs and resources that provide enriching and equitable opportunities for each person to contribute professionally and personally.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Clinical Specialist role primarily supports field sales in the cardiac operating room and related departments in the following:

  • Support during surgical procedures where company devices are utilized.
  • Training of surgical and OR staff personnel in the use of company devices.
  • Guidance and support for physicians during live surgical procedures, and utilization and/or operation of company technology.

This position requires teamwork and strategic planning with the sales force and Program Development team. The focus of the Clinical Specialist is to support the account development process for the company by providing a resource to the sales manager, physician, and operating room staff. Clinical Specialists must be able to train and support the surgeon and their staff in various procedures and support him/her technically in the O.R. and during follow-up patient care as required.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct training for the surgeon and medical staff with modalities such as didactic and hands-on laboratory approaches.
  • Provide technical and clinical support during surgical procedures.
  • Make calls on surgeons and support staff as necessary to discuss AtriCure technology, training programs, and clinical programs and trials.
  • Work in a team environment with Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.
  • Communication on a frequent basis, reporting on case notes and product and clinical feedback.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Experience working in an Operating Room, Electrophysiology (EP) Lab or Catheterization lab either through industry or clinical setting preferred, but not required.
  • Presentation and customer relationship skills.
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with people across all levels.
  • Computer experience with Microsoft programs such as PowerPoint, Outlook, Excel, and Word.
  • Excellent interpersonal The candidate must enjoy and excel at personal relationship-building.
  • Problem-solving / trouble-shooting skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Undergraduate degree in technical or scientific field.
  • Nurse, scrub nurse with experience in Cardiac Surgery or EP Lab.

This role is a maternity cover and will be employed under a fixed term on an AtriCure contract.

AtriCure has a variety of benefits available for US based employees and their families. Examples include Medical & Dental beginning day 1 of employment, 401K plus match, 30 days of paid Parental Leave, in addition to maternity leave, for new moms and dads, Volunteer Time off, Pet Insurance, and more. title: Commercial Strategy Associate
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Insurance Officer
description:
6 Month Contract With A Local Authority


Job Purpose

To support the Council's Risk and Insurance Team in managing the Council's insurance portfolio and delivering an effective insurance claims service across the Council and its partner organisations. The postholder will be responsible for processing high volumes of historic and ongoing insurance claims, investigating liability, negotiating settlements and liaising with insurers and other relevant stakeholders.

A key priority of the role is to help reduce and clear a significant backlog of historic claims, requiring the successful candidate to process approximately 20–25 claims per day while maintaining accuracy, making sound liability decisions and ensuring claims are progressed within agreed timescales.



Key Responsibilities

  • Receive, register and process routine insurance claims made by and against the Council, ensuring accurate and timely submission to external insurers.

  • Manage high volumes of insurance claims, targeting approximately 20–25 claims per day to support the reduction and clearance of historic backlogs.

  • Assess claims, investigate circumstances and make informed liability decisions in accordance with insurance policies, legislation and Council procedures.

  • Process claims across various insurance areas, including Employers' Liability (EL), Public Liability (PL), motor and property insurance.

  • Negotiate and settle property and liability claims within the Council's agreed financial and claims-handling arrangements.

  • Investigate claims falling within the Council's internal insurance arrangements, as well as those exceeding policy excess levels and requiring insurer involvement.

  • Review supporting evidence, documentation and information to establish liability, assess risk and determine appropriate claim outcomes.

  • Liaise with external insurers, solicitors, loss adjusters, internal departments and other relevant stakeholders to progress claims and resolve disputes.

  • Handle general insurance correspondence, telephone enquiries, emails and face-to-face enquiries professionally and efficiently.

  • Prepare reports, statistical returns, supporting documentation and evidence for insurers and court proceedings where required.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date claims records using relevant insurance management systems.

  • Monitor outstanding claims and ensure cases are progressed, investigated and resolved within agreed service standards and deadlines.

  • Ensure all claims handling activities comply with relevant insurance policy requirements, legal and regulatory obligations and Council procedures.

  • Identify and resolve day-to-day claims issues independently, exercising appropriate judgement, discretion and initiative.

  • Support the wider Risk and Insurance Team in maintaining an effective insurance service across the Council and its partner organisations.



Requirements

  • Essential: Demonstrable experience handling Employers' Liability (EL) and Public Liability (PL) insurance claims.

  • Proven experience making liability decisions and assessing responsibility for insurance claims.

  • Previous experience within non-life insurance, covering motor, public liability, employers' liability and property claims.

  • Strong knowledge of insurance policy coverage, liability assessment and claims-handling procedures.

  • Experience investigating, negotiating and settling insurance claims.

  • Ability to manage high-volume claims workloads, ideally with experience processing approximately 20–25 claims per day.

  • Experience managing claims backlogs and prioritising historic and outstanding cases.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to review evidence, assess information and reach well-reasoned conclusions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including confidence communicating with insurers, solicitors, claimants and internal stakeholders.

  • Good IT skills, with practical experience using Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet strict deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and resolve routine problems without constant supervision.

  • High levels of discretion, confidentiality and attention to detail.

  • Desirable: Experience working within a local authority insurance team or public sector environment.

  • Desirable: Knowledge and experience using JCAD LACHS or similar insurance claims management systems.

  • Desirable: Part-qualified Chartered Insurance Institute (CII) qualification or equivalent professional insurance qualification.



Additional Information

  • Hours per week: 36 hours.

  • Working arrangement: Primarily office-based, with occasional work from alternative locations.

  • Payment: Bi-weekly payments.

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience managing teams in a large-format retail grocery environment, ideally overnight.
  • Ability to make decisions independently with a hands-on attitude and a drive to improve processes and people.
  • Confidence in developing large teams and managing change.
  • Strong customer service focus.
  • Flexibility to work a range of night shifts, including weekends.

Are you ready to be the guiding force behind a critical shift, leading with strength and fostering growth in others? Apply today and find your everything at Asda.

  • Colleague discount: 15% off your shopping at Asda from day 1 for you and a nominated user

  • Company pension
