  • Asda Allies Inclusion Networks – helping colleagues to make sure everybody is included and that our differences are recognised and celebrated

  • Excellent parental leave policies, including maternity & adoption leave, paternity leave, shared parental leave, neonatal care leave, and support for those doing fertility treatments.

  • Colleague recognition programme

  • Special offers and discounts across a range of services and activities, from airport parking to theme parks and cinemas

title: Senior Data Engineer, IT Enterprise Data Solutions
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

As part of the IT Enterprise Data Solutions (EDS) department, the Data Engineering team’s mission is to lead on data technology and utilization, enabling informed decision-making and strategic insights across the foundation. We are committed to providing a robust, secure, and scalable data platform that empowers data-driven initiatives and cultivate collaboration. Working with our business operations and foundation strategy program partners, the team supports the management of the EDW, Enterprise Data Platform, building and integration of data systems, shared data exchange, data platform operations and data architecture support.

Your Role

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, operate, and continuously improve secure, scalable, and reliable data solutions on the foundation’s Modern Data Platform. You will be a senior hands-on engineer and domain expert who translates business and technical requirements into production-ready pipelines, data products, models, and platform capabilities.

You will work with data and AI engineers, business systems analysts, product owners, data analysts, BI engineers, security specialists, and service partners. Your work will improve the availability, quality, lineage, and usability of data for reporting, search, AI-assisted knowledge discovery, retrieval-augmented generation, and other data-driven decision-making across the foundation and its affiliates.

*This is a Seattle based role.

What You’ll Do

  • Data Engineering & Solution Delivery

Design, develop, test, deploy, and support configuration-driven ELT/ETL pipelines that acquire data from enterprise applications, databases, APIs, file repositories, partner data sources, and shared data exchanges.

Build reusable ingestion and transformation patterns for structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including relational data, JSON, XML, CSV, Excel, and document metadata.

Develop curated data products and dimensional models using star and snowflake techniques to support enterprise reporting, semantic models, analytics, and downstream operational use cases.

Implement transformations using SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, Databricks notebooks, dbt Cloud, Snowpark, and related cloud-native engineering tools.

Contribute hands-on to modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy data warehouse and ETL patterns to lakehouse, cloud warehouse, and ELT-based architectures.

  • Platform Reliability, Security & Operations

Monitor and optimize pipelines, storage, compute, and databases for performance, scalability, availability, and cost efficiency.

Implement data quality controls, reconciliation, exception handling, observability, logging, alerting, and service-level measures for critical data flows.

Lead or support incident triage, root-cause analysis, restoration, and follow-through on preventive actions for production data services.

Apply secure engineering practices including managed identity, role-based access, encryption, secrets management, least-privilege access, and sensitive-data handling requirements.

Implement and maintain CI/CD, automated testing, version control, release management, and environment promotion practices for data workloads.

  • AI, Search & Advanced Analytics Enablement

Engineer governed, high-quality data and document pipelines that support enterprise search, AI-assisted knowledge discovery, retrieval-augmented generation, analytics, and data science use cases.

Prepare and curate source data, metadata, permissions, lineage, and quality signals needed for reliable AI solutions while preserving source-system security and access policies.

Partner with Knowledge Management, AI, Business Intelligence, and Information Security teams to define fit-for-purpose data products for model grounding, evaluation, and responsible use.

Help establish repeatable patterns for document ingestion, chunking-ready content preparation, semantic metadata, and controlled data exchange across internal teams and affiliates.

Evaluate emerging data and AI platform capabilities through proofs of concept and recommend adoption based on value, security, sustainability, and architectural fit.

  • Engineering Excellence & Collaboration

Conduct design and code reviews, contribute to engineering standards, and promote reusable patterns for data modeling, orchestration, testing, observability, and documentation.

Collaborate with architects and product teams to clarify requirements, assess trade-offs, estimate delivery, and convert solution designs into actionable implementation plans.

Mentor data engineers and contingent staff through pairing, technical guidance, review, and knowledge sharing; may coordinate work across small delivery efforts.

Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, data mappings, lineage, and operational procedures; contribute metadata and descriptions for synchronization with Collibra.

Work effectively in Agile delivery teams using Scrum, Jira, and DevSecOps practices while communicating clearly with technical and non-technical partners.

Your Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Typically 7+ years of relevant data engineering experience in enterprise environments, including designing, delivering, and operating production data platforms and pipelines.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Azure data services, Databricks, Snowflake, and dbt Cloud; experience with Azure Data Factory and Fivetran is strongly preferred.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, plus practical experience with Spark/PySpark or Scala and cloud scripting or automation.

  • Experience implementing lakehouse, cloud data warehouse, ELT/ETL, and medallion or layered data architecture patterns.

  • Demonstrated experience with dimensional modeling, data normalization, slowly changing dimensions, point-in-time history, and enterprise data quality practices.

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code or configuration-as-code, and modern version control workflows.

  • Strong understanding of data security, privacy, access controls, encryption, lineage, retention, and governance in cloud data environments.

  • Experience supporting analytics and semantic-layer platforms such as Power BI, and working with metadata/governance platforms such as Collibra, is preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to enable AI through data, including an understanding of the architecture, quality, metadata, permissions, lineage, scalability, and evaluation requirements for search, RAG, and other AI use cases.

  • Proven ability to diagnose production issues, lead technical problem solving, and implement short-, medium-, and long-term corrective actions.

  • Experience working with vendors or distributed engineering teams and reviewing deliverables for alignment with enterprise standards and maintainability.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to varied audiences.

  • A demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and respectful collaboration.

*Must have unrestricted work authorization in the country where this position is located.

The Foundation does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (eg: H-1B, O-1, L-1, E, OPT, STEM-OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.).

#LI-SC2

The salary range for this role is $157,400 to $236,000 USD. We recognize high-wage market differences in Seattle and Washington D.C., where our offices are located. The range for this role in these locations is $173,100 to $259,700 USD. As a mission-driven organization, we strive to balance competitive pay with our mission. New hires salaries are typically between the range minimum and the salary range midpoint. Actual placement in the range will depend on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, and expertise, as evaluated during the interview process.

Hiring Requirements

As part of our standard hiring process for new employees, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Candidate Accommodations

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you have a disability or medical condition and need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process—such as an ASL interpreter, alternative interview format, or physical accessibility support—we’re happy to help. Please contact HR@gatesfoundation.org with the position number and a brief description of your accommodation needs. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Inclusion Statement

We are dedicated to the belief that all lives have equal value. We strive for a global and cultural workplace that supports ever greater diversity, equity, and inclusion — of voices, ideas, and approaches — and we support this diversity through all our employment practices.

All applicants and employees who are drawn to serve our mission will enjoy equality of opportunity and fair treatment without regard to race, color, age, religion, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, and prior protected activity.

title: Client Solutions Manager - Helix
description:
About AI71

AI71 is an industry leader in artificial intelligence, delivering innovative solutions that empower developers, businesses and governments to solve complex challenges. AI71 builds secure, enterprise-ready applications powered by cutting-edge technology tailored for knowledge workers and sector-specific needs. AI71 bridges the gap between advanced AI and real-world impact. Guided by a strong commitment to research and responsibility, we create transformative solutions that drive progress and empower communities.

The Role

As Client Solutions Manager for AI Products, you will own the full sales journey for UAE government and large enterprise accounts, from first meeting through contract, onboarding and expansion. You will work hand in hand with AI71's product teams and partners across the Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC) ecosystem to turn advanced AI capabilities into real deployments. Your work directly drives AI71's revenue and shapes how national-level clients adopt AI.

What You'll Do

● Build and close a pipeline of UAE government and large enterprise accounts that meets or exceeds revenue targets.
● Run discovery sessions and product demos with prospective clients to uncover needs and define the right AI solution.
● Develop tailored proposals in partnership with AI71's product teams.
● Lead responses to requests for proposal (RFPs) and tenders, from qualification through submission and negotiation.
● Own key accounts end to end, including contracting, onboarding and expansion into new use cases.
● Co-sell with system integrators, resellers and ATRC ecosystem partners to extend reach and win joint opportunities.
● Maintain accurate records and forecasts in HubSpot, our customer relationship management (CRM) platform.
● Share client insights with product and leadership teams to inform roadmap and strategy.

What You'll Bring

● Nationality: Hold UAE National status.
● Experience: Bring 5+ years of business-to-business (B2B) sales experience selling IT services or products in the UAE.
● Education: Hold a degree in business, information technology or engineering.
● Track Record: Show a proven history of hitting sales targets and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals with government or large enterprise clients, including RFPs and tenders.
● Network: Maintain strong relationships across UAE government and enterprise organizations.
● Languages and Communication: Speak fluent Arabic and English, and deliver strong presentations.

Great Pluses / Preferred Experience

● Sell AI, data, analytics, cloud or cybersecurity solutions, ideally to security, defence, public safety, media or financial services clients.
● Understand UAE government procurement, supplier registration and digital transformation programmes.
● Work with system integrators and channel partners.
● Use a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce hands-on.

Why AI71

● Mission-Driven Work: Work on cutting-edge AI applications with a talented and passionate team, solving real-world challenges in critical sectors.
● Unparalleled Opportunity: This is a chance to innovate and solve real-world challenges using AI at a company with unique access to world-leading models and resources.
● Career Growth: We offer competitive compensation, benefits, and significant career growth opportunities as a foundational member of the team.
● World-Class Environment: Enjoy a flexible working environment and the latest tools & technologies needed to do your best work.

title: AI Data Ops Engineer
description:
Design, build, and operate the data backbone for enterprise AI.

We're hiring an AI Data Ops Engineer for a leading Abu Dhabi-based holding group investing heavily in its data and AI capability. You'll engineer the pipelines that feed everyday AI assistants and enterprise AI products — and you'll be the technical authority reviewing and signing off vendor-delivered data architectures before they reach production. Reports to the AI Solutions Manager.

What you'll own:

Engineer batch and stream pipelines using Fabric Data Pipelines / Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or Databricks.

Implement data quality rules, schema validation, de-duplication, SCD, and reconciliation checks.

Operationalize lineage, cataloging, and classifications with Microsoft Purview; enforce RBAC and access patterns.

Automate CI/CD via Azure DevOps or GitHub with environment promotion, infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/Terraform), and secrets management via Key Vault.

Build feature stores and model-serving data contracts in partnership with MLOps and AI engineering teams.

Own reliability: alerts, runbooks, on-call rotation, and cost and performance optimization.

Review and finalize vendor-delivered data pipelines and data architecture for AI projects; ensure compliance with client standards for security, performance, and reliability; approve production readiness.

Collaborate with delivery partner squads on interface specifications, test data, and delivery checkpoints; support SIT/UAT and production cutover.

Define and enforce Data Contracts and SLAs per priority dataset (schema, refresh frequency, quality thresholds, reconciliation checks, and consumer expectations).

Own data incident management: classification, RCA, corrective actions, and prevention of recurring nonconformities.

Formalize the handshake with AI/ML/DevOps engineers on feature and embedding pipelines, monitoring hooks, and release gates for data-dependent AI deployments.

What you bring:

6–8 years in data engineering with strong SQL and PySpark and cloud-native data services.

Hands-on experience across the Azure data stack: Fabric/Synapse, Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake/Parquet.

Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

Core skills and tools required:

Python and PySpark, SQL, Lakehouse patterns, medallion architecture.

Microsoft Purview: catalog, lineage, classifications; data privacy controls and masking.

CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub; IaC with Bicep or Terraform; Docker basics.

Observability: Kusto/KQL, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics; performance tuning and FinOps.

Production incident response and RCA discipline.

Databricks Data Engineer Associate or Professional

title: Controls, Vision & Robotics Engineer
description:
Controls, Vision & Robotics Engineer | Elgin, IL

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a motivated and hardworking individual to join our team in Elgin, IL as a Controls, Vision & Robotics Engineer. You will be part of a group of engineers dedicated to high-quality work, value-add solutions, skill development, and career growth. We welcome candidates from the Chicago metro and beyond to apply.

title: Activation Lead
description:
Job Description:


Recruiting Job Description

Dentsu søker engasjert og strukturert prosjektleder/Activation Lead – vikariat

Vi søker en erfaren prosjektleder/Activation Lead til dentsu Norge. I denne rollen vil du være ansvarlig for å planlegge, drive og sikre gjennomføring av initiativer. Du vil jobbe tett med våre kunder, interne ressurser og eksterne leverandører for å sikre at alle aspekter av prosjektene/kampanjene er koordinert og integrert.

Som prosjektleder/Activation Lead skal du sørge for at kampanjer og prosjekter blir levert på tid, med høy kvalitet og i henhold til budsjett.


Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Prosjektledelse: Lede prosjektarbeidet på daglig basis, definere og delegere oppgaver, og sikre at alle aspekter av prosjektene er koordinert og integrert.
  • Budsjett- og kostnadsstyring: Håndtere prosjektbudsjetter, kontrollere og rapportere om prognoser, endringer og faktiske kostnader.
  • Planlegging og gjennomføring: Utvikle og vedlikeholde tidsplaner for prosjektaktiviteter, og sikre effektiv realisering av prosjekter.: Utvikle og implementere ressursallokeringsplaner.
  • Risiko- og problemstyring: Identifisere og overvåke prosjektrisikoer, utvikle avbøtende tiltak og samarbeide med relaterte prosjekter

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Erfaring med å håndtere komplekse prosjekter på tvers av organisasjoner.
  • Erfaring med å bygge og opprettholde gode relasjoner med kunder og interne ressurser.
  • Erfaring med å ta briefing fra kunder og omforme dette til konkrete forslag.
  • Dokumentert evne til å fullføre prosjekter effektivt og innen tidsfrister.
  • Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med prosjektstyringsverktøy, og gjerne ERP systemer for media/kreative byråer som f.eks. Marathon

Vi tror du vil lykkes i rollen hvis du:

  • Er en lagspiller
  • Har gode samarbeidsegenskaper, er positiv og engasjert
  • Er strukturert, effektiv og operativ
  • Evner å veilede folk for å levere resultater.
  • Er detaljorientert og løsningsorientert og har høy grad av gjennomføringskraft
  • Har sterke kommunikasjonsferdigheter, både muntlig og skriftlig. Både i norsk og engelsk
  • Har gode ferdigheter i PowerPoint, Excel. Og plattformer ala Salesforce etc.
  • Har god forståelse for budsjettering, prognoser og prosjektleveranser.
  • Drives av å følge prosjekter fra start til slutt
  • Har evne til å stoppe opp og vurdere situasjoner kritisk.

Om dentsu og Dentsu Norway

Dentsu er en global partner for vekst og transformasjon for verdens ledende virksomheter. Selskapet ble etablert i Tokyo i 1901 og har i dag virksomhet i rundt 120 land. Gjennom integrerte tjenester innen Media, CXM og Creative skaper dentsu helhetlige løsninger som driver vekst, innovasjon og bærekraftig utvikling.

Dentsu Norway er en del av dette globale nettverket og består av engasjerte medarbeidere som jobber med markedsledende merkevarer og spennende kunder. På kontoret vårt i Oslo, sitter det rundt 200 ansatte.

Mangfold, likestilling og inkludering er sentrale verdier hos oss, forankret i The 8 Ways to Never Before og vårt globale Leadership Framework. Vi er stolte av vår kultur og oppmuntrer kandidater med ulik bakgrunn og erfaring til å søke.

Vi tilbyr blant annet:

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Subsidiert personalrestaurant
  • Subsidiert treningsabonnement og andre treningsaktiviteter
  • Fleksibel hjemmekontorordning
  • Rabatter og gode tilbud hos avtalepartnere

Høres dette spennende ut? Send oss din søknad i dag! Vi vil gjennomgå søknader kontinuerlig, og egnede kandidater vil bli kontaktet for intervjuer fortløpende.

Hvis du har spørsmål om stillingen, vennligst kontakt Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Maria K. Cederbrand, på maria.cederbrand@dentsu.com

title: Demo Engineering Developer
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About the Team & Impact
At Okta, Demo Engineering bridges the gap between product innovation and go-to-market execution—acting as a global force multiplier for our technical sales organization. We equip internal and partner Solution Engineers worldwide with the tools and environments needed to effortlessly demonstrate how Okta secures identities across workforces, customers, and AI agents.

In this role, your code directly powers Okta’s global sales engine. The demo architectures and interactive experiences you create will be leveraged by hundreds of field engineers across dozens of countries, influencing thousands of enterprise customer conversations. Operating within an engineering-first, collaborative culture focused on automation, modularity, and self-service, you will build the core platform that makes Okta’s field teams faster, sharper, and more scalable.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect Reusable Assets: Design and develop modular demo components and pre-configured product environments tailored to high-impact, solution-driven customer scenarios.
  • Capture Field Insights: Partner closely with global field teams to gather "Voice of the Customer" feedback—translating prospect expectations, preferences, and friction points into platform improvements.
  • Drive Platform Adoption: Team up with Field Readiness to champion the Demo Platform and accelerate usage across the broader go-to-market organization.
  • Measure & Optimize: Build telemetry, analytics, and reporting dashboards to monitor demo engagement and quantify field impact.
  • Launch New Capabilities: Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management and Core Engineering to build demo-ready experiences ahead of new product releases.
  • Influence Product Roadmap: Represent field and customer insights during release planning to help shape future product direction.
  • Enable the Field: Author clear technical walkthroughs, demonstration guides, and video tutorials to empower self-service adoption.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Industry Experience: 5+ years of hands-on software development experience building Enterprise SaaS solutions.
  • Full-Stack & Cloud Expertise: Strong proficiency in React.js, Node.js, and AWS Serverless architectures (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS).
  • Multi-Tenant Architecture: Proven background designing and implementing multi-tenant systems with strict tenant isolation.
  • DevOps & Automation: Practical experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) or automated configuration management tools.
  • Identity & API Fluency: Solid experience integrating REST/GraphQL APIs with identity providers, backed by strong working knowledge of modern authentication and authorization standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).

How You Work

  • Globally Minded: Experienced in collaborating across time zones and supporting a distributed, international field organization.
  • Proactive Builder: Self-driven and resourceful—you spot gaps, propose solutions, and execute without needing micromanagement.
  • Cross-Functional Connector: Energized by working at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering.
  • Systems Thinker: Capable of balancing fast-turnaround field requests with long-term architectural scalability and code reuse.

description:

The Certified CARES Peer Specialist (CPS-CARES) works with people who experience serious mental illness and acts as a role model of recovery. CPS provides group and/or individual training and counseling, as well as service coordination, support for community linkage, and advocacy support to meet individual needs. At Grady, we believe in supporting the health, well-being, and growth of every team member. Our Total Rewards package is designed to provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefits that make a difference in your life and career, including:

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

  • Work-Life Balance: Paid time off, holidays, and family leave benefits.

  • Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement, professional development programs, and opportunities for advancement.

Grady’s Total Rewards are designed to ensure our employees feel valued, supported, and empowered, both at work and beyond.

Grady Health System is more than a hospital — we are a vital part of Atlanta and the surrounding communities. For over 125 years, Grady has been committed to providing exceptional care, advancing health equity, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve. When you join Grady, you become part of a team that values excellence, compassion, innovation, and collaboration.


Here, every role matters. Whether you provide direct patient care, support our operations, or lead teams, you play an important part in fulfilling our mission. We offer opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career in an environment where your contributions are recognized and valued.


At Grady, we don’t just work, we make an impact.

title: Associate – Meter Technology (Quality Assurance)
description:
Role Snapshot

Location: Lagos, Nigeria
Department: TEC – Technology
Reports to: Manager – Quality Assurance
Work arrangement: Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote)

Our Mission

We are a technology company that provides electrical grid management software and related network analytics solutions for utilities across Africa. Beacon Power Services was founded with a bold mission to expand access to reliable electricity for over 400 million people living in Africa's cities and a vision to lead Africa's power sector through data and innovation.

How You'll Make an Impact

We are seeking a detail-oriented Associate – Meter Technology (Quality Assurance) to support testing and validation of meter onboarding and communication processes within a DLMS/COSEM-enabled ecosystem. The role focuses on ensuring accurate meter registration, configuration, and data exchange, while maintaining high standards of reliability and data integrity.

You will work closely with Senior QA Engineers, developers, and field teams to validate functional, integration, and protocol-level scenarios, ensuring seamless onboarding and operation of smart meters.
This role will contribute to smoother meter deployments, stronger data integrity, and greater confidence in the systems that help expand access to reliable electricity across Africa.

What You'll Do

Meter Onboarding & Configuration Testing

  • Execute test cases for meter onboarding and configuration workflows to confirm that meters are registered and configured accurately before they go live.
  • Validate edge cases such as network instability, partial onboarding scenarios, and firmware inconsistencies so that the system behaves reliably under real world conditions.
  • Support field testing and user acceptance testing for meter deployments, working alongside field teams to confirm that meters perform as expected once installed.

DLMS/COSEM Protocol Validation

  • Validate DLMS/COSEM communication flows, including meter association and authentication, so that secure and correct connections are established between meters and our systems.
  • Test OBIS read and write operations to confirm that meters respond accurately to commands and configuration changes.
  • Verify the retrieval of billing, load profile, and event data to confirm that the information collected from meters is complete and accurate.

API & Integration Testing

  • Perform API and integration testing between HES, MDMS, and supporting systems to confirm that data flows accurately across the platform.
  • Test prepaid and postpaid meter functionality, including token processing (STS), so that customers can reliably purchase and use electricity.
  • Validate meter data using SQL queries and database checks to confirm data integrity across systems.

Defect Management & Test Automation

  • Log, track, and verify defects while maintaining proper documentation and traceability from discovery through to resolution.
  • Assist in the automation of regression and API test cases to improve test coverage and speed over time.

What We're Looking For

Professional & Technical Strengths

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, or Systems Testing within an energy, IoT, or smart metering environment.
  • Exposure to smart meter onboarding or HES and MDMS environments.
  • Working knowledge of DLMS/COSEM fundamentals and OBIS structures.
  • Hands on experience with API testing tools such as Postman and REST clients.
  • Basic understanding of meter communication protocols and network behavior.
  • Familiarity with SQL and database validation for meter data.
  • Familiarity with Agile development practices.

Leadership & Interpersonal Strengths

  • Ability to collaborate with multicultural and geographically distributed teams.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability (we operate within a hybrid work environment).
  • Strong attention to detail and problem solving ability, with the patience to trace issues back to their root cause.
  • Clear and professional communicator, able to explain defects and test findings to developers, senior engineers, and field teams.
  • Proactive and curious, with a focus on continuous learning and improvement.
  • Adaptable and comfortable navigating fast paced and changing environments.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to test automation, including basic scripting.
  • ISTQB Foundation certification.
  • Fluency in French.

What the Recruitment Process Looks Like

  • Step 1 - Application Review: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application to evaluate your experience, qualifications, and overall suitability for the role.
  • Step 2 - Behavioral & Cognitive Assessments: If selected to move forward, you will complete behavioral and cognitive assessments. These help us better understand your working style and ensure alignment with the role requirements and BPS’s culture.
  • Step 3 - Technical Assessments: If you progress to this stage, you will complete technical assessments designed to evaluate your problem-solving approach and the key technical skills required for the role.
  • Step 4 - HR & Culture Fit Interview: At this stage, you will meet with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background, motivations, and potential fit within the
  • Step 5 - Technical Excellence Interview: In the final stage, you will interview with the Hiring team to further assess your technical expertise and overall fit for the role, and to ensure alignment on expectations from both sides.

title: GTM Consultant
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

Our unique business model, fast paced and growing environment, promote from within culture, and excellent benefits make Fresh Thyme the best employer in the grocery market. The Coordinator team member plans, directs and supervises team members in the day to day operations of their respective department area. Delivers exceptional customer service by managing the day to day ordering, receiving, stocking and displaying of related products to maximize profits. Maintains department cleanliness and adheres to all food safety processes.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Assists in scheduling, staffing selection, and hiring to achieve staffing needs
  • Promotes succession planning by providing career paths, identifying development needs for their respective departments team, and being involved with and accountable for promotion decisions
  • Supports disciplinary actions and makes recommendations concerning discharge
  • Attain P&L budgeted goals, achieving sales, labor and margin plans for the department
  • Reviews sales goals, supply costs, stock loss/shrink results and goals
  • Models exceptional, fast and friendly customer service
  • Reviews Customer Survey and customer feedback from previous day or week
  • Prepares, packages, stocks store and display merchandise appropriately
  • Price change compliance
  • Food safety compliance
  • Ordering of manual ordered items
  • Supervises, trains and manages their Department Team in the absence of the Dept. Manager to:
    • Stock (including washing, bundling and trimming) rotating, and merchandise facing products according to department procedure
    • Ensure all inferior out of code products are not sold and removes from display
    • Ensure all products are accurately priced and sales prices are maintained and up to date
    • Provides consultation to customers when needed regarding consumer products
    • Execute ad set compliance including signage
    • Ensure the backroom is neat and organized
    • Meet or exceed sales floor conditions expectations in respective department

  • Promotes a safe work environment
  • Reliable and consistent attendance required
  • Proper usage of production planner and fresh dashboard
  • Other daily tasks as required

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or its equivalent required
  • 2-3 years of related retail experience
  • One year of management experience
  • Previous experience in a natural foods industry is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate to team members in the organization in a way that provides clear and precise direction
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve conflict and by addressing root cause issues
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze financial and statistical information and use that information to make informed decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to consult with customers on all areas pertaining to their department
  • Demonstrated ability to lead an organization that practices working safely at all times

title: Manager, Compliance & Mechatronics
description:
Business Unit Automation is the home of AutoMine® - the world-leading solution for autonomous mining - and Newtrax – the world leader in collision avoidance and operations management solutions for underground mining – and Universal Field Robots UFR, a fast-growing Australia-based provider of autonomous interoperable solutions for the surface mining and underground mining markets.

Our hubs are located in Tampere (Finland), Montreal (Canada) and Brisbane (Australia) where we focus on developing fully automated and robotic mining technologies for mobile machinery, and safety solutions including collision avoidance system. Our overriding aim is to make mining safer and more sustainable for the future. We work closely together with our Sandvik Mining sales areas to serve our customers across the globe, striving for the highest level of service and support.

We are now looking for a self-driven and collaborative Compliance and Mechatronics Engineering Manager to join Business Unit Automation and lead product compliance and electrical, mechanical and hardware engineering for our AutoMine® product family. You will lead the team, manage an efficient supplier network, create roadmaps and bring internal and external stakeholders together around clear priorities. You will report directly to Olli Snellman, Head of Product Development, AutoMine®. The position is based in Tampere, Finland at our home office in Tulli Business Park located in the city center.

Your role is to be the driving force for product compliance in AutoMine® engineering, combined with practical mechatronics engineering leadership. In this role, compliance covers product safety, functional safety, cyber security and sustainability. You will ensure these perspectives are integrated into all engineering activities and decisions, working closely with our common Compliance team and drawing on its experts for support. On electrical, mechanical and hardware topics, you will work closely with our Supply team and common control system platform hardware team, and align capabilities, priorities and delivery with product development needs. Through strong compliance understanding, effective team leadership, supplier and stakeholder collaboration, and well-defined roadmaps, you will foster innovation and continuous improvement.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own and drive product compliance in engineering, covering product safety, functional safety, cyber security and sustainability with the experts in your team and common services.
  • Lead and develop the electrical, mechanical and hardware engineering team, including prototyping capabilities with the experts in your team, our supply organization and common control system hardware team.
  • Create and maintain roadmaps, aligning internal and external stakeholders and translating product needs and compliance requirements.
  • Foster a strong innovative attitude and drive continuous improvement in compliance practices, engineering methods, prototyping, supplier collaboration and ways of working to improve quality, efficiency and delivery.

Your Profile

You have previous experience as a manager, leading engineering teams and building results through experts rather than as an individual expert yourself. You empower and develop specialists, set clear direction and priorities, and use their expertise to deliver compliance, hardware and prototyping outcomes together. You have a relevant technical education, for example a bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, and a solid general understanding of electrical, mechanical and hardware engineering. You do not need to be a specialist in every discipline, as long as you can connect technical direction with practical execution and guide your experts effectively. You have a good understanding of product compliance and its main areas, product safety, functional safety, cyber security and sustainability, without needing to be an expert in all of them; a strong safety perspective is preferred. You can translate compliance requirements into engineering priorities and make full use of the specialists in your team and in our common Compliance team, as well as our Supply team and common platform hardware team. You have experience managing engineering suppliers and collaborating with external partners, creating roadmaps and aligning internal stakeholders around clear priorities. Experience with automation or autonomous industrial equipment is an advantage.

You combine a strong innovative attitude with a systematic approach, sound judgment and a drive for continuous improvement. You encourage new ideas, practical experimentation and learning through prototyping while maintaining a firm focus on quality and compliance. You build trusted relationships across functions and organizations, communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, and work proactively and independently in a changing environment. You enjoy developing people and helping teams, suppliers and partners take ownership and deliver together.

What is in it for you?

We offer you an engaging role in an international business environment, extraordinary products, great colleagues, and opportunities for professional development.

At Sandvik, we believe in finding the right balance between work, family life, and personal interests, and we actively support our employees in achieving this. We offer a hybrid office/home working environment and an open-minded culture where diversity and inclusion are part of how we work.

Contact Information

For further information about this position, please contact the recruiting manager:

Olli Snellman, Head of Product Development, AutoMine®, BU Automation, tel. +358 445990279 (on Tuesdays at 15:45 - 16:30 EET).

For further information regarding the recruitment process, please contact:

Sandvik’s HR Services Finland, tel. +358 800 1 44444 (weekdays at 9-11 and at 12-15 EET).

Want to join our team?

Submit your application at home.sandvik/careers by Wednesday, December 9th, 2026.

Applications are processed in order of arrival, and the position may be filled before the deadline.

Your application should consist of an introductory letter including your salary request and a CV. If you wish to add a cover letter to your application, please make sure to attach the file when uploading your CV. Please note that we don’t accept applications by email.

Job ID: R0098566.

About our company

Sandvik is a global, high-tech engineering group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability, and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. We are at the forefront of digitalization and focus on optimizing our customers’ processes. Our world-leading offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation, and rock processing. In 2025, the group had approximately 42.000 employees, sales in more than 150 countries and revenues of about SEK 121 billion.

We have already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.

title: AI Business Strategy Associate
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Senior Director, Technology Strategy, Product & Delivery Lead
description:
Role Summary

Pfizer is building one Data, AI & Engineering organisation to build and run the data, artificial intelligence (AI) and digital products for International Commercial. This role owns the technology strategy for International Commercial's data and AI products and decides how every approved need gets built. Reporting directly to the Vice President - Data, AI & Engineering and sitting on the pillar's leadership team, the Technology Strategy, Product & Delivery Lead turns approved business needs and domain AI strategies into technical designs, owns the strategy and roadmap of the AI Consumption Layer and the AI-ready data roadmap, and names the accountable technical owner for every product and data warehouse, global and local. The role leads about 20 technical product owners and technical program managers through senior leads, owns the delivery budgets for the portfolio's programs once allocated by the Strategy, Value and Investment pillar, holds every product to its release dates, production stability and data quality at the point of use, and owns build and change delivery for the commercial web and interactive channels and local market sites. Investment governance decides what gets built and business owners set priority; this role decides how, is the technical counterpart to every business owner in the portfolio, and is the senior counterpart to the Strategy, Value and Investment and Adoption and Scale pillar heads on every product triad. It represents International Commercial in Pfizer Digital product, platform and data forums. This role owns technical design and configure-or-build decisions, the strategy and content of the AI Consumption Layer, the AI-ready data roadmap, the data-product strategy, technical ownership of every product, sequencing and release execution, and web and site build and change.


Role Responsibilities

  • Technology strategy and technical design
    • Turns approved business needs and domain AI strategies into technical designs for International Commercial: modules, global data products and configure-or-build decisions
    • Sets the design rules for one common core across all markets, with local variation held in configuration
    • Builds every design on the Chief Information Officer (CIO) platforms and the AI Consumption Layer
    • Owns the technical design and roadmap of the portfolio, within which the strategic program MVPs are built
  • Product ownership
    • Leads about 16 technical product owners and names an accountable technical owner for every product and data warehouse, global and local
    • Holds technical owners accountable for architecture, platform fit, security and compliance, release dates, production stability and data quality at the point of use
    • Protects technical owners' capacity so every tier one product has an owner with the time to lead it
    • Makes every market's data readiness an owned accountability on every product
  • AI Consumption Layer and data strategy
    • Owns the strategy, roadmap and content of the AI Consumption Layer: the reusable data, agent and solution components International Commercial builds on
    • Owns the AI-ready data roadmap: which data is ready for AI use, in what order, and what it lets the business do
    • Owns the data-product strategy and gives every solution and data product a roadmap, release plan, value hypothesis, run cost and sunset path
  • Delivery and release management
    • Leads 10 to 11 technical program managers who run delivery and releases across the portfolio
    • Owns sequencing across teams and the release plan for the portfolio
    • Owns build and change delivery for the commercial web and interactive channels and local market sites
    • Owns the delivery budgets for the portfolio's programs once allocated by the Strategy, Value and Investment pillar, and holds budget accountability for the solutions delivered
  • Vendor delivery
    • Sets acceptance criteria and requirements for vendor-delivered work
    • Holds vendors to their delivery milestones and dependencies
  • Team leadership
    • Leads about 20 technical product owners and technical program managers through senior leads
    • Carries the product ownership and delivery guild and nominates its stewards
    • Uses AI agents for roadmaps, release notes and status, and holds the team accountable for decisions
    • Represents International Commercial in Pfizer Digital product, platform and data forums

This role covers a broad spectrum of skills and we encourage you to apply even if you meet partially.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field
  • Extensive relevant experience
  • Experience in technical product management or delivery of data, AI or software products on enterprise platforms
  • Experience owning roadmaps and releases across several products or teams, including vendor-delivered work
  • Working knowledge of modern data platforms and data-product practice, and of agile and scaled delivery frameworks
  • Working knowledge of AI and agent solution delivery, including large language model (LLM) solutions, and of delivery tooling
  • Experience leading agile, cross-functional product and delivery teams, with an AI-first approach to changing ways of working
  • Experience communicating technical designs, roadmaps and trade-offs to executives, business owners and product teams, and working across functions, regions and time zones
  • Experience solving complex, ambiguous product and delivery problems with structured analysis and clear recommendations
  • Experience leading product and delivery teams and influencing business owners and senior stakeholders without direct authority
  • Experience evaluating configure-or-build options and vendor solutions against business and technical criteria

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree in computer science, business administration or a related field
  • Experience turning business needs into technical designs and configure-or-build decisions on enterprise platforms
  • Experience leading technical product owners and programme professionals with a clear split of responsibilities
  • Knowledge of commercial pharmaceutical processes and operations across field force, marketing, market access, pricing and tenders, and launch
  • Experience directing AI agents on roadmap, release and status work, and clear communication with senior business and technology stakeholders
  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow or equivalent
  • Experience with delivery tooling such as Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Ability to work non-traditional work hours interacting with global teams spanning across the different regions (eg: North America, Europe, Asia)


ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

Other teams within Data, AI & Engineering

Other teams within Business Transformation & Technology

Chief Marketing Office, Global Commercial Analytics

CIO platform teams

Supervision: The role leads about 20 technical product owners and technical program managers through senior leads


Purpose

Breakthroughs that change patients' lives... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives.

Digital Transformation Strategy

One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. We are leading the way in adopting new data, modelling and automated solutions to further digitize and accelerate drug discovery and development with the aim of enhancing health outcomes and the patient experience.

Flexibility

We aim to create a trusting, flexible workplace culture which encourages employees to achieve work life harmony, attracts talent and enables everyone to be their best working self. Let’s start the conversation!

Equal Employment Opportunity

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to building a successful business. As an employer, Pfizer is committed to celebrating this, in all its forms – allowing for us to be as diverse as the patients and communities we serve. Together, we continue to build a culture that encourages, supports and empowers our employees.

DisAbility Confident

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer and we encourage you to put your best self forward with the knowledge and trust that we will make any reasonable adjustments necessary to support your application and future career. Our mission is unleashing the power of our people, especially those with unique superpowers. Your journey with Pfizer starts here!

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

title: Head of client platform
description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.


-


What Else?


In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.


At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.


Our Values


At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.


Equal Opportunity


Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

A variety of programs, techniques, methods, and materials are available and utilized for individualized instruction. Exceptional Child Education programs are provided to students with disabilities in Comprehensive and special education programs facilities/agencies. Assignments could include students with Moderate to Severe Disabilities (MSD), Mild Mental Disabilities (MMD), Other Health Impairments (OHI), Emotional Behavioral Disabilities (EBD), Autism (AUT), Visual Impairment (VI), Hearing Impairment (HI), Learning Disabilities (LD), Social Communication or a combination of each area. Changes in assignment or ECE designation could occur during a school year due to student and classroom needs or could occur between school years when ECE allocations are reviewed.

title: Pre-Award Grant Manager
description:
Department: Finance / GSMA Mobile for Development Foundation

Team: Finance & Compliance

Location: London (hybrid working)

Position type: Permanent, Full-time



What the hiring manager says


This role is central to how the Foundation assesses opportunities from a Finance & Compliance perspective, and how we price and structure them. As we grow our donor portfolio and strengthen our fundraising operating model, I am looking for a Pre-Award Grant Manager who brings sound Finance & Compliance judgement to every proposal: building robust budgets, spotting donor compliance risks early, and providing clear advice and input to support decision-making on the most appropriate funding mechanism for each opportunity. You will be a trusted partner to Fundraising and Programmes, and a key link into our post-award team. Jawdat Nasri, Head of Award Management


About the Team


The Finance & Compliance team provides end-to-end stewardship of the Foundation’s donor-funded portfolio, supporting programmes from pre-award through closeout. Working across the US 501(c)(3) and the upcoming new Belgian AISBL, we partner closely with Programmes, Operations, Legal, and People & Culture to ensure robust financial management, strong internal controls, and timely, accurate donor reporting.


The role will report to the Head of Award Management and join the established Foundation Finance and Compliance team, which includes professionals located in Atlanta, India, London and Kenya. This role will also work closely with the Fundraising team, Operations and the M4D Head of Programmes located in London.


About the Role


The Pre-Award Grant Manager supports the Head of Award Management in coordinating Finance & Compliance input during the proposal stage of the grant lifecycle. The role contributes to the Foundation’s fundraising activity by reviewing funding opportunities from a financial and compliance perspective, preparing compliant and competitive budgets, advising on funding mechanisms such as consortia, prime awards and sub-awards, and helping to ensure a smooth handover of awarded grants to the post-award team.


Key Responsibilities:


A. Opportunity Assessment

  • Carry out financial and compliance review of funding opportunities, identifying Finance & Compliance considerations early in the fundraising process.
  • Provide Finance & Compliance input to the Head of Award Management to inform Go/No-Go discussions in line with the M4D Fundraising SOP, including eligibility, risk thresholds and Delegation of Authority requirements.

B. Proposal Budgeting & Cost Recovery


  • Prepare complex proposal budgets and supporting documents in line with donor guidelines.
  • Apply and advise on cost-recovery approaches, ensuring budgets are realistic, compliant and fundable.
  • Develop and maintain budget templates and tools that facilitate the proposal and approval process.
  • Work with the proposal and fundraising teams to ensure submissions are complete and meet deadlines.

C. Funding Mechanisms & Partnerships


  • Provide Finance & Compliance advice on suitable funding mechanisms and structures for each opportunity, including consortia, prime awards and sub-awards.
  • Review partner arrangements and subcontracting models, including due diligence and donor flow-down requirements.
  • Liaise with Legal and Finance colleagues on the Foundation’s eligibility for each opportunity.

D. Donor Compliance & Policy


  • Interpret donor rules and regulations (e.g. FCDO, EU, SIDA, GIZ, NORAD, Gates Foundation, US Government) and identify any conflicts with GSMA policies.
  • Complete donor-required certifications, representations and pre-submission compliance checks.
  • Monitor changing regulations and the external context that could affect the Foundation’s fundraising strategy or donor relationships.

E. Handover & Collaboration


  • Coordinate with the Operations team to ensure a smooth handover of awarded grants to the post-award team, covering award terms, approved budget baselines, reporting requirements and compliance obligations.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with relevant stakeholders across teams.
  • Capture lessons learned from successful and unsuccessful proposals to improve future submissions.

F. Systems & Process Improvement


  • Contribute to improvements in proposal tools, budget templates and workflows, and keep pipeline and proposal information accurate in the relevant systems.
  • Proactively resolve issues in a timely manner and work effectively under pressure to meet deadlines.

About You


  • Proven experience in pre-award grant management, grant finance or proposal budgeting within an INGO, foundation or multi-donor environment.
  • Experience preparing and submitting grant proposals and budgets for institutional donors such as FCDO, EU institutions, SIDA, GIZ, NORAD, the US Government and private foundations.
  • Working knowledge of donor rules and regulations relating to grants and contracts, including cost eligibility, indirect costs, consortium and sub-award arrangements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate donor requirements into practical budgets and controls.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Excel and an aptitude for systems; experience with Workday financials is desirable.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage donors and internal stakeholders across programmes, operations, legal and leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple proposals to tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

About Your Skills


  • Communication
  • Delivery
  • Teamwork
  • Influence
  • Stakeholder management

Contract type

Regular

Worker type

Employee

What We Offer

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.

Being You at the GSMA

We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.

GSMA Values

Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.

Passionately driven

We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.

Insightful leaders

We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

title: Sr. Sales Engineer
description:
Who is Forcepoint?

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

As a Sr. Sales Engineer at Forcepoint, you'll be the technical heartbeat of the sales process. You'll partner closely with our sales team to help prospective customers understand how Forcepoint's solutions solve their real-world security challenges, through product demos, technical presentations, and consultative support.


Location: Florida


What You'll Do

  • Deliver product, technology and/or customized solution presentations to technical and business decision makers which may include system demonstrations, white-boarding and technical Q&A sessions to the client.

  • Provide pre-sales technical support, security engineering and technical guidance for the development and implementation of Forcepoint cybersecurity technologies for customers.

  • Work with customers, strategic partners, resellers and Forcepoint team members to architect, design, build, and deploy cyber security solutions for customers and partners in support of pilot and proof of concept demonstrations.

  • Attending industry conferences, trade shows and sales events and participating in related activities.

  • Work with account managers and proposal team to develop technical content and diagrams for RFI/RFP responses

  • Orchestrate Product Specialists involvement during pre-sales activities

  • Collaborate with partners and professional services to design projects activities to align them with customer expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of relevant experience (or equivalent) in cybersecurity

  • Strong ability to understand customer needs and translate them into solution-focused conversations

  • Comfortable working independently with minimal day-to-day direction

  • Good judgment in evaluating approaches and recommending solutions

Nice to Have

  • Cybersecurity certifications: CISSP, CEH, or SANS credentials are a plus

  • Hands-on experience with DLP, DSPM, or NGFW technologies - these are a real differentiator

  • Familiarity with AI fundamentals, particularly as they relate to data protection

Why It Matters

This role sits at the intersection of technology and business impact. You won't just be explaining products - you'll be helping organizations protect their most sensitive data in an increasingly complex threat landscape.

Forcepoint is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range and variable compensation for this role is 240,000.00 - 260,000.00 and represents the low and high end of compensation for this position. Actual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to, location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Forcepoint’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include bonuses, paid time off policy, and many region-specific benefits

Don’t meet every single qualification? Studies show people are hesitant to apply if they don’t meet all requirements listed in a job posting. Forcepoint is focused on building an inclusive and diverse workplace – so if there is something slightly different about your previous experience, but it otherwise aligns and you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You could be a great candidate for this or other roles on our team.

The policy of Forcepoint is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.
