title: Student Software Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

As an Associate Software Engineer, you will join the team building NICE’s next-generation Workforce Management platform: a cloud-native system with AI built in, used by some of the world’s largest enterprises to schedule tens of thousands of agents. In this role, you will build full-stack features alongside experienced engineers, use AI agents as your default way of working, and see your code reach production and real customers early on. You’ll work in a fast-paced, AI-driven environment with close mentoring. From day one, we expect you to think a problem through before you code, ask good questions, and own the tasks you take on. If you’re curious, careful about detail, already building things with AI, and want to grow quickly into an engineer who owns features from start to finish, this role is tailor-made for you.

How will you make an impact?

  • Develop cloud features on AWS end to end with guidance from senior engineers, from understanding the requirement through tests to production.
  • Use AI agents in your everyday engineering work, and help improve the skills and practices the team relies on.
  • Investigate bugs and performance issues down to the root cause, and support your fixes with evidence.
  • Write tests and test plans that catch edge cases before customers do.
  • Grow quickly: take feedback from code reviews, share what you learn, and take on more ownership each release.

Have you got what it takes?

  • Computer Science B.Sc./BE/BEng (graduates, or students in their final year)
  • GPA of at least 85
  • 0–1 years of experience (internships, student positions and substantial projects count)
  • Hands-on use of AI coding tools (agents, prompts, skills) in personal, academic or work projects
  • Strong grasp of OOP and OOD concepts, with sound algorithmic thinking
  • Basic knowledge of client/server software systems
  • Thorough and structured: you break problems down, test your own work and don’t stop at “it works on my machine”
  • Self-motivated and accountable, a quick learner and a team player
  • Good interpersonal communication skills
  • Fluent English

You will have an advantage if you also have:

  • Built an AI/LLM project, agent or tool, especially one other people used
  • A final project, hackathon or open-source contribution you can walk us through in depth
  • Experience in working with cloud (SAAS) environments
  • Leadership skills: you’ve driven an initiative, mentored others or improved how a team/process works

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Requisition ID: 12019
Reporting into: Group Lead, Engineering, CXone

title: Manager In Training (Part-Time)
description:
HB: 00460 Minden, Louisiana (Minden Shopping Center)

R301US Hibbett Retail, Inc.

Hourly:

$10.35 - $10.35

Job Title: Manager in Training

Department: Operations

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Reports To: Store Manager

SUMMARY

The Manager in Training is responsible for assisting the Store Manager regarding overall operations and administrative duties. The Manager in Training is knowledgeable in each product area or department in our store. Assists in determining the methods and approaches necessary to accomplish the store’s goals and initiatives. Upholds policies, procedures and standards listed in the visual manual. They must fully promote each sale and/or promotion. Serves as an ambassador of Hibbett I City Gear creating a unique customer experience helping to acquire and retain long-time customers. The Manager in Training is passionate about giving outstanding customer service and promoting the merchandise in stores. The Manager in Training assumes supervisory control in the Store Manager’s absence and is trained in the Store Manager’s Responsibilities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist the Store Manager in controlling the assets of Hibbett I City Gear
  • Consults with Store Manager in establishing action plan to accomplish departmental and overall store responsibilities such as selling, restocking, merchandising, ordering, and scheduling.
  • Assumes responsibility of the entire store in the absence of the Store Manager.
  • Provides knowledge and guidance to employees and customers in all departments when necessary.
  • Is aware of inventory, sales statistics, and expenses to ensure profitability in all departments.
  • Direct staff to ensure each department’s responsibilities and standards are completed.
  • Keeps the Store Manager informed about inventory movement and customer trends.
  • Assures quality customer service is maintained.
  • Performs general administrative duties as needed and is trained in the Store Manager’s responsibilities.
  • Produce and give extraordinary customer service highlighted in the customer service manual, including helping customers as they enter the store, and helping multiple customers during peak periods.
  • Promote and sell services and merchandise provided by Hibbett I City Gear.
  • Practice and uphold all Hibbett I City Gear policies, procedures, and standards as listed in the operations policy manual, personnel policy manual, visual manual, customer service manual, and memos with the company’s direction.
  • Protect the company’s assets and financial information by ensuring the accuracy and effectiveness of internal control procedures and informing management and/or appropriate officials of potential fraud risk.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Supervises employees in the absence of the Store Manager. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; and resolving problems.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience working in a retail environment, preferably in footwear and athletic apparel.
  • 1-3 years of customer service experience.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to assist in managing a team and keep up with overall goals and profits.
  • Is a self-starter, has initiative to take on important tasks without being asked.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and with precision.
  • Is a team-player, passionate about outstanding customer service and selling merchandise.

Hibbett's Privacy Policy

Candidates will have an option during the application process to withdraw their application prior to completion of the application. Throughout this online job application process, you will be asked to provide personal information about yourself. Please review Hibbett’s Privacy Policy to understand how the information you provide will be utilized and safeguarded.

By clicking the Apply button, I acknowledge that I have read and understand the Hibbett's Privacy Policy. Further, I consent to the use of the same as my Electronic Agreement for purposes hereof. I acknowledge that I have a right to withdraw such consent at any time by contacting Hibbett.

title: Fluency & Scaling Lead
description:
Why this role matters

Lead the system that makes AI adoption and scale measurable, governable and repeatable across Pfizer International. This role connects AI Adoption & Scale to Strategy & Value and the central PMO, establishes common product ownership and measurement standards, and turns market and portfolio evidence into clear scaling decisions.


Reports to: VP, AI Adoption & Scale

Location / scope: Above-market, International; scaled portfolio and market adoption system

People leadership: Approximately 5-6 direct reports

Role type: Scaling strategy, performance and operating excellence


Key accountabilities

Scale, ownership and measurement standards

· Define and continuously improve the adoption-and-scale playbook, lifecycle stages, decision gates and reusable evidence pack.

· Establish consistent product ownership roles, decision rights, hand-offs, evidence requirements and escalation routes.

· Set common KPI definitions and data signals so adoption, workflow change, experience and business value are measured consistently.


Portfolio and operating rhythm

· Run the pillar cadence across priorities, dependencies, risks, decisions and actions.

· Maintain an integrated scale calendar that connects release plans, market capacity, readiness and value commitments.

· Prepare decision-ready portfolio views for leadership and ensure actions have named owners and due dates.


Adoption evidence and control tower

· Own the control tower and single AI view by market, including adoption, workflow attainment, agent creation metrics and token consumption where relevant.

· Translate centrally calculated data into clear management signals and define thresholds that trigger action.

· Improve data quality, comparability and traceability across portfolio reporting.


Governance, readiness and reuse

· Coordinate clearance pathways and define proportionate readiness criteria across workflow, capacity, access, data, support, Legal, Compliance and Responsible AI.

· Create reusable standards for communication, localization, activation and evidence capture.

· Identify cross-market patterns and recommend scale, adapt, consolidate, BAU or retire actions.


What success looks like

· A trusted, decision-ready view of portfolio adoption, workflow attainment, value, readiness and risks.

· Consistent ownership and measurement across scaled products and markets.

· Faster movement from validated evidence to qualified next-market activation.

· Governance and clearance issues resolved with clear accountability.

· Greater reuse of proven methods and disciplined transition to BAU or retirement.


Candidate profile

Basic qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, commercial operations, transformation, technology, analytics, healthcare or a related field.

· Significant experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation in a global, regional or multi-market environment.

· Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and deliver through matrix teams without relying solely on formal authority.

· Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear decisions and practical action.

· Working understanding of AI, responsible AI, data, digital products and workflow transformation.

· Experience in portfolio operations, transformation PMO, scaling, commercial excellence, measurement or governance.

· Strong analytical judgment and experience simplifying fragmented reporting or operating rhythms.


Preferred qualifications

· Experience in biopharma, healthcare, regulated industries or similarly complex global organizations.

· Track record scaling capabilities across markets or business units and using evidence to improve adoption and value.

· Experience working across cultures and balancing enterprise standards with local market needs.


Leadership capabilities

· Enterprise mindset with strong judgment on where to standardize, configure or adapt.

· Customer and colleague centricity, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguity.

· Bias for action, disciplined follow-through and willingness to surface risks early.

· Commitment to integrity, quality, compliance and inclusive leadership.


Key partnerships

· Strategy & Value and the central PMO

· Finance, Legal, Compliance, PX and Responsible AI

· Domain Transformation Leads and Business Product Owners

· Adoption & Market Activation Lead, AFL network and market leadership

· Process Automation & Workflow Design Lead, Build and KPI / telemetry owners


Role boundaries

· Does not own market portfolio prioritization, funding decisions or business outcomes.

· Does not replace Business Product Owners, technical owners or local accountability.

· Is not a central rollout office that pushes uniform activation regardless of market readiness.

Purpose

Breakthroughs that change patients' lives... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives.

Digital Transformation Strategy

One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. We are leading the way in adopting new data, modelling and automated solutions to further digitize and accelerate drug discovery and development with the aim of enhancing health outcomes and the patient experience.

Flexibility

We aim to create a trusting, flexible workplace culture which encourages employees to achieve work life harmony, attracts talent and enables everyone to be their best working self. Let’s start the conversation!

Equal Employment Opportunity

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to building a successful business. As an employer, Pfizer is committed to celebrating this, in all its forms – allowing for us to be as diverse as the patients and communities we serve. Together, we continue to build a culture that encourages, supports and empowers our employees.

DisAbility Confident

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer and we encourage you to put your best self forward with the knowledge and trust that we will make any reasonable adjustments necessary to support your application and future career. Our mission is unleashing the power of our people, especially those with unique superpowers. Your journey with Pfizer starts here!

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

title: Director, Health and Well-being
description:
The role:

The Director of Health and Well-being reports to the Vice President, Health and Well-being, and works closely with medical actuaries and Benefits Team colleagues to inform strategic decision making related to the design and financial management of the health and well-being products offered to employing organizations and members.


What you will do:

  • Develops and maintains competitive, cost-effective health, medical, dental, vision, and well-being programs.
  • Monitors financial effectiveness of health and well-being programs including claims trends and point solution efficacy by working closely with internal analytics resources and external medical plan actuaries.
  • Responsible for third-party health and well-being business partner relationship management to ensure efficient delivery of contractual services to plan constituents.
  • Participates in contract negotiations, renewals, and Requests for Proposals (RFPs) with current and prospective business partners for innovative and cost-effective health and well-being related products and services.
  • Evaluates emerging health care trends, market innovations and industry best practices to inform program strategy and design.
  • Works closely with Plan Administration team to support accurate documentation of product provisions across organization.
  • Represents The Board of Pensions on applicable Church Benefits Association committees and purchasing coalitions strengthening relationships with other church plan peer organizations.
  • Provides effective leadership to the Health and Well-being team by managing individual performance, providing coaching and feedback, and ensuring the team’s continued professional development.

What you need to succeed:

  • A bachelor’s degree.
  • Ten years of experience in health and well-being space, including product design and business partner performance management.
  • Certified Employee Benefit Specialist or Group Benefits Associate designation or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Experience managing the financial elements of large self-funded group health benefit programs.
  • Detailed knowledge of health-related benefit programs and all aspects of managed care approaches to healthcare delivery services.
  • An ability to make informed decisions and sound judgments regarding complex issues.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills to present technical benefits information in an easy-to-understand manner.
  • Excellent analytical, decision making, and problem-solving skills.

We offer a generous benefits package for eligible employees.

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Defined benefit pension plan.
  • 403(b)(9) retirement savings plan.
  • Generous paid time off, including sick time, holidays, and 22 days of personal leave.
  • Tuition assistance.
  • Employee Assistance Plan and other health and well-being resources.
  • Employer-paid death benefits with opportunities to purchase additional coverage.
  • Employer-paid Short-Term and Long-Term disability coverage.
  • Access to the Board’s education and grant assistance programs.
  • Discount programs on entertainment, travel, and more.
  • Satisfaction gained from working for a service-oriented employer.
  • Volunteer and other service opportunities in the community at large.

Our recruiting process is simple.

If you’re interested in a role at the Board of Pensions, apply online at pensions.org. If your skills match an open position, one of our recruiters will set up a phone or Microsoft Teams interview to discuss your interests, background, and skills. They’ll also answer any questions you might have. If you are selected to continue with the recruitment process, you will meet the hiring manager and other relevant team members.

To protect the health of our staff, we encourage everyone to receive FDA-approved vaccinations that may reduce the spread of certain infectious diseases, such as the flu and COVID-19.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Board of Pensions of the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.) is proud to be an equal opportunity employer We value diversity, equity, and inclusion and do not discriminate based on race; color; sex; national origin; age; pregnancy, childbirth, or a related medical condition; military/veteran status; marital/domestic partner status; physical or mental disability; medical condition; religion or religious affiliation, except where determined to be a bona fide occupational qualification; sexual orientation; gender; gender identity or expression; genetic information; ancestry; or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Communications Officer - EMEEA
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The Communications Division, led by the Chief Communications Officer in Seattle, oversees the foundation’s global communications strategy. The division brings together internal and external communications to advance the foundation’s mission of a more equitable world. The Global Communications team is responsible for shaping internal and external use of foundation voice to protect the foundation’s reputation and advance its priority advocacy and program objectives and ensure that employees are meaningfully connected to the foundation’s mission and community. The team is responsible for comprehensive voice planning for foundation leadership and key spokespeople as well as driving engagement with media.

The Global Policy and Advocacy (GPA) Division’s mission is to understand the political context and policy debates affecting the foundation’s work, build support for our major program and policy objectives, and develop partnerships and alliances that can advance the foundation’s objectives nationally and globally. GPA works in close partnership with grantees, and with our colleagues in the Global Health, Global Development, Global Growth & Opportunity, Gender Equality divisions to build the environment in which all people have the opportunity to lead healthy and productive lives.

Within the GPA division, the Europe, Middle East, and East Asia (EMEEA) team leads the foundation’s geographic presence in the largest donor countries outside North America and China, covering Europe (with a focus on UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the Nordics, Netherlands, and European Union institutions), the Middle East (Arab League countries), and the Asia-Pacific region (Japan, South Korea, and Australia).

EMEEA acts as the bridge between foundation teams and donor markets by offering deep insights on the geo-political landscape, media and public attitudes, and the foundation’s communication and advocacy priorities. EMEEA works alongside a network of grantees and partners - including, media, civil society organizations, think tanks, and academic institutions - to support the foundation’s overarching strategic goals.

Your Role

This Senior Communications Officer role is at the heart of delivering the Communication Division’s priorities, supporting the work of the GPA Division and driving the work of the EMEEA team.

This is a fascinating, stretching, fast-paced, and diverse role with no one day the same. The successful application will develop and execute communication strategies for the foundation’s work in France, Italy, Spain, and Arab League countries in the Middle East - to support the brand, reputation and advocacy goals of the foundation. This involves gaining a deep understanding of those countries listed - how they work, their priorities, audiences, and communications landscape. The strategies developed and implemented will cover everything from leadership visits and voice planning, to writing key messages, editorial planning, and creative content creation. They will be informed by audience insights and have measurement and evaluation embedded from the outset.


The role would suit someone who is experienced, full of innovative ideas, energy, and enthusiasm who has a track record of working well with others to get things done. Increasingly the role requires a campaigning mindset and approach to ensure cut-through and impact. Full professional proficiency in French and English is an essential requirement for this role. Arabic is highly desirable.

Based in the foundation’s London office, the postholder will be expected to undertake regular international travel, including to the countries referenced above and, occasionally, to the foundation’s headquarters in Seattle. The role will report to the Deputy Director, EMEEA Communications, who is also based in London.

The postholder will work closely with other Senior Communications Officers across EMEEA, the Insights and Measurement and Digital Content and Partnerships leads, and colleagues across the wider Global Communications team. The role will also involve extensive collaboration with Seattle-based stakeholders, external partners and grantees to ensure alignment, strengthen coordination and advance the foundation’s communications priorities across the region.

What You’ll Do

You will draw on your knowledge and skills to provide communications counsel to programmatic colleagues, grantees, and partners, and work together to build awareness and support for the foundation's work and programmatic, policy, advocacy, and communications goals. You will develop and manage a portfolio of grants and contracts to achieve this and build and maintain a network of relationships, including with senior leaders.

There is a lot of space for creative and innovative thinking, working collaboratively with new and existing partners to find ways to get attention and capture the attention of audiences. To achieve this, you must balance strategic thinking, whilst remaining nimble and opportunistic.

  • Drawing on your knowledge of the communications landscape in each country and the most impactful distribution approaches, together with colleagues across the foundation you will agree communication goals and draft strategies that will enable and support the foundation’s objectives - leveraging print and digital channels - to build and sustain the right kind of momentum for the programs.
  • Proactively manage all media relations, PR, enquiries, relationships at senior levels, cultivate partnerships with creators, influencers and the entertainment sector, and a full spectrum of media. This requires good judgement, risk management, and the ability to flex.
  • Work with partners and foundation colleagues to develop narratives, key messages, research data, and ensure this is used to develop content at key moments.
  • Work with the government and grantees in country communication to elevate priority issues and manage issues that may be reputational risks for the foundation. Ensure strategic communications campaigns are coherent, well-designed, and creative, so they have impact and build momentum.
  • Develop a coalition of third-party voices and messengers to elevate priority issues and build strategies to align voices and narrative. Ensure core communications material and collateral are market ready and used.
  • You will manage vendors and grantees to ensure collaborative and successful delivery of objectives, always with an eye to robust resource management and RoI.
  • Develop messaging and support leadership trips, including speaking and media opportunities.

By doing this you will help achieve:

  • Stronger awareness among target audiences of key foundation policy positions.
  • An enabling environment to encourage increased political and public commitment to international development, global health and/or accountability for past commitments.
  • Strengthened communications partnership with government and other institutions.
  • Strengthened profile of foundation local leadership among target audiences and knowledge and trust in the foundation and its work.

Your Experience

  • A bachelor’s degree and senior-level experience in journalism, communications, public relations, public policy or a related field.
  • Excellent experience of working with a full range of media, including print, broadcast and digital in the countries listed above. Plus, event management and execution experience.
  • A proven track record of leading complex communications initiatives, providing strategic counsel to senior stakeholders, and managing executive communications and reputational risks, ideally within complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Experience working with government institutions and/or public/NGO institutions is desirable.
  • Experience in devising and leading communication campaigns that are creative and have impact.
  • A demonstrable understanding of global and local politics - particularly in France and/or the Middle East, a strong analytical mindset to understand and react to real-time data and insights, and excellent judgement.
  • Full professional proficiency in French and English. Arabic is highly desirable.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and oral, and the ability to influence and engage individuals at all levels internally and externally.
  • Ability to assimilate and understand complex new subjects, including scientific, medical and development of finance policy areas.
  • Ability to confidently represent the foundation when dealing with media, and exercising sound media judgment.
  • Confidence in working in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, with a demonstrated ability to juggle multiple and competing demands and establish priorities, remain flexible, and work collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Ability to effectively cultivate and manage relationships both with internal staff and foundation partners.

Other Attributes

  • Comfortable in a wide range of cultural, geographic and operational situations, demonstrating culturally sensitive behaviour with a diverse range of people and a deep commitment to development issues and high standards of personal integrity.
  • Ability to travel 30-40% to France, Southern Europe, Middle East and the US.

Application deadline: 21 November 2026

title: Senior Fullstack Developer
description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

We are looking for a Senior FullStack Developer with a strong front-end focus to build the web experiences and modular front-end framework behind TEGNA's digital content management system. You'll work primarily in React and TypeScript, building scalable, reusable interfaces — ideally within a micro-frontend (MFE) architecture — that compose cleanly across teams and product lines. These front-ends are backed by our C#/.NET microservices on Azure, so you'll integrate closely with backend services and APIs. You'll partner with the Solutions Architects, who set the overall platform direction, and with the microservices teams whose services you consume. As a senior, you'll set front-end standards, mentor other engineers, and raise the bar for quality and maintainability across the UI/UX layer.

Responsibilities:

● Build and maintain performant, accessible web front-ends in React and TypeScript, and contribute to our modular, micro-frontend architecture.
● Design reusable UI components and front-end modules that standardize experiences and accelerate delivery across teams.
● Integrate front-ends with backend C#/.NET microservices and APIs (REST and event-driven), handling loading, error, and failure states gracefully.
● Own front-end quality — testing, performance, accessibility, and cross-browser/device behavior.
● Set and uphold front-end standards and patterns, and mentor mid-level engineers on UI architecture and best practices.
● Turn designs and product requirements into well-structured, maintainable implementations, and help shape them with product and design partners.
● Collaborate with the Solutions Architects and microservices teams to align the front-end with the broader platform direction.
● Work cloud-native in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined Git-based source control.

Requirements:

● 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong front-end emphasis.
● Deep, hands-on expertise with React and TypeScript, and modern front-end tooling (build systems, state management, component libraries).
● Experience with micro-frontend architecture (e.g., module federation or equivalent composition patterns) is strongly preferred.
● Solid experience integrating front-ends with backend services and APIs (REST, and ideally event-driven patterns).
● Strong grasp of front-end performance, accessibility, and testing practices.
● Full-stack range — comfort working close to the backend; familiarity with C#/.NET is a plus, since our services are .NET.
● A track record of setting front-end standards and mentoring other engineers.
● Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
● Media, streaming, CMS, or high-traffic consumer platform experience is a plus.


Why Join TEGNA?
You'll shape the front-end framework and user experiences that reach more than 100 million people across all of TEGNA's media properties, working at the intersection of modern UI architecture and a rich cloud-native backend. We are investing heavily in AI-assisted development, modern cloud-native services, and flexible, modular architecture patterns that let our teams innovate quickly while delivering high-quality, high-impact products for our users.

Pay Range
$100,000—$105,000 USD

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background. Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.

description:

title: Director, AI Product Engineering
description:
About Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.

Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. is the global leader in innovating, developing, and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with solid tumors. Amtagvi® (lifileucel) is the first FDA-approved, one-time treatment for previously treated advanced melanoma, now approved in three global markets and available at more than 95 authorized treatment centers. The Iovance TIL platform spans registrational trials and next-generation programs in additional solid tumors, including gene-edited and IL-12 tethered TIL therapies, next-generation IL-2, and precision immuno-oncology approaches. As the first and only company to take TIL therapy from concept to a broadly accessible commercial treatment, Iovance operates as an end-to-end cell therapy company, anchored by fully owned, centralized U.S.-based manufacturing that is scaled to serve thousands of cancer patients worldwide each year. For more information, please visit .

Amtagvi® and its accompanying design marks, Proleukin®, Iovance®, and IovanceCares™ are trademarks and registered trademarks of Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. or its subsidiaries. All other trademarks and registered trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

Information on Iovance’s broad, industry-leading patent portfolio is available on the Intellectual Property page on .

Overview

Iovance Biotherapeutics is a commercial-stage cell therapy company focused on developing life-saving cancer immunotherapies. We are building an internal AI Strategy & Operations function to drive measurable cost savings and operational efficiency across every department in the company.

The Director, AI Product Engineering will lead the engineering team that turns validated AI use cases into production applications across Iovance. This role will build production AI systems yourself and lead the onshore AI Product Engineers and the offshore engineering and software testing team who build alongside you.

The team serves every business function from one scored build queue. AI Strategists embedded in each function find the problems and build the first prototypes. Your team hardens them, validates them where required, ships them, and keeps them running. You will set the engineering standards and own the path from prototype to production.

This role is for an AI engineer who leads. You will be hands-on in the code at all times, set the technical direction for how Iovance builds, evaluates, and operates AI applications, and hold the team to the bar you set in your own work. You should use AI tools fluently and expect your team to produce significantly more because of how they use them.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Personally design, code, test, and deploy production AI applications, services, APIs, and reusable engineering components, using Python, Node.js, and React on AWS. This is a hands-on role at all times, not only when the team is blocked.
  • Architect LLM applications end to end: retrieval-augmented generation (document parsing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking), prompt and context design, structured outputs, tool use, and agentic workflows, integrated with Iovance systems through APIs and MCP.
  • Design the data models and databases behind the team’s applications, with attention to data integrity, access control, and appropriate handling of sensitive data.
  • Own evaluation. Build eval harnesses, golden datasets with human-annotated ground truth, and regression suites for every LLM application, and use them to gate releases, prompt changes, and model upgrades. Design safeguards against hallucination and misuse, with human-in-the-loop review wherever outputs inform business, quality, or regulatory decisions.
  • Own production observability. Every deployed application is traced and monitored for latency, token cost, error rates, and output quality, with alerts when performance drifts.
  • Lead build vs. buy assessments. Evaluate commercial AI platforms against internal builds through bake-offs on Iovance documents and data, not vendor benchmarks, and recommend the right path to the Executive Director.
  • Apply machine learning where it outperforms an LLM, including classification, forecasting, and anomaly detection on manufacturing, quality, and commercial data.
  • Lead and develop the AI Product Engineering team. Set clear expectations, review designs and code, give direct feedback, and grow each engineer’s AI engineering depth.
  • Own the path from prototype to production. Define the handoff standard AI Strategists use to bring work into the queue (specification, success metric, data sources, GxP classification), and manage the production handoff to the Infrastructure team.
  • Set engineering standards for architecture, reusable components, code review, testing, documentation, and release on Iovance’s enterprise AI platform. Keep production support light by design: simple, single-purpose tools, monitored in production and retired when no longer used. Build in AI-specific security from the first design: prompt-injection defenses, least-privilege tool and data access, and controls around patient data.
  • Own the team’s CI/CD pipelines: automated build, test, security checks, and deployment from version control for every application.
  • Hold offshore engineers and testers to the same engineering standards, code review, and testing bar as the onshore team. Make sure specifications are clear, review the output, and keep architecture and validation-sensitive work in-house.
  • Build applications that hold up in a regulated environment. Partner with IT Security and the AI Validation & Quality Lead so that tools touching GxP processes are designed for 21 CFR Part 11 and computer software assurance requirements from the first design, not retrofitted later.
  • Measure what ships. Work with the AI Strategists to tie every deployed tool to adoption and to the time, cost, or throughput result it was built to deliver, and report progress to senior leadership through regular demos of working software.
  • Must adhere to Iovance Biotherapeutics’ core values, policies, procedures, and business ethics.
  • Perform miscellaneous duties as assigned.

Travel

Minimal. Occasional travel to Iovance’s facilities, including the Philadelphia office, for stakeholder workshops or team collaboration may be required.

Required Education, Skills, and Knowledge

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 12+ years of professional experience building and deploying production software, including at least 3 years leading engineers as a manager or technical lead.
  • Hands-on experience managing performance and growing engineers into senior roles.
  • Experience managing distributed teams across time zones, including offshore or vendor engineering and testing teams.
  • A strong engineering foundation in React and Python or Node.js. You write production code today, not just review it.
  • Strong working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, including schema design, query writing and optimization, and managing schema changes through migrations.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar).
  • 2+ years building and operating production LLM applications on Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar APIs, with shipped work you can walk through in technical detail.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation: document parsing and chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, and reranking.
  • Experience designing LLM evaluations: golden datasets, automated and LLM-as-judge scoring calibrated against human review, and regression testing tied to release decisions.
  • Experience instrumenting AI applications for production observability, including tracing, cost, latency, and quality monitoring (for example, Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, or OpenTelemetry-based tooling).
  • Experience building agentic systems: multi-step tool use, planning, and integration protocols such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  • Hands-on AWS experience deploying and operating production services (compute, serverless, storage, IAM), and working with enterprise data platforms such as Redshift or Databricks.
  • Working knowledge of machine learning (classification, forecasting, anomaly detection) and the judgment to know when it is a better tool than an LLM.
  • A track record of build vs. buy decisions on AI tooling, based on evaluation against real data rather than vendor claims.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards: code review, testing, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and documentation.
  • Comfort working with APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
  • Excellent communication skills. You will demo to executives, negotiate scope with department heads, and work with non-technical stakeholders daily.

Preferred Education, Skills, and Knowledge

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare environments, especially with GxP-regulated systems (21 CFR Part 11, computer system validation or computer software assurance).
  • Experience building software for manufacturing, quality, or supply chain operations.
  • Production machine learning on manufacturing or process data, such as anomaly detection or predictive quality.
  • Experience fine-tuning or adapting models, or deploying them through managed platforms such as Amazon Bedrock or SageMaker.
  • Experience building document intelligence and OCR pipelines for scanned, table-heavy, or regulated documents.

Physical Demands and Activities Required

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to move about inside an office and exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects.
  • Must have visual acuity to perform activities such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures, viewing a computer screen, and extensive reading.
  • This position requires repetitive motion, substantial movements (motions) of the wrist, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to communicate with others to exchange information.

Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem-solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines.

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional workplace or remote office environment and requires standard office equipment and keyboards. Employees who work remotely are expected to maintain their workspace and environment safely and free from safety hazards.

#LI-Remote

The annual base salary we reasonably expect to pay is listed. Individual pay decisions depend on various factors, such as primary work location, complexity and responsibility of the role, job duties/requirements, and relevant education, experience and skills.

Pay Transparency
$270,000—$290,000 USD

title: GTM
description:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media () focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Staff Business Analyst - IT SAP HR
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As an IT Business Analyst, you will be working in a fast-paced environment, closely partnered with business stakeholders as part of project teams utilizing the Agile methodologies to deliver new capabilities and business value. You will configure, develop, maintain and support Micron applications. You will participate in new functionality estimation, analysis, design and development of application requirements by working closely with the Human Resources stakeholders and other members of the team.


Responsibilities and Tasks:

• Strong expertise in SAP HCM, including Employee Master Data, PA, OM, and relevant HR infotypes.

• Hands-on experience in SAP Payroll configuration, troubleshooting, and production support.

• Strong knowledge of payroll schemas, PCRs, wage types, retro calculations, and country-specific payroll processes.

• Experience with SAP Time Management and payroll-related functionality.

• Expertise in Workday-to-SAP Payroll integrations, including PECI troubleshooting and issue resolution.

• Experience designing, developing POCs, implementing, testing, and supporting complex SAP Payroll and Time solutions.

• Strong capability in production incident investigation, root-cause analysis, recovery, and preventive solutioning.

• Experience in functional testing, validation, and deployment of SAP Payroll and HR changes.

• Knowledge of payroll interfaces, banking processes, and downstream system integrations.

• Ability to analyze business requirements and provide guidance on system capabilities, solution options, and recommended approaches.

• Collaborate with Area Architects, implementation teams, and technical teams to define effective IT solutions for business requirements.

• Partner effectively with Payroll, HR, SAP Support, AMS providers, PMO, and cross-functional project teams to drive successful implementations.

• Support the S/4 HCM/Payroll transition, including future-state solution design and architecture.

• Demonstrated systems thinking, analytical ability, and strong problem-solving skills.

• Self-motivated, outcome-oriented, and capable of working independently under tight deadlines.

• Strong ability to build trusted relationships and rapport with business and customer groups.

• Effective team player with proven ability to collaborate across teams and drive results.

• Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

• Ability to act as a single point of contact for business stakeholders, leading discussions, coordinating decisions, and driving issues through closure.


AI Proficiency and Expectations:

  • Ability to apply AI capabilities to analyze Workday business processes, configuration, reporting, integrations, and operational issues.
  • Experience leveraging AI to develop test scenarios, positive/negative test cases, regression coverage, and release-impact analysis.
  • Working knowledge of AI agents, workflow automation, APIs/MCP concepts, and opportunities to integrate AI with enterprise platforms such as Workday.
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles, data privacy, security, access controls, and appropriate handling of sensitive HR/employee information when using AI tools.
  • Ability to critically validate AI-generated recommendations and maintain human accountability for configuration, design, testing, and production decisions.

Qualifications and Experience:

• SAP HCM Certified

• SAP S4HANA knowledge and experience.

• Minimum of 7+ years of direct, hands-on experience in SAP Payroll and Time.

• Hands on Experience on Payroll /Time Schemas and PCR’s for more than one country in US & APAC.

• Hands on experience on Positive / Negative time management and Time Evaluation.

• Experience in Configuration of PA/OM/ Time Management/ Payroll/ Time/ ESS-MSS/ Interfaces.

• Integration experience with HCM on S/4 HANA with Workday, SuccessFactors and other third-party systems.

• Deep understanding of Human Resources Processes, Master Data, Payroll & Time Data.

• WD Implementation / Support experience is value added.


Education:

• B.Tech./M.Tech./MCA/B.S./B.B.A. in Information Systems, Computer Science, or industry-related curriculum or equivalent work experience


About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport_india@micron.com

Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.

Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.

AI alert: Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.

title: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior DevOps / Platform Reliability Engineer is responsible for ensuring the availability, security, scalability, and operational excellence of our ERP platforms across AWS cloud and customer-managed environments.

The role owns infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, production support, system monitoring, and incident management. The position also supports the deployment and operation of AI and GenAI services integrated into the platform.

Working closely with customers and internal teams, the engineer drives reliable deployments, resolves complex production issues, and continuously improves platform architecture, security, and operational processes.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Platform Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

  • Design, provision, and maintain AWS and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Automate infrastructure using Terraform, CloudFormation, and Ansible.
  • Manage development, QA, staging, UAT, production, and customer environments.
  • Maintain high availability, backups, resilience, and disaster recovery.
  • Perform infrastructure scaling, patching, hardening, and performance tuning.
  • Drive capacity planning and cloud cost optimization.

DevOps & Release Engineering

  • Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for product engineering and customer deployment automation.
  • Standardize deployment automation, release workflows, rollback mechanisms, and configuration management, using GitOps.
  • Support release execution, environment readiness, deployment verification, and release governance, including progressive delivery (blue/green, canary, feature flags).
  • Build self-service “golden path” templates and tooling that let engineering teams provision and deploy without manual tickets.

Platform Reliability & Production Operations

  • Monitor platform health, performance, reliability, and operational stability across environments.
  • Implement and maintain centralized observability (metrics, logs, and traces) using OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation, with defined SLOs and error budgets for critical services.
  • Participate in production incident response, major incident troubleshooting, and on-call support rotations.
  • Lead blameless root cause analysis (RCA), post-incident remediation, and long-term reliability improvements.
  • Profile infrastructure resource utilization and optimize compute, storage, network, and service performance.

AI-Enabled Operations & AI Platform Support

  • BDeploy, scale, and operate AI/GenAI workloads used by the ERP platform, such as LLM APIs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI), model inference endpoints, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.
  • Build LLMOps / MLOps pipelines covering versioning of models, prompts, and configurations; automated evaluation gates before release; and safe rollout and rollback of model changes.
  • Monitor AI services for latency, errors, token usage, cost, and output quality drift, and enforce budgets, quotas, and rate limits.
  • Apply AI security and governance controls: API key and secrets management, PII and data-residency protection, prompt-injection and data-leakage safeguards, guardrails, audit logging, and model access policies.
  • Use AIOps and AI-assisted tooling for alert correlation, log analysis, anomaly detection, and faster incident triage and RCA.
  • Integrate AI coding assistants and agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer) into engineering workflows with review controls, and govern agent access to infrastructure through least privilege, scoped tool/MCP permissions, and human approval for production changes.
  • Support delivery of AI features into customer-hosted environments, including restricted-network or data-residency constraints where required.

Application-Aware ERP Platform Support

  • Troubleshoot ERP infrastructure, applications, integrations, and deployments.
  • Diagnose and resolve API, queue, configuration, and deployment issues.
  • Perform root-cause analysis across platform and database layers.
  • Collaborate with internal and customer teams on incident resolution.
  • Support MySQL, AWS RDS, and Aurora operations.
  • Manage backup, replication, recovery, and failover processes.
  • Resolve database performance and connectivity issues.

DevSecOps & Platform Security

  • Implement DevSecOps controls across infrastructure and pipelines, including SAST, dependency and container image scanning, and IaC scanning.
  • Secure the software supply chain through SBOM generation, artifact signing, and build provenance.
  • Manage platform hardening, secrets management, least-privilege IAM with short-lived credentials (OIDC), patch governance, and secure deployment practices.
  • Support vulnerability remediation, security monitoring integrations, and compliance-aligned practices (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) where required.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Leadership

  • Champion responsible use of AI tools across the DevOps team by sharing practices, templates, and guardrails.
  • Drive continuous improvement in automation, reliability, deployment governance, and operational maturity.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, or Cloud Infrastructure roles.
  • Mandatory experience supporting ERP or complex enterprise web applications in production environments.
  • Proven experience in customer-facing technical operations, deployment support, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting both cloud-hosted and customer-hosted / on-premises deployments.
  • Experience participating in production incident response and on-call support.
  • Hands‑on experience using AI-assisted tools in daily engineering work, and exposure to running AI/LLM-powered services in production.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • AWS EC2, VPC, ALB / NLB, Auto Scaling, Route 53, S3, CloudFront
  • AWS IAM, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, Secrets Manager
  • AWS RDS, Aurora, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway
  • Amazon Bedrock / SageMaker (preferred)

Containers & Kubernetes

Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Docker and container image management
  • Kubernetes in production (Amazon EKS or self-managed)
  • Helm / Kustomize
  • GitOps with Argo CD or Flux
  • Cluster autoscaling (e.g., Karpenter); GPU node scheduling (preferred)

Infrastructure Automation / IaC

Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Terraform / OpenTofu
  • CloudFormation / AWS CDK
  • Ansible
  • Bash / Shell and Python scripting
  • AWS CLI / SDK (boto3)
  • Policy-as-code and IaC scanning, e.g., OPA, Checkov (preferred)

CI/CD & DevOps Tooling

Hands-on experience with:

  • GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Bitbucket Pipelines
  • Jenkins (maintaining and modernizing existing pipelines)
  • AWS CodePipeline / CodeDeploy (preferred)
  • Artifact and container registries (ECR, Nexus, Artifactory)
  • Progressive delivery and feature flags

Linux / Middleware / Application Hosting

Strong experience with:

  • Linux (Ubuntu, RHEL, Amazon Linux)
  • Apache and Nginx, including reverse proxy configuration
  • SSL / TLS and automated certificate management
  • DNS troubleshooting and load balancing
  • System performance troubleshooting and OS-level diagnostics

Monitoring / Observability

  • Hands‑on experience with:
  • CloudWatch
  • Prometheus and Grafana
  • OpenTelemetry
  • ELK / OpenSearch
  • Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk (preferred)
  • SLOs, alerting frameworks, and incident diagnostics

AI / GenAI Operations

  • Working knowledge of:
  • LLM platforms and APIs (Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI / OpenAI, Anthropic Claude)
  • Model serving (SageMaker, vLLM, KServe, or similar)
  • RAG building blocks: embeddings and vector databases (pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone)
  • LLMOps: prompt and model versioning, evaluations, and LLM observability (e.g., Langfuse, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry GenAI)
  • AI security risks and controls (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, guardrails, PII handling)
  • AIOps platforms and AI coding assistants / agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer)
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) and governance of agent tool access (preferred)

Database Platform Awareness

Good operational knowledge of:

  • MySQL, AWS RDS, and Aurora
  • Replication, backup / restore, and failover concepts
  • Connectivity troubleshooting
  • PostgreSQL / pgvector (preferred)

Architecture / Platform Concepts

Strong understanding of:

  • Microservices and API-driven platforms
  • Service integrations and event-driven systems (SQS / SNS, Kafka)
  • Distributed application reliability
  • HA / DR design
  • Secrets management platforms (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)
  • Infrastructure security hardening

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • ERP deployment automation experience.
  • Customer-hosted enterprise deployment experience, including restricted-network environments.
  • AWS certifications (DevOps Engineer – Professional, Solutions Architect).
  • AWS AI/ML certification or equivalent hands‑on GenAI project experience.
  • Experience with internal developer platforms (e.g., Backstage).
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems) practices.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Core Identity (Auth0)
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Product

Auth0 is a developer-friendly identity platform that simplifies authentication and authorization for applications.Designed by developers for developers, we make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier-Ø global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation. Know more about our product at .

The Core Identity organization

Core Identity is the Auth0 Engineering organization entrusted with the very heart of our platform: the authentication pipeline, user sessions, and the foundational concepts the rest of the product is built on. We are also the stewards of the platform’s technical health, performance, and efficiency. We are hiring for the Protocols team. The team owns and builds the core authentication and authorization protocols at Auth0, which carry millions of logins every day for customers around the world, and we are also building the protocols that will power the agentic era.

The Role

This is an opportunity to solve complex distributed systems challenges at a global scale. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Protocols team, you will design, build, and operate the services that implement identity standards at global scale. You will primarily work with our Node.js backend (TypeScript/JavaScript), with data stored in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis, running on multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure).

We use the latest AI technologies and practices in our daily work, from AI coding assistants to AI-assisted design, testing, and operations. We're looking for an engineer who is comfortable using these tools and eager to find new ways they can help us build better software.

If you enjoy simplifying complex problems and building resilient, secure software, we encourage you to apply.

What you will do:

  • Join a fast paced and agile team spread remotely across Central Europe and US or Canada EST.
  • Build innovative features and standards that extend the capabilities of Auth0’s platform to help organizations securely innovate around the world.
  • Take ownership of the technical quality, security, reliability, and scalability of our systems. You'll drive architectural improvements and advocate for engineering best practices.
  • Use AI tools and practices across the development lifecycle and help the team keep improving how we use them.
  • Work in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment, working with talented engineers and partners across Product, Security, Design, Architecture and QA to deliver features that delight our customers.
  • Deepen or gain expertise in identity, security, and modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure) while working on distributed systems at scale.
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to our culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our critical services remain healthy and reliable.
  • Work hands-on with new and evolving identity specifications, and share implementation feedback that helps shape them.

What you will bring:

title: AI Associate, Growth
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.
