title: Associate Director -Operations Strategy & Business Intelligence
description:
About the Team

The Ops Strategy & BI function at Code and Theory is a small team with a wide mandate. We sit at the intersection of people, process and technology, and our work directly shapes how the agency runs and how leadership makes decisions. The team is early in its maturity, which means you will have real influence over how systems get built and how the function evolves. You will work directly with the Head of Ops Strategy & BI and have regular exposure to Finance, Delivery, Resourcing and executive leadership.

About the Role

This role sits inside the Operations Strategy & Business Intelligence function at Code and Theory, a Stagwell company. The team owns the systems, data, and workflows that run the agency — project management, financials, CRM, HR infrastructure — and the BI layer that connects all of it into something leadership can use to make forward-looking decisions. Beyond systems, the team is operationalizing Progressive Delivery across the agency, embedding a suite of internal AI accelerators into how projects are scoped and delivered, and building the automation layer that eliminates manual handoffs across finance, resourcing, and contracts.

We are hiring someone who can do two things well: understand a messy operational problem deeply enough to design a solution, and then build it. That means gathering requirements from stakeholders across Finance, Delivery, Resourcing, HR, and Technology; synthesizing what you hear into a clear plan; and executing against it using automation, agentic tooling, and structured process design. This is a 60% execution role. You will ship things.

What You Will Do

Operational Systems & Process Design

  • Own requirements gathering and workflow design across the agency's operational stack, including project management, financial, CRM, HR, and data infrastructure systems
  • Map where manual steps, data handoffs, and system gaps create risk or overhead, and design solutions that address the root cause rather than the symptoms
  • Partner with Finance, Resourcing, Delivery, HR, and Technology leads to translate operational pain into structured problem statements and scoped plans

Agentic Build & Automation

  • Design and build agentic workflows and automations using tools including Claude, n8n, Airtable, Python scripting, and AI-native tooling
  • Develop and maintain integrations across internal platforms, reducing manual data relay and reporting overhead across finance, HR, delivery, and pipeline functions to support the goal of eliminating manual steps entirely, not just reducing them
  • Build lightweight internal agents that surface anomalies, generate narrative summaries, and flag risks from financial, project, and operational data
  • Contribute to the AI accelerator portfolio: support scoping, testing, and rollout of internal tools

BI & Reporting

  • Support development of a centralized data lake and BI layer that ingests from project management, financial, CRM, and HR systems into a single source of truth
  • Translate stakeholder reporting needs into clean data requirements, a shared data dictionary, and scalable dashboard logic for Finance, Resourcing, and Delivery
  • Contribute to forward-looking operational intelligence: capacity forecasts, margin signals, delivery health, and pipeline trends that inform decisions before they are made, not after

Strategy, Communication & Investment Cases

  • Support Ops Strat & BI leadership in the initial building of business cases for operational investments: define the problem, size the opportunity, and make the ROI argument with precision
  • Communicate plans and progress to stakeholders across levels, from Delivery to Finance, Ops, and executive leadership
  • Produce clear documentation, process decks, and implementation briefs that hold up under scrutiny and do not require a meeting to explain

What You'll Need

  • 5 to 8 years of experience spanning operations, product, or systems work in a professional services, agency, or technology environment
  • Strong operational problem-solving instinct: you can walk into a broken workflow, understand what is actually wrong, and design a fix that addresses root cause rather than symptoms
  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements from stakeholders across different functions, synthesize competing inputs, and turn ambiguity into a scoped plan without losing momentum
  • Hands-on experience building agentic workflows or automations; comfort with at least one automation platform and basic scripting (Python and/or JavaScript) is expected
  • Enough fluency with operational systems to ramp quickly on new tools; you do not need a certification in any of them, you need the judgment to know what a system should be doing and the ability to figure out why it is not
  • Comfort working across a wide surface area without losing track of priority; you triage well and do not wait to be told what matters
  • Strong business case instinct: you understand ROI framing, push back on unsourced assumptions, and can write a one-pager that earns a decision
  • Clear, concise communicator in writing. You do not over-document. You do not under-explain.
  • Experience working with global teams across multiple time zones
  • Experience working with commonly used project management platforms such as Adobe Workfront, Smartsheet, Airtable, and Atlassian’s suite of products (including Jira and Confluence)
  • Experience with Agile principles and values, and frameworks including Scrum and Kanban to deliver a project

AI Competency Requirements

This is an explicit requirement, not a nice-to-have. You should be able to demonstrate experience building with AI-native tools and a point of view on where agentic workflows create real leverage versus where they add complexity.

  • Practical experience designing and deploying agentic pipelines or AI-assisted workflows in an operational context
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and model behavior sufficient to build reliable internal tooling without engineering support
  • Understanding of the difference between automation that runs reliably at scale and a proof-of-concept that works once
  • Awareness of data governance and privacy considerations when using AI tools against internal or client data

title: Franchise Business Director
description:
What’s Unique About You Is What Makes Us Better! Diversity is our strength and competitive advantage. Bring your flavor to the Papa John's team today!

Job Summary

The Franchise Business Director (FBD) serves as the primary liaison between the franchisor and franchise partners across multiple DMAs within a defined region. This is an operations-first role with direct accountability for driving restaurant performance, operational excellence, and franchisee results.

The FBD owns market-level outcomes, including sales growth, guest experience, operational performance, and financial health. This role is responsible for improving underperforming restaurants, strengthening franchisee capability, and ensuring consistent execution of brand standards across all locations.

The FBD builds strong, credible relationships with franchisees through direct, candid engagement while holding them accountable to expectations and commitments. Success in this role requires the ability to influence at a strategic level and execute at a tactical level to drive measurable improvements across the business.

Partners closely with the Senior Director of Franchise Operations and Divisional Vice President to align on priorities, escalate risks, and ensure consistent execution across markets.


Duties and Responsibilities (other duties as assigned)

  • Owns performance and results across assigned markets, including sales, operational execution, guest experience, and financial performance
  • Owns franchisee performance and results across assigned markets, with direct accountability for improving restaurant-level execution, sales performance, and financial outcomes
  • Improves underperforming restaurants by identifying gaps, implementing corrective actions, and driving sustained performance improvement
  • Ensures restaurants operate with operational excellence and consistent execution of brand standards
  • Holds franchisees accountable for operational and financial performance by setting clear expectations, driving action plans, and ensuring follow-through on commitments
  • Owns market-level performance by driving operational consistency, sales growth, market share, and unit performance across all franchisees within the DMA
  • Executes a disciplined operating system across all franchisees, including:
  • Weekly business recaps, inspection follow-ups, and issue resolution
  • Monthly SMG/service reviews, recognition, best practice sharing, and outlier follow-up
  • Quarterly business reviews including financial validation, strategic planning, COOP/DMA meetings, and in-market training and development sessions
  • Executes divisional and system initiatives within assigned markets, ensuring consistent implementation and follow-through across all franchisees
  • Leads execution of cross-functional initiatives within assigned markets to drive measurable improvements in sales, operations, and profitability
  • Uses data, field observations, and operational insights to identify performance gaps and take action to improve results across the market
  • Ensures full financial transparency by requiring timely submission of franchisee P&Ls and leveraging business reviews to improve financial performance and overall system health
  • Analyzes franchisee financial performance including P&L and balance sheet to identify opportunities for improved profitability and capital deployment
  • Develops franchisee capability through coaching, training, and exposure to best practices, improving operational execution and financial performance
  • Supports and executes portfolio optimization initiatives, including relocations, transfers, and store closure actions, ensuring alignment with divisional priorities
  • Provides timely, clear, and actionable communication to divisional leadership and cross-functional partners on franchisee performance, risks, and opportunities
  • Stays current on operations, financial performance drivers, and industry trends to continuously improve effectiveness and provide informed recommendations
  • Responsible for driving franchisee engagement, alignment, and participation across DMA-level initiatives including co-op and market planning

Education, Experience & Certifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required; College degree preferred
  • 7–10 years of progressive operations management experience required with at least three years in multi-unit leadership
  • Experience working with franchise business models strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated knowledge of financial analysis, including P&L and balance sheet interpretation
  • Demonstrated knowledge of restaurant operations including labor management, sales forecasting, marketing, and development
  • Experience influencing and working cross-functionally across multiple business units
  • Role requires travel to support franchisee engagement and in-market execution

Functional Skills

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Financial and business acumen with a focus on profitability and growth
  • Effective communication with the ability to influence franchisees and senior leaders
  • Problem-solving skills with a structured, results-oriented approach
  • Planning and prioritization with a focus on highest impact initiatives
  • Ability to drive accountability and manage performance
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and leadership

Our Values

  • EVERYONE BELONGS - We believe connectedness and belonging are the essential ingredients to our success
  • DO THE RIGHT THING - We are relentlessly focused on quality and integrity and make the right choices, even when it's difficult
  • PEOPLE FIRST - To craft positive experiences for our customers, we take care of each other first
  • INNOVATE TO WIN - We champion and challenge for a better way in all we do
  • HAVE FUN - We find joy, create meaningful impact and celebrate the journey together

Our Core Competencies

  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC - We leverage data and insights to craft a customer experience that builds relationships, cultivates trust, and delivers excellence
  • RESULTS DRIVEN – We focus on measurable outcomes by remaining optimistic, tenacious, and persistent even in the face of challenges
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT - We champion for better through strategic risk taking, experimentation and challenging the status quo
  • BIAS FOR ACTION - We courageously lead, drive towards decisions, and maintain agility to meet the demands of our dynamic industry

title: Senior Program Officer, Advocacy, Digital Transformation, Asia
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The mission of the Global Policy and Advocacy (GPA) division is to understand and shape the public policy debates affecting the foundation's work, build support for its major program and policy objectives, and develop partnerships and alliances that can advance the foundation’s objectives nationally and globally. GPA works in close partnership with our colleagues in the Global Health, Global Development, Global Growth & Opportunity (GGO), and Gender Equality Divisions to build the environment in which all people have the opportunity to lead healthy and productive lives. Within GPA, the Program Advocacy & Communications (PAC) team partners directly with program strategy teams – such as Digital Public Infrastructure and Inclusive Financial Systems - to define and advance their policy and finance goals.

- The Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) team supports country efforts to design, scale, and govern safe and inclusive digital public infrastructure, including digital ID, data-sharing, and verifiable credentials. The team also ensures that AI-enabled services are built on trusted DPI foundations, and that people in underserved communities can access these services in local languages and contexts. To advance these goals, the DPI team invests in open-source digital public goods (DPGs) which countries can adapt and deploy to build DPI; technical assistance to help countries implement DPI underpinned by strong regulation and safeguards; research and measurement to inform policies and practical implementation strategies; and experimentation to demonstrate how DPI can advance use cases in health, education, agriculture, social protection, and other sectors.

- The Inclusive Financial Systems (IFS) team works to accelerate the buildout of inclusive financial systems by 1) helping governments and central banks craft policies and regulations which support the expansion of inclusive financial services while also protecting users; 2) supporting the design, implementation, and regulation of inclusive instant payments systems (IIPS); 3) driving scale and economic sustainability by promoting pro-poor use cases, including government to person payments, wage payments, digital merchant payments, and productive credit; and 4) closing the gender gap in the usage of formal financial products.

The Role

The Senior Program Officer, Advocacy, Digital Transformation, Asia will advance the advocacy and goals of two program teams: Digital Public Infrastructure and Includes Financial Systems.

We are looking for a dynamic and well-connected leader to help shape the future of digital transformation in Asia and engagement with related regional and global multilaterals. In this role, you will serve as the foundation’s advocacy and policy lead for DPI and IFS in Asia, working at the intersection of government, technology, and global development to accelerate the adoption of safe and inclusive DPI - one of the most consequential levers for public service delivery, financial access, and inclusive digital economies.

Based in Singapore, you will play a pivotal role in engaging government decision-makers - particularly across Southeast and South Asia - to translate cutting-edge digital innovation into real-world systems that improve lives at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Asian governments - including central banks, ICT ministries, and ID authorities - that are focused on digital transformation, DPI, and related AI-enabled systems.
  • Ensure government decision-makers have access to the evidence, technologies, technical assistance, and policy frameworks needed to build and govern DPI effectively.
  • Represent the foundation in key regional and international forums (e.g. ASEAN, SAARC, World Bank, UN, ITU, G20, G7), influencing the global policy agenda and positioning DPI as the default model for digital development.
  • Develop and execute the foundation’s DPI and IFS policy and advocacy strategy across Asia, while helping elevate DPI as a global priority for inclusive digital development.
  • Build strong partnerships with the Monetary Authority of Singapore, the Government Technology Agency of Singapore, and other government departments to ensure other countries can learn from Singapore’s efforts to build and regulate DPI and AI-enabled services.
  • Serve as an internal expert on DPI, IFS, and AI in Asia - connecting internal teams and external partners and shaping conversations across the ecosystem.
  • Design, negotiate, and manage a high-impact portfolio of investments, ensuring clear outcomes and measurable progress toward safer, more inclusive digital systems.
  • Cultivate a diverse, high-performing network of partners and grantees to accelerate global momentum around DPI.
  • Partner with our DPI/IFS Resource Mobilization Lead to unlock donor financing to support country efforts to advance financial inclusion and build DPI more broadly.
  • Partner with the foundation’s Africa Regional Office to support vibrant South-South peer-learning platforms that enable countries to exchange practical lessons on deploying and regulating DPI and AI.
  • Produce clear, high-quality analysis and recommendations to guide investment decisions and strategy
  • Develop compelling briefings, reports, and updates on global DPI policy, financing trends, and emerging issues for senior leadership.
  • Support broader GGO policy and advocacy priorities e.g., Agricultural Development; Nutrition), aligned with DPI and IFS strategies.

Your Experience

We are looking for a recognized global professional with deep advocacy expertise in digital transformation, including DPI and financial inclusion in Asia. Additional knowledge and skills include:

  • Advanced degree preferred in public policy, business, international relations, development or a related field, with 10+years of senior-level experience in financial inclusion, DPI, or related fields in in Singapore and the Asian region, ideally spanning both the public and private sectors.
  • Strong understanding of how digital ID, payments, and data systems - increasingly powered by AI - are designed, deployed, and governed to deliver impact at scale.
  • Demonstrated success designing and executing policy and advocacy strategies that influence policymakers, donors, and ecosystem leaders across government, civil society, and the private sector
  • Deep familiarity with the regulatory frameworks, safeguards, and risk mitigation approaches needed to ensure DPI systems are safe, inclusive, and rights-respecting.
  • Understanding of the policy and regulatory enablers and safeguards for DPI and IFS.
  • Understanding of how AI can amplify DPI and IFS across sectors such as health, agriculture, social protection, education, and women’s economic opportunity - and the policies required to guide its responsible use.
  • Practical knowledge of policies and delivery approaches needed to close gender gaps in financial inclusion and ensure women can access and benefit from DPI.
  • Ability to connect DPI, AI, and finance to broader development goals, including public service delivery, social protection, and regional economic integration.
  • Strong understanding of how digital policies are shaped at the national level, and the influence of regional and global bodies in setting norms and standards.
  • Familiarity with the role of donor financing and blended finance in scaling DPI and financial inclusion efforts.
  • Established, trusted relationships with key institutions such as the Monetary Authority of Singapore, GovTech, and other agencies shaping DPI and AI-enabled public services.
  • Excellent strategic thinker and strategy development experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize/prioritize work and meet deadlines within a fast-paced environment with multiple and competing demands.
  • Demonstrated ability to question and challenge colleagues in a constructive manner.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to effectively synthesize information to reach diverse audiences and create consensus.

Other Attributes

  • Comfortable in a wide range of cultural, geographic and operational situations, demonstrating culturally sensitive behavior with a diverse range of people and a deep commitment to development issues and high standards of personal integrity.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% domestically and internationally.

*Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
description:
Financial Advisory Service Offerings

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

The Role

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Client service

  • Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
  • Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
  • Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
  • Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
  • Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
  • Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
  • Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
  • Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
  • Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
  • Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

  • Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
  • Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
  • Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

  • Support practice and talent development.
  • Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
  • Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
  • Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
  • Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

  • Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
  • Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
  • Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
  • Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

  • Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
  • Debt restructuring
  • Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
  • Preparation and validation of business plans
  • Independent business reviews and options analysis
  • Working capital management
  • Operational cost reduction
  • Interim management and active PMO leadership

Key Skills & Experience

Basic Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
  • Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
  • Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
  • Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
  • Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
  • Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
  • Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

About Teneo

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

title: Manager - Software Engineering
description:
At R1, we’re transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers.

All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We’re a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.


Develop high performing teams that are equipped with right capabilities in terms of skills, tools, technology, and resources to continuously deliver high-quality and high-value software.

Collaborate with the -Agile practitioners to help avoid distractions for the team, so that the team is focused on delivering their sprint commitments.

Drive adoption of modern engineering practices such as Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, Code Reviews, TDD, Functional\Non-Functional testing, Test Automation, Performance Engineering etc. to deliver high-quality, high-value software for 2-3 scrum teams.

Craft individual development plans for team members and provide growth opportunities.

Mentor, coach and challenge the team members to continuously raise performance standards.

Align the teams with organization’s vision, mission and strategic priorities and act as a key communication channel between team and senior leadership.

Assess and provide team members timely feedback and conduct 360 feedback for self and team’s assessment.

Foster a culture and mindset of continuous learning improvement to develop agility using the three pillars transparency, inspection and adaptation across levels and geographies. B.E/B. Tech/MCA or equivalent professional degree

10+ years of experience in building web-based enterprise software using Microsoft .NET technology stack.

Demonstrable experience of leading teams of highly skilled software engineers (15-25 team members) and working successfully across cultures.

Must have solid understanding of modern architectural and design patterns.

Comprehensive knowledge of automation testing and modern testing practices e.g. TDD, BDD etc.

Well versed with C#, modern UI technologies and database\ORM technologies.

Strong exposure to Agile software development methodologies and enabling tools such as Jira, Confluence

Excellent communicator with ability demonstrable ability of influencing decisions.

Knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle management, HL7, EMR systems, HIPAA, FHIR would be preferred.

Working in an evolving healthcare setting, we use our shared expertise to deliver innovative solutions. Our fast-growing team has opportunities to learn and grow through rewarding interactions, collaboration and the freedom to explore professional interests.

We also offer a culture of excellence that drives customer success and improves patient care. We believe in giving back to the community and offer a competitive benefits package. title: Principal R&D Scientist
description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen, permanent resident, Asylee, or Refugee.



Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Please review the job details below.

Leads the design, development, execution, and implementation of technology research projects. Assesses the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to potential inventions and products, and plans and executes applied research programs. Maintains deep knowledge of state-of-the-art principles and theories, and contributes to the scientific literature and to conferences. May participate in the development of patent applications, and may coordinate interdepartmental activities and research efforts.


Key Responsibilities and Expectations

  • Draws on broad expertise or unique knowledge to shape company objectives and principles, achieving goals in creative and effective ways.
  • Takes on significant and unique issues where analyzing situations or data requires the evaluation of intangibles.
  • Exercises independent judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria to obtain results.
  • Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments.
  • May advise on the activities of others.

Minimum Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering end-to-end ML pipelines, including data processing, training automation, evaluation frameworks, and scalable inference.
  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying deep learning models, particularly in one or more of the following areas: Vision-language models (VLMs) Multimodal learning Reasoning models Large language models (LLMs) Computer vision or geospatial AI
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with experience using modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
  • Experience building reproducible experimentation pipelines, including model evaluation, dataset versioning, and experiment tracking.
  • Experience deploying models into production environments using modern cloud infrastructure and containerized systems.
  • Familiarity with distributed training, large-scale data processing, and model optimization techniques.
  • Ability to collaborate across research, engineering, and product teams to bring advanced AI capabilities into real-world applications.
  • Must be a United States citizen and eligible to obtain a security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with geospatial data, remote sensing, satellite imagery, or Earth observation systems.
  • Experience building or fine-tuning foundation models, multimodal models, or agentic AI systems.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including large-scale AI/ML infrastructure.
  • Experience implementing model monitoring, evaluation pipelines, and automated retraining systems.
  • Contributions to open-source AI projects, research publications, or patents.

Starting pay for this role will fall within the listed range and will be based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills, location, and market conditions. Candidates who meet the minimum requirements for the role should not expect to receive compensation at the top of the range. The listed range reflects the expected pay for this position, and final offers will be determined based on each candidate’s experience, expertise, and alignment with the role.

For all other states, we use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop market-driven ranges for our roles, and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range.

Benefits: Vantor offers a competitive total rewards package that goes beyond the standard, including a robust 401(k) with company match, mental health resources, and unique perks like student loan repayment assistance, adoption reimbursement and pet insurance to support all aspects of your life. title: Lead Platform Engineer
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

Within Business Operations and the Information Technology (IT) organization, the Enterprise Data Solutions (EDS) team leads work across Knowledge Management, AI, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Infrastructure, and Health Data Platforms. The team’s vision is to empower the Foundation with innovative, data and AI driven services and solutions that enable timely, informed decision-making.

As part of this scope, the EDS team recently launched the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) - the central hub for managing, analyzing, and sharing the Foundation’s data assets and enabling AI.

Your Role

As a Lead Platform Engineer, you are an experienced, hands-on technical leader responsible for architecting, delivering, and evolving complex technology solutions that support foundation and affiliate staff around the world. You operate with a high degree of independence, serving as a subject matter expert and acting as a practice lead who contributes to technical execution, builds team capability and mentors engineers. You translate complex organizational and technical problems into actionable, tactical plans, partnering across service teams and being accountable for outcomes—not just deliverables.

In this role, you provide technical leadership across multiple platforms and domains, shape solution strategy, contribute to technical execution and guide engineering excellence across the organization. You serve as a trusted advisor to IT leadership and business partners, helping translate long-term organizational needs into scalable, secure, sustainable technology capabilities. You influence architectural direction, coach engineering teams, and ensure the overall health, usability, and reliability of the systems entrusted to your stewardship. Your work directly strengthens the foundation’s ability to operate effectively and advance its mission globally.

What You’ll Do

Technology & Architecture Leadership

  • Define and evolve multi-year Data and AI platform roadmaps aligned to enterprise architecture, security standards, and business strategies.

  • Work with business leaders globally to understand business needs, translate requirements to meaningful design artifacts and implement data and AI tooling for Enterprise Data Platform (EDP).

  • Implement Data and AI governance controls, data and platform level security best practices as we continue to build out EDP.

  • Provide platform architectural leadership and hands-on development of frameworks (example: Data Classification, data auditing, etc.) on complex, cross-team initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable.

  • Lead platform tools, frameworks and vendor evaluations, guiding build vs. buy decisions and ensuring alignment with enterprise technical direction.

  • Develop and promote engineering standards, reference architectures, and data access design patterns used across IT and partner teams.

  • Anticipate technology impacts across applications, data, integrations, and infrastructure—and guide teams through informed trade-off decisions including assessing new technology.

Solution Delivery & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop design patterns for developing and governing data and agentic AI applications on EDP using Databricks foundation models, OpenAI, Claude, Snowflake Cortex etc.

  • Manage and drive improvements of a lightweight custom application (Data Portal) for self-service data cataloging, search and discovery and data sharing with internal and external users.

  • Day-to-day hands-on execution and implementation of solutions, initiatives, processes and practices.

  • Lead and oversee technical direction for large multi-team delivery efforts, ensuring application of modern engineering and DevSecOps practices through completion.

  • Conduct architectural and technical reviews of solution designs, code, and delivery approaches to raise quality and consistency.

  • Champion automation, governance, observability, and operational excellence to ensure platforms remain reliable, performant, and cost effective.

  • Pilot emerging technologies and guide their adoption into stable enterprise capabilities when appropriate.

  • Drive continuous improvement of engineering practices, tooling, automation and operational processes.

Service & Portfolio Strategy

  • Partner with service managers and product owners to shape service strategies, roadmaps, and investment priorities.

  • Translate complex system challenges into actionable plans that improve sustainability, lifecycle health, and user experience.

  • Provide senior-level input to annual planning, including resource needs, modernization opportunities, risks, and capacity considerations.

  • Represent technology perspectives in strategic and portfolio discussions, ensuring alignment between business direction and technical capability.

Leadership, Influence & Collaboration

  • Serve as a practice lead, SME and senior mentor; coach engineers and contingent staff, as well as manage service partners.

  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across IT, Business Operations, and programmatic teams.

  • Lead cross-functional architecture and design discussions, guiding teams through ambiguity with clarity, sound judgment, and tactical planning.

  • Communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership, translating complex concepts into clear implications and recommendations.

  • Represent IT in foundation working groups, governance forums, and cross-team initiatives, ensuring alignment with broader strategies and priorities.

  • Lead core initiatives partnering across PSTs, Ops and IT.

Your Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science or related field or equivalent experience.

  • 12+ years’ experience in data platforms with a focus on advanced analytics, AI/ML Infrastructure, data security and automation.

  • Experience in implementing managed and custom MCP servers.

  • Experience in working on data platform architecture, processing of unstructured data and extracting insights.

  • Experience with analyzing and extracting insights from health and life sciences data (internal and external public repositories) using analytical and reporting tools.

  • Experienced in working with business users and co-developing solutions on EDP using Databricks, Azure and governing AI applications.

  • Hands-on experience with:

    • Azure (Data Lake, Azure ML, Event Hubs, etc.)

    • IaC automating infrastructure provisioning using Terraform

    • Databricks experience is a must (Lakeflow, Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks Applications, Unity Catalog)

    • Snowflake (Iceberg, Horizon catalog, Cortex AI, secure data sharing)

  • Experience designing and building API-driven data platforms (REST/GraphQL, microservices), and API/AI gateways.

  • Experience with data sharing with internal and external users, cataloging external data platforms is preferred.

  • Familiarity with building data pipelines with Databricks and DBT Cloud and orchestration.

  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and distributed systems.

Additional qualifications:

Strong understanding of:

  • RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.

  • Document chunking, indexing, and retrieval strategies.

  • Experience with document processing/NLP pipelines (OCR, entity extraction, classification).

  • Collibra data catalog and Data Governance.

  • Deep expertise with cloud-based infrastructure (Azure preferred), networking, identity, security, automation, and cost optimization.

  • Advanced experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, cloud-native operational models, and modern version control strategies.

  • Proficiency with programming and scripting languages such as C# .Net, Python, or PowerShell is desirable.

  • Previous experience with Salesforce would be a plus.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills.

*Must have unrestricted work authorization in the country where this position is located.

The Foundation does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (eg: H-1B, O-1, L-1, E, OPT, STEM-OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.).

The salary range for this role is $190,100 to $294,700 USD. We recognize high-wage market differences in Seattle and Washington D.C., where our offices are located. The range for this role in these locations is $209,100 to $324,100 USD. As a mission-driven organization, we strive to balance competitive pay with our mission. New hires salaries are typically between the range minimum and the salary range midpoint. Actual placement in the range will depend on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, and expertise, as evaluated during the interview process.

Hiring Requirements

As part of our standard hiring process for new employees, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Candidate Accommodations

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you have a disability or medical condition and need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process—such as an ASL interpreter, alternative interview format, or physical accessibility support—we’re happy to help. title: Condition Monitoring Advisor
description:
Career Area:

Product Support

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Provide condition monitoring and asset management expertise by analyzing equipment health data and delivering recommendations that improve asset reliability, equipment availability, and customer operational performance.

Responsibilities

• Analyze equipment health data using condition monitoring hardware and software to identify asset issues, recognize trends, and provide recommendations that improve reliability, availability, and equipment performance.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, dealers, and customers to understand operational needs, support problem resolution, and deliver condition monitoring recommendations aligned with customer priorities.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives by sharing best practices and participating in condition monitoring meetings, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing forums.

• Develop and share condition monitoring knowledge to support capability development and the consistent application of best practices.

•

Skill Descriptors

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.

• Identifies issues and communicates with others when a decision needs to be made.

• Names decision makers in own environment and cites examples of past decisions.

• Describes types of decisions incumbent may and may not make in own job or function.


Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Describes non-verbal behaviors that influence the interpretation of the message.

• Cites examples of effective and ineffective communications.

• Explains the importance of effective business communication.

• Speaks/writes using correct language, mechanics, and gestures.


Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

Level Working Knowledge:

• Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.

• Researches and verifies customer needs and expectations.

• Solicits customer satisfaction feedback and acts on improvement opportunities.

• Helps link organizational objectives to customer needs and expectations.

• Meets regularly with customers to understand their wants, needs and expectations.

• Provides examples of the characteristics of effective business relationships.

• Identifies key business relationships in own organization.

• Explains the benefits of building business partnerships.

title: Residence Education Manager
description:
OVERVIEW: Gallaudet University, federally chartered in 1864, is a bilingual, diverse, and multicultural institution of higher education dedicated to the intellectual and professional advancement of Deaf and hard of hearing individuals through American Sign Language and English. Gallaudet maintains a proud tradition of research and scholarly activity and prepares graduates for career opportunities in a highly competitive, technological, and rapidly changing world. As part of the university, the Laurent Clerc National Deaf Education Center is a federally funded center that operates exemplary elementary and secondary education programs for deaf and hard of hearing students as well as national outreach programs which develop and disseminate innovative curricula, instructional techniques, and products nationwide, and provide information, training, and technical assistance to parents and professionals serving children from birth through age 21.


Job Title:

Residence Education Manager

Worker Type:

Regular


Pay Type:

Salary


Exempt Status:

Yes


Compensation Grade (Track/Level):

CA3


Hiring Range (Commensurate with experience and qualifications):


Salary Ranges:

All Compensation Grades


Supervisory Organization (Department):

Student Life Leaders


Summary:

Reporting to the Director of Student Life, the Residence Education Manager provides leadership in the Student Life program for students living in the Model Secondary School for the Deaf (MSSD) residence halls and promotes an atmosphere conducive to the academic, social, emotional and life planning development of students.


Job Description:

  • Recruits, trains, and supervises residential staff, conducts regular staff meetings, and provides ongoing professional development opportunities; evaluates staff performance and provides constructive feedback; ensures that all residential educators are focused on the health and wellbeing of students and provide learning and personal growth activities and educational opportunities to students.
  • Responds promptly and effectively to emergencies, following established protocols; provides support and resources to students in crisis, coordinating with school counselors and other professionals as needed; serves as essential personnel and responds to emergency situations according to Clerc Center procedures; remains on call 24/7 to respond to any emergencies in accordance with Clerc Center crisis response protocols; works with Clerc Center leadership to develop crisis and incident management plans and additional response plans; and provides periodic exercises and drills to ensure all aspects of the crisis management program are viable and that team members are educated.
  • Serves as a leader and first responder for emergencies during work shift and during off hours non-work shift hours according to assigned rotating schedule; responds to student and staff situations when escalated to provide guidance to staff, and uses a high level of professional judgment in determining appropriate response plans, including reporting to the scene of the incident to lead crisis response as needed; serves as the building marshal for the residence hall; and serves as Manager on Call (MOC) on a rotation basis.
  • Provides direct supervision and support to students living in the dormitory; establishes and maintains a positive, respectful, and inclusive dormitory culture.
  • Serves as a primary point of contact for students, addressing their concerns, providing guidance, and fostering their personal development.
  • Organizes and implements programs and activities that promote community, leadership, and personal growth among residents; and encourages student participation in dormitory events and broader school activities.
  • Works with the Director of Student Life, teachers, and other school staff to support the overall well-being and academic success of students.
  • Collaborates with other dorm managers to ensure consistency in residential policies and practices; and serves as a liaison between the dormitory and the broader school community.
  • Ensures the safety and security of students by enforcing dormitory rules and school policies; conducts regular room checks and inspections to maintain cleanliness and order; addresses disciplinary issues promptly and fairly, in accordance with school policies and procedures.
  • Communicates and works with department chairs, transition and school counselors, and other personnel to provide students with continued learning during after school hours; facilitates the day-to-day exchange of information among various staff (teachers, counselors, family educators, parents, residence staff, and others) who share responsibility for the students' development.
  • Facilitates the MSSD student discipline system; assists Student Support Advisor with situations involving student behavior issues; follows-up with Incident Reports written by Residential Educators or other staff; meets with students to discuss code of conduct violations; assigns consequences according to the MSSD student/parent handbook; and contacts parents to inform them of student incident reports and subsequent consequences.
  • Plans professional Development with the director of Student Life for Residence Hall Staff; and provides ongoing mentorship and input for residence Hall Staff through individual meetings.
  • Maintains accurate records of student attendance, incidents, and disciplinary actions; and communicates regularly with parents and guardians regarding student progress and any concerns.
  • Facilitates conflict resolution and promotes positive interactions among students.
  • Manages dormitory budgets and resources effectively.
  • Establishes and maintains a positive and supportive working relationship with co-workers and supervisors.
  • Demonstrates a genuine commitment to belonging in the workplace and participates in activities and workshops to foster continuous learning.
  • Serves as a mandatory reporter under Title IX; and commits to completing Title IX training and other compliance requirements on an annual basis.
  • Prioritizes workplace safety as a collective responsibility for employee well-being and fosters a culture of safety integral to our success, including strict adherence to safety procedures and protocols and the prompt reporting of any safety hazards or incidents.
  • Performs related and other duties as needed.

Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree.
  • A minimum of four years of professional experience with residential education, student development, or a related field.
  • Ability to communicate in American Sign Language.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Master’s degree.
  • Supervisory experience.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:


  • Strong writing and communication skills.
  • Strong familiarity with current trends and practices in student development.
  • Strong familiarity with current concepts of K-12 student development.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of effective school administration practices and techniques.
  • Strong ability to work effectively with teachers, staff, students and parents.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with and across University departments, outside constituents and groups.

Additional Job Details:


  • The incumbent must be willing to work evenings and weekends.
  • The incumbent must be able to possess a driver’s license.
  • The incumbent must be able to possess First Aid and CPR certificates upon employment.
  • The incumbent must pass the Gallaudet University defensive driving safety course within four months of employment.
  • The incumbent must notify the supervisor of any and all traffic incidents which result in a ticket being issued by the Police Department of any jurisdiction in the United States.
  • The Model Secondary School for the Deaf dorms are for high school students, the majority of whom are minors. Therefore, female candidates may apply for jobs in the girl's dorm and male candidates may apply for jobs in the boy's dorm.

Other Important Information:


  • The successful candidate will undergo a background check that must be cleared prior to working at Gallaudet University.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Job Title: Senior SRE

Location: Bangalore

Position Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) will help keep Kaseya’s globally distributed SaaS production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. This role combines software engineering and operations capabilities to strengthen infrastructure monitoring, automate operational tasks, resolve incidents, and improve the stability and capacity of production environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and maintain Kaseya’s globally distributed SaaS infrastructure.
  • Manage and monitor virtual machines across hybrid virtualization environments, including Hyper-V, VMware, Amazon EC2, and Microsoft Azure.
  • Enhance and support global infrastructure and cloud software monitoring solutions.
  • Collaborate effectively with R&D, Customer Success, Support, and Operations teams.
  • Investigate and resolve hardware, operational, infrastructure, performance, and application incidents.
  • Perform preventative maintenance and troubleshooting to maintain infrastructure and application stability.
  • Provision new servers as required to anticipate and meet production server capacity needs.
  • Participate in weekly maintenance activities and rotational on-call support, including after-hours work when required.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Windows administration experience, including Active Directory, IIS, disk management, Windows patching, and performance troubleshooting, along with experience administering Linux-based production systems such as Ubuntu and RHEL.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies and processes, including P2V, vMotion, and VMware vCenter.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure.
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and load balancing.
  • Strong fault analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills; ability to work effectively in a distributed team and manage multiple priorities.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic scripting experience in PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Datadog.
  • Working knowledge of databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
  • Working knowledge of container technologies such as Docker.
  • Relevant Microsoft and/or Linux certifications.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: AI Growth Deployment Specialist
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Senior AI Platform Product Manager
location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
description:
About Aidoc

Aidoc is the market leader in healthcare AI and has developed the world's largest clinical frontier model, supporting nearly 50 million patients each year.
Aidoc is deployed in more than 2,000 medical centers worldwide. Since our founding in 2016, Aidoc has raised over $500 million and achieved a record number of FDA-cleared solutions.

Medical diagnosis is hitting a breaking point, where the number of physicians hasn't kept up with the rapidly growing patient load. This leads to misdiagnosis and treatment delays that result in hundreds of thousands of deaths every year. Aidoc assists clinicians by precisely highlighting diseases directly on medical images, preventing misdiagnosis and ensuring that urgent patients receive the immediate attention they need.

About this role:

Aidoc’s product team is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to join our AI Platform Product team, focusing on our core user-facing products and how clinicians experience and interact with AI in their daily workflows. These products are at the heart of our ability to deliver meaningful clinical value across thousands of healthcare facilities worldwide.

As the Senior Product Manager, you will own the product vision and roadmap for both mature, highly scaled applications and innovative new products used by radiologists and emergency department clinicians. Your core challenge will be to deeply understand physicians’ work environments, workflows, and clinical challenges, while mastering the underlying AI capabilities and technology, and translating both into exceptional AI-powered experiences that seamlessly integrate into clinical workflows, support better decision-making, and ultimately improve patient care.

You will work closely with R&D, UX, clinical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve the user experience, drive product adoption, and deliver new capabilities. In parallel, you will lead technically complex initiatives involving integrations, backend orchestration, performance, and scalability, balancing innovation with the stability and quality required for mission-critical medical applications.

This is a highly impactful product management role for someone who combines strong UX intuition with technical depth and wants to shape how clinicians interact with AI, directly impacting patient care worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Product Roadmap: Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Aidoc’s Clinical AI Applications, balancing innovation, customer needs, and product maturity.
  • Bridge Clinical Needs and Technology: Develop a deep understanding of physicians’ work environments, workflows, and challenges, alongside the underlying AI capabilities and technology. Translate these insights into intuitive, impactful AI-powered experiences that support better clinical decisions, reduce diagnostic errors, and ultimately improve patient care.
  • Lead Technical Product Initiatives: Partner closely with R&D to define and deliver technically complex capabilities involving software integrations, architecture, performance, and reliability.
  • Drive Product Adoption and Engagement: Identify opportunities to improve usability, adoption, and engagement through customer feedback, product analytics, and continuous iteration.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with UX, Engineering, Clinical, Delivery, and Commercial teams to align priorities and deliver high-impact solutions.
  • Engage with Customers: Work directly with clinicians and healthcare organizations to understand their workflows, challenges, and evolving needs.
  • Ensure Product Quality at Scale: Balance new feature development with stability, performance, and operational excellence across mature products deployed in complex healthcare environments.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of Product Management experience – must.
  • Experience with AI-powered products – must.
  • Proven experience managing user-facing software products, with a strong focus on UX, usability, and simplifying complex workflows – must.
  • Strong technical product management experience, including the ability to understand software architecture, APIs, integrations, and technical trade-offs – must.
  • Experience managing mature, large-scale products, balancing feature development with performance, reliability, and continuous improvement.
  • Enterprise software product management experience – strong advantage.
  • Tech-savvy, highly analytical, data-driven, and self-motivated.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment across multiple teams.
  • Proven ability to independently drive product initiatives from discovery through delivery and adoption.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Advantages:
    • Previous experience in software development or another technical discipline.
    • Experience in healthcare technology, medical imaging, or clinical workflows.
    • Experience with desktop applications or products integrated into complex enterprise environments.
    • B.Sc. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Working at Aidoc -Our Perks:

  • Be part of something big - using cutting-edge technologies to transform the Healthcare industry (while saving patients’ lives)
  • We work in a hybrid model, with our new offices located at 34 HaMasger Street in Tel Aviv and parking for employees.
  • Amazing and healthy breakfasts and lunches prepared daily by our personal chef!
  • Stocked up kitchen & meal card
  • Wellness: Aidoc employees-only gym, plus Pilates, Yoga, and functional workouts classes.
  • Amazing culture - collaborative, transparent & fun!
  • Attractive compensation package & benefits

Aidoc is deeply committed to creating an inclusive workplace, and to the principle of equal opportunity for all individuals. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

The Role:
