  • Drive continuous improvement in credit risk management, using insights from portfolio and lending activity to identify trends, strengthen controls and enhance the quality of credit decision-making.
  • Demonstrate leadership through expertise, influence and collaboration, sharing best practices, coaching colleagues and helping build credit capability across the organisation.
  • Gain meaningful exposure to senior leadership and broader business decision-making, providing the opportunity to increase your strategic influence, develop your leadership capabilities and contribute beyond individual credit decisions.

What You Will Bring:

  • Deep commercial credit expertise, with the confidence to assess complex lending opportunities, interpret financial performance and make well-reasoned credit decisions and recommendations.
  • Strong financial and analytical capability, particularly in financial statement analysis, creditworthiness, profitability, liquidity and forward-looking risk assessment.
  • Leadership through expertise and influence, with the credibility to guide decisions, challenge constructively and become a trusted advisor to colleagues and senior stakeholders.
  • Sound commercial judgement, balancing risk, customer opportunity and business objectives while maintaining disciplined credit standards.
  • The ability to communicate complex decisions with clarity and confidence, adapting your approach to influence stakeholders and build alignment around key credit decisions.
  • A collaborative, coaching mindset, with a genuine interest in sharing knowledge, developing others and helping strengthen credit capability and best practices across the organisation.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset, bringing fresh thinking to credit governance, lending practices and risk management while identifying opportunities to raise standards.
  • Ambition to grow as a leader, with the willingness to broaden your organisational impact, increase your exposure to se
  • nior leadership and develop toward future leadership opportunities.

title: Intern, Data and AI Enablement
description:
Job Description


The Data and AI Enablement Intern will join the Constellation Brands Data & Analytics Platform team to help advance the adoption of modern data, analytics, and AI capabilities across the enterprise.

Working closely with data engineers, platform engineers, architects, analysts, and business stakeholders, the intern will gain hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Gen2 Dataflows, Data Pipelines, semantic models, Power BI, Copilot, and Fabric Data Agents.

The role will provide practical exposure to the full data lifecycle, from ingesting and transforming data through building governed semantic models and analytics experiences, to exploring how generative AI and Fabric Data Agents can enable natural-language interaction with trusted enterprise data.

The ideal candidate is curious about data and AI, enjoys solving technical problems, and is eager to learn how modern cloud data platforms are designed, governed, and operated in a large enterprise.



Responsibilities:


  • Work with technical mentors on strategic Data & Analytics Platform initiatives supporting Microsoft Fabric and enterprise AI enablement.
  • Assist with the development and testing of Microsoft Fabric Lakehouses, including organizing data within OneLake and working with Delta-based data structures.
  • Build and enhance Fabric Gen2 Dataflows and Fabric Data Pipelines to ingest, transform, and orchestrate data from enterprise data sources.
  • Assist with designing and maintaining Power BI semantic models, including relationships, measures, business definitions, and reusable analytics components.
  • Develop and enhance Power BI reports and dashboards that provide intuitive, actionable insights to business users.
  • Explore and test Microsoft Fabric Copilot capabilities across data engineering, analytics, semantic modeling, and Power BI scenarios.
  • Assist with devleloping Fabric Data Agents that enable users to interact with governed enterprise data through natural-language questions.
  • Provide ad hoc data analysis, technical documentation, presentation, and project support as needed.
  • Participate in Constellation Brands internship activities, including senior leader meetings, goal setting, networking, team-building activities, tours, and a final internship presentation, consistent with the existing internship program structure.



Core Competencies to be Successful:


  • Technical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate and organize across levels and departments.
  • Strong ability to concisely and logically deliver analyses and proposals.
  • Strong initiative to seek out information and solutions.
  • Strong focus on quality and timely work.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.



Qualifications:


  • Current student in, or recent graduate of, a Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or other STEM-related program.
  • Basic understanding of AI concepts, including generative AI and common limitations/risks (e.g., hallucinations, bias, privacy considerations).
  • Familiarity with productivity and analytics tools (e.g., Excel), and exposure to data querying languages such as SQL; familiarity with Python or similar scripting tools is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and to exercise strong technical judgment.
  • Excellent problem solving and trouble-shooting skills.



ADA Physical/Mental/Workplace Requirements


  • Occasional lifting up to 25 lbs.
  • Sitting, working at desk/personal computer for extended periods of time.
  • Primary work environment is within a corporate office setting.
  • Ability to travel commercially and internationally.

$19.00- $32.00 an hour

We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. title: GTM
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Projectleider ICT
description:
For this assignment, we are looking for candidates who have excellent communication skills in Dutch (spoken and written)

Omschrijving

De coördinatie van multidisciplinaire maatwerk-klantverzoeken op het gebied van
applicatieomgevingen en ICT-infrastructuur, en daarnaast als deelprojectleider een impactvolle bijdrage leveren aan grotere ICT-projecten. Dat is in het kort je uitdagende functie als technisch projectleider. Je bent de onmisbare spil in trajecten met directe impact op de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening voor zeven ministeries.
Als technisch projectleider ben je de schakel tussen klanten, projectmanagers, relatiemanagers, architecten en specialisten. Daarbij werk je in de dagelijkse praktijk aan ongeveer tien maatwerk-klantverzoeken en twee projecten tegelijk, met een focus op het aansturen van trajecten voor het bouwen of aanpassen van applicatieomgevingen. Daarnaast heb je een coördinerende rol bij andere ICT-oplossingen zoals datakoppelingen, lifecycle-management, uitfaseringen,
applicatie-updates en cloudintegraties. Een uitdagende, afwisselende en verantwoordelijke functie dus.
Bij klantverzoeken ben je van begin tot eind de coördinator en het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de klant en onze organisatie. Je werkzaamheden beginnen bij het vertalen van de vraag van de klant, met vaak een functionele behoefte naar een technische oplossing die past binnen onze dienstverlening en kaders. Hiervoor organiseer je intakes en haal je informatie op bij specialisten en
architecten. Vervolgens maak je een plan van aanpak, de technische tekening en een
risico-impactanalyse. Je verdedigt jouw afgestemde plan en ontwerp in een change advisoryboard en verzorgt de input voor een offerte. Na akkoord van de klant ga je aan de slag met het verzoek.
Om het klantverzoek waaraan je werkt te realiseren, zijn veel verschillende handelingen en producten van technische teams nodig. Je stelt hiervoor zelf technische werkopdrachten op en maakt gebruik van een selfserviceportaal. Hiermee heb je toegang tot al onze standaardproducten. Op belangrijke momenten, zoals een livegang of migratie van een applicatie, zorg je ervoor dat de juiste resources
beschikbaar zijn en dat er een plan voor rollback aanwezig is.
In je brede functie als technisch projectleider heb je continu contact met veel verschillende mensen, zowel binnen als buiten onze organisatie. Daarbij is het belangrijk dat je aandacht houdt voor de menselijke kant van het werk. Je betrekt collega’s bij trajecten en brengt hierbij het belang van de klant zo goed mogelijk over. Je creëert een omgeving waarin de specialisten zo optimaal mogelijk
hun werk kunnen doen en motiveert hen met een positieve instelling. Soms moet je ook ingrijpen door collega’s ergens op aan te spreken, of te stimuleren om gemaakte afspraken op tijd na te komen.
Je gaat als technisch projectleider aan de slag in ons team Specialisaties. Het team is onderdeel van de afdeling Projecten en Specialisaties binnen de Business Unit IT Applicatie Services. Samen met zo’n 28 collega’s – technisch projectleiders, solutionarchitecten en security-adviseurs – werk je voornamelijk aan maatwerk-klantverzoeken en projecten. Ons team is verdeeld over drie clusters die
zich elk focussen op opdrachten voor een vast aantal ministeries. Binnen ieder cluster zorgt een coördinator voor de werkverdeling.
In ons team nemen we allemaal zelfstandig de verantwoordelijkheid voor eigen projecten, maar werken we wel op een hechte en informele manier samen. Dat doen we deels vanuit huis. Een dag in de week hebben we een gezamenlijke werkdag op kantoor.
Regelmatig sparren we met elkaar over de aanpak van zaken en één keer per maand bespreken we bijzonderheden, werkwijzen en nieuws in ons teamoverleg. In de wekelijkse clusteroverleggen zorgen we voor goede onderlinge afstemming over de werkzaamheden en helpen we elkaar met vraagstukken. Het mooie is dat je bij ons veel samenwerkt met specialisten van andere teams en
business units. Sta dus niet raar te kijken als collega’s van andere teams je uitnodigen voor een lunchwandeling of borrel.

Eisen:
  • Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring in een coördinerende functie waarbij je technische ICT-werkzaamheden en
  • specialisten hebt aangestuurd.
  • Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring in complexe Enterprise ICT omgevingen


Wensen:
  • Ervaring met ICT-infrastructuur (servers, databases, netwerken, packages, opslag en/of werkplek).
  • Ervaring met projectleiding op basis van PRINCE2
  • Ervaring met projectleiding binnen een SAFe Agile organisatie
  • Kandidaat begrijpt de opdracht en past bij de organisatie
Competenties:
  • - Omgevingsbewust
  • - Communicatief vaardig
  • - Plannen en organiseren
  • - Resultaatgericht
  • - Verbinden en samenwerken
  • - Organisatiesensitiviteit
  • - Probleemoplossend
  • - Overtuigingskracht

01-12-2026 tm 31-05-2027 met optie verlenging
36 uur per week
Den Haag
ZZP: Nee

title: Senior Supply Manager, Web & Non Enterprise - Tokyo, Japan
description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

About the Team

The InMobi Business Development/CSM team is the secret sauce in transforming publisher partnerships into revenue powerhouses. This team is the cornerstone of the broader InMobi SSP (Supply Side Platform) function that creates partnerships with regional publishers. The role is essentially customer-facing, working with app developers, media owners, social networks, and other publishers operating on mobile platforms. In a rapidly growing market, the supply team combines exceptional strategic sales and negotiation skills, with a deep understanding of industry trends, market analysis, competitor insights and a passion for uncovering new opportunities and converting these into revenue.

About the Role

InMobi is seeking for a dynamic and results-oriented Senior Supply Manager to join our team in Japan. Your key focus will be on building and expanding our partnerships within the web (desktop & mobile) & mid-market (non-enterprise) industry. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of the mobile landscape in Japan, excellent relationship-building skills, and a proven track record of driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships. You will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing partnerships with developers, publishers, and other key players in the Japanese gaming market.

You will also spend considerable time interacting with internal product, sales, and marketing stakeholders to explore new avenues of supply and revenue growth, thereby effectively creating an action plan that syncs perfectly with our broader business objectives.

In this role, you will report to the Director of Business Development & Partnerships, Japan & Korea.

Key Responsibilities:

  • New Publisher Acquisition: Identify, engage, and onboard high-value web publishers in Japan, aligned with InMobi's strategic priorities and revenue growth objectives.
  • Mid-Market Expansion: Establish and scale InMobi's presence among mid-market, non-enterprise app publishers in Japan (typically with DAU below 100K). Build a scalable, automated framework for publisher outreach, onboarding, and account growth. As a 0-to-1 initiative in Japan, this will require close collaboration with HQ to adapt existing playbooks, localize value propositions, and develop an effective go-to-market strategy.
  • Publisher Farming & Growth: Strengthen and expand existing publisher partnerships through yield optimization, onboarding additional sites and ad formats, and introducing new monetization solutions. Position InMobi as the publisher's preferred monetization partner.
  • Market Expertise & Industry Relationships: Demonstrate a strong understanding of Japan's developer ecosystem, monetization models, ad formats, and key industry players. Established relationships with key publishers are essential.
  • Competitive intelligence: Analyze market trends and customer performance to generate industry insights and identify growth opportunities
  • Structure joint business plans for key accounts, focusing on transforming growth curves through a deep understanding of client objectives and challenges
  • Relationship Building: Cultivate and maintain senior-level relationships, serving as the primary point of contact for partners.
  • Be the customer champion to the internal teams driving for outcomes on behalf of the customer.
  • Prepare and deliver transformational pitches and presentations to drive business growth.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to identify next big bets and innovative solutions for the gaming industry.
  • Develop case studies of successful campaigns and participate in industry events to showcase InMobi's expertise.
  • Provide regular reports on business performance, market trends, and competitive landscape.
  • Procure any required collateral from customer teams for any ad-sales pitches (case studies, media-kits, demographic split of users, daily active user count etc.

What we require of you

  • 10+ years of experience in the adtech industry, mobile advertising, or digital marketing. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical. MBA is preferred but not necessary
  • Fluency in Japanese and English to effectively communicate with local and international stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of the Japanese mobile market and its unique characteristics.
  • Comfortable handling & anchoring high level conversations regarding internal InMobi products & supply-side metrics
  • Experience in growing and maintaining complex, high-value managed accounts through a consultative approach.
  • In-depth knowledge of mobile advertising products across various formats (e.g., in-app, video, display).
  • Outstanding in teamwork with strong organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and decision-making in the absence of perfect information
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and presentation skills.
  • Knowledge of markets in KR, CN and APAC will be a plus.

This role offers a rare and exciting opportunity to shape the mobile market in Japan. The individual will not only play a pivotal role in establishing partnerships and driving growth but also contribute to building a team by selecting key collaborators. All of this is backed by the stability and confidence of joining a globally recognized company with a proven platform and successful business model.

Location: Tokyo.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

title: Principal Ops Engineer
description:
Business Unit:

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details:

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

Job Details:

Principal Operations Engineer

Service Operations · Product & Platform Engineering for NOC and SOC

Grade / Job Profile: P4

Reports to: NOC Senior Manager

Dotted line to: SOC Manager

Function: Service Operations

Location: Hyderabad, India

Work pattern: Shifts, with an on-call during weekends as technical expert for P1/P2 incidents

Experience: 8+ years in IT infrastructure, application support or operations; internal candidates with hands-on Cubic product experience preferred

Role Purpose

The Principal Operations Engineer is the product and platform expert who links how Cubic's products are built with how they are run. Involved from design and development through implementation and maintenance, you stay current on our products and bring that knowledge to the NOC and SOC to keep services available, performing well and secure, and to stop problems from coming back.

Your technical skills are broad across Windows, Linux, Azure, networking, Java applications and Microsoft SQL. Your depth is in Cubic's own products, applications and OT/IoT devices. You will serve the NOC and SOC equally, working alongside the teams that run day-to-day operations rather than duplicating them.

Product Portfolio

  • Each Principal Operations Engineer is primary for an assigned set of Cubic products and backup for another set, so every product always has cover.
  • Portfolios are set by the NOC Senior Manager, together with the SOC Manager, and reviewed as products and contracts change.

Key Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle: Design to Maintenance

  • Take part in design reviews and development check-ins for releases and major changes to portfolio products.
  • Define requirements for supportability, monitoring, logging, security and access before products go live.
  • Sign off operational readiness before go-live, and provide hypercare support for two weeks afterwards.
  • Keep up-to-date knowledge of portfolio products, applications and OT/IoT devices, and their architecture, dependencies and normal behaviour.

Availability and Performance

  • Monitor the health of portfolio products daily (availability, performance and capacity) and act on warning signs before they become incidents.
  • Act as technical expert for incidents and war rooms involving portfolio products, working with Incident Commanders and Major Incident Managers.
  • Run a monthly service review for each portfolio product covering availability, performance, incidents, problems, risks and upcoming changes.

Problem Prevention and Best Practices

  • Carry out the technical root-cause analysis for problems on portfolio products, working within the problem management process.
  • Deliver assigned problem fixes, and draft known-error entries and workarounds.
  • Build operational best practices, and feed lessons from problems into design reviews and readiness checklists so they don't recur.

Vulnerability Remediation into Production

  • Give technical guidance to the patch pod and to change and delivery teams on taking vulnerability fixes into live production: impact on products and services, test plan, rollback and readiness.
  • Act as technical reviewer at the change advisory board for changes affecting portfolio products and the Azure and Wintel estate.

Secure Operations Architecture (Azure and Wintel)

  • Maintain reference designs and hardening standards that support secure operations in Azure and Wintel environments.
  • Check portfolio products against hardening baselines every month, and raise gaps with the owning teams.

Application and Database Support

  • Act as the top internal escalation point for Java-based applications (JVM, threads, connection pools, application servers) and Microsoft SQL databases (slow queries, blocking, performance).
  • Diagnose problems that span several technologies across network, operating system, cloud, application and database layers.

NOC and SOC Support

  • Work a shared NOC/SOC consult queue in order of severity, with roughly equal capacity for each.
  • Provide product and infrastructure context to SOC investigations, including what normal behaviour looks like and the business impact of containment options.
  • Supply runbooks, product knowledge articles and known-error articles to NOC, SOC and the service desk.
  • Identify automation opportunities and define what healthy looks like for products, working with the automation pod and the observability team.
  • Take on additional design-to-support responsibilities for NOC-run services as defined by the NOC Senior Manager.

Compliance and Planning

  • Follow audit and compliance processes (including ISO 27001), and provide technical evidence and close findings for portfolio products.
  • Review capacity and end-of-life for portfolio products, and contribute to future hardware and software planning and budgets.

Working With Other Teams

This role makes other teams more effective on Cubic products. It does not duplicate their work.

Out of scope: alert triage, incident command, patch deployment, building automation, administering monitoring tools, and provisioning access.

Required Skills and Experience

Cubic Products

  • Thorough understanding of Cubic products, applications and OT/IoT devices: architecture, components, data flows, dependencies and how they connect to back-end and cloud services.

Broad Technical Skills

  • Windows / Wintel: Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy, with an understanding of hardening.
  • Linux: administration and troubleshooting.
  • Microsoft Azure: compute, networking, identity and security services, with the ability to design secure operations; working knowledge of AWS.
  • Networking: TCP/IP, routing and switching, firewalls, VPN, DNS, DHCP and load balancers.
  • Application support: Java-based applications and application servers, including JVM, thread and heap analysis.
  • Microsoft SQL Server: performance, query plans, blocking, backup and restore, and access control.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (AppDynamics, SolarWinds, Oracle Enterprise Manager, Site24x7, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch).

Process and Professional Skills

  • ITIL change, problem and release management; experience with operational readiness and service transition.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence.
  • Structured, analytical troubleshooting across technology layers.
  • Clear communication with engineers, delivery teams, auditors and senior stakeholders, and the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to balance competing NOC and SOC priorities.

Preferred Skills

  • Scripting in PowerShell or Python.
  • Experience with OT/IoT device management, gateways and firmware lifecycle.
  • Experience supporting a SOC or security investigations.
  • Experience in a multi-customer environment with contract-specific SLAs.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • ITIL 4 Foundation or higher
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • ISO 27001 Foundation or Internal Auditor
  • CCNA, RHCSA or equivalent

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and Asia. We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses.

If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey.

The Role

As a Delivery Manager, you will own the successful delivery of client engagements, from first conversation to final outcome. Working hand in hand with an Account Manager and Technical Lead, you’ll shape engagements before they’re committed, lead them through delivery, and make sure they land on time, on budget and to the quality our clients expect.

You will combine delivery leadership with commercial judgement and real client partnership. You’ll lead medium-scale engagements autonomously, take a key role in our most complex programmes, and be the person clients and colleagues turn to when the way forward isn’t clear.

This is a client-facing, billable role within the UK Delivery Team. Alongside delivery, you’ll help grow our work with clients, lead offers and develop the people around you.



How you’ll make an impact

  • Own end-to-end delivery of client engagements, balancing scope, timeline, budget, quality and margin.
  • Shape and communicate a clear vision and delivery strategy for each engagement, and bring clients and teams with you.
  • Act as the primary delivery contact and a trusted thought partner for client stakeholders, managing expectations with honesty and confidence.
  • Work as one team with the Account Manager and Technical Lead, balancing business needs with technical requirements and making clear, owned decisions.
  • Get involved early: shape, estimate and present offers, owning the delivery approach, team and plan before work is committed.
  • Navigate uncertainty by asking the right questions, making sense of complex situations quickly and guiding people towards practical next steps.
  • Spot delivery, commercial, technical and contractual risks early, and raise them openly so they’re solved before they become problems.
  • Keep a firm grip on engagement financials, forecasting accurately and managing scope change through clear change control.
  • Lead cross-functional teams of consultants, engineers and designers, delegating well so others can own outcomes and grow.
  • Identify opportunities to extend and grow our work with clients, and support pre-sales across the wider practice.
  • Coach colleagues and share your delivery know-how across our delivery community.
  • Help us continuously improve how we deliver, from methods and tools to governance.



What’s important to us

  • A proven track record of leading technology engagements in a client-facing consulting or professional services environment.
  • Experience delivering medium-scale projects autonomously and playing a key leadership role in highly complex ones.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including managing budgets, forecasts and margin across time-and-materials and fixed-price work.
  • Confidence in taking decisions and owning them, while balancing business needs with technical realities.
  • The ability to communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, client-side and internally, and to navigate conflict constructively.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to move things forward when information is incomplete.
  • A transparent approach: you raise issues early and see escalation as a way to get help, not a sign of failure.
  • Experience of agile and hybrid delivery, applying governance proportionately rather than for its own sake.
  • An understanding of technology delivery across areas such as software, data or AI.
  • Experience in complex, regulated environments such as health or finance would be a differentiator.

What we offer

  • Work life blend: we offer a safe & healthy workplace, with flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home
  • Profit share scheme: In addition to your annual salary, you may receive a profit share defined by the company’s success in the previous year
  • Global and Diverse Zühlke community: witness how colleagues from all our 16 offices across the globe come together to create a unique, positive and inclusive work culture, learning from one another at annual team camps, and celebrating year-end parties and other local festivities.
  • Committed to development: we are committed to the growth of our people and are investing in your development. We’re empowering you to build the skills you need to make a positive impact, both personally and for our clients, today and in the future.



To dive deeper into local benefits of working in Zühlke follow the link



How to Apply

Important: To ensure a smooth review process, please submit all application documents (CV, cover letter) in English only.


If you feel you don't meet all the requirements, we are still happy to get to know you, learn more about your ambitions and ideas and look forward to receiving your application!


We welcome people from all backgrounds, regardless of their gender, personality, national origin, race, religion, colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability or veteran status.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: QA Engineer - Payments
description:
SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes
  • Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.
  • Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff
  • Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they're fixed
  • Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence
  • Work closely in collaboration with engineers, product and market-launch teams, as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs.

What you'll bring

  • Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and comfort reading code in languages such as Golang, Kotlin, Java or others on our Tech Radar.
  • Experience testing software both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk.
  • Ability to analyse logs, transaction traces and test results, and to write defect reports that include reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, impact and evidence.
  • Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools)
  • Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation.
  • An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence
  • A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Card payments, payment terminals, acquirers, card schemes or certification labs.
  • Market launches, device integrations, external technical partners or business-to-business communication.

Payments experience is helpful but not required. We'll support you in learning card payments, devices and the certification process.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first set up
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
  • 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
  • 🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
  • 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches
  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
  • 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Senior Officer, Nutrition R&D
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The Global Growth & Opportunity division works to catalyze sustainable transformative change in the face of inequities and market failures, to realize the potential of untapped markets, and to see the economic and social benefits of including everyone. We focus on the areas of Agricultural Development; Inclusive Financial Systems; Water, Sanitation & Hygiene; Nutrition; Global Education; and Digital Public Infrastructure. We seek solutions that are sustainable, ground-breaking, and inclusive with an eye toward applying technology innovations as well as data evidence to lead change in the world’s developing countries.

Within the GGO division, the Nutrition program strategy team (PST) focuses on addressing micronutrient deficiencies at the population level through the development, implementation, and scaling of large-scale food fortification (LSFF). The team’s portfolio includes investments to produce actionable data & insights to inform our strategy and support countries in the design, monitoring & evaluation of LSFF to achieve population impact; delivers high-quality technical assistance to millers and food producers; advances new innovations in micronutrients and food vehicles; supports quality assurance data in mills to empower industry self-monitoring; and strengthens public sector standards and regulations for LSFF programs. We work with partners across public and private sectors to support the attainment of SDG 2: A global commitment to end hunger, achieve food security and improve nutrition.

Your Role

As a Senior Officer, Nutrition R&D on our agile and impact-first Nutrition team, you will manage and grow a portfolio of investments primarily focused on India, with some engagement in Africa, to advance technology and product innovations that strengthen LSFF.

The role requires a deep understanding of India’s nutrition ecosystem and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical experts across the Nutrition team, GGO division and the broader Foundation. The postholder will provide technical leadership, help shape strategy and influence key decisions to advance the LSFF strategic priorities.

The role sits within the Foundation’s India Country Office in New Delhi, however we are open to considering a remote work arrangement for the right candidate whose qualifications and experience strongly align with the requirements of the role. The postholder reports to the Deputy Director, Agricultural Development and Nutrition - South Asia, and works in close alignment with the strategic priorities of the global Nutrition PST.


What You’ll Do

  • R&D and Product Development: Provide strategic and technical oversight of complex R&D projects and partnerships across the product development continuum, from early-stage research to technology development, formulation optimization, product development, process scaleup, clinical trials, and regulatory approval.
  • Investment Management: Develop and manage a portfolio of investments focused on advancing technology and product innovations to improve LSFF programmes in priority low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).
  • Investment Strategy and Prioritisation: Develop frameworks to identify, assess and prioritise high-impact nutrition innovations. Lead due diligence on investment opportunities and provide evidence-based funding recommendations to foundation leadership.
  • Grant and Portfolio Oversight: Oversee grant implementation and performance, providing technical guidance to grantees, monitoring milestones, managing budgets and reporting, and ensuring investments deliver intended outcomes.
  • Scientific and Technical Expertise: Stay abreast of advances in nutrition science and emerging technologies, providing scientific guidance and reviewing technical materials for the Nutrition team, foundation leadership and strategic partners.
  • Strategic Advisory: Contribute to the strategic direction of the Nutrition R&D portfolio, advising the Nutrition Leadership Team on emerging opportunities, scientific developments and investment priorities.
  • External Partnerships: Build and maintain relationships with universities, research institutions, private sector organisations and NGOs to advance the foundation's R&D agenda and support grantee innovation.
  • Innovation Ecosystem Engagement: Represent the foundation in relevant scientific conferences, innovation networks and technical convenings, identifying emerging technologies and opportunities for collaboration in LSFF.
  • Evidence Generation and Communication: Synthesise scientific literature, prepare technical briefs and translate complex research findings into actionable recommendations to inform programme strategy and investment decisions.
  • Cross-Foundation Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the foundation, including maternal and newborn health, food systems and country offices, to advance an integrated approach to nutrition and contribute to improved health and developmental outcomes.
  • Technical Leadership: Serve as a key technical resource on LSFF technology and product innovation, supporting strategic planning, cross-team collaboration and evidence-informed decision-making across the Nutrition team, GGO Division and broader foundation.

Your Experience

  • A master’s degree or equivalent demonstrated experience, preferably in Biochemistry, Food Science and Technology, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Nutrition or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of senior-level experience in R&D, technology innovation or product development within the life sciences sector, preferably in nutrition.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex R&D and product development portfolios focused on human health, ideally in nutrition science. Private sector product development experience is highly desirable, as is experience working with organisations in LMICs.
  • Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholder interests, build strategic partnerships and effectively lead and influence others in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Established scientific and technical credibility, demonstrated through publications, presentations, product development achievements, commercialization or recognised contributions to the field. Strong professional networks across academia, industry, research institutions and NGOs.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate scientific evidence, assess research outcomes and guide R&D initiatives towards measurable impact.
  • In-depth understanding of current nutrition science, particularly its application to LSFF and nutrition challenges in India and LMICs, including Africa.
  • Experience across the product lifecycle, including clinical research, product design, sensory, shelf-life and stability management, manufacturing scale-up, and regulatory processes for innovations, is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively and influence decisions within complex, matrixed organisations.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex technical information, provide clear strategic recommendations and build consensus among diverse audiences.
  • Familiarity with micronutrient assessment and diagnostic technologies, including biomarkers and product testing methodologies, is an advantage.

Other Attributes

  • Comfortable in a wide range of cultural, geographic and operational situations, demonstrating culturally sensitive behaviour with a diverse range of people and a deep commitment to development issues and high standards of personal integrity.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time.

*Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.

Application deadline: 14 November 2026

#LI-RT1

Hiring Requirements

As part of our standard hiring process for new employees, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Candidate Accommodations

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you have a disability or medical condition and need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process—such as an ASL interpreter, alternative interview format, or physical accessibility support—we’re happy to help. Please contact HR@gatesfoundation.org with the position number and a brief description of your accommodation needs. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Inclusion Statement

We are dedicated to the belief that all lives have equal value. We strive for a global and cultural workplace that supports ever greater diversity, equity, and inclusion — of voices, ideas, and approaches — and we support this diversity through all our employment practices.

All applicants and employees who are drawn to serve our mission will enjoy equality of opportunity and fair treatment without regard to race, color, age, religion, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, and prior protected activity.

title: Activity Manager - Shift
description:

Templecombe – Onsite

3 x 12 hour shift Thursday-Saturday.

We’re committed to giving you opportunities to be your best. We hire from within as our first priority, so you’ll have a myriad of opportunities within our diverse, global organisation.


Flexibility

Your health and well-being matters to us and that’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, home working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times. Where possible, we support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions.


If you are interested in this role, we would encourage you to have informal chat with the Talent Acquisition Partner.


Thales is an equal opportunities employer and diversity and inclusion are integral to the success of Thales.


This role will require SC Clearance. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant will undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance. Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for Baseline and Security Clearance please refer to the National Security Vetting (NSV) Agency - United Kingdom Security Vetting - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)

At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.


Join Thales in the UK – Innovate with us and shape the future!

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
We are scaling our engineering core and looking for a Senior Python Developer with deep expertise in Computer Vision, NVIDIA DeepStream, and TensorRT to lead the architecture, optimization, and edge deployment of our enterprise video analytics pipelines.

Role Overview

As a Senior Python Developer at Dezzex, you will take ownership of high-throughput video ingestion pipelines, real-time object detection/tracking models, and edge-to-cloud inference optimization. You will bridge the gap between advanced deep learning research and industrial-grade production deployments, ensuring our computer vision solutions run with ultra-low latency, high concurrency, and robust reliability across enterprise hardware (NVIDIA Jetson and datacenter GPUs).

  • Pipeline Architecture & Optimization: Design, build, and optimize end-to-end real-time computer vision pipelines utilizing NVIDIA DeepStream SDK and GStreamer for multi-stream RTSP/ONVIF camera ingestion.
  • Model Acceleration & Deployment: Convert, quantize (FP16/INT8), and deploy deep learning models (PyTorch/TensorFlow) using TensorRT to maximize throughput and minimize latency on target hardware.
  • Core Computer Vision & Analytics: Implement and scale advanced algorithms for object detection, tracking (DeepSORT/ByteTrack), facial recognition, anomaly detection, and spatial analytics.
  • System Integration: Integrate video analytics telemetry, metadata streams, and event triggers with backend architectures via REST APIs, WebSockets, MQTT, and databases (PostgreSQL/Redis).
  • Performance Tuning & Scalability: Profile memory usage, GPU utilization, and CPU bottlenecks to ensure seamless scaling across multi-camera edge deployments and enterprise servers.
  • Code Quality & Mentorship: Establish rigorous software engineering standards, write clean, maintainable Python/C++ code, conduct code reviews, and mentor mid-level engineers and computer vision interns.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on production-grade Computer Vision and Video Analytics.
  • Core Languages
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python; solid working knowledge or integration experience with C++.CV & Deep Learning Frameworks
  • Strong command of PyTorch or TensorFlow, OpenCV, and object tracking frameworks.
  • Inference & Streaming Stacks
  • Deep hands-on experience with NVIDIA Deep
  • Stream SDK, TensorRT, GStreamer, and video protocols (RTSP, RTMP, ONVIF Profile S/T/G/M).Hardware & Infrastructure
  • Experience deploying models on NVIDIA Jetson edge devices (Orin/Nano) as well as enterprise datacenter GPUs (Ada Lovelace / Ampere architectures).Containerization & DevOps
  • Proficient with Docker, Linux system administration (Ubuntu/RHEL), and edge orchestration tools.
What We Offer

title: Electrification Engineering & Regulatory Specialist
description:

Engineering

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Title: Electrification Engineering & Regulatory Specialist

Salary: £66,000 - £99,000 (depending on experience)

Location: Peterborough, UK

Benefits:

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Up to 18% bonus
  • Contributory pension scheme - Caterpillar will double the employee's contribution up to 10%.
  • Contributory share scheme - Caterpillar will match 50% of the employee's contribution.
  • Optional flexible benefits including access to health and dental care plans, EV car lease, holiday purchase.

About E+ES

Whether it be groundbreaking products, best in class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do the work that matters at Caterpillar. With a 95-year legacy of quality and innovation and 150 locations in countries around the world, your impact spans the globe.
Caterpillar’s Electrification + Energy Solutions (E+ES) division focuses on delivering advanced electrified power train, zero-emissions products/technologies, and the solutions and services associated with these technologies. Focus areas include batteries, fuel cells, motors, inverters, micro grid controllers, charging, energy storage systems, lifecycle solutions/services and integration of components for ePowertrain solutions across industries.
We are looking for top talent to build and scale the next generation of technologies, products and services to help our customers build a better, more sustainable, world. We need self-motivated, intelligent and team-oriented individuals to make our plans a reality. Individuals with high emotional intelligence, humility and openness to discovery will thrive in the teams we are building.


The Opportunity

As an Engineering Specialist, you will use your knowledge of engineering standards and product safety requirements to support the development and introduction of Battery, Charging and advanced Powertrain technologies.

You will lead regulatory compliance activities for prototype machines, new product and technology projects, working closely with engineering and project teams to identify applicable regulatory, legislative and product safety requirements and ensure these are incorporated throughout the product development process.

You will coordinate the engineering evidence required to support product safety, regulatory compliance and successful market introduction, including risk assessments, validation evidence, technical documentation and applicable product markings.

The role will provide broad exposure across engineering disciplines, product development and senior leadership, while also offering opportunities to contribute to industry standards and emerging legislation.


What You Will Do

  • Lead certification activities for new technologies and product development projects, identifying applicable legal, safety and regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with project leads and engineering teams to translate product safety, regulatory and technical requirements into clear engineering actions and ensure these are delivered to agreed timelines.
  • Support the development and introduction of Battery, Charging and advanced Powertrain systems, contributing to the transition from conventional powertrains to electrified and lower-carbon technologies.
  • Coordinate engineering evidence and technical documentation demonstrating that products meet applicable safety, regulatory and engineering requirements.
  • Communicate technical, product safety and regulatory requirements to engineering teams, lead risk assessments and support the development and delivery of appropriate risk-reduction measures.
  • Work across engineering disciplines including systems, controls, electrical, validation, reliability and product safety to support the successful development and introduction of new technologies.
  • Provide technical leadership and oversight to manage engineering risks, resolve issues and support successful project delivery.
  • Engage confidently with senior leaders, project teams, customers and stakeholders, providing guidance on regulatory requirements and compliance activities.
  • Work with regional compliance experts, standards bodies and trade associations to understand current and emerging legislation, helping the business anticipate future regulatory changes and contribute to industry discussions.
  • Support the development of lean and efficient regulatory processes and share knowledge and best practice across engineering teams.

What You Have

Education & Experience

title: Client Executive
description:
About us

At Design Bridge and Partners, part of WPP, we design brands with the power to move. Pulling people towards them with an irresistible force that compels and connects. With 900 creative minds across 17 studios worldwide, diverse in expertise, experience, backgrounds and beliefs, we are united in our ambition to achieve real impact for our clients’ brands benefiting their business, people and the planet.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. This Client Executive role here at Design Bridge and Partners involves supporting the Client Team in managing strategic design projects, with a focus on nurturing and maintaining excellent client relationships with exciting global corporate brands. title: Foodcraft Greeter
location: The Lodge at Gulf State Park, Gulf Shores, Alabama
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

At Valor, we are passionate Hotelitarians—driven, detail-obsessed professionals who go beyond service to deliver true hospitality. With a global perspective and a commitment to thoughtful hospitality and sustainable dining, we bring enthusiasm, creativity, and local flair to every property we support. We seek individuals who value relationships, embrace high standards, and create meaningful experiences for guests, teams, and owners alike. Please visit http://www.valorhospitality.com to learn more about our existing hotels, other exciting job opportunities and our company.

POSITION PROFILE

Greet and seat all guests and ensure a quality dining experience. Supervises and coordinate the activities of the dining room in a restaurant.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Greet guests, escort them to their table, pull chair out for the guest, and present menus.

  • Positive Attitude & Empathy
  • Knowledge of Restaurant Flow & Basic Systems

  • Able to lift, push, carry 20 - 40 lbs.
  • Stand continuously for long periods of time.
  • Communicate information and hotel services to management, staff and guests.

BENEFITS PACKAGE

  • Competitive Salary

  • Daily Pay!

  • Team Member Hotel Discount Program

  • Uniforms Provided for most positions

  • Benefits - Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and other supplemental options

  • Paid PTO

  • 401k with employer match

  • Food and Beverage Discounts

  • Tuition Reimbursement

title: Concrete Industry Management Internship
description:
Job Summary:

What You'll Do:

To support the Concrete Industry Bachelor of Science Degree Program (Concrete Industry Management or similar), the following internship is designed to expose students to the various aspects of Cemstone Companies. These aspects include engineering services, sales, operations, environmental and business development.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES: The following is a list of essential duties & key responsibilities assigned to the role. Other duties may be assigned.

Engineering Services (ES) (34%)

  • Assist ES staff with mixture review and selections for projects
  • Assist with project submittal documents
  • Calibrate production equipment
  • Conduct aggregate testing for moisture content, minus #200 sieve and gradations
  • Sample and test raw materials for specification compliance
  • Perform QC tests such as temperature, slump, unit weight, air content, set time, water/cement ratio and casting strength specimens in the field and laboratory
  • Use test results to make mix adjustments
  • Record and report test results to your supervisor, batch personnel, dispatch and the customer
  • Required to keep a “daily journal” and fill out “Cemstone sample reports” for each sample taken
  • Interact with the customer’s field production and management staff to manage project expectations
  • Responsible for maintaining your own testing equipment, including cleaning and proper calibration

Sales and Business Development (33%)

  • Assist sales staff with project quoting, mixture selection and costing and project pricing
  • Read and interpret project documents including drawings and specifications
  • Attend job site meetings and concrete placements
  • When asked, participate in industry group meetings, conferences and webinars
  • Assist BD staff with project conversion opportunities including but not limited to paving, fibers and Cemstone Proprietary systems
  • Read and interpret project documents including drawings and specifications for[potential project conversions
  • Attend BD presentations and meetings with designers, owners, contractors and municipal entities.
  • When asked, participate in industry group meetings, conferences and webinars

Environmental, Safety and Operations (33%)

  • Assist safety staff with production site visits, and hazard assessments
  • Assist ready-mix operations staff with daily plant and field operations including, project visits, plant maintenance, driver management and safety.
  • Assist Customer Service Representatives with customer ordering
  • Assists dispatch personnel with truck dispatching
  • Assist with environmental and safety site audits.
  • Review and update environmental plans and procedures.
  • Help to research and recommend sustainable Best Management Practices (BMPs) across the company.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

  • Must have access to a reliable personal vehicle
  • Must be proficient with computers, smart phones, data entry and Microsoft Office applications
  • Ability to discuss technical and logistical aspects of concrete quality, production and delivery

Education and/or Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED is mandatory, Technical School graduate or Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Currently enrolled in Concrete Industry Management, Bachelor of Science, or equivalent technical program.

Language Skills:

  • Good English oral/written communication skills

Mathematical Skills:

  • Ability to use a scientific calculator

Reasoning Ability:

  • Capable of making quick and logical decisions in a fast-paced/stressful environment

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • Must have a valid driver’s licenseACI Field, State Plant and State Field certifications preferred

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The work environment and physical demands described here are characteristic and representative of those that must be made by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Ability to work at ready-mix production facilities, plant job sites, raw material production facilities and laboratories
  • Subject to plastic concrete, cementitious material, chemical admixtures, dust and dirt
  • Able to lift 50 pounds
  • Able to climb up and down ready-mix truck ladders
  • Able to carry 2 buckets of rocks up stairs
  • Able to push a loaded wheel barrel
  • Able to work on uneven ground at job sites

Pay: $18.00 per hour


Benefits

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental Insurance

  • Life Insurance

  • Retirement Plans

  • Paid Time Off

  • Wellness Program

  • Education Assistance

  • Employee Assistance Program

Closing

If you are interested in becoming part of our team, please apply online today.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We recognize that a diverse

workforce is essential and strongly encourage qualified women, minorities,

individuals with disabilities and veterans to apply. Join us in building a diverse and talented workforce that reflects the communities we serve.

title: Category Lead
description:
Category Lead

About the Role


Join Reece as a Category Lead and oversee an industry-leading product portfolio that sets us apart from our competitors helping us build customers for life. You’ll manage stakeholder relationships across our supply chain, collaborating with local and overseas partners.


Your responsibilities will include:


  • Ensuring category portfolios are customer-focused and deliver a clear competitive edge by conducting regular range reviews for optimisation and identifying new product opportunities.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with suppliers and key stakeholders, including negotiating commercial terms and overseeing supplier performance.
  • Driving product innovation and development, guiding products from concept through to launch while collaborating with key stakeholders to bring ideas to fruition.
  • Building industry connections to stay informed on the latest innovations and disruptions.
  • Producing insightful reports on category portfolios using tools like Excel and Power BI, analysing results to share updates on trends and impacts.
  • Developing category strategies that guarantee efficient product supply and align with business objectives.

About you


To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Demonstrated experience in a similar category management, buying and/or product management role – including supplier management and new product development.
  • Strong relationship building skills; you'll be working with a number of stakeholders within the business and external vendors and suppliers, including leading global brands and overseas partners.
  • Experience mentoring and/or leading a team will be highly regarded as you will be leading a small team in this role.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills with a passion for mentoring and sharing your knowledge and expertise, and an ability to present and engage audiences.
  • A positive, can-do attitude and an inquisitive nature, with a thirst to understand the Reece business and products.
  • Good Excel and Power BI skills.
  • Ideally you will also have had some experience working in a B2B environment (trade/distribution customers).

Reece offers a competitive salary, structured career progression opportunities, discounts on our products, EAP services and more.

About Reece

You probably know Reece as Australia’s largest supplier of plumbing and bathroom products.


But we are much more than that. We are a leading Australian distributor of trade products to residential, commercial and infrastructure customers. We’re an ASX listed company with more than 800+ branches and 9,000 employees across Australia, New Zealand and the United States and we’re growing all the time. We’re searching for an experienced Category Lead to join us on our journey to be the trades most valued partner.
