title: Customer Experience Coordinator (Overnight) - Chicago, IL (Lincoln Park)
description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online
  • Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly
  • Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs
  • Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate
  • Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.
  • Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions
  • Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information
  • Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships
  • Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

WHAT YOU NEED

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer service role
  • Advanced knowledge in computer programs and practice management software
  • Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
  • A strong communicator; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone
  • A strong multitasker, able to thrive amid chaos
  • High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly
  • Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments
  • Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors
  • Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs
  • Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

  • Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives
  • Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments
  • Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results
  • Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive compensation, including base (between $18-$26/hr) and 401K match
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling
  • Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success
  • A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.
  • Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt
  • Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families
  • Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work
  • Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people
  • And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

title: Revenue Strategy Analyst
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Deputy Director, Leadership Advising, India Country Office
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The India Country Office (ICO) is part of the Africa & India Offices Division (AIO). We work closely with India’s central and state governments, and partner with community-based organizations, nonprofit organizations, academic and research institutions, the private sector, and development partners to advance our shared objectives. Our strong networks and ability to convene intellectual and technical resources globally and across sectors enable us to respond effectively to emerging and complex challenges.

In India, our work focuses on key priorities that shape the future of the country’s most vulnerable communities, including reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health and nutrition; urban sanitation; agricultural development; women’s economic empowerment; digital public infrastructure and digital financial inclusion, across several states in the country.

Your Role
The Deputy Director, Leadership Advising, India Country Office (“Deputy Director”) serves as a trusted strategic advisor to the Director, India Country Office, with responsibility for three critical priorities: strategic advising and enterprise alignment; executive leadership visits and engagement; and strategic communications and reputation management.

You are a critical partner to the Executive Team of Program Directors in the Country. You are responsible for enabling the Director’s leadership priorities through high-quality advising, effective internal coordination, and supporting external engagement. This includes supporting and representing the Director’s office across internal and external touchpoints, engaging with the other Chiefs of Staff, and ensuring strategic coherence based on external and ecosystem perspective, while working closely with the Deputy Director Cluster lead for Strategy Planning and Management (SPM) who leads on internal country program strategies and investment portfolio perspective.

You act as a trusted representative of the Director, cultivating and sustaining internal relationships, locally and with Seattle offices, guiding operational alignment. You also incubate high-priority initiatives on behalf of the Director, serve as the point person for senior leadership visits to the country, and steward the foundation’s reputation by curating the Director’s voice, participation, and visibility in strategic fora. You will work with the Country Director to anticipate and mitigate risks and guide a senior communication team on transparently disseminating locally grounded impact to support our country-level goals.

You will be responsible for planning and delivering executive leadership visits, ensuring seamless coordination, strategic alignment, and high-impact partner engagement.


You will report to the Director, India Country Office. You will manage a team, support the Director’s office, and broader cross-functional efforts. You will sit on the ICO Management Team and other ICO leadership structures, as needed. You serve on the India Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) Council to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture across the country.


*Applications accepted until Friday, November 20th, 2026. This role is based in our India Country Office in New Delhi, India.

What You'll Do


Strategic Advising, Leadership Support & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a principal advisor to the Director, India – guiding ICO enterprise strategy, priorities, providing thought partnership, and helping navigate complex strategic and operational decisions.
  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with critical Seattle-based team members, including Office of the Africa and India Office President (AIO OOP), other Divisional OOPs, Directors of Program Strategy Team (PSTs), FSO, and enterprise leadership teams.
  • Maintains a strong cadence of engagement and builds relationship with DD Leadership Advisor to the Director of the Africa Region Office.
  • Serve as a strategic liaison to the AIO Office of the President (OOP), shaping and aligning India priorities within the AIO ; contribute to defining agendas for AIO Executive Team (ET) and Leadership Team (LT) engagements; proactively elevate India’s strategic priorities and insights within AIO priority areas; and provide inputs into workforce planning for the Division.
  • Support the Director’s participation in the Executive Partner Advisory Group (EPAG) and other cross-foundation leadership forums.
  • Assess all external invitations and representational opportunities for the Director, working closely with Communications, Partnerships, and program teams to ensure strategic relevance and strengthen the foundation’s reputation.
  • Maintain a candid, unbiased advisory role supporting effective decision-making while promoting sustainable leadership.

Leadership Coordination & Internal Team Orchestration

  • Lead the planning, agenda-setting, and execution of:
    • Monthly India Executive Team (ET) meetings
  • Ensure the Director is well-prepared for each meeting, including background materials, framing guidance, and follow-up.
  • Enable internal coordination with program leaders to ensure seamless strategy execution and aligned team communications.
  • Serve as overall point of contact for leadership visits to India, engaging across program teams, trip directors, to align strategic objectives, messaging, partner engagement, and operational execution.

Strategic Projects & Special Initiatives

  • Incubate special projects and initiatives for the India team as needed, providing strategic support and coordination.
  • Partner closely with Deputy Director SPM on the regular reviews and refinement of the strategy portfolios led by the Director’s Office.

External Communications and Engagement

  • Provide strategic guidance and oversight for the ICO’s external communications priorities, working with Communications Leadership Team and relevant teams to ensure credible, locally grounded narratives that advance country priorities and strengthen the foundation’s reputation.
  • Help shape and advance the Director’s strategic external engagement with government, private-sector, philanthropic, and development partners, strengthening institutional relationships and finding opportunities to advance shared goals.

Operations, Workforce Planning & Team Management

  • Partner closely with DD SPM & People team colleagues to lead on workforce planning, aligning talent strategy with geographic, technical, and organizational needs.
  • Support timely hiring and onboarding of key roles within the ICO Director’s portfolio.
  • Partner closely with SPM and contribute to annual planning, budget alignment, portfolio strategy and performance tracking processes across the India Team.

Relationship Building & Influence

  • Build and sustain high-trust relationships across the India Team, PSTs, enterprise functions, and external partners.
  • Act as a connector across teams, and organizational levels - translating across contexts, building alignment, and enabling collaboration.
  • Represent the Director’s office with credibility, care, and discretion, ensuring interactions reflect foundation values and advance mutual trust.

Culture, DEI & Internal Communications

  • Serve as a member of the India DEI Council, leading leadership engagement and ensuring DEI principles are embedded in strategy, talent processes and communications.
  • Design and implement internal communications, translating foundation priorities and leadership decisions into clear, transparent, and coherent messages that strengthen alignment and engagement across the India and Seattle teams.


Your Experience

  • Advanced degree in business, international development, or related field preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in programmatic strategy creation, strategic advising, partner management, executive coordination, or organizational effectiveness roles in complex, global organizations.
  • Experience supporting or coordinating executive-level engagements (e.g. board, CEO, Executive Leadership Team (ELT).
  • Demonstrated experience with donors, bi/multilateral organizations; experience in India or cross-cultural settings preferred.
  • Experience in engaging with leaders across public, private, and development sectors to align efforts and goals is preferred.
  • Success in people leadership, cross-country portfolio coordination, and enterprise-level change initiatives.
  • Knowledge of reputation management is preferred.
  • Exceptional political competence, judgment, integrity, and discretion.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic leadership: Synthesizes complexity into actionable insights; enables adaptive execution; supports systems-level impact.
  • Executive presence & communication: Communicates with clarity, diplomacy, and intent across a wide range of audiences and settings.
  • Enterprise coordination: Connects strategy, operations, people, and influence country and teams.
  • Stakeholder engagement & relationship management: Builds and nurtures high-impact relationships across functions, geographies, and levels of seniority. Uses trust, emotional intelligence, and diplomacy to align stakeholders, resolve tension, and strengthen collaboration. Recognizes relationships as core to impact.
  • Team leadership & talent development: Manages a diverse, high-performing team with care, accountability, and purpose.
  • Workforce & operational planning: Leads with a systemic view of talent, performance, and organizational alignment.
  • Cultural fluency & DEI advocacy: Models equity-focused leadership and fosters a culture of inclusion across geographies.

Other Attributes

  • Comfortable working in culturally diverse environments and high-paced settings.
  • Ability to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. title: Engineer, Global Quality Package Design and Development Quality Assurance
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

The Engineer, GQPDDQA supports package design and development quality assurance for advanced packaging technologies, including high-bandwidth memory (HBM), 2.5D/3D integration, and wafer-level packaging. The role executes technical risk assessments, qualification planning, characterization, and package-related issue analysis in collaboration with Technology Development, Product Engineering, Packaging, and customer-facing teams. The Engineer contributes to identifying and mitigating chip-package interaction and reliability risks before new product introduction, enabling robust technology release, customer qualification, and continuous improvement across the product lifecycle.

Main Responsibilities

  • Execute technical risk assessments and New, Unique, Different, Difficult (NUDD) analyses for new package designs and design rules; document risks and support mitigation actions.
  • Develop and coordinate qualification and characterization plans for advanced package technologies, including test coverage, execution tracking, data review, and technical reporting.
  • Analyze qualification and reliability results, identify trends and failure mechanisms, and provide data-based recommendations for package technology release under guidance from senior technical leaders.
  • Support chip-package interaction, package reliability, and quality issue investigations using structured root cause analysis and contribute to effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with Technology Development, Product Engineering, Packaging, and other cross-functional teams to ensure package technologies meet quality, reliability, manufacturability, and customer requirements.
  • Work with customer-facing teams to prepare clear technical content supporting customer inquiries, qualification activities, and issue resolution.

Other Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate qualification records, risk assessments, technical reports, and lessons learned for reuse in future technology generations.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of package quality and reliability methodologies, technical knowledge sharing, and innovation activities within the assigned scope.
  • Support technical presentations and knowledge sharing with engineering stakeholders.

AI Responsibilities

  • Integrate AI-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, while exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within the scope of work.

Minimum Qualifications / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or a related field.
  • Zero to three years of relevant experience in semiconductor package design, package manufacturing, or package quality and reliability.

Must-Have Technical Skills

  • Foundational knowledge of semiconductor packaging, package design or manufacturing.
  • Working knowledge of structured root cause analysis, failure mechanism investigation, and corrective and preventive action methods.

Must-Have Soft Skills

  • Structured analytical problem-solving and attention to detail.
  • Clear technical communication and effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently on assigned tasks, and escalate risks appropriately.

Highly Desirable / Preferred

  • Exposure to advanced packaging technologies such as HBM, 2.5D/3D integration, wafer-level packaging, or chip-package interaction analysis.
  • Experience with package qualification, reliability testing, failure analysis, or statistical engineering data analysis.

Embody Micron's Core Values

  • People - Respect, develop and empower others
  • Innovation - Drive continuous improvement and breakthrough thinking
  • Tenacity - Show grit and determination
  • Collaboration - Build trust and foster teamwork
  • Customer Focus - Deliver excellence and value
  • Speed - Act with purpose and set the pace

About Micron Technology, Inc.

title: AI Value Creation Consultant
description:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media () focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Senior Program Assistant,  Neglected Tropical Diseases and Vaccine Development
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The Global Health (GH) Division harnesses advances in science and technology to save lives in low- and middle-income countries. We focus on health problems that have a major impact in developing countries but receive too little attention and funding. Where proven tools and interventions exist, we support sustainable delivery and implementation at scale. Where they do not, we invest in research and development of new interventions, including vaccines, drugs, and diagnostics. Our work spans multiple infectious disease portfolios and is supported by highly matrixed, cross-cutting teams including Vaccine Development (VDev) and Neglected Tropical Diseases (NTD). The VDev team focuses on accelerating the development and commercialization of novel vaccines and the sustainable manufacturing of existing vaccines particularly for these countries. The NTD team works across technical, operational, and regional partners to advance ambitious disease control and elimination goals for 8 of the 20 WHO-recognized neglected tropical diseases.

Application Deadline: Wednesday, November 18, 2026


Your Role

The Senior Program Assistant (SPA) is a key member of both the Neglected Tropical Diseases (NTD) and Vaccine Development (VDev) teams working closely with the Director, who leads both teams, and the team-dedicated Deputy Director Strategy, Planning & Management. The SPA acts as a trusted partner and steward of leadership time while providing comprehensive administrative support and proactive communications. In the Global Health Division, our SPAs support up to 5 principals beyond the Director with activities that vary by role such as complex meeting scheduling, international travel support, and convening planning and logistics. In addition to core administrative responsibilities, the SPA contributes meaningfully to team culture, operations, and rhythm of business processes in collaboration with Strategy, Planning & Management (SPM) and Office of the President (OoP) partners. To do this well, the SPA is expected to have a working understanding of team priorities, goals, initiatives, major deadlines, and organizational dynamics to inform scheduling and support decisions.

*This role is based in Seattle, WA and in line with the foundation’s commitment to hybrid work, requires working from the office approximately 50% of the time. Please note that relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Core Administrative Expectations

  • Provide administrative support by anticipating and managing competing priorities, proactively handling high volumes of complex emails, and coordinating workflow and rhythm of business support.
  • Exercise sound judgment about when to act independently within agreed boundaries and when to seek guidance or escalate, bringing recommendations rather than only identifying problems.
  • Represent leadership priorities in cross-team and cross-functional interactions by acting as a point of coordination and alignment with internal partners and external customers.
  • Leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and digital tools to streamline support, enhance efficiency, and continuously improve processes rather than simply maintaining them.

Calendar Management

  • Strategically manage active and complex calendar for team Director and other assigned team leaders, requiring frequent engagement with internal and external parties across multiple time zones.
  • Assess each scheduling request against the principal’s priorities, preparation needs, and competing commitments while anticipating and resolving calendar conflicts before they become problems.
  • For Director support:
    • Partner with the Director and DDSPM to shape a balanced calendar that makes room for strategic priorities, focused work, time with leaders inside and outside the organization, and the day-to-day business that keeps things moving.
    • Look ahead on the Director’s behalf, reviewing upcoming commitments, so they walk into every decision and meeting feeling prepared.
    • Offer thoughtful recommendations that help the Director weigh competing priorities and protect their time.

Director Communication & Coordination

  • Keep information flowing smoothly to and from the Director, so they always have a clear view of key updates, decisions, and follow-ups, and can set priorities and make decisions with confidence.
  • Share a short daily recap that highlights anything needing the Director’s input, with clear options and what each would mean. Spot what matters most and flag it early.
  • Partner with lead staff to plan materials and briefings for important meetings, so the Director always walks in feeling well prepared.

Team Culture & Coordination

  • Lead projects to strengthen team culture and ways of working across the NTD and VDev teams, while enabling greater consistency and standards across shared operations.
  • Coordinate and facilitate team member onboarding and offboarding in partnership with hiring managers.
  • Represent NTD and VDev teams on the space planning committee and GHET Support Team group.
  • Maintain awareness of key foundation, division-wide, and cross-team updates and initiatives, highlighting relevant information to leadership and team partners.
  • Work on team and division special projects as needed or aligned to professional development goals.

Team Events & Travel Support

  • Support team-wide and leadership meetings as assigned, which could include retreats, partner convenings, and executive presentations.
  • Manage event logistics, travel, communications, and materials in coordination with internal and external sponsors.
  • Drive readiness and follow-through for recurring leadership meetings and operating cadences, including preparing agendas and materials and tracking action items and follow-ups.
  • Complete travel-related tasks in a timely way including complex and detailed itineraries, visa applications, travel arrangements, and expense reports for Director (all travel) and Deputy Directors (international only).
  • Ensure completeness and readiness of logistical and trip briefing materials in coordination with internal and external sponsors.

Collaboration & Business Operations

  • Build trusted relationships across teams and executive offices by understanding business priorities, following through reliably, and facilitating communication between groups.
  • Proactively manage and prioritize high volumes of requests and correspondence, with timely communication and sound judgment.
  • Represent the Director with confidence, discretion, and professionalism in interactions with senior leaders and partners, including under pressure.
  • Manage highly sensitive matters with strict confidentiality and expedite issues appropriately.
  • Partner with support team and business team to improve and maintain knowledge management processes through platforms such as SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, OneNote, and AI tools. Maintain distribution lists, SharePoint sites, and MS Teams channels as assigned.
  • Contribute to improving the support community practices, processes, and tools across the division.

Your Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Experience in an administrative job supporting senior management or executives within a fast-paced, matrixed environment required.
  • Ability to prioritize effectively, use time precisely, communicate decisions and process to execution in a clear effective manner.
  • Demonstrates excellence with calendar management, international travel support, and event planning coordination.
  • Experience managing complex assignments and projects that require initiative, independent problem-solving, and resourcefulness.
  • Strong ability to balance the support needs of multiple individuals with varied work, communication, and learning styles.
  • Understanding of how to identify and anticipate leadership and team needs and opportunities and how to champion and resolve them.
  • Adept at building relationships to gain respect and trust of others; including internally and externally (e.g., grantees and high-level officials).
  • Experience adopting approach, goals, and methods to achieve solutions and results in dynamic situations, helping others deal with the ongoing demands of change.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and project management skills that reflect the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with excellent attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office suite, especially Outlook, and including Copilot, Chat GPT and other AI tools is strongly preferred.
  • Intellectually curious and actively seeks to understand team strategies, annual plans, and priorities.

**Must have unrestricted work authorization in the country where this position is located. The Foundation does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (eg: H-1B, O-1, L-1, E, OPT, STEM-OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.).


#LI-TL1

The hourly rate for this role is $36.68/hour to $51.39/hour USD. As a mission-driven organization, we strive to balance competitive pay with our mission. New hires salaries are typically between the range minimum and the salary range midpoint. Actual placement in the range will depend on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, and expertise, as evaluated during the interview process.

Hiring Requirements

As part of our standard hiring process for new employees, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Candidate Accommodations

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you have a disability or medical condition and need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process—such as an ASL interpreter, alternative interview format, or physical accessibility support—we’re happy to help. Please contact HR@gatesfoundation.org with the position number and a brief description of your accommodation needs. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Inclusion Statement

We are dedicated to the belief that all lives have equal value. We strive for a global and cultural workplace that supports ever greater diversity, equity, and inclusion — of voices, ideas, and approaches — and we support this diversity through all our employment practices.

All applicants and employees who are drawn to serve our mission will enjoy equality of opportunity and fair treatment without regard to race, color, age, religion, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, and prior protected activity.

title: Senior Java Developer - Energy Trading (h/f)
description:

The mission

Our organization trades electricity on the energy market. To meet regulatory and market requirements, they need to manage their trading positions and nominations in real time, and reallocate volumes based on current forecasts. You will finalise and evolve several Java Spring Boot applications (validation, enrichment, database ingestion, reporting), then deploy them in the organization's environment.

  • Develop and test high-volume, business-critical microservices

  • Adapt PostgreSQL processing, APIs and data exchanges between forecasting, positions and nominations

  • Deploy on Kubernetes and take part in releases through CI/CD (GitLab)

  • Write technical documentation and share your knowledge with the team

  • Work with business and IT teams in an Agile framework

  • 6+ years of Java Spring Boot development

  • Microservices: design patterns, clean code, secure development, API versioning

  • PostgreSQL

  • Kubernetes and CI/CD

  • Unit and integration testing

  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • Experience in the electricity sector, ideally in trading

  • Python (scripting, lightweight services)

  • Airflow 3, Keycloak, AWS, FastAPI, Streamlit, Dash0, UML

  • German, Romanian or Russian

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and Asia. We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses.

If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey.

The Role.

As a DevOps Engineer at Zühlke, you will join a cross-functional delivery team working on a greenfield initiative for a Hong Kong–based client, building a next-generation cloud platform powered by automation, GitOps, and cloud-native engineering practices. You will play a key role in designing and implementing a GitOps-driven operating model and an “Everything as Code” approach to enable scalable Environment-on-Demand capabilities across AWS. Working at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, and software delivery, you will help development teams accelerate delivery through self-service tooling, automated provisioning, and advanced CI/CD/CT pipelines. This role is highly hands-on and engineering-focused. You will design and implement reusable platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and contribute to scalable, secure, and observable cloud infrastructure. You will collaborate closely with

DevOps, Security, QA, Data, and Software Engineering teams to build resilient systems and continuously improve engineering practices across the delivery lifecycle. You will also contribute to platform reliability, observability, quality engineering, and operational excellence by integrating monitoring, testing, security, and compliance automation into modern cloud-native delivery workflows.


What’s Important To Us.

  • Strong experience with GitOps practices and tooling such as Argo CD, Argo Workflows, and Argo Events.
  • Hands-on expertise with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform Cloud, reusable modules, and automation frameworks.
  • Proven experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production environments, ideally using EKS, Docker, Helm, and Kustomize.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD engineering using GitHub Actions and pipeline-as-code approaches.
  • Experience developing automation and integration tooling using TypeScript, Python, Bash, or Groovy.
  • Solid AWS platform knowledge including services such as EKS, RDS Aurora PostgreSQL, MSK (Kafka), S3, Lambda, API Gateway, and VPC networking.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, CloudWatch, distributed tracing, and custom dashboards.
  • Familiarity with automated testing and quality engineering practices, including integration testing, Testcontainers, SonarQube, security scanning, and quality gates.
  • Understanding of cloud security, compliance automation, secrets management, and secure delivery practices.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with experience working in agile, cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have.

  • AWS certifications such as DevOps Engineer Professional, Solutions Architect Associate, or Security Specialty.
  • Kubernetes certifications such as CKA or CKAD.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate or GitOps-related certifications.
  • Experience within financial services, regulated industries, or high-availability environments.
  • Exposure to chaos engineering, service mesh technologies, and resilience testing frameworks such as Gremlin or Chaos Toolkit.
  • Experience building developer platforms, self-service infrastructure, or Environment-on-Demand capabilities.

What we offer.

  • Work life blend: we offer a safe & healthy workplace, with flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home
  • Profit share scheme: In addition to your annual salary, you may receive a profit share defined by the company’s success in the previous year.
  • Global and Diverse Zühlke community: witness how colleagues from all our 17 offices across the globe come together to create a unique, positive and inclusive work culture, learning from one another at annual team camps, and celebrating year-end parties and other local festivities.
  • Committed to development: we are committed to the growth of our people and are investing in your development. We’re empowering you to build the skills you need to make a positive impact, both personally and for our clients, today and in the future.

If you feel you don't meet all the requirements, we are still happy to get to know you, learn more about your ambitions and ideas and look forward to receiving your application!


We welcome people from all backgrounds, regardless of their gender, personality, national origin, race, religion, colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability or veteran status.

title: Senior Director, Team Lead, KAT6i (Prifetrastat), US Breast Cancer
location: United States - New York - New York City
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Pfizer Commercial Oncology is introducing the world to the next era of cancer care. With a growing portfolio of novel therapies, industry-leading R&D, and a goal of delivering eight breakthroughs by 2030 across major cancer types, we're translating cutting-edge science into market-shaping impact. Here, you'll partner with exceptional colleagues across scientific, medical, and manufacturing teams, backed by advanced digital and AI-enabled infrastructure and the authority to accelerate medicines from discovery to delivery. Guided by our values of courage, excellence, equity, and joy, you'll have the opportunity to stretch your skills and build a career that evolves with you—across teams, roles, and the Pfizer enterprise. Join us to make history — for patients, for their families, for the future.


Breast cancer is the most common cancer affecting women in the US, and Pfizer has led the HR+ metastatic breast cancer market for a decade with IBRANCE, our first-in-class CDK 4/6 inhibitor. We are now building the next generation of breast cancer medicines, including prifetrastat (PF-07248144), our first-in-class KAT6 inhibitor in Phase 3 for HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer after prior CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy.


The next three years are the most consequential in the history of Pfizer’s breast cancer business. As IBRANCE moves through IRA effectuation and LOE in 2027, prifetrastat is the franchise’s first opportunity to extend its leadership into the post-CDK4/6 setting, where the landscape is fragmented and no established playbook exists. This role builds the commercial foundation for prifetrastat so that customers, accounts and the field are ready when it reaches the market, and ensures its strategy connects to the first-line CDK franchise.



ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

This Senior Director, Team Lead role reports to the VP, US Breast Cancer Franchise Lead and is an excellent opportunity for an experienced, collaborative and innovative leader to build a launch from the ground up. The role owns US launch preparation for prifetrastat and leads a team of up to 3–4 marketers at the Director and Sr. Manager level, including a dedicated launch lead.


1. Build the prifetrastat launch foundation

  • Own the prifetrastat pre-launch P&L and launch budget: build the long-range forecast and investment case, manage OpEx and resource allocation through launch, and establish the financial discipline the brand will carry into its first years on the mark
  • Lead US commercial strategy in a complex shifting landscape for prifetrastat, including target product profile input, positioning, segmentation, target customers and the HCP and account launch plan.
  • Assess the market landscape with CtDNA & competitive entrants into the post-CDK 4/6 treatment paradigm
  • Shape the market ahead of approval with disease-state education on post-CDK4/6 progression and KAT6 biology, and pre-launch engagement with key customers and advocacy groups, in partnership with Medical Affairs and Patient Advocacy.
  • Turn the brand strategy into workstreams that address the launch-critical issues: differentiation in a fragmented post-CDK4/6 landscape, biomarker testing readiness, tolerability and dose-management support for clinicians and patients, and customer value.
  • Define launch-readiness milestones, evidence needs and the investment case in partnership with Clinical Development, Market Access, Commercial Insights and Sales.

2. Build access and the patient foundation

  • Partner with Market Access, Pricing and Trade to shape the prifetrastat pricing and contracting strategy, channel and distribution model, and gross-to-net plan, ensuring the launch is positioned for durable access and profitability.
  • Build the prifetrastat patient and advocacy strategy from the start, including DTC/DTP, patient support and adherence programs, with tolerability and dose management designed in for both HCPs and patients.

3. Connect the launch to the franchise

  • Map the patient journey from first-line CDK4/6 inhibitor use to post-CDK4/6 treatment so the IBRANCE, atirmociclib and prifetrastat strategies reinforce each other.
  • Align with BC Sales and KAD leadership on how prifetrastat enters annual POAs and field focus, incorporating CFC (customer facing colleague) feedback as the portfolio changes.
  • Lead the prifetrastat customer insight plan in partnership with analytics, CFCs and cross-functional partners, and use it to evolve the strategic and tactical approach and anticipate how HCPs will sequence therapy after CDK4/6 progression.
  • Drive innovation and build new approaches from the ground up where no established playbook exists, with a particular focus on AI and the go-to-market model.

4. Lead people and the franchise

  • Manage, engage and coach the team to achieve high performance and maximize team potential, and plan roles, development and succession as the team scales toward launch.
  • Actively foster a positive team culture and collaboration across the broader US BC marketing team.
  • Participate in leadership presentations, performance updates and OpEx management to maintain Pfizer’s Breast Cancer leadership for the next decade.



BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, and oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

  • Bachelor’s degree required and 12+ years of pharmaceutical industry experience required, or Master's degree and 10+ years, or Ph.D./PharmD
  • US marketing experience with focus on HCP stakeholders, including pre-launch or launch work
  • Deep understanding of US market dynamics including specialty channels, organized customers and payers
  • Demonstrated success developing, executing and measuring complex marketing programs and championing innovative solutions
  • COMMERCIAL EXCELLENCE: Proven track record of identifying customer needs and extracting and translating key insights into meaningful strategies and tactics
  • LEADERSHIP: 5+ years of direct or matrix management or coaching of marketing colleagues at all levels (Manager to Director) and commitment to fostering team engagement, team culture and developing people
  • INTERNAL AMBASSADOR: Collaborative team player with demonstrated ability to engage experts from a wide range of cross-functional areas to improve business performance and find a path forward
  • INNOVATION & AI FLUENCY: Demonstrated use of AI and advanced analytics to sharpen customer insight, targeting, forecasting and investment decisions, and a track record of championing innovative solutions that change how the team works
  • Strong analytical skills; detail and action oriented, creative, flexible, self-motivated
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for a wide range of audiences
  • Is a role model for the Pfizer Values



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Oncology, or breast cancer marketing experience
  • Experience leading patient marketing, including DTC/DTP strategy, patient support and adherence programs, and advocacy engagement, with the ability to integrate patient and HCP strategies into one customer plan
  • Experience leading a US oncology or specialty product launch, from pre-launch market shaping through commercialization
  • Experience with biomarker-driven or precision medicine launches, including diagnostic testing readiness
  • Experience designing, piloting or scaling new go-to-market models (e.g., omnichannel or AI-enabled customer engagement, hybrid field/digital coverage, account-based approaches)


Non-Standard Work Schedule, Travel or Environment Requirements

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment and making complex decisions quickly
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze complex data and understand trends and mathematical calculations
  • Ability to work on a computer for extended periods using common applications (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed for congresses, sales meetings and customer interactions
  • Pending Pfizer policies, travel is required: domestic travel of up to 25%

Position is hybrid and will require to work 2 to 3 days per week on site

- Comfortable with handling objections from busy developers.

title: Program Officer, Medical Devices (12-month LTE)
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The India Country Office (ICO) is central to the foundation’s commitment to advancing equitable health outcomes and strengthening India’s health innovation ecosystem. The Digital, Health Innovations, and Artificial Intelligence (DHAI) Cluster is a core enabler of the ICO’s key goals across our portfolio. The cluster advances R&D and innovation across foundational research; medical devices, vaccines, and drugs, as well as data-science methods (modeling, AI-enabled tools). We approach this by accelerating R&D and the deployment of affordable, high-quality, accessible devices, working with the Government of India - at central and state level, academia, industry, and global networks.

Your Role

As a Program Officer, Medical Devices you will play a crucial role in shaping and managing a portfolio of critical investments focused on advancing sensor-based, AI-enabled medical device technologies that support improved maternal, neonatal, and women’s health, including devices for respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) management, intrapartum monitoring, antenatal care innovations, as well as neonatal care device packages and algorithmic risk-stratification tools with the potential to improve public health outcomes in high-burden populations. You will collaborate with internal and external partners to drive innovative solutions ensuring medical devices are designed, validated and deployed effectively in public health programs.

You will bring expertise in medical device development, including clinical use case prioritization and validation, product specifications, sensor, AI vision and algorithm development, regulatory pathways, and market access strategies, and work closely with product development partners, global health organizations, and policymakers to ensure successful implementation of devices for maternal, neonatal, and respiratory health.

This is a 12-month limited term employment (LTE), based at the foundation’s ICO in New Delhi, reporting to the Deputy Director, Drugs, Diagnostics & Devices. Relocation will not be provided.

What You’ll Do

This is a highly collaborative role and will involve working with multiple Program Strategy Teams (PSTs) in Seattle and teams across the ICO, for new product development and scaling. In this role you will:

  • Design, structure, and manage grants and contracts for AI-enabled medical device innovation for maternal, neonatal, and women health conditions aligned with India and PST goals.
  • Identify and select partner institutions and shape scope and strategy for selected grants and contracts to meet selected strategic goals.
  • Apply milestone-based technical performance metrics and drive go/no-go decision-making.
  • Provide technical and strategic support to grantees and contractors, ensuring alignment with foundation priorities.
  • Review interim and final reports; write final evaluation and synthesize and document lessons learned across related grants and contracts.
  • Collaborate closely with foundation teams in Seattle and ICO on the medical devices for maternal, neonatal, and respiratory health.
  • Analyze opportunities based on medical device advances in maternal, neonatal, and respiratory health needs to find opportunities.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with key institutions to build ownership and collaboration to help with adoption and scaling of new/innovative products and technologies.

Your Experience

  • Bachelor’s in engineering, science or medicine or related fields is required. Master’s or PhD is preferred.
  • Minimum of five years’ experience with preference in medical device development including AI-enabled technologies, exposure in regulatory affairs, in India and/or low and middle-income countries (LMICs) contexts.
  • Deep understanding of medical device lifecycle - from concept through verification/validation, regulatory approval, and commercialization.
  • Familiarity with India’s medical devices policy ecosystem and experience working with relevant agencies (e.g. ANRF, Biodesign programs).
  • Portfolio and project management skills; ability to structure, oversee and review large-scale grants and contracts advancing medical device technologies.
  • Excellent analytical thinking and communications skills, including the ability to synthesize evidence into actionable insights, prepare high-quality briefings and analyses for leadership, and public speaking.
  • Passion for health equity, innovation, and systems change.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a highly matrixed and diverse work environment, with strong collaboration, consultative and negotiation skills.
  • Results-driven and self-motivated with ability to inspire the pursuit of excellence.

Other Attributes

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media () focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Corporate Finance Intern
description:
Overview

The Corporate Finance Intern will be supporting various Corporate Finance functions including Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Financial Reporting, Corporate Credit, and Facilities-Finance. This internship offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced corporate finance environment, working closely with experienced professionals on financial projects and initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in the development and enhancement of internal Management reporting tools and dashboards to support business insights and decision-making.
  • Support the Facilities / Real-Estate team in analyzing lease-market conditions identifying opportunities for Rent / OpEx savings
  • Support the various Finance departments with ad-hoc analyses, data gathering, and participation in special projects to gain exposure to key financial planning activities.
  • Explore opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve reporting efficiency; contribute creative ideas to encourage innovation and process improvement.

Position Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite, with strong proficiency in Excel
  • Exposure to enterprise systems such as SAP, BW (Business Warehouse), and Hyperion preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure
  • Demonstrated analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong interpersonal communication and team collaboration abilities
  • A self-starter with a proactive attitude and a strong desire to learn

About Sharp Imaging and Information Company of America (SIICA)

Sharp Imaging and Information Company of America (SIICA) is a division of Sharp Electronics Corporation, the U.S. subsidiary of Japan's Sharp Corporation, a global technology company which has been named to Fortune magazine's World's Most Admired Company List. Sharp strives to help businesses achieve Simply Smarter work by helping companies manage workflow efficiently, create immersive and engaging environments, and increase productivity. SIICA offers a full suite of secure printer and copier solutions, professional and commercial visual displays and projectors, software management and productivity software and markets durable Dynabook laptops. As a total solutions provider, Sharp has a reputation for innovation, quality, reliability, and industry-leading customer support expertise.

The listed salary range or contractual rate excludes bonuses, incentives, differential pay, and any other forms of compensation or benefits. The starting salary will be determined by several variables, including but not limited to experience, education, training, certification, and location. You may also be eligible to receive an annual discretionary incentive award, commissions, and program-specific awards, which are subject to the rules governing these programs.

Compensation Statement
$20—$20 USD

These tools are used to support, and not replace, human decision-making. We are committed to fair and equitable hiring practices, and all hiring decisions are made or reviewed by qualified personnel.

title: Centralized Director of Finance
description:
Noble House Hotels and Resorts owns, manages, or operates a portfolio of 20+ luxury, independent hotels and resorts around the country and Mexico. We were recently Voted Top 25 Best Hotel Brand in the World – Travel + Leisure World’s Best Awards. We are seeking a Centralized Director of Finance to join our Corporate Finance Team in our Kirkland, WA Offices.


OUR CULTURE | Individual Distinction, Collective Soul

The Noble House Hotels & Resorts philosophy emphasizes "location, distinction, and soul." Our properties are not a "one-size-fits-all." And neither are our team members. What makes us the Corporate Office lies within our team. We are a group of individuals who share a passion for hospitality. We let our personalities shine, and we enjoy having fun.


The JOB

The Centralized Director of Finance will provide interim financial leadership at a Corporate level by maintaining full control over accounting operations for properties; oversee month-end closing, financial reporting, and balance sheet reconciliations to ensure accuracy and compliance with company policies and USALI/GAAP; analyze hotel financial performance including P&L, cash flow, and operating metrics and present insights to property and corporate leadership; train, mentor, and support property accounting teams to ensure continuity and adherence to brand and company standards; implement and strengthen internal controls to safeguard assets and maintain audit readiness;

description:

You will work with AI-assisted development tools daily, ensure secure, scalable solutions, and collaborate closely with Data Engineers and business stakeholders to productionize prototypes.

Responsibilities include developing APIs, integrating with Azure services, and maintaining production-grade code with CI/CD, testing, and governance.

title: Supply Manager, ATSM Capital
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Are you a fresh graduate looking to start a career in procurement and supply management? We are looking for highly motivated individuals to join our global team supporting Assembly and Test (AT) manufacturing.

As an Individual Contributor in Global Procurement Supply Management, you will support the procurement of capital equipment, spares and services across our Assembly and Test sites. You will work closely with experienced Supply Managers and stakeholders to keep deliveries on track, manage day-to-day supplier interactions, and contribute to cost savings and supplier performance improvement.

You will learn and grow through structured exposure to category strategies, supplier negotiations, localization efforts and data-driven improvement projects. Over time, you will take on greater ownership of suppliers and projects.

This role works closely with Category Supplier Managers, Central Engineering, Planning/Industrial Engineering, Site Engineering, Finance, Legal and other stakeholders.


Responsibilities

  • Manage procurement process for Capital, Spares and ServicesManage the Procure to Pay (P2P) process for capital, spares and services, including purchase order follow-up, delivery date tracking, invoice reconciliation and support for cash flow and budgeting activities.Monitor and maintain on-time delivery (OTD) to meet network capacity requirements, escalating risks early.
  • Support Supplier Relationship ManagementAct as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned site/network suppliers.Build collaborative working relationships with suppliers and help resolve delivery, quality and performance issues.Ensure suppliers comply with Micron's code-of-conduct programs and corporate social responsibility initiatives.Communicate supplier updates clearly to the team and stakeholders.
  • Support localization effortsSupport the execution of service and spares localization initiatives to improve equipment uptime, response time, cost competitiveness and supply chain resilience.
  • Support supplier-related cost savingsGather and analyze data (e.g., pricing, spend, quotations) to identify cost improvement opportunities.Assist in preparing should-cost analyses and savings tracking.
  • Participate in negotiations and sourcing activitiesSupport RFQ / quotation processes and bid comparisons for local or regional sourcing events.Participate in negotiations for contract extensions and renewals alongside senior team members.Monitor contracted terms and conditions and flag deviations.
  • Support Supplier Performance ManagementTrack and report supplier performance metrics (e.g., OTD, quality, responsiveness).Relay site-specific priorities to suppliers and follow up on improvement actions.
  • AI-Enabled Continuous ImprovementContribute to automation or AI-enabled improvement projects that simplify business processes and improve productivity.Ensure compliance with company policies and departmental procedures.

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business or a related field of study.

Experience

  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
  • Internship or project exposure in procurement, supply chain or the semiconductor industry is a plus.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to summarize information for different audiences.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with SAP or data tools (e.g., Power BI) is a plus.
  • Eager to learn, proactive and detail-oriented.
  • Team player who can work independently as well as with global cross-functional teams.
  • Interest in automation, AI or data analytics to improve how work gets done is an added advantage.

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
