title: Client Services Technician - Entry
description:
Amwins Global Risks

At Amwins Global Risks, we succeed together. We’re not ‘just another London broker’ placing risks and signing contracts. We’re forging relationships that are built to last. With over 700 employees around the world and a global footprint across more than 150 countries, we’ve cemented our place as a top 10 contributor to Lloyd’s.

Insurance is a relationship-based business, and achieving success means hiring the best talent in the industry. When you join us, we will encourage and support your professional and personal development as we invest in you and your learning to help you succeed and grow.

We believe in a flat organisational structure that prizes expertise and relationships equally. We’ve built a workplace where talent, collaboration and inclusivity are valued, and our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion helps cultivate an open, welcoming workplace where everyone who works with us can be themselves.

As an Entry Technician in our Operations Team, you will provide technical processing support to the Technical Team and Broking Divisions through standard processing activities, in line with compliance, FCA and internal audit guidelines.

This is a development role. You will work within documented processes, seeking guidance and support where required, and building the knowledge and proficiency needed to complete work accurately and within agreed timeframes.

Responsibilities

  • Complete standard processing tasks in accordance with documented procedures, seeking guidance and support where required.
  • Gather information and complete standard document templates for internal and external distribution.
  • Enter, amend, update and validate data accurately on relevant systems.
  • Create and maintain accurate electronic and paper files and management information.
  • Support documentation checking, claims and premium processing, as applicable to the team.
  • Check that information is complete and accurate before progressing work.
  • Manage and prioritise allocated work, escalating when support or further knowledge is required.
  • Identify potential errors and omissions risks and escalate them promptly.
  • Respond professionally and promptly to colleagues and customers.
  • Take responsibility for own learning and apply feedback and training in the role.

Knowledge/Skills/Qualifications

  • Basic understanding of insurance and reinsurance principles, terminology and common policy terms.
  • Awareness of the team’s classes of business and coverage.
  • Ability to follow documented processes and procedures accurately.
  • Ability to identify key information and solve routine problems with guidance.
  • Good attention to detail, organisation, communication, customer service and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to use relevant business systems and everyday technology, including Microsoft Excel and Power BI reports.

Amwins Global Risks is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Inpatient Coding Quality Reviewer
description:
At R1, we’re transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers.

All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We’re a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.

R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration.

As our Inpatient Coding Quality Reviewer, you will help the Coding Quality department review inpatient coded cases for coding completeness and accuracy. Every day you will identify potential coding and DRG errors, research appropriate guidelines to support recommended changes, and communicates the changes to the coder involved on a timely basis. The Reviewer provides expert coding advice to coding staff and relays needed coding educational topics to the Regional Manager, IP Coding Quality. To thrive in this role, you must conduct daily pre-bill review of cases flagged by the PwC SMART coding quality monitoring software tool, maintain required productivity standards and high-quality results.

Here’s what you will experience working as an Inpatient Coding Quality Reviewer:

  • Audits records as defined in the coding quality review plan.
  • Review cases flagged by the coding quality software daily for multiple hospitals, including validating the completeness of documentation, identifying diagnoses and procedures that have been missed, proposing physician queries, and ensuring the accuracy of diagnoses, procedures, POA, discharge disposition and DRG assignment.
  • Follows, and maintains up-to-date knowledge of, industry coding and documentation guidelines.
  • Communicates audit findings with coders in a timely manner and supports the teams in effectively and efficiently addressing and resolving local coding issues.
  • Maintains both a high productivity rate and a high accuracy rate in accordance with established auditing standards.
  • Serves as an inpatient coding expert & resource for the coding teams and other departments.
  • Work with the hospital’s CDI team to address and resolve documentation issues. Assists with compilation, generation, and analysis of data for results reporting and performance Improvement initiatives.
  • Assists with training of new auditors. Assists with other audits and duties as requested.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's or Associates Degree or CCS credential is required.
  • A minimum of seven (7) years of hospital inpatient coding experience is required.
  • Extensive knowledge of ICD-10-CM/PCS classification system and MS- DRG and APR-DRG methodologies is required.
  • In-depth knowledge of medical terminology, human anatomy/physiology, pharmacology, and pathology is required.
  • Expert and up-to-date knowledge of industry Official Coding and Reporting Guidelines along with CMS and other agency directives for ICD-10 coding.
  • Must have proficient MS Office computer skills, specifically in Excel and knowledge of various coding software/platforms and EMRs.
  • Must be detail-oriented and can work independently and maintain a high productivity rate and coding accuracy rate.
  • Ability to interact with other employees through effective communication.
For this US-based position, the base pay range is $28.24 - $40.21 per hour . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The healthcare system is always evolving — and it’s up to us to use our shared expertise to find new solutions that can keep up. On our growing team you’ll find the opportunity to constantly learn, collaborate across groups and explore new paths for your career.


Our associates are given the chance to contribute, think boldly and create meaningful work that makes a difference in the communities we serve around the world. We go beyond expectations in everything we do. Not only does that drive customer success and improve patient care, but that same enthusiasm is applied to giving back to the community and taking care of our team — including offering a competitive benefits package.

title: Senior AI Engineer (2 year LTE)
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The Team
Within Business Operations and the IT organization, the Enterprise Data Solutions (EDS) team designs and delivers enterprise-scale platforms and services across Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Infrastructure, and Health Data Platforms.

The EDS team’s mission is to empower the Foundation with reliable, innovative, and data-driven solutions that enable timely, informed decision-making and support critical operational workflows.
Central to this mission is the development of an AI-powered intelligent data and AI platform that enables employees to discover and interact with connected knowledge through conversational experiences. The Knowledge Mgmt & Insights (KMI) is an AI-first team and leverages technologies such as large language models (LLMs), knowledge graphs, and modern data platforms to deliver scalable, impactful enterprise-wide AI solutions.


*This position is a limited-term position for 24 months and located in our Seattle, Washington office. This is a hybrid role with a requirement of 50% in office.

Your Role

As a Senior AI Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor responsible for designing, building, and deploying AI solutions that support foundation and affiliate staff around the world. You bring strong technical expertise and a hands-on approach to developing scalable, secure, and reliable AI systems that address real organizational needs.

You translate defined problem statements into effective technical solutions, partnering closely with the team and contributing directly to implementation and delivery. In this role, you play a key part in executing AI initiatives—designing solutions, integrating systems, and ensuring solutions are production-ready and aligned with engineering best practices.

You collaborate with Lead Engineers and cross-functional partners to deliver high-impact AI capabilities, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve performance, usability, and scalability. You contribute to code quality, documentation, and shared standards, helping strengthen the team’s engineering discipline.

You also support other engineers through knowledge sharing and collaboration, while continuing to grow your own expertise in AI technologies and approaches. Your work enables innovative access to knowledge assets at the foundation, helping drive better decision-making and streamline workflows to advance the organization’s mission globally.

What You’ll Do

Your work will include:

  • Develop and implement agentic AI systems, including multi-step workflows, tool use, and autonomous task orchestration using LLM-based frameworks

  • Design, build, and deploy scalable AI/ML solutions using Python and cloud-native services in Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure Foundry, Azure AI Search)

  • Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows through APIs, microservices, and Azure-based architecture

  • Translate business and technical requirements into robust, production-ready solutions, balancing performance, scalability, and maintainability

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver AI solutions aligned to requirements

  • Contribute to solution design and architecture discussions, including tooling and implementation trade-offs

  • Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot) to improve development efficiency while maintaining strong code quality

  • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable and secure deployments

  • Deploy, monitor, and optimize AI solutions in Azure, addressing performance, cost and reliability

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across development and production environments

  • Contribute to reusable components, shared frameworks and engineering standards for AI development across the team

  • Support data preparation, prompt engineering, and evaluation processes to improve model performance and outcomes

  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies and proactively identify opportunities to apply them to enhance solutions where relevant

Your Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; typically requires an advanced degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a commitment to operational excellence, continuous learning, and raising the bar on engineering practices

  • Strong programming skills in Python

  • Hands-on experience with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex or other AI-assisted coding tools

  • Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art LLMs, agentic systems, and RAG architecture, graph technologies and practical knowledge of embeddings, tokenization, evaluation, observability, and frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex.

  • Experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining ML/LLM systems in production.

  • Deep understanding of data privacy, security, and compliance considerations when building AI-powered systems.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage immediate and extended team, build consensus, and move work forward in ambiguous or rapidly evolving environments.

  • 3+ years of professional experience with cloud technologies preferably Azure

  • Proven ability to prototype, iterate, and productionize innovative AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

  • Knowledge of ethics in AI and responsible AI development.

  • Experience with agile development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to travel as needed.

  • Ability to participate in on-call duties

  • Must be able to work effectively across geographic and cultural boundaries.

  • Commitment to the foundation’s mission and values, including diversity, equity, and inclusion.

*Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship. The Foundation does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (eg: H-1B, O-1, L-1, E, OPT, STEM-OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.).

The salary range for this role is $157,400 to $236,000 USD. We recognize high-wage market differences in Seattle and Washington D.C., where our offices are located. The range for this role in these locations is $173,100 to $259,700 USD. As a mission-driven organization, we strive to balance competitive pay with our mission. New hires salaries are typically between the range minimum and the salary range midpoint. Actual placement in the range will depend on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, and expertise, as evaluated during the interview process.

Hiring Requirements

As part of our standard hiring process for new employees, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Candidate Accommodations

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you have a disability or medical condition and need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process—such as an ASL interpreter, alternative interview format, or physical accessibility support—we’re happy to help. Please contact HR@gatesfoundation.org with the position number and a brief description of your accommodation needs. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Inclusion Statement

We are dedicated to the belief that all lives have equal value. We strive for a global and cultural workplace that supports ever greater diversity, equity, and inclusion — of voices, ideas, and approaches — and we support this diversity through all our employment practices.

All applicants and employees who are drawn to serve our mission will enjoy equality of opportunity and fair treatment without regard to race, color, age, religion, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, and prior protected activity.

title: Integrated Insights & Strategy Undergraduate
description:
Pfizer UK Undergraduate Programme 2027/2028

Integrated Insights & Strategy Undergraduate, UK

IIS Job Description - UK Marketing Company


Who can apply?

Applicants must be completing a placement as part of a degree course at a UK University, either through Year in Industry/Industrial Placement or Gap Year.


Please note that we will only consider candidates who have applied by completing the Pfizer Placement Application Form. Candidates who do not complete and attach the application form will NOT be considered.


You can download the Word version of the Application Form here: Undergraduate Vacancies | Pfizer UK and find instructions as to how to complete your application and more about eligibility criteria.


To learn more about this exciting opportunity, please see below!!


Department Overview

· At Pfizer UK, the Integrated Insights & Strategy (IIS) team is the engine behind data-driven decision-making. We believe everything starts with “why” – why patients need better outcomes, why prescribers make certain choices, and why brands succeed.

· Our mission is to transform data into actionable insights that shape strategy across the UK business. We partner with marketing and medical teams to interpret complex datasets, track performance, and uncover opportunities that improve patient care and business impact.

· Joining IIS means working at the heart of the business, gaining visibility across multiple brands, campaigns, and therapeutic areas. You’ll be part of a team that values curiosity, agility, and inclusivity—where speaking up and sharing ideas is encouraged. If you’re passionate about making a positive impact on patients’ lives and excited by the challenge of turning numbers into narratives, this is the role for you.

What can I achieve and what will I be accountable for whilst completing a placement at Pfizer?

Pfizer provides you with the opportunity to work with experts and seasoned professionals across the pharmaceutical industry. Pfizer is a global leading biopharmaceutical organization which has a wealth of opportunities available across a variety of departments.

As an IIS Undergraduate, you’ll work alongside experts in analytics, strategy, and market research within one of the world’s leading biopharmaceutical companies. You’ll:

· Drive strategic decisions by supporting competitive intelligence and market analysis.

· Manipulate and interpret data from multiple sources (e.g., MIDAS) to uncover trends.

· Refresh and maintain Tableau dashboards to track brand performance.

· Support primary and secondary market research to inform brand strategies.

· Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, medical, and global IIS teams.

This placement will strengthen your skills in:

· Communication – liaising with stakeholders across the business.

· Multi-tasking – managing diverse projects simultaneously.

· Leadership – owning key deliverables and influencing decisions.

You’ll leave with a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, strategic analytics, and the role insights play in shaping healthcare outcomes.

What other opportunities and benefits do Pfizer offer?

As part of UK IIS team you will have several opportunities of growth. Business travels would be something occasionally needed; however, you will be able to:

· Exposure to multiple brands and therapeutic areas.

· Training on Target Product Profiles to understand the science behind our portfolio.

· Participation in global IIS soft-skill development programmes.

· Attendance at management meetings and networking opportunities.

· Occasional business travel and cross-functional project involvement.

When can I start?

Placements will start on 1st September 2027 and will run for 12 months.


PERSON SPECIFICATION

Type of person we are looking for, in relation to ‘Skills’, ‘Knowledge’ and ‘Motivation’:

Skills:

  • Flexibility – adapt to changing business priorities.
  • Accuracy – ensure data integrity and precision.
  • Accountability – take ownership of projects.

Knowledge:

  • Excel (advanced preferred)
  • PowerPoint (for impactful presentations)
  • AI Literate
  • Basic statistics/regression analysis

Motivation:

  • Self-driven with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Curious and eager to ask the right questions.
  • Passionate about improving patient outcomes.

Who can apply?

Applicants must be completing placement as part of a degree course at a UK University, either through Year in Industry/Industrial Placement or Gap Year.

title: Growth Analytics Associate
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

Customer & Dealer Consulting

Engage with dealers, account teams, and customers to understand fleet-management challenges and business priorities.

Position FMC capabilities against customer needs, including uptime, condition monitoring, productivity, and operational performance.

Lead discovery workshops and translate customer requirements into an appropriate FMC solution.

Build strong relationships with dealer and customer leadership.

FMC Opportunity Development

Develop and maintain the regional FMC opportunity pipeline.

Identify customers and fleets suitable for FMC adoption.

Support business-case and value-proposition development.

Coordinate with commercial and account teams to move opportunities from lead → opportunity → pilot → contract → production.

Drive conversion of successful pilots into scalable commercial deployments.

Contracting & Commercial Deployment

Coordinate the activities necessary to establish FMC agreements accurately.

Ensure alignment on service scope, fleet population, customer expectations, dealer responsibilities, KPIs, and governance.

Work across commercial, dealer, account-management, and FMC teams to resolve deployment barriers.

This reflects the established expectation that the Deployment Manager helps convert opportunities into active contracts and ensures contracts are correctly established and successfully launched.

Customer Onboarding & Deployment

Develop and execute customer onboarding and deployment plans.

Coordinate machine and asset enrolment into FMC.

Establish customer/dealer contacts, communication channels, escalation paths, and operating routines.

Confirm operational readiness before transitioning customers into steady-state FMC operations.

Ensure a smooth handoff to the FMC delivery team.

Stakeholder Integration

Act as the primary coordination point across: Customer, Caterpillar dealer, Caterpillar account team, FMC operations, Product and Service teams and Digital/technology teams, as required.

The existing internal role definition specifically positions the Deployment Manager as the integration point across customers, dealers, Caterpillar account teams, and FMC delivery.

Governance & Customer Success

Establish governance with customers and dealers after deployment.

Conduct periodic reviews of service performance and customer outcomes.

Track adoption, engagement, recommendation effectiveness, and deployment performance.

Identify gaps and coordinate corrective actions.

Support FMC operations in maintaining consistent service quality.

Identify expansion opportunities within existing customers and fleets.

Bachelor’s degree.

Advanced English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Previous experience with technology or machine sales in industry companies similar to Caterpillar.

title: Team Lead of Process Design
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

In this position, you’ll become part of our Global Vinted Team and will be in a position to lead and develop one of the Process Design teams (based in Vilnius).

The Process Design team is responsible for developing and continuously improving processes in alignment with our policies, ensuring fairness, consistency, and accuracy in how we serve our members.

We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to lead and develop our Process Design team, build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and drive collaboration across the organisation. The ideal candidate is passionate about building and improving effective processes, ensuring alignment with business needs and policies, while guiding the team, sharing knowledge, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

As Process Design Team Lead, you'll be directly responsible for the growth and development of your team of process specialists. We're looking for someone to help achieve our ultimate goal of making Vinted's community feel safe and well taken care of by making sure the processes behind Trust & Safety Operations are clear, compliant and built to scale.

In this position, you’ll

  • Set the direction for the Process Design team, turning business, operational and policy priorities into clear objectives and ways of working
  • Lead, develop and support your team, setting clear expectations and providing constructive feedback
  • Monitor team delivery and quality, identify risks or underperformance early and take action to improve outcomes
  • Provide direction on complex, high-impact process design and change, stepping in personally where needed
  • Ensure process changes have documentation, enablement and adoption in place before go-live
  • Make sure process changes reflect current policy and compliance requirements
  • Build strong relationships with Operations, Policy, Training, Quality and other teams, and report on process performance, risks and change impact
  • Forecast team capacity against demand and balance workload across specialists
  • Contribute to shaping the wider process strategy

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Access to all the tools & tech needed for work
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Private health insurance
  • Pension plan with flexible contribution options and a matching contribution from Vinted
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • A dog-friendly office
  • In Vilnius office: gym & in-house meals at friendly prices
  • In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast

Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The gross monthly salary range for this position is:
€2.550—€3.450 EUR

title: FullStack Engineer (UI/UX)
description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer (with UI/UX expertise) to help build and evolve the web applications and supporting services our teams and audiences rely on every day. You’ll work across the stack, from modern React front ends to the APIs and services behind them, and you’ll be a strong contributor to how we structure, ship, and scale user-facing software. We build with micro-frontends so that teams can deliver independently without sacrificing a cohesive experience, and we embrace agentic software development, using AI agents as real collaborators in design, implementation, testing, and review. You’ll take product requirements and technical briefs and turn them into well-structured, well-tested features, working closely with product, design, architecture, and platform partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate full stack features, from React UIs through to the backend APIs and services that support them.
  • Develop and evolve micro-frontend architectures, including module boundaries, shared component libraries, versioning, and runtime integration across independently deployed applications.
  • Use agentic development methods in day-to-day work: directing AI coding agents, writing effective specs and prompts, reviewing and validating agent-generated code, and building guardrails (tests, linting, CI checks) that keep agent output reliable.
  • Set and uphold standards for code quality, testing, accessibility, performance, and observability across the front end and back end.
  • Contribute to technical design for meaningful features and help break epics into actionable, well-scoped stories alongside the team lead.
  • Share what works in agent-assisted workflows, and help teammates build effective habits and practices.
  • Modernize legacy front ends and monolithic UIs into scalable, maintainable, componentized applications.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and platform teams to deliver cohesive user experiences.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined source control and code review practices.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building production web applications.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, including state management, hooks, performance optimization, and component design.
  • Practical experience with micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Module Federation, single-spa, or equivalent approaches), including managing shared dependencies, design systems, and cross-team integration.
  • Solid backend experience building RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs in a language such as Node.js, C#/.NET, or similar, with a working understanding of databases and data modeling.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic or AI-assisted software development, and good judgment about when to trust, verify, and correct agent output.
  • Strong grasp of web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, accessibility, browser performance, and security basics (authentication, authorization, XSS/CSRF).
  • Strong testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and a genuine concern for code structure and maintainability.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-hosted applications in AWS, Azure, or similar environments.
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
  • Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach, including a willingness to mentor and learn from teammates.
  • Exposure to Docker, monorepo tooling, or design-system development is a plus.
  • Media, streaming, or high-traffic consumer web experience is a plus.
Pay Range
$100,000—$130,000 USD

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background. Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.

title: AI Workflow Specialist
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Python Developer/Specialist
description:
The Python Developer/Specialist sits within the IT Development team and is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining Python-based tooling, scripts, and integrations that underpin the majority of SOCAR Trading’s AI and data-driven deliverables. The role works closely with the business and the Data Engineer to turn python developments and data pipelines into robust, production-grade code, ensuring solutions move safely from prototype to reliable operational tooling. The role embraces AI-assisted development as a daily way of working, using tools such as Claude and Claude Code while remaining accountable for the quality and security of everything delivered.

MAIN TASKS

These tasks ensure AI and data initiatives across SOCAR Trading are underpinned by reliable, maintainable, production-grade tooling.

Python Development & Tooling:
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain Python-based applications, scripts, and integrations supporting AI, automation, and data workflows.
  • Build and maintain APIs and connectors linking AI solutions, data pipelines, and business systems (Dynamics 365 F&O, ION TriplePoint, Azure services).
  • Harden prototype solutions developed by non-specialists into production-ready, efficient and maintainable code.
  • Apply software engineering best practices: version control (Git), automated testing, CI/CD, and code review via Azure DevOps.
  • Analyze business requirements with stakeholders and translate them into secure, scalable solutions.
AI-Assisted Development:
  • Use AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code daily to accelerate development, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation.
  • Review, test, and validate code for quality, security, and data governance before production.
  • Craft effective prompts and share AI best practices with the IT Development team.
Support & Maintenance:
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting support for Python-based tools already in production.
  • Optimize existing scripts and tooling for performance, reliability, and security.
  • Document code, architecture, and deployment processes for maintainability.
Collaboration:
  • Work with the Data Engineer to ensure Python tooling correctly consumes and processes data from governed pipelines.
  • Support the Applied AI Specialist in integrating AI models and APIs (e.g., Azure AI Foundry) into business tooling.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and delivery tracking within Azure DevOps.
Qualifications & Competencies required Education & Certification:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
  • Certifications (Desirable): Python-related certifications; Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate.
Previous Experience:
  • Professional Experience:3 to 5 years of professional Python development experience.
  • Delivery Track Record: Hands-on experience delivering and supporting Python applications in production as well as scripts or APIs.
Industry Experience:
  • Experience in trading, energy, or financial services and exposure to ERP/ETRM integrations are advantages, not mandatory.
Technical Expertise:
  • Strong Python development skills (core language and common libraries for data handling and automation, e.g. pandas, requests).
  • API development/integration (REST) and SQL databases (SQL Server, T-SQL or equivalent).
  • Git, automated and unit testing, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps).
  • Working knowledge of Azure services (Functions, App Services) is an advantage.
AI Tooling:
  • Daily, hands-on use of AI coding assistants (Claude, Claude Code or equivalent).
  • Sound judgment on the security, privacy, and quality of AI-generated output.
Preferred Competencies:
  • React or any other modern JavaScript framework; Agile experience.
IT skills:
  • Python (data handling and automation libraries), Fast API/Flask/Django, REST APIs, SQL Server/T-SQL.
  • Backend frameworks: Fast API, Flask, or Django; REST APIs.
  • AI-assisted development: daily use of Claude and Claude Code (or equivalent); prompt engineering; LLM API integration.
Soft Skills:
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Reliable, quality-focused, and detail-oriented in coding practices.
  • Adaptable and quick to learn new tools and frameworks, including AI tools.
  • Adapts quickly to evolving business priorities and supports users on daily requests.
  • Strong communication; able to translate business needs into technical solutions.

title: Solutions Architect, Implementation
description:
A little bit about us:

Microblink is the Identity Intelligence OS that establishes Know Your Actor: control over people and agents, how risk is assessed, and how decisions are made across digital journeys. Built for an adversarial AI era, Microblink replaces static verification with continuous identity control. As the only solution spanning IDs, biometrics, and payment cards, Microblink delivers a real-time command center where signals, policies, and decisioning can be calibrated with granular precision. Companies use Microblink to adapt faster than fraud, optimize outcomes over time, and enforce trust at scale across onboarding, authentication, and every moment in between. In 2025, Microblink processed 2.9 billion identities across 195+ countries. Our proprietary Fraud Lab generates 100,000+ images monthly for training and testing models, achieving 100% deepfake detection in DHS-powered testing.

Interested in learning more? Explore our tech in action.

Here is why this role matters to us:

We're looking for a Solutions Architect, Implementation to bridge the gap between our technology and our customers' real-world needs. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, working closely with engineering teams, and taking ownership of implementations from initial architecture to successful production launch.

If you're equally comfortable discussing technical architecture with stakeholders and rolling up your sleeves to troubleshoot an API integration, we'd love to meet you.

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Own Post-Sales Technical Architecture & Implementation: Serve as the technical DRI and architect for enterprise implementations, designing end-to-end integration workflows, API schemas, and client-side architectures, and Cloud and self-hosted platforms.
  • Drive Hands-on Technical Execution & Delivery: Lead white-glove technical onboarding and launch by supporting integration code review, troubleshooting, and conducting configuration tuning prior to production rollout.
  • Troubleshoot & Unblock Complex Technical Roadblocks: Act as the primary escalation contact for post-sale technical roadblocks - debugging API integrations, analyzing network/server logs, isolating custom code vs. product environment issues, and optimizing SDK/container performance.
  • Partner Cross-Functionally on Customer Programs: Collaborate closely with Technical Project Managers to ensure smooth customer onboarding, technical risk mitigation, timely go-lives, and seamless transitions through hypercare.
  • Advocate for Customer Engineering & Product Supportability: Translate post-sales customer feedback, edge-case requirements, and implementation pain points into actionable technical requirements for Product and Engineering to improve product supportability and SDK/API features.
  • Build Architecture Assets & Developer Resources: Create reusable technical documentation, standard reference architectures, and sample code that streamline deployment cycles and elevate self-service onboarding.

You'll be successful in this role if you:

  • Have 5–8+ years of experience in SaaS enterprise technical roles, specifically as a Post-Sales Solutions Architect, Implementation Engineer, Technical Consultant, or Senior Solutions Engineer handling complex client integrations.
  • Possess strong hands-on technical capabilities with working knowledge of APIs (REST/JSON), Web development (JS, HTML/CSS), Mobile platforms (iOS/Swift, Android/Kotlin/Java), and backend/cloud integrations (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).
  • Demonstrate a "builder" mindset - comfortable diving into code and debugging integration logs in developer tools (Postman, Xcode, Android Studio) to prove technical feasibility to client engineering teams.
  • Are a confident, articulate communicator who easily engages with both client developer teams and executive business stakeholders to explain technical trade-offs, architecture decisions, and implementation timelines.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments where you comfortably navigate ambiguity, balance multiple simultaneous customer implementations, and build scalable deployment frameworks from scratch.
  • Are action-oriented and deeply customer-obsessed, with a passion for solving complex technical puzzles and driving reliable production rollouts.
  • Bonus: You bring hands-on experience with Identity Verification (IDV), IAM, biometrics, fraud detection, cybersecurity, or working with highly regulated enterprise clients.

Here’s what you’ll gain if you join us:

  • Become part of a global B2B SaaS identity company where your contributions truly make an impact, a high-performing, people-first culture that values growth, fosters learning, and rewards success.
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements - work remotely, hybrid, or from one of our offices, depending on your preference and location.
  • Unlimited PTO to support work-life balance.
  • Equity.

How can you join us?

If this role intrigues you, do not hesitate to hit the apply button and send us your resume. We are excited to meet talented people even if you don’t feel that you match 100% of the requirements.

So don’t let that discourage you, get in touch with us and we promise to get back to you.

Microblink LLC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, from hiring to the end of your business relationship with us. Accordingly, this job advertisement is equally applicable to all people and Microblink will make a hiring decision based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We prohibit discrimination of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws, as well as our internal policies and culture.

For detailed information on how we process personal data, please read our Privacy Policy or reach out to our Data Protection Officer at privacy@microblink.com.

This Deputy Program Manager (PM) role will manage both of these contracts and lead customer and key stakeholder interaction. In addition, the Deputy PM role will lead with local business development initiatives in support of the broader Cubic Ground Training product portfolio. The role is office-based and located in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Manages programs in accordance with contracts and policies, procedures and department instructions.
  • Ensures that contracts are met in the most efficient and profitable manner.
  • Serves as key contact for program-specific customers and supports new business acquisition with the regional Director to implement UAE and Regional business growth strategy.

title: AI Value Creation Consultant
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: AI/ML/DevOps Engineer
description:
Own the MLOps platform that powers enterprise AI at scale.

A leading Abu Dhabi-based holding group is hiring an AI/ML/DevOps Engineer to architect, operate, and continuously improve the end-to-end MLOps and LLMOps platform for a flagship enterprise AI programme. You'll be the technical authority reviewing, governing, and signing off CI/CD, data and model pipelines, infrastructure, deployment, security, and observability — ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant delivery across environments. Reports to the AI Product Manager within the AI Excellence Centre.

What you'll own:

Architect, review, and approve CI/CD for ML and LLM systems: code, data, prompt, and model artifact versioning; build and release pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions); automated unit, integration, and contract testing; and promotion/rollback (blue-green / canary) across dev, test, and production.

Define and govern AI platform foundations on Azure: IaC (Bicep/Terraform), AML workspaces, AKS GPU node pools and scheduling, private networking (VNet integration / Private Link), identity (Managed Identities / PIM), secrets (Key Vault), and encryption and data residency controls.

Review and approve production deployment patterns for model and LLM serving (AKS / KServe / AML online endpoints), including containerization, inference optimization (batching, quantization where applicable), API management, autoscaling, resiliency, and RAG runtime components (vector store, retriever, re-ranker, cache).

Own observability and reliability for AI services: OpenTelemetry tracing, prompt and inference logs (with PII controls), latency/throughput/cost metrics, SLOs/SLIs, model performance monitoring, data and model drift detection, and LLM evaluations (quality, hallucination checks, toxicity and safety guardrails) with incident playbooks.

Establish and enforce MLOps/LLMOps governance: dataset lineage, data quality validation (schema and tests), feature store and model registry standards, artifact provenance (SBOM/SLSA), vulnerability scanning, approval gates for model and prompt releases, and compliance-aligned documentation for model risk (intended use, limitations, evaluation results).

Enable delivery squads — including the primary delivery partner — with \"golden path\" templates (AML pipelines, RAG blueprints, evaluation harnesses), reusable IaC modules, and coding standards; run deep technical design and architecture reviews and sign off production readiness (capacity, security, observability, DR) for all AI releases.

Support the Run & Operate model by enabling issue triage and minor enhancement workflows (ticket intake → fix → controlled release), ensuring changes follow the same release governance and quality gates.

Own the Operational Acceptance Gate: no production release without runbooks, monitoring dashboards, incident playbooks, access model, and DR test evidence.

Scope clarity: you provide platform standards, review, and sign-off — you do not replace the delivery partner's engineering, but you enforce the \"golden path\" and production readiness bar.

What you bring:

8–10 years across DevOps, SRE, and/or ML Engineering with production systems on Azure.

Hands‑on experience with Azure ML, AKS, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, IaC, and containerization.

Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Core skills required:

Python, YAML, Docker, Helm, KQL; GitOps (Argo/Flux) awareness.

Security in CI/CD: SAST/DAST, supply-chain security (Sigstore), secrets management (Key Vault).

Performance testing (k6 / JMeter), contract testing, and E2E testing.

Cost optimization and capacity planning for GPU and CPU workloads.

Strong grasp of model serving, inference optimization, and observability tooling.

Required certification: Preferred certifications:

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator (AZ-104) or Solutions Architect (AZ-305)

Employment Type: Permanent,Full-timeExperience: 8–10 years

Salary Range: 25,000 - 33,000 (AED per month)

title: Cyber Defense Operations & Enablement Lead
location: Boise, Idaho, United States of America
description:

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Cyber Defense Operations & Enablement Lead supports the effectiveness, efficiency, and execution of the Cyber Defense organization.
This role partners across Cyber Defense capabilities to improve operational processes, coordinate cross-functional initiatives, drive remediation activities, support vendor management, enable AI and automation initiatives, improve performance visibility, and ensure organizational commitments are effectively accomplished.


The position serves as a force multiplier for Cyber Defense leadership and individual capability leads by taking ownership of cross-functional coordination, operational follow-through, process improvement, and business operations activities that span multiple teams.


A key focus of the role will be helping Cyber Defense scale through AI, automation, and process modernization, while ensuring the organization can clearly demonstrate and communicate measurable outcomes, innovation, and business value to senior leadership.


The role does not own technical security decisions or replace functional leadership. Instead, it helps Cyber Defense teams operate more efficiently, scale effectively, and convert identified risks, strategic priorities, and improvement opportunities into measurable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Cyber Defense Operational Enablement: Partner with Cyber Defense capability leaders to identify and eliminate inefficient, manual, or duplicative processes. Develop repeatable workflows, operating procedures, tracking mechanisms, and effective cross-functional handoffs. Support individual Cyber Defense towers with planning, coordination, metrics, reporting, and operational execution. Identify operational dependencies, risks, and barriers to execution and drive actions to resolution. Maintain action, dependency, risk, and issue tracking across major Cyber Defense initiatives. Drive organizational commitments to closure and escalate significant blockers as appropriate.
  • AI, Automation & Cyber Defense Transformation: Support the execution of AI and automation initiatives across Security Operations and the broader Cyber Defense organization. Partner with functional leaders, analysts, engineers, and AI/automation resources to identify high-value opportunities for AI-assisted workflows and process automation. Help translate operational challenges and use cases into defined AI and automation initiatives with measurable outcomes. Coordinate AI enablement projects from use-case identification through implementation, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement. Establish mechanisms for measuring the impact of AI and automation, including improvements in analyst capacity, cycle time, scalability, consistency, and operational effectiveness. Identify successful AI-enabled capabilities and help expand proven approaches across additional Cyber Defense functions. Maintain insight into Cyber Defense AI initiatives, outcomes, lessons learned, and future opportunities.
  • AI Success Storytelling & Visibility: Capture and communicate Cyber Defense AI, automation, and transformation success stories. Translate technical achievements into concise business outcomes demonstrating improvements in efficiency, risk reduction, operational effectiveness, and workforce enablement. Develop leadership-level updates, metrics, and narratives highlighting Cyber Defense innovation and transformation progress. Partner with Cyber Defense leadership to maintain visibility of key innovations and accomplishments with senior cybersecurity and technology leadership. Create repeatable mechanisms for capturing measurable outcomes and demonstrating the value produced by Cyber Defense investments.
  • Vulnerability & Penetration Test Remediation: Coordinate remediation activities resulting from penetration testing, Red Team engagements, vulnerability assessments, and other security testing. Partner with Cyber Risk, technology teams, asset owners, and Cyber Defense SMEs to establish appropriate ownership and remediation plans. Track remediation progress, aging, exceptions, dependencies, and barriers to completion. Facilitate escalation of significant overdue or blocked remediation activities. Improve the end-to-end process for moving findings from identification → ownership → remediation → validation → closure. Provide leadership transparency into remediation progress, significant risks, and systemic trends. Find opportunities to automate remediation tracking, coordination, and reporting.
  • Vendor & Business Operations: Support operational management of Cyber Defense vendors, technologies, services, contracts, and renewals. Coordinate vendor performance reviews and track deliverables, issues, improvement commitments, and dependencies. Support Cyber Defense leadership with renewal planning, vendor evaluations, business justification, and investment decisions. Coordinate with Procurement, Finance, Legal, Cyber Risk, and other partner organizations as appropriate. Maintain awareness of major Cyber Defense vendor and technology investments. Identify capability overlap, inefficient spend, underutilized services, and potential consolidation opportunities. Reduce the administrative burden of vendor management on technical Cyber Defense leaders.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Coordinate initiatives requiring participation from multiple Cyber Defense capabilities and partner organizations. Establish clear owners, achievements, dependencies, completion criteria, and measures of success. Facilitate coordination between Cyber Defense, Cyber Risk, IT, infrastructure, application, and business stakeholders. Drive follow-through on commitments resulting from operational reviews, assessments, incidents, penetration tests, leadership decisions, and pivotal initiatives. Identify systemic obstacles to execution and facilitate appropriate handling and resolution of critical issues. Help Cyber Defense leadership maintain visibility across significant organizational priorities and commitments.
  • Metrics, Reporting & Operational Visibility: Partner with Cyber Defense leaders to establish meaningful measures of operational effectiveness. Consolidate operational metrics into leadership-level reporting and organizational scorecards. Track trends across operational performance, remediation, transformation, AI adoption, vendor activity, and significant Cyber Defense initiatives. Look for opportunities to automate metrics collection, analysis, visualization, and reporting. Translate Cyber Defense activities and technical accomplishments into measurable risk, operational, and business outcomes. Support recurring Cyber Defense leadership updates and reviews.
  • Continuous Improvement: Maintain a Cyber Defense continuous-improvement backlog informed by operational friction, performance trends, incidents, exercises, assessments, and team feedback. Identify processes suitable for simplification, standardization, automation, or elimination. Work with Cyber Defense teams to redesign inefficient processes before automating them. Establish measurable outcomes for improvement initiatives. Promote adoption of successful practices across Cyber Defense while accommodating the operational requirements of individual capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, with 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology operations, program management, operational strategy, risk management, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex initiatives across multiple technical and business functions, improving organizational processes, and driving multi-functional initiatives through completion.
  • Experience developing operational metrics, dashboards, reporting, and performance measures to support organizational effectiveness and decision-making.
  • Demonstrable ability to partner effectively with technical subject-matter experts and collaborators without direct authority, while managing competing priorities and driving actions to completion.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and operational information into clear, concise, actionable communications for leadership.

  • Experience coordinating vulnerability and penetration-testing remediation and managing or supporting cybersecurity technology vendors and service providers.

title: Senior SCADA Software Engineer
description:
Notre client dans le secteur Énergie et ressources naturelles recherche un/une Senior SCADA Software Engineer H/F

Description de la mission :

Context

Join a collaborative development team responsible for a real-time SCADA system used by dispatchers to keep a power perimeter balanced across Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands. The team aims to extend the system’s geographical scope and integrate an increasing number of smaller, flexible assets.

The tools support real-time control of power plants, integration of flexibility assets and compliance with European grid codes. They monitor production assets and available capacity, provide information between TSOs and the real-time SCADA system, and calculate real-time setpoints from production plans, real-time acquisition and inputs such as FCR, aFRR and mFRR.

Mission

Develop and maintain a real-time SCADA platform that supports power generation control and grid stability. Work on both back-end logic and responsive web interfaces for dispatchers, contributing to reliable operation of systems that run 24/7.

Principales responsabilités

  • Develop and maintain the SCADA system used to keep the power perimeter balanced.

  • Design and develop clear, responsive web interfaces for dispatchers, and contribute to back-end logic.

  • Build custom logic and algorithms for real-time automated decision-making using SCIL, the native language of the SCADA platform. Prior SCIL knowledge is not required; training and coaching are provided.

  • Apply architectural design and software craftsmanship principles, including SOLID, DRY, KISS and YAGNI, to produce scalable, clean, maintainable and resilient code.

  • Collaborate in an Agile environment with analysts, dispatchers and technical teams.

  • After onboarding, take part in a shared, compensated on-call rotation to support system availability and grid stability. On-call work is mostly remote, and critical incidents are handled with team support.

Environnement technique

  • SCADA : Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA X SYS600, microSCADA framework, SCIL

  • Développement web : HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript

  • Ingénierie logicielle : SOLID, DRY, KISS, YAGNI

  • Énergie : FCR, aFRR, mFRR, TSOs, European grid codes

Profil recherché

Expérience

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in an industrial OT environment or a comparable real-time or critical environment.

  • A master’s degree in IT and/or electrical engineering, or equivalent experience.

Compétences techniques

  • Ability to build reliable, well-designed software for industrial environments, with an interest in architecture and design patterns.

  • Back-end development and, as part of the role, development of web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and TypeScript.

Compétences personnelles

  • Proactive, curious and structured, with initiative to improve the environment and practices.

  • Collaborative, able to take ownership and solve problems with peers and colleagues across teams.

  • Clear oral and written communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.

Langues

  • Fluent spoken and written English is essential.

  • French or Dutch is a plus for informal conversations but is not required.

Compétences / Qualités indispensables :

At least 3 years of experience in industrial OT or a comparable real-time/critical environment, SCADA and real-time industrial systems development, Reliable software design and software craftsmanship, Back-end development and responsive web interfaces, Fluent spoken and written English

Expérience dans le secteur de l'énergie

title: AI Commercial Strategy Associate
description:
