If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Assistant School Principal ( Assistant Principal (HS only), Assistant Principal of Discipline (MS and HS only), Assistant Principal of Curriculum (Elementary and Secondary)
description:
Position Purpose
Under the general supervision of a school principal, to assist the Principal in providing leadership and supervision in administering the educational program of a school in order to promote the educational development and achievement of students in accordance with Collier County School Board policies, administrative procedures, rules and regulations, and applicable law.

Essential Functions

  • Assists in the development and administration of school programs consistent with District goals and objectives.
  • Provides leadership and direction to staff with regard to the ongoing evaluation and improvement of educational programs, including curricular and extra-curricular activities.
  • Promotes a school environment that is safe and conducive to individualized instruction, cooperative curriculum development, and student learning.
  • Continues to acquire professional knowledge and learn of current developments in the educational field by attending seminars, workshops or professional meetings, or by conducting research.
  • Encourages staff to continue to grow professionally and to experiment with new approaches or strategies to teaching.
  • Assists in coordinating the work of school staff and District program leaders to develop and implement instructional programs and teaching practices.
  • Conducts ongoing assessment of student learning, and works with teaching staff to modify instructional methods to fit students' needs, including students with special needs.
  • Assists in the recruitment and selection of employees, the proper maintenance of employee personnel files, the administration of collective bargaining agreements, corrective action, and other human resource issues.
  • Encourages parental involvement in students' education and ensures effective communication with students and parents.
  • Ensures that student conduct and attendance conforms with the District's standards and District policies.
  • Supervises and evaluates teaching staff and other building employees in accordance with the District's evaluation plan, and makes recommendations regarding goals, areas needing improvement and continued employment.
  • Assists in the budgetary and financial affairs of the school consistent with District policies.

Additional Duties
Performs other related tasks as assigned by the Principal, Superintendent and other central office administrators as designated by the Superintendent.
Note: The above description is illustrative of tasks and responsibilities. It is not meant to be all inclusive of every task or responsibility.

Education

  • Master's degree in Educational Leadership or related field
  • Minimum of five years of full-time experience in a certificated position.
  • Florida Certification in Educational Leadership or School Principal.

Experience

  • Extensive successful teaching experience with a minimum of five (5) years full time school experience in a certificated position or a District position

Candidates must complete and upload to their application the following documents

  1. Completed or updated online administrative application
  2. Letter of Interest
  3. Resume
  4. Evaluations from the last three (3) years (2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024-2025, and/or 2025-2026)
  5. *Writing Sample (questions embedded in application can be uploaded to the application as a PDF form to allow for accuracy of information shared), * note in the question box to refer to the uploaded document.
  6. Two (2) professional references within the last two (2) years (24 months) ~ written ~ one being from current supervisor with an original signature and date on letterhead

*Review the attached paper screening tool. All external applications will be screened for the AP pool using this rubric. All candidates will be notified if they are qualified for the AP pool and will remain qualified for three (3) years.
*Review the attached HRMD guidelines for insight into the assistant principal pool process.

PLEASE NOTE: If you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact Alma Tello, 377-0344, HRMD@collierschools.com .

title: Multiskilled Journalist
description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

9NEWS in Denver is looking for a talented and experienced Multi-Skilled Journalist who can hit the ground running while covering news in the rapidly growing Mile High City.
The successful candidate will be a positive problem solver who can work quickly to produce compelling daily content for our broadcast and digital platforms.

Responsibilities:
• Pitch enterprise and compelling promotable stories for a morning viewer. This content will include elements that can be teased throughout the morning.
• Turn content for a daily broadcast and digital platform deadlines including web articles and mobile short video
• Develop contacts and sources within Colorado communities
• Effective story development and ability to vet
• Streaming digital assignments as needed
Our Reporters are expected to pitch compelling stories that can be turned on a daily deadline. This includes the ability to research effectively and build relationships with newsmakers who provide updates on stories today and in the future. Responsibilities also include meeting all broadcast and digital deadlines and communicating any obstacles to meeting those deadlines so we can change plans if necessary. In this role you will also contribute vertical content for the app and on-air.

Requirements:
• A journalism or communications degree is preferred.
• Three to five years of daily local newsgathering experience is required.
• The candidate must be able to shoot, write and edit video using a non-linear video editing software program.

  • We also expect complete command of writing clean broadcast and digital copy and a thorough understanding of the principles and practice of effective and ethical newsgathering.
  • Strong on-air presentation with the ability to speak smoothly during live coverage including completely unscripted breaking news situations.


The application deadline for this position is December 4, 2026

**RELOCATION ASSISTANCE IS PROVIDED**

Pay Range

$36.05 - $40.86 USD Final salary based on experience.

Pay Range
$36.05—$40.86 USD

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background. Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.

title: Solutions Architect ONL
description:
For this assignment, we are looking for candidates who have excellent communication skills in Dutch (spoken and written)

Omschrijving

Als Solution Architect bij Logius werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van een vernieuwd Overheid.nl. Binnen de Agile Release Train (ART) Integrale Ontsluiting Overheidinformatie (IOO) werk je samen met de system architect, productmanagement en ontwikkelteams om de architectuur te ontwerpen van een vernieuwd platform voor Overheid.nl. Overheidsinformatie is divers (wetten, regels, bekendmakingen, diensten, etc.) en kent vele afzenders, het Rijk, provincies, gemeenten en hun websites. Burgers hebben behoefte aan een overheid die zich als één overheid presenteert: gezamenlijk en in samenhang.

Je bent daarbij de schakel tussen business en realisatie en ontwerpt het technische fundament waarmee inwoners van Nederland via één portaal toegang hebben tot betrouwbare en toegankelijke overheidinformatie.

Je ontwerpt oplossingen en borgt daarbij de gestelde eisen op het gebied van continuïteit, onderhoudbaarheid en beschikbaarheid. Daarbij houdt je rekening met verplichte standaarden en de Nederlandse Overheid Referentie Architectuur (NORA). Cyberbeveiliging is daarbij altijd onderdeel van de gemaakte ontwerpkeuzes, waarbij eisen en risico's worden vertaald naar passende en evenredige maatregelen.

Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken en brengt samenhang tussen processen, informatie, applicaties en infrastructuur. Je combineert informatie uit verschillende bronnen en perspectieven tot een logisch en navolgbaar advies en kan dit overtuigend onderbouwen richting technische als niet-technische stakeholders. Je behoudt daarbij het overzicht en werkt met een vooruitkijkende blik.

Wat ga je doen:

- Ontwerpen van technische oplossingen die gebruikers toegang bieden tot verschillende informatiebronnen.
- Opstellen en onderhouden van de solutionarchitectuur en high-level designs.
- Borgen van cyberbeveiliging volgens het principe "privacy by design" op basis van de NIS2/BIO2.
- Samenwerken en afstemmen met stakeholders, teams en andere architecten binnen een Agile/SAFe-omgeving.
- Analyseren van processen, informatiestromen, afhankelijkheden en knelpunten en deze overzichtelijk in kaart brengen.
- Vertalen van eisen en wensen naar technische oplossingsrichtingen.
- Ontwerpen en meetbaar maken van niet-functionele eisen zoals continuïteit, beschikbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid.
- Adviseren van product owners en teams over architectuur- en technische vraagstukken.
- Vaststellen van architectuurkaders en oplossingsrichtingen waarbinnen teams de oplossing realiseren.

Achtergrond Opdracht:
Logius beheert in opdracht van BZK het overheidsportaal Overheid.nl. In samenwerking met Dienst Publiek en Communicatie (DPC) van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken wordt Overheid.nl vernieuwd. Overheid.nl wordt ontwikkeld tot een overheidsbrede wegwijzer: een centrale ingang die mensen helpt hun weg te vinden binnen de publieke dienstverlening, afgestemd op de persoonlijke situatie.

DPC en Logius richten hiervoor een structurele samenwerking in waarin Logius de beheer en exploitatie van het platform uitvoert en DPC verantwoordelijke is voor de redactie en voorlichting.

Eisen:
  • Certificering TOGAF
  • Niveau: WO of HBO+ in Informatica of vergelijkbaar
  • Kennis van NIS2, BIO2 & ISO 27001/27002
  • Kandidaat beschikt over een eigen (ontwikkel-)laptop met toegangswoord, versleutelde harde schijf (encryptie), up to date antivirussoftware t.b.v. de uit te voeren werkzaamheden.
  • Ervaring als architect binnen publieke context (Rijks)werkervaring in de rol van systeem-, solution- of domeinarchitect (Bewezen aantal jaar: 5)

Wensen:
  • Kennis van en ervaring met SAFe en Agile werken. Weten hoe een organisatie volgens de principes werkt.
  • Ervaring met specificeren van Features/User Stories
  • Ervaring met herbouw/nieuwbouwtrajecten
  • Ervaring met analyseren van bedrijfsprocessen en vertalen van requirements naar technische ontwerpen
  • Wij zoeken een energieke en gemotiveerde architect die graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt.
  • De kandidaat werkt pragmatisch, zelfstandig, maar ook graag met anderen en schroomt niet contact te leggen.
  • Voelt zich verantwoordelijk voor het resultaat en wacht niet af tot iemand anders het oppakt.

Competenties:
  • •Proactieve houding, zoek actief samenwerking en neemt initiatief om tot resultaat te komen.
  • •Conceptueel denken, creëert overzicht en brengt structuur en samenhang.
  • •Sterk analytisch vermogen om complexe vraagstukken snel te doorgronden.
  • •Agile/Safe-mindset; architectuurfunctie binnen een Agile Release Train (ART).
  • •Risicogebaseerd werken passend bij Rijksorganisaties (NIS2/BIO2 als kaders voor ontwerp)
  • •Ontwerpen opstellen en meetbaar maken op basis van het productkwaliteitsmodel uit ISO 25010

Inzetgegevens
04-01-2027 tm 03-01-2027 met optie verlenging
36 uur per week
Den Haag

title: Master’s Thesis Project  Characterization and Testing of Grease for Rock Drilling Tools
description:
Background and scope of the project
Rock drilling tools used in mining and construction operate under demanding conditions involving high mechanical loads, vibrations, impact loads, contamination, and challenging environmental conditions. Grease plays an important role in protecting components and interfaces where reliable lubrication is required.


This Master’s thesis project will investigate the properties and performance of greases intended for rock drilling tool applications.

The project combines laboratory-scale characterization of grease properties with an assessment of how these properties may influence performance in the intended application. Depending on project progress and the availability of suitable test equipment, the work may also include functional testing under conditions representative of rock drilling tools.


Objectives
The overall objective is to improve the understanding of how grease properties influence lubrication performance and suitability for demanding rock drilling applications.


The project aims to:

  • Characterize relevant physical, mechanical, rheological, and tribological properties of selected greases.
  • Compare different grease formulations and properties using laboratory-scale testing.
  • Investigate relationships between measured grease properties and expected performance in drill tools.
  • Identify suitable laboratory test methods and parameters for evaluating grease for rock drilling applications.
  • If feasible, conduct functional testing to investigate how laboratory measurements correlate with performance under more application-relevant conditions.
  • Provide recommendations for future grease selection, testing and evaluation.

Student background
We believe that you are:

  • Currently pursuing a Master of Science in Engineering, specializing in Materials Science
  • Curious and interested in understanding how materials and lubricants behave in demanding engineering applications.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with engineers, specialists, and laboratory personnel.
  • Interested in hands-on experimental work.
  • Systematic in planning experiments, documenting results, and analyzing data.
  • Able to communicate technical results in English.

Our culture
At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. We invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Duration of the project
The thesis project will start in January 2027 and is expected to be concluded in June 2027.


Contact information

For further information about this project, please contact:

  • Majid Jafari Bahramabadi, Senior R&D Professional, +46 (0)73-267 0625
  • Åsa Grönqvist, R&D Manager for Rotary and Raiseboring Tools, +46 (0)79-066 3214

We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contact in that matter.

How to apply

Send your application no later than December 10th, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0099523.

title: STAFF — Wafer Level NAND SILICON DESIGN VALIDATION (SDV)
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

ROLE

Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration.

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent. Be able to perform micro probing to validate and char internal signals at Wafer level and hands on experience with ATEs.

• Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions.

• Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features.

• Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions.

• Convert silicon observations into engineering insight and product decisions by explaining deviations from expected behavior, assessing risk, recommending next actions, reviewing validation evidence, mentoring engineers, and improving reusable validation and debug methodologies.



  • Proven ability to leverage AI‑assisted (vibe) coding techniques to improve efficiency or automate design and analysis methodologies
  • Leverage AI tools to automate the tools and workflow Applying Artificial Intelligence in workflows to improve build efficiency

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, with experience appropriate to the approved Senior Staff/Principal level.

• Strong analog and mixed-signal fundamentals with substantial experience in at least one of the following:

  • Mixed-signal verification
  • Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design
  • Post-silicon validation and characterization
  • Memory validation

• Experience with mixed-signal simulation environments, including full-chip, block-level, pre-layout, or post-layout simulations.

• Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments.

• Ability to derive tests from specifications, assess coverage, debug complex circuit behavior, and explain differences between expected and observed results.

• Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python.

• Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• NAND Flash, SSD, DRAM, or other memory technology experience, including program/read/erase operations, sensing architectures, bias generation, charge pumps, timing/control circuits, reliability characterization, or system-level integration.

• Experience with System-Verilog, Verilog-AMS, real-number modeling, SPICE, assertions, functional coverage, or simulation-to-silicon correlation methodologies.

• Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, probe stations, source measurement units (SMUs), semiconductor parameter analyzers, automated test equipment (ATE), or similar silicon characterization platforms.

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

Business Unit


Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTi)


Business Description


Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTi) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone’s businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTi is nimble and entrepreneurial - our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development mean that everyone on the team has the opportunity to make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who can take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring and developing excellence. We collaborate to find the best answers for our customers and for Blackstone. We are critical to the firm maintaining its competitive edge.


Job Title


Senior Vice President, Engineering Manager - Fund Finance Technology, Finance and Operations Technology


Job Description


We are seeking a hands-on Senior Vice President, Engineering Manager to lead Fund Finance Technology within the Finance and Operations Technology team. The team is responsible for all accounting systems across the firm, including the general ledger, sub-ledgers, and waterfall calculations. The role owns architecture, delivery, and platform reliability for these enterprise-grade systems.


The successful candidate will be a key part of driving the end-to-end transformation of Blackstone’s accounting systems as we modernize the platform for straight-through processing (STP). Significant AI-based build is required to meet Blackstone’s platform requirements and to make the solution vendor agnostic. The ideal candidate operates as a player-coach: leading engineers, partnering with business stakeholders, guiding technical direction, and staying close enough to the work to unblock teams and solve complex problems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead engineering strategy, architecture, delivery, scalability, reliability, and operational performance for Fund Finance Technology platforms, including the general ledger, sub-ledgers, and waterfall calculation systems.
  • Lead significant AI-based build to deliver Blackstone’s platform requirements, and architect solutions to be vendor agnostic, avoiding lock-in to any vendor platform.
  • Drive the end-to-end transformation of accounting systems, modernizing the platform to enable straight-through processing across accounting, fund operations, reporting, and regulatory workflows.
  • Partner with Finance, Treasury, Operations, Data Engineering, and technology stakeholders to shape requirements, priorities, and roadmap trade-offs.
  • Operate as a player-coach by managing and mentoring engineers while remaining hands-on in solution design, architecture reviews, delivery planning, and complex problem solving.
  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across system design, code quality, CI/CD, testing automation, observability, security, and production operations.
  • Drive modernization initiatives across cloud, microservices, APIs, workflow orchestration, and distributed systems architecture.
  • Oversee integration across general ledger and sub-ledger platforms, waterfall calculation engines, data warehouses, ETL pipelines, reporting infrastructure, and downstream operational systems.
  • Collaborate with Information Security and Risk teams to ensure platforms meet internal controls, audit requirements, regulatory standards, and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Improve operational maturity through monitoring, incident management, performance optimization, capacity planning, and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Recruit, retain, and develop top engineering talent while creating strong career development pathways across the organization.

Qualifications


  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise platform development, or financial systems technology, including significant engineering leadership experience.
  • Proven experience leading teams that deliver enterprise-grade fund accounting, general ledger, sub-ledger, treasury, or fund operations technology platforms.
  • Strong hands-on background in application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native development, platform engineering, and modern delivery practices.
  • Hands-on experience building AI/ML or generative AI solutions and designing vendor-agnostic, modular platforms.
  • Experience managing senior stakeholder expectations, clarifying ambiguity, and making pragmatic trade-offs while maintaining professional integrity.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise systems integration, including general ledger platforms, ETL frameworks, data warehousing technologies, and financial reporting systems.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, observability, DevSecOps, and production operations.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience in private equity, asset management, alternative investments, or financial services.
  • Familiarity with fund accounting, waterfall calculations, treasury operations, financial controls, and regulatory reporting.
  • Experience with modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Background working with enterprise financial platforms such as SAP, Oracle Financials, Workday Financials, or proprietary ledger systems.
  • Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations and large-scale technology transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, financial controls, and enterprise security frameworks.

title: Co-op, Advanced Cell Engineering
description:
Company Overview:

Strand Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering programmable mRNA therapeutics to unlock the full potential of genetic medicines. Strand is applying its proprietary Signal Stack platform, which integrates EverScript circular RNA, AmpliScript self-replicating RNA, SignalPath targeted delivery, and logic-driven SignalLock genetic circuits to enable precise control of therapeutic activity across tissues and cell types and overcome foundational limitations in targeting, durability, and safety.

Strand is advancing a pipeline with an initial focus on oncology and autoimmune disease. Its initial program, STX-001, an intratumorally delivered LNP-encapsulated self-replicating RNA expressing IL-12, has demonstrated preliminary evidence of systemic immune activation and anti-tumor activity in patients with advanced solid tumors who have progressed on prior therapies. Building on this early clinical validation, intravenously delivered STX-003 is designed for tumor-targeted expression and avoidance of off-target expression. STX-003, which is expected to enter the clinic in mid-2026, has the potential to be a major step forward for the fields of genetic medicine and oncology. Strand is also advancing STX-005, an in vivo CAR-T program designed to enable controlled, durable expression and repeat dosing. Founded by MIT synthetic biology pioneers, Strand has raised over $250 million and is headquartered in Boston, MA.

Become the next standout single strand!

Job Summary:

Strand is looking for people who have the enthusiasm and motivation to be a highly contributing member of a small but extremely productive team. This opportunity will offer the employee the ability to work in a matrix-based environment and be a part of the future strategy of the company.

We are looking for a highly motivated and innovative candidate for the role of Co-op, Advanced Cell Engineering. This is a fantastic opportunity to make a significant impact as a scientifically motivated self-starter capable of independently conceiving, conducting, and critically analyzing their own work with minimal supervision.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Generate, expand, and maintain stable mammalian cell lines expressing proteins of interest.
  • Develop and optimize flow cytometry assays to characterize cell lines, including protein expression levels and stability over time.
  • Perform mammalian cell transfections and downstream functional assays such as in vitro cytotoxicity and ELISA assays.
  • Execute experiments, maintain accurate laboratory records, and contribute to troubleshooting experiments with the team.
  • Working across diverse areas to support the group's research activities in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Qualifications:

  • On track to graduate with a BS or MS in Biology, Biochemistry, Bioengineering, or a related discipline.
  • 1-3 years of research experience in a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or academic environment is preferred.
  • Experience with mammalian cell culture, transfection, and flow cytometry is preferred.
  • Hands on experience with ELISAs, viral transductions, and RNA handling is a plus.
  • Exposure to immune cell assays such as immune cells isolation, phenotyping, and co-culture is a great bonus.
  • Ability to write, edit, and follow standard operating procedures, make careful observations, and maintain clear and complete records of lab work.

title: Deputy Director, Family Health
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

- Division Summary
The Africa and India Offices include a diverse range of program areas aimed at finding creative ways to ensure solutions and products get into the hands of people in low-income countries who need them most. We work in areas with the potential for high-impact, sustainable solutions that can reach millions of people. Our focus is on innovative delivery, including an emphasis on strengthening primary health care systems.

Our efforts are aligned with India’s National Health Policy Goals (NHP, 2017) to - reduce preventable deaths among mothers and children and enable elimination of selected infectious diseases, and we work closely with India’s Central and State governments, and partner with community-based organizations, nonprofit organizations, academic and research institutions, the private sector, and development organizations, to achieve our shared goals. Our strong networks and ability to convene intellectual resources globally and across many sectors enable us to address emerging and complex challenges. Our efforts in India focus on key issues that affect the future of India’s most vulnerable communities: reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health and nutrition; urban sanitation; agricultural development; gender equality, and digital financial inclusion in several states of the country.

Your Role

India has made substantial progress in improving maternal, newborn, and child health outcomes, reflecting sustained national and state-level efforts. Building on these gains, opportunities remain to accelerate progress, particularly in states such as Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Assam, Meghalaya, Odisha, Jharkhand, and Chhattisgarh, where the foundation collaborates with the state governments and other partners in advancing these efforts. The foundation is committed to supporting India’s continued progress towards a future where no mother, newborn, or child dies from preventable causes. The Deputy Director, Family Health plays a key role in advancing this goal in partnership with India’s central and state governments.

- What you will be directly accountable

The Deputy Director, Family Health, holds direct accountability for the foundation’s Maternal, Newborn, Child and Nutrition Health (MNCNH) portfolio in India - its strategy, investment choices and results - and family planning and women’s health innovation to advance health outside of pregnancy, supporting advancement towards national goals and contribute to progress against the foundation's global goals in the areas described above.


You will lead implementation of the foundation’s health priorities through partners in the states assigned to you, currently Assam, Meghalaya, and Odisha (and other states of strategic importance as assigned). You will also prepare strategy for local institutional capacity building for national and state institutions and for comprehensive primary health care and implement them through the respective foundation’s state leads for the state work.

- What you will integrate or converge

You will connect the MNCNH portfolio with the foundation’s other health work - including Program Strategy Teams (PSTs) such as Women’s Health Innovation, Health Research & Development (R&D), Digital and AI, Measurement, Learning and Evaluation (MLE), and Partnerships and Communications - so that strategies, grants and investments fit together and trade-offs are made explicitly. Convergence with health (R&D) team is required to facilitate innovations development, testing, and integration into health systems to solve complex challenges. Where heath systems lever such as human resources for health, data systems, supply chains, strategic purchasing or comprehensive primary health care are needed to deliver MNCNH and state goals, you will draw on them in coordination with the teams that lead that work.

- Where accountability is shared

In your assigned states you will share accountability with the foundation’s state teams, working alongside the Deputy Directors for the Infectious Diseases and State Health Systems.

You will report to the Director - Health, India Country Office, and be a member of the India Country Office management team. This position partners closely with multiple Deputy Directors and Program Officers and is a member of a matrixed team, requiring collaboration with cross-domain program and functional teams in India and other foundation offices.

- What success looks like

Measurable, time bound programs on MNCNH goals in the portfolio and your assigned states; a well-chosen portfolio of investments with clear milestones and go/no-go decisions; strong relationship with government and local partners; and mentor a high-performing, well-developed team.

The role sits within the Foundation’s India Country Office (ICO) in New Delhi.

- What You’ll Do

a) Strategy, Portfolio Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead the strategy, development and delivery of the foundation’s grant portfolio in India, spanning MNCNH, Family Planning and Women’s Health Innovation. Drive measurable, time-bound progress against clearly defined outcomes and indicators aligned with maternal and child survival goals.
  • Collaborate closely with the foundation’s Program Strategy Teams (PSTs) in Seattle to ensure alignment between global priorities and ICO strategies, while using evidence and local insights to advocate for context-specific adaptations.
  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the foundation’s health priorities in assigned states, currently Assam, Meghalaya and Odisha, as well as other states of strategic importance as required. Lead, manage and support the teams (two members) responsible for delivering these priorities.
  • Shape and advance strategies to strengthen the capacity of local institutions and improve comprehensive primary health care, working through national and state-level teams and institutional partners to support effective implementation.
  • Oversee the design, management and performance of strategic investments and grant portfolios in support of programmatic and policy objectives. Establish clear milestones and performance measures to inform investment decisions, assess progress, manage risks and make informed trade-offs across interventions, while promoting learning and knowledge-sharing across states.

b) Cross-Functional Leadership and Health Systems Strengthening

  • Share accountability with the foundation’s state health systems strengthening and infectious disease teams for achieving health outcomes in assigned states. Provide strategic direction, foster cross-team collaboration and resolve complex challenges requiring senior leadership engagement.
  • Lead convergence between MNCNH, family planning, women’s health initiative PST teams, India Country Office’s Health Research & Development and Digital Health and AI for family health and state deliverables.
  • Leverage critical health system enablers, including human resources for health, health information systems, supply chains, procurement and strategic purchasing, to accelerate progress towards MNCNH and state-level objectives, in close collaboration with the teams leading health systems strengthening.
  • Foster effective collaboration across matrixed teams, ensuring alignment of priorities, coordinated execution and shared accountability for results.

c) Partnerships, Policy Engagement and External Influence

  • Build and sustain strategic relationships with senior government officials, technical divisions within relevant national ministries and state departments, and other key stakeholders to advance the foundation’s health priorities and influence policy and programme implementation.
  • Monitor emerging policy developments, evolving government priorities and programme reforms to identify opportunities for strategic engagement and support. Leverage evidence generation, data analysis and technical expertise to inform policy dialogue and strengthen decision-making across MNCNH, Family Planning and Women’s Health.
  • Develop and nurture high-impact partnerships with bilateral and multilateral agencies, philanthropic organisations, public health institutions, NGOs, private sector organisations and other stakeholders to accelerate progress towards the foundation’s goals in India.
  • Maintain a structured and purposeful cadence of engagement with government counterparts, grantees and strategic partners. Lead periodic consultations, portfolio reviews and stakeholder discussions to assess progress, address challenges and continuously refine strategies.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner and resource to grantees and foundation programme teams, providing guidance, facilitating collaboration and supporting the achievement of shared objectives.

d) Measurement, Learning and Performance

  • Partner closely with the Measurement, Learning and Evaluation (MLE) function to develop and advance a coherent learning agenda across states, ensuring that evidence and insights inform strategic decisions, programme adaptations and future investments.
  • Oversee the monitoring, evaluation and synthesis of results from grants and contracts, translating performance data and implementation experience into actionable insights. Lead contributions to portfolio reviews, strategic assessments and presentations to senior leadership.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, evidence-based decision-making and cross-state learning, ensuring that successful approaches are identified, adapted and scaled where appropriate.

e) People Leadership and Organisational Contribution

  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary team, with direct management responsibility for two staff members. Provide coaching, mentorship and professional development opportunities that strengthen individual capabilities, team effectiveness and succession planning.
  • Contribute actively to the ICO management team, helping shape organisational priorities, strengthen collaboration across functions and foster a culture of accountability, inclusion and high performance.
  • Represent the foundation at high-level meetings, public events, technical forums and strategic engagements, effectively communicating its priorities, investments and impact.
  • Lead or contribute to the development of strategic briefs, landscape analyses, policy papers and other thought leadership materials, and undertake special projects or strategic initiatives as required.

Your Experience

We are seeking exceptional leaders and strategic thinkers with a proven track record of developing innovative solutions and addressing complex challenges in the health sector in India. Ideal candidates will bring a hypothesis-driven, data-informed approach to problem-solving, alongside demonstrated experience navigating matrixed organizations and collaborating across diverse teams to deliver transformative, high-impact solutions.

The qualified candidate should have the following competencies and experience:

  • MD in Obstetrics and Gynecology, or other advanced degree in Public Health, Global Health or related field. A doctoral degree (PhD/DrPH/MD) would be preferred.
  • A minimum of 15 years of senior-level experience working within health systems at both state and national levels.
  • Senior-level leadership experience in a health organization, either public or private, including responsibility for program strategy, design, and implementation, preferably in the areas of Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child and Nutrition Health.
  • Deep, technical knowledge of family health domains, in Indian and global contexts.
  • Demonstrated experience building and leading strategic partnerships with collaborators from diverse sectors including NGOs, government, and the private sector.
  • Proven success using and communicating (verbally and in writing) evidence and data to inform policy, programming, and management decisions.
  • Superior skills in critical thinking and planning.
  • Comfortable with use of responsible AI for improving health
  • Strong ability to work with efficiency and diplomacy, particularly as part of a multi-disciplinary team effort. Demonstrated ability to work in productive collaboration with diverse teams including scientists, business analysts, program implementers, and developing country partners.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and comfort in areas beyond current areas of expertise with proven ability to rapidly acquire knowledge and implement good judgment in diverse scientific and political areas.
  • Ability to plan, organize, and prioritize work of self and others in a fast-paced environment with multiple and competing demands, which requires the ability to see critical paths, measure and mitigate risk, and make trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to structure and manage high-return, well-risk-mitigated investments, with clear benchmarks and outcomes; with experience in developing this skill in others.
  • Demonstrated experience in building, leading and developing high-performing, highly skilled teams.
  • Role model for courageous inquiry and intellectual integrity.
  • Willingness to prioritize collective success over self.

Other Attributes

  • Comfortable in a wide range of cultural, geographic and operational situations, demonstrating culturally sensitive behaviour with a diverse range of people and a deep commitment to development issues and high standards of personal integrity.
  • Ability to travel locally and internationally, up to 40%.

*Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.

Application deadline: 6 December 2026

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you have a disability or medical condition and need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process—such as an ASL interpreter, alternative interview format, or physical accessibility support—we’re happy to help. Please contact HR@gatesfoundation.org with the position number and a brief description of your accommodation needs. Requests will be handled confidentially.

We are dedicated to the belief that all lives have equal value. We strive for a global and cultural workplace that supports ever greater diversity, equity, and inclusion — of voices, ideas, and approaches — and we support this diversity through all our employment practices.

All applicants and employees who are drawn to serve our mission will enjoy equality of opportunity and fair treatment without regard to race, color, age, religion, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, and prior protected activity.

title: AI Operations Associate
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Director, Innovation Central Adelaide
description:
Position Details

  • Full-Time | Fixed term until July 2029
  • Professional HEO10 | $147,656 - $156,497 p.a
  • Location: Tonsley / Kaurna Country
  • View Position Description

About the Role

The Director, Innovation Central Adelaide (ICA) is a senior leadership opportunity responsible for driving the strategic growth, commercial success and international profile of one of Australia's leading industry-university innovation hubs. Leading Innovation Central Adelaide within the National Industry Innovation Network (NIIN), the role will build high-value industry partnerships, expand engagement across the Asia-Pacific region, and position Flinders University as a key contributor to innovation, research translation and industry collaboration. Reporting to the Chief Research Development Officer, the Director will provide visionary leadership to maximise the impact of the Tonsley Innovation District and deliver transformational outcomes for the University, industry partners and the broader innovation ecosystem.


In this position, you will:

  • Lead the strategic direction, growth and performance of Innovation Central Adelaide, ensuring alignment with Flinders University, Cisco and NIIN priorities.
  • Drive business development and commercial outcomes by securing high-value partnerships, funding opportunities and industry collaborations nationally and internationally.
  • Champion Asia-Pacific engagement and support the expansion of the NIIN network through international partnerships, programs and stakeholder relationships.
  • Represent Innovation Central Adelaide and Flinders University at executive forums, industry events and government engagements while providing strategic advice to senior leaders and advisory boards.

This position makes a significant contribution to the University’s strategic plan to changing 10 million lives, Every One Matters, by 2035 through directly contributing to the strategic driver of Industry & Enterprise Partnerships, fostering impactful collaborations that accelerate innovation, research translation and economic growth while strengthening Flinders University's reputation as a globally connected innovation leader.

About You

You are a strategic and commercially astute leader with a proven ability to build high-impact partnerships, drive innovation and influence outcomes across complex stakeholder environments. With extensive experience operating at a senior level, you bring strong business development capability, international engagement experience, and the confidence to represent organisations in executive, industry and government settings. A collaborative and entrepreneurial mindset, coupled with exceptional communication skills, will enable you to thrive in this high-profile leadership role.


To be successful in this position, you will have:

  • Significant senior leadership experience within research, innovation, commercialisation, industry engagement or related environments, supported by a postgraduate qualification or equivalent executive experience.
  • A proven track record of securing, developing and managing high-value partnerships and delivering strategic growth outcomes across complex, multi-stakeholder settings.
  • Strong international engagement experience, including building relationships across the Asia-Pacific region and representing organisations in senior industry, government or international forums.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to lead high-performing teams, navigate ambiguity, and drive innovation-focused initiatives to successful outcomes.

Office of the Deputy Vice-Chancellor, (Research)

Research is a fundamental cornerstone of our mission as a university. Through research, and research-led teaching, we build and develop the knowledge and capabilities that improve lives and enhance society as a whole.


The Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Research) Leadership Team comprise the Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Research), the Pro Vice-Chancellor (Research Training and Capabilities) and Dean of Graduate Research, the Pro Vice-Chancellor (Research Enterprise and Infrastructure), the Pro Vice-Chancellor (Research Performance and Impact), the Chief Research Development Officer and the Research Lead: Indigenous Research Strategy. This team, together with the Research Development and Support (RDS) and the Office of Graduate Research (OGR) Teams provide leadership and support to achieve the University’s research goals.


The Portfolio includes:

The Research Development and Support (RDS) Team works with Flinders researchers, Colleges, Institutes and Centres, other portfolios and external stakeholders to proactively support research.


The Office of Graduate Research (OGR) Team provides support, expertise and guidance for prospective and enrolled HDR students, HDR supervisors and Colleges through each stage of candidature and professional development.


Life at Flinders

They say know your place. We say you've found it right here.


Flinders University was founded on the belief that learning should open minds, celebrate individuality and give people the freedom to pursue their own point of view. That spirit lives on in our community of thinkers, doers and changemakers who challenge convention, and each other, to shape what comes next.


Rising to a challenge is nothing new for Flinders. During our first 60 years, we’ve navigated revolutionary changes in social and cultural norms, and have responded to transformative economic, environmental and technological developments. Through it all, we’ve continued to deliver for our students and community, innovating in learning and research to prepare graduates for the changing world they help create.


Reaching beyond the limits of buildings, borders, and backgrounds, ours is an inclusive culture that believes absolutely in equality and opportunity for all. We don't just accommodate differences; we embrace and celebrate them.


So, why work at Flinders?

  • 17% Superannuation + salary packaging options
  • Ranked in the top 2% of universities worldwide.
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Awarded the AHEIA Higher Education Award for Workplace Culture Excellence due to our commitment to wellbeing through our Thriving@Flinders staff wellbeing program
  • Wide range of professional development activities and services, including exclusive staff study offers
  • We embrace diversity and promote equity and inclusion for all students and staff, as shown through our three SAGE Cygnet Awards.
  • Recognised as a Veteran Employer of Choice

Our Commitment to Reconciliation and Indigenous Employment

Flinders University is proud to be an organisation that is committed to our Reconciliation Action Plan and Indigenous Workforce Strategy. Our vision is to be a preferred employer for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples. We are committed to progressing Indigenous advancement in education, research, employment, and wellbeing, and strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples for all Flinders vacancies.

  • Please see here for our Indigenous Workforce Strategy

The contract of Employment is conditional upon the receipt of these completed compliance checks. A disclosable outcome will not automatically disqualify a candidate from consideration. Each case will be assessed on its individual merits and relevance to the inherent requirements of the role.


How to Apply and Information

You are required to submit a CV, along with a cover letter as a separate document, telling us a little about yourself, and why you feel you are suited to this role.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to contribute to Fever’s global strategy and financial operations in a high-growth, tech-driven environment.
  • Exposure to senior leaders and cross-functional projects across business lines, finance, data, product, and operations.

description:

Job Description


Job Title: Associate Manager, Learning and Development

Locations: Kansas City, MO; Braintree, MA; Denver, CO - Hybrid

About the Role

SS&C GlobeOp is seeking a Learning and Development specialist to lead training for our Retail Alternatives fund administration teams. You will build and deliver onboarding and ongoing training for employees supporting interval funds, tender-offer funds, and other alternative retail investment products.

You will partner with Fund Accounting, Investor Services, Transfer Agency and other operations teams to turn fund requirements, system workflows, and operating procedures into practical training. Your work will help employees process activity a

Why Join SS&C

SS&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence.

You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real-world operational challenges and large-scale enterprise environments.

How You Will Make an Impact

· Set the Retail Alternatives training strategy and develop learning plans by role, from new hire onboarding through ongoing technical development.

· Identify training needs with department leaders and subject matter experts. Use quality reviews, recurring processing errors, system changes, and upcoming fund launches to prioritize training.

· Design and deliver technical and systems training on the fund lifecycle, including NAV production, cash and share reconciliations, subscriptions, distributions, periodic repurchases, investor reporting, and servicing through intermediaries.

· Build case studies and simulations that let employees practice applying controls, resolving discrepancies, communicating with clients, and escalating exceptions.

· Partner with subject matter experts create facilitator guides, job aids, videos, and e-learning modules. Keep materials current as fund terms, processes, and systems change.

· Create and maintain interactive, self-paced eLearning for Retail Alternatives. Write scripts, build system walkthroughs and knowledge checks and publish courses to the learning management system.

· Facilitate virtual and in-person training, coordinate training logistics, and coach new employees as they transition from training to live work.

· Track participation, assessment results and readiness for live processing. Evaluate training impact using measures such as time to proficiency, processing accuracy, and rework, then adjust training based on the results.

Required Experience

  • Experience designing, delivering and evaluating training programs for operational or technical teams.
  • Experience in fund administration, fund accounting, investor services, transfer agency or a related investment operations function, with the ability to explain how fund activity flows across teams.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking and writing skills, including the ability to turn complex workflows into clear procedures and training materials.
  • Ability to manage multiple training initiatives, partner with stakeholders across departments and learn new systems quickly.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Experience with e-learning authoring tools and learning management systems.

Additional Requirements

· Travel requirement - up to 5%.

  • Direct experience supporting Retail Alternatives.
  • Proven experience managing training initiatives, with a track record of designing, delivering, and evaluating effective training programs.
  • Hands-on experience creating eLearning courses using Articulate 360 (Rise or Storyline) or a comparable authoring tool.
  • Experience using a range of training methods, including instructor-led training, workshops, simulations, coaching, mentoring and on-the-job training.
  • Strong leadership, facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and system workflows clearly.
  • Strong writing skills for developing training manuals and procedures, preparing reports, and maintaining accurate training records.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment and maintain attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and the ability to learn new software and database applications quickly.

What Sets You Apart (preferred qualifications)

· Additional experience in Investor Services, hedge funds, private equity, or real assets.

· Bachelor’s degree or relevant training or industry certification.

title: Product Manager - Payments Acceptance (Merchant of Record)
location: Bangalore, India ; Jakarta, Indonesia; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Mumbai, India; Singapore, Singapore
description:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

About the Job

At Xendit, we are seeking a Product Manager - Payments Acceptance (Merchant of Record) who will build, launch, and scale Xendit's new Merchant of Record (MoR) offering across cards and local payment methods, starting in Southeast Asia and expanding to global markets. In this role, you will take full ownership of end-to-end payment acceptance flows, managing complex liabilities around local entity compliance, tax withholding, cross-border FX settlement, and chargeback mitigation for global enterprise merchants. Working at the intersection of product, engineering, risk, legal, and commercial teams, you will take this product from 0 to 1 and scale it to deliver seamless checkout conversion while maintaining airtight compliance rails across high-throughput transaction environments.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience in fintech, payment gateways, card acquiring, or B2B payment platforms, or an equivalent proven track record with MoR.
  • Hands-on experience with the Merchant of Record (MoR) model (must-have), either from the provider side (e.g. building or running an MoR or managed payments product) or from the merchant side (e.g. working at a company that used MoR services to process payments locally and settle cross-border).
  • Strong technical fluency with RESTful APIs, webhooks, sandbox testing environments, and financial data reconciliation.
  • Experience navigating regulatory, tax, and compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Exceptional analytical skills with hands-on capability to query data independently, optimize unit economics, and define clear product metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing cross-border payments, localized FX solutions, or global merchant acquirers across global markets (e.g. Asia, Latin America, Africa, or Europe).
  • Background in high-scale tech startups, e-commerce infrastructure platforms, or global SaaS scale-ups.
  • Direct experience partnering with card schemes, acquirers, and local payment method operators.
  • Experience building zero-to-one product

Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Xendit's new Merchant of Record (MoR) acceptance offering, from the 0-to-1 launch across cards and local payment methods to expansion into new markets.
  • Design and launch end-to-end MoR payment flows that let global merchants accept payments locally without having a local entity: collecting in local currency, handling FX and local tax, and settling cross-border in the merchant's currency, starting with cards and extending to local payment methods.
  • Partner with Engineering to build MoR capabilities on top of Xendit's existing acceptance stack of 100+ payment methods and connections, including reliable APIs and automated settlement and reconciliation.
  • Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Risk to define how Xendit takes on the liabilities of being the Merchant of Record in each market, including local tax, regulatory requirements, chargebacks, and fraud.
  • Spend time with merchants and prospects to understand their problems and why they need to process locally without a local presence, and consult stakeholders across the business before proposing solutions.
  • Define and own success metrics for the MoR product, such as merchant adoption, Total Payment Volume (TPV) processed through MoR, transaction success rate, and margin.
  • Write clear PRDs and acceptance criteria, and work with Go-To-Market (GTM) and Customer Success teams to launch MoR to enterprise merchants and support their onboarding.

title: Strategy Analyst
description:
Help us shape the future!


There’s never been a more exciting time to join HL. We’re looking for a Strategy Analyst to support our bold ambition to become the UK’s premier investment and savings platform, all in service of our purpose to help Britain build wealth with confidence.

We’re transforming how we support our clients through personalised guidance, distinctive products and trusted expertise, and our people are at the heart of making that happen.

Backed by private equity investors and entering an exciting new phase of growth and transformation, we're investing heavily in our future. Our Strategy team sits at the heart of that journey, helping shape the decisions that will define the next chapter of the business. It is also recognised as a strong development platform, providing outstanding exposure and future career opportunities across the organisation.

Join us and you’ll have the opportunity to think boldly, do brilliant work and make a purposeful difference, while growing your career and helping to shape the next chapter of HL.

About the role

We're looking for a high-calibre Strategy Analyst to join our Bristol-based Strategy team.


This is an exceptional opportunity for an analytically minded professional with early career experience in strategy consulting, financial services, corporate strategy or a commercial analytical role to develop core strategic skills within a market-leading business.


Working alongside experienced strategy professionals, you'll support some of HL’s most important growth, transformation and value creation priorities. You’ll gain first-hand experience of how strategic decisions are translated into tangible commercial outcomes and gain regular exposure to executive stakeholders and work closely with senior leaders across the organisation, including members of the Executive Committee.


From day one, you'll contribute to high-impact strategic initiatives and gain first-hand experience of how major commercial decisions are made and implemented.


What you’ll be doing

  • Conduct market, competitor and customer analysis to support strategic decision-making.
  • Identify growth opportunities, risks and commercial implications through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
  • Support the development of strategic recommendations, business cases and value creation initiatives.
  • Build clear and compelling material for senior leadership and Board discussions.
  • Contribute to strategic reviews, transformation programmes and growth projects across the business.
  • Work closely with stakeholders across multiple business functions to gather insight and challenge assumptions.
  • Translate complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.

About you

Essential

  • Strong undergraduate degree with a proven academic track record.
  • Approximately 1-3 years' experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, financial services, analytics or a similarly commercial environment.
  • Excellent analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation abilities.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting strategic reviews, commercial due diligence, transformation programmes or business cases.
  • Exposure to financial services, wealth management, banking or investment platforms.
  • Familiarity with market analysis, commercial modelling or strategy development frameworks.

We know great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this opportunity excites you and you have many of the skills and experiences we’re looking for, we encourage you to apply.

Working pattern

Location: Bristol

The selection process is expected to include an introductory conversation and a competency-based interview. We will confirm the final stages and discuss any adjustments with shortlisted candidates.
