title: Process Technologist
description:
The Process Technologist plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient, safe, and compliant operation of automated production lines within a clean manufacturing environment. This role requires a high level of technical expertise in automation, instrumentation, and aseptic processes, along with strong problem-solving and leadership capabilities.


Key responsibilities include supporting machine setup, changeovers, emergency repairs, and preventative maintenance, while serving as a subject matter expert (SME) for production equipment and operational processes. The Process Technologist collaborates with cross-functional teams and external vendors to manage equipment rebuilds, coordinate shutdowns, and resolve technical issues.


This role actively contributes to Integrated Manufacturing Excellence (IMEx) initiatives such as Continuous Improvement (CI), Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), and Standard Work (SW). The Technical Lead supports defect handling, maintenance planning, and visual management systems, while driving improvements in Clean-Inspect-Lubricate (CIL) and Centerline routines.


Additionally, the Process Technologist partners with internal stakeholders to support technology transfers, new product introductions, and recruiting efforts. They play a key role in Tier 1 and Tier 2 CI processes, facilitating root cause analysis and problem-solving within Process-Centric Teams, and ensuring alignment with departmental CI strategies.


ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support machine set-up, repairs, adjustments, changeovers, emergency repair/replacement, and preventative maintenance on production equipment per the applicable procedures.
  • Manage equipment rebuilds and repairs with outside vendors.
  • Responsible for vendor coordination for issues and shutdowns.
  • Interact and interpret data from production equipment automated control systems and displays.
  • Adhere to all safety requirements (e.g. PPE, LOTO, etc.) and process step requirements (e.g. SOP, Batch Records).
  • Support the Integrated Manufacturing Excellence (IMEx) activities (e.g. Continuous Improvement (CI), Standard Work (SW), and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) including tracking metrics.
  • Serve as Subject Matter Expert (SME) of production equipment within respective areas and for operations and technical resources outside the department.
  • Collaborate with SPO III and PES in planning and organizing shutdown and slowdown activities.
  • Participate in the Tier 1 Operator Care program maintenance activities; including utilizing the Operator Care slots, providing needed updates for the visual management systems for Operator Care and maintenance activities, ensuring continuous improvement of Clean-Inspect-Lubricate (CIL) routines and Centerline routines.
  • Utilize the defect handling and related work management processes including the defect log, maintenance planning and technology/process upgrades.
  • Contribute to CI process at Tier 1 and Tier 2 including support of CI projects/actions, attend Tier 1 CI meeting, support the Process-Centric Team with problem solving and root cause analysis.
  • Partner with CI Specialist within the department assigned to best support the Process-Centric Team on the TPM activities and CI processes.
  • Collaborate internally to support tech transfers and new products or configurations.


Here's What You Need (Minimum Requirements):

  • High School Diploma or GED and 6+ years of experience
  • Demonstrated functional and technical capabilities to learn and operate all lines in assigned area
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Functions with high sense of urgency to support production line issues
  • Strong interpersonal, decision making and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated proficiency in troubleshooting and applying Root Cause analysis
  • Basic computer skills using Microsoft Office (i.e. Excel, PowerPoint and Word)
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently and in a team environment
  • Prior experience working with automated production equipment and instrumentation/controls

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements):

  • Previous Biopharma or Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Experience
  • Knowledge of Food and Drug Administration PSM, Good Manufacturing Practices {also cGMP} policies and procedures

Physical/Mental Requirements

  • Ability to aseptically gown may be required depending on specific areas assigned
  • Lifting, sitting, standing, walking, bending
  • Ability to perform equipment troubleshooting and ability to perform complex data analysis: MTBF, TPM

Non-Stantard Work Schedule, Travel, or Environment Requirements

  • Ability to work off hours: nights, weekend; overtime when requested
  • Ability to work in a clean manufacturing environment, requiring special garments to be worn
  • Support FAT or visit vendors
  • Work Location Assignment: On Premise
  • Working hours: 7 am to 3:30 pm

Other Job Details

Last day to apply: November 30th, 2026.

The salary for this position ranges from $28.76 to $47.93 per hour. In addition, this position offers eligibility for overtime, weekend, holiday and other pay premiums depending on the work schedule and the Company’s policies. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. title: AI Automation Analyst
description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media () which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Senior Internal Auditor – SOX & Compliance
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Senior Internal Auditor on our Internal Audit team, you will play a pivotal role in leading SOX evaluations and readiness exercises across Roblox's dynamic internal business and technology environment. In this role, you will champion internal control compliance while helping scale our operational objectives. We are looking for an innovative auditor with strong foundations in SOX, with compliance audit experience a plus, who can design and build cutting-edge, AI-integrated audit programs. You will partner closely with key cross-functional teams to shape a secure and resilient ecosystem at Roblox.

You will

  • Identify, evaluate and document the test of design and test of operating effectiveness of the company's internal controls over financial reporting.
  • Execute other internal audits applying a top-down, risk-based approach to assess risks of key operational and financial processes.
  • Update SOX scoping analysis to confirm in-scope accounts, business processes and related systems.
  • Identify and assist the business in the implementation of SOX controls to properly mitigate financial reporting risks associated with new products or entities.
  • Guide the business in developing action plans to remediate control deficiencies.
  • Monitor controls and follow-up on all outstanding audit issues and progress of corresponding corrective actions.
  • Build and maintain Risk and Control Matrices and coordination of SOX testing in SOX compliance tools.
  • Create a sustainable structure to enable efficient controls testing in the future
  • Provide periodic updates to the team on the status of internal controls testing.
  • Manage and maintain positive and collaborative relationships with all levels of management, consultants, and external auditors.
  • Support compliance audits, including safety audits where applicable, assessing Roblox's controls against regulatory requirements.

You have

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Minimum 6+ years of relevant experience, with progressive experience within a technology company or a Big 4 accounting firm
  • Possess or working towards recognized professional certification(s) : CPA or CIA
  • Understanding of internal auditing standards and techniques, financial and operational risks and controls, SOX and COSO framework
  • Experience identifying, evaluating and documenting the design and effectiveness of internal controls
  • Knowledge of U.S. GAAP and/or GAAS guidelines
  • Strong project management skills and able to work independently and effectively within a team environment
  • Have the highest level of integrity and ethics
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work with flexible hours to ensure reasonable overlap with the U.S.-based team for meetings, walkthroughs, and testing discussions.
  • Strong technical foundations and interest in applying data analytics and AI to build audit programs and tooling.
  • Experience performing or supporting compliance audits or assessments, ideally including safety audits is a plus (ex. Online Safety Act and Digital Safety Act audits).

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

title: Bypass Pumping Project Coordinator
description:
Introduction & Key Role Objectives

WJ Groundwater is the leading construction dewatering and groundwater specialist in the UK with operations in Canada, the Middle East, Poland, & the Philippines. We have specialized plant and equipment that allows us to install custom dewatering and bypass pumping systems in a wide range of environments. Our Bypass Pumping Division designs, installs, and operates temporary bypass systems that maintain sewer and water flows during construction, repair, and rehabilitation work. Our current portfolio of projects covers everything from large infrastructure (heavy civil works) to residential developments, and small-scale dewatering and bypass pumping solutions in hard-to-access areas.


The primary function of this position is to support the management of bypass pumping projects, including design, schedules, budgets, resources, and quality standards. The role involves facilitating design activities, supervising site operations, and liaising with clients to ensure project success.


We are dedicated to fostering the growth and development of our employees. We provide extensive internal and external training programs, continuous learning opportunities, and clear career advancement paths to help our team members achieve their full potential. By promoting a supportive and dynamic environment, we ensure our employees thrive and contribute to our company's ongoing success and innovation.



Reports to Bypass Pumping Division Manager


Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Support Project Managers by overseeing bypass pumping project activities, managing contract and commercial aspects, ensuring high standards, compliance with contract terms, managing change orders, and following up with clients for necessary actions.
  • Manage project schedules to meet contractual targets and consistently achieve top-tier industry benchmarks for quality, financials, and overall project delivery.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation of WJ’s contractual activities including the collection, collation and presentation of data.
  • Perform project management and dissemination responsibilities, including drafting regular progress reports and participating in team meetings.
  • Coordinate the permits and approvals required for bypass installations, including road occupancy, traffic control, and discharge approvals.
  • Aid the Finance Department and Project Managers in achieving commercial success and revenue collection, including preparing progress billings at the end of each billing cycle.
  • Track project expenditures and workforce requirements to ensure financial profitability.
  • Prepare accurate and timely engineering and financial status reports for WJ’s clients.
  • Track rental pumps and equipment on and off hire across projects to control rental costs and support accurate billing.
  • Contribute to the development and application of bypass pumping system methodologies and techniques to ensure high-quality technical delivery and maintain industry expertise.
  • Monitor bypass pumping performance, oversee pump and equipment selection, system modifications, and suggest optimizations based on project goals and site conditions.
  • Support the preparation of Work Plans, working drawings, and work procedures.
  • Collaborate with the Logistics Manager to arrange material and equipment shipments for bypass pumping systems and source quality pumps, pipework, and related products at competitive prices.
  • Coordinate fuel supply and system monitoring, including remote monitoring and alarms, for operating bypass systems.
  • Oversee site activities to minimize labour hours and liaise with clients, site staff, supervisors, subcontractors and suppliers to resolve issues and ensure project progress.
  • Ensure personal health and safety, prepare Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), brief, and audit site staff to enforce safe working practices.
  • Contribute to business development activities, including site visits, client discussions, and the preparation of tenders and quotations for new contracts.


The above is not exhaustive and you will be expected to undertake any other duties that may reasonably fall within the level of responsibility and competence.


Qualifications & Experience

  • A motivated and hardworking individual with good written and communication skills is essential
  • Bachelor’s degree or technologist diploma in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Environmental) or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 1 year in project coordination or site supervision within the water treatment or construction industry or in a similar environment.
  • At least 1 year of experience in design, project coordination, and/or construction within bypass pumping, groundwater management, or related infrastructure.
  • An understanding of pumping systems, water and wastewater management, sewer hydraulics and flow, pump selection, and temporary pipework.
  • Familiarity with construction industry contracts and commercial issues is preferred.
  • Advanced IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 and Autodesk Suite.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills, capable of managing workloads and multiple high-value projects under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to read and modify technical drawings.

This role is primarily based at our head office in Toronto but requires site visits for client meetings, site inspections, inductions, and project briefings, with occasional full-day work on client worksites. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday. Occasional flexibility in working hours may be required.


Accessibility & Accommodation

This is an existing position and all applications are reviewed by our hiring team. AI is not used in the screening or selection process.

title: Bilingual Associate Lead - Incident Coordinator
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

This Incident Support team manages complex breach, fraud, and identity theft incidents, providing expert guidance and support to clients, impacted individuals, and internal partners. They coordinate sensitive and high-priority cases, help improve incident response processes, and provide coaching and expertise to the broader team.

This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

The Bilingual Associate Lead - Incident Coordinator is responsible for managing complex breach, fraud and identity theft cases while serving as a subject matter expert for clients, internal teams and impacted individuals. This role requires advanced analytical skills, exceptional communication and the ability to lead high priority or high‑sensitivity incidents. The incumbent contributes to operational excellence, supports continuous improvement efforts and provides coaching and guidance to other team members.


Incident & Customer Management

  • Conduct detailed customer interviews to gather required information related to breach, fraud or identity theft events.
  • Analyze case details to determine severity, scope and appropriate remediation actions.
  • Independently manage high‑complexity and escalated incidents, ensuring timely resolution and adherence to client requirements.
  • Serve as the point of contact for customers, clients and internal experts throughout the lifecycle of an incident.
  • Provide clear, professional and empathetic communication regarding services, expectations and next steps.
  • Coordinate with internal teams such as Forensics, Privacy, Legal and Operations to support complex investigations.
  • Assemble and preserve documentation, statements and timelines for use in remediation or claims processes.
  • Escalate issues requiring additional expertise and lead cross‑functional discussions and updates.

Client Support & Subject-Matter Expertise

  • Provide guidance on fraud trends, breach impact and best‑practice response methods.
  • Assist where requested with new client Implementation tasks.

Operational & Administrative Responsibilities

  • Assist to Identify and communicate incident trends, emerging risks, and unique client issues to internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to breaches and identity theft.
  • Support project scheduling, tracking, and reporting activities.
  • Oversee secure document and data transfers between the company and clients.
  • Record accurate, complete case notes and ensure timely case closure and final reporting.
  • Drive efficiency and consistency across the incident management process.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Support with mentorship, guidance and informal training to junior level Incident Coordinators.
  • Support onboarding through job‑shadowing, process guidance and knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct QA and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and compliance in case management.

Quality, Compliance & Governance

  • Support internal and external audit activities, including preparation of necessary documentation.
  • Monitor adherence to regulatory requirements, operational processes and client commitments.
  • Identify risks or gaps and escalate appropriately.

Continuous Improvement & SME Contribution

  • Recommend and support improvements to workflows, tools, templates and procedures.
  • Participate in pilot programs, process testing and system rollouts.
  • Contribute to SOP updates, and knowledge-base content.

Language Responsibilities

  • Review translated materials for accuracy and clarity when acting as language SME.
  • Assist French language clients with understanding any English only documents from our IRF/BFE teams.


Required Knowledge And Experiences

  • A university degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • French proficiency is a must have - both verbal and written as well as experience working in a bilingual capacity.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in a role of similar capacity.
  • Experience in credit industry is preferred.
  • Strong analytical, communication and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to manage high‑volume and high‑complexity cases with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated experience in breach, fraud, identity theft or related investigative work.
  • High level of professionalism, discretion and customer empathy.
  • Ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and communication.
  • Collaborate with Team Leads and Managers for any ad hoc items that arise due to business needs.

The expected pay range for this position is $55,000 - $70,000 annually. title: Patient Service Specialist
description:
At Cleveland Clinic Health System, we believe in a better future for healthcare. And each of us is responsible for honoring our commitment to excellence, pushing the boundaries and transforming the patient experience, every day.

We all have the power to help, heal and change lives — beginning with our own. That’s the power of the Cleveland Clinic Health System team, and The Power of Every One.

Job Title

Patient Service Specialist

Location

Garfield Hts

Facility

Marymount Hospital

Department

Access Operations Support-Clinical and Operational Improvement

Job Code

B15028

Shift

Days

Schedule

8:00am-4:30pm

Job Summary

Job Details


Serving the needs of Garfield Heights and the Southeast communities of Cuyahoga County since 1949, Marymount Hospital is a 269-registered bed acute care, faith-based hospital and became the first regional hospital to become a member of the Cleveland Clinic Healthcare System in 1995. This Magnet-recognized hospital maintains a strong commitment to the communities it serves through blending compassionate patient care with exceptional medical expertise. At Marymount Hospital, caregivers are guided by the Christian values of service, compassion, dignity and respect and live by the mission of providing world-class healthcare.


Cleveland Clinic is the first hospital in the nation to make great customer service a cornerstone of our mission. Patient Service Specialists deliver what matters most to our patients and their families, ensure exceptional experiences and thrive on making positive impacts in the community. The Patient Service Specialist role is a great steppingstone to other careers within customer service and other departments with Cleveland Clinic.

A caregiver in this position works days from 8:00AM – 4:30PM, with rotating weekend and holiday requirements.

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

  • Provide a comprehensive, proactive and “Patients First” experience for patients and visitors.
  • Investigate, triage and resolve patient issues using the established HEART model.
  • Create a welcome and professional environment, interact with patients and ensure outstanding patient experiences.
  • Perform patient registration, visit preparation, telephone triage, insurance verification, co-pay collection, patient and record tracking, scheduling, arrival and/or departure desk activities and screening and scheduling of interpreter services.
  • Enter and maintain confidential patient information.
  • Recruit, enroll and educate patients on MyChart and Appointment Pass.
  • Process the workflow for the day.
  • Maintain measured performance in quality, patient experience, first call resolution (FCR), customer satisfaction, teamwork and medical terminology.
  • Generate staff provider schedule and relay staff messaging.

Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • High School Diploma/GED and 2 years of experience in patient registration, appointment scheduling, insurance processing or customer service
  • OR Associate’s Degree and one year of experience
  • OR Bachelor’s Degree
  • Working knowledge of PC window applications
  • Ability to perform basic math sufficient to process insurance co-pays

Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

  • Knowledge of medical terminology
  • Ability to type a minimum of 30 words per minute or demonstrable personal computer keyboard skills

Physical Requirements:

  • Dexterity sufficient to operate a PC and other office equipment.
  • Requires extended periods of standing, walking or sitting.
  • Good visual acuity through normal or corrected vision.
  • Must be able to navigate various locations and function in a fast-paced, hectic environment.
  • Ability to lift and transport up to 25 pounds.

Personal Protective Equipment:

  • Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required.

title: Executive Business Partner, GTM
description:
Executive Business Partner, GTM

As an Executive Business Partner, you’ll work alongside four GTM leaders: the CRO, VP of Marketing, VP of Customer Success, and SVP of Business Development.

This is a partner role, not a scheduling role. You’ll know the business, use your own judgment to move decisions forward, and help these leaders plan their time, prepare for the conversations that matter, and follow through on what comes out of them.

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with at least two days a week onsite at our SF office. You’ll report to the Senior Manager of Executive Operations.

About the Team

The GTM organization at CircleCI spans Revenue, Marketing, Customer Success, and Business Development. These teams work in quarterly revenue cycles and depend on strong operational support to stay focused on customers and pipeline. You’ll join the Executive Business Partner team, which holds shared standards and meets weekly, and work alongside the EBPs who support the rest of our senior leadership.

What You’ll Do

Calendars and meeting preparation

  • Manage the CRO’s calendar with a clear view across the revenue calendar, fiscal quarter, pipeline review cadence, and board cycles to help navigate dependencies.
  • Prepare for meetings: gather briefing documents, send pre-reads proactively, and make sure the context is in hand before the meeting starts.
  • Support customer meetings, a big part of GTM: schedule them, prepare briefing materials, coordinate travel and onsite visits, and follow up afterward.
  • Support the VP of Marketing’s calendar across campaign cycles, product launches, analyst briefings, and external partner engagements.
  • Prepare the VP of Customer Success for Executive Business Reviews, renewal windows, and key account conversations, and handle the cross-functional coordination they require.
  • Handle scheduling and external logistics for the SVP of Business Development, including partner meetings, introductions, and multi-party deal coordination with Legal, Finance, and Product.

Follow-through and coordination

  • Attend meetings with any of the four leaders as needed, so you have the context to follow up and move things forward.
  • Track action items for all four leaders, close the loop on every commitment, and flag anything at risk of slipping before it does.
  • Work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and People, building relationships and getting things moving.
  • Book travel, review expenses, and handle the other day-to-day needs of the four leaders.
  • Handle board-related logistics and documents with discretion and accuracy.

All-hands and events

  • Plan and facilitate the preparation and execution of our quarterly GTM all-hands calls.
  • Plan and run GTM team events and offsites, including our annual Kickoff and President’s Club. You’ll own event planning cadence with other stakeholders, day of event logistics, agendas, and vendor coordination.

Team and tools

  • Take part in the weekly EBP team meeting and help the team hold each other accountable.
  • Use AI tools daily to draft communications, prepare briefings, and summarize information, in line with CircleCI’s AI fluency expectations.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of experience as an Executive Business Partner or Executive Assistant supporting C-suite or senior GTM leaders in a fast-paced tech company.
  • You understand how revenue organizations work: what quarter-end means, what a pipeline review needs, and how the last weeks of a quarter change everything.
  • You’re a proactive calendar manager. You anticipate conflicts, protect focus time, and decide routine matters without asking permission.
  • You have strong follow-through. When you own something, you finish it.
  • You use good judgment about when to act and when to escalate, and your aim is to reduce the decisions your leaders have to make.
  • You build trust and coordinate across teams without formal authority. Your ability to influence matters.
  • You write and speak clearly and effectively, and when you communicate on a leader’s behalf, it reflects well on them.
  • You stay calm and focused when priorities change.
  • You’re curious about the business and want to understand how the company makes money, beyond managing schedules.

Nice to Have

  • You love planning events, large and small, from a leadership dinner to a company-wide kickoff.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you need an accommodation, please let us know.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.


Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.
  • Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.
  • Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com. For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

title: Audience Growth Specialist
description:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: MS Data Engineer
company: Bespin Global MEA, an e& enterprise company
description:
The MS Data Engineer is responsible for maintaining, optimizing, and supporting data platforms, data pipelines, and relational database environments for managed services clients. The role combines data engineering with hands‑on database administration across Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL, whether hosted on cloud IaaS (virtual machines) or on cloud‑native PaaS services such as Amazon RDS, Azure SQL Database, and Azure SQL Managed Instance. The role focuses on operational excellence, system stability, continuous improvement, SLA adherence, and proactive monitoring of data and database environments across cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Key Accountabilities: Data Engineering & Operations (Managed Service Focus):
  • Monitor, maintain, and support existing data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data platforms for managed services clients.
  • Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of data systems across cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Perform ongoing optimization and tuning of data workflows and workloads to improve efficiency, reliability, and cost‑effectiveness.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline failures, integration issues, and performance bottlenecks within defined SLAs.
  • Implement enhancements and minor change requests within client‑managed environments, following agreed change management processes.
  • Maintain secure data environments, ensuring compliance with data governance, regulatory, and cross‑border data requirements.
  • Manage incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventive action planning for data platform incidents.
  • Support backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes for data platforms.
  • Collaborate with cloud, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure seamless operations.
  • Administer Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL databases hosted on cloud IaaS virtual machines (Azure, AWS, GCP) for managed services clients, covering installation, configuration, patching, version upgrades, and routine maintenance.
  • Design, implement, and regularly test backup and recovery strategies (full, differential/incremental, and point‑in‑time recovery) in line with client RPO/RTO requirements.
  • Configure and operate high availability and disaster recovery solutions, including SQL Server Always On Availability Groups and failover clustering, Oracle Data Guard / RAC, MySQL replication and clustering, and PostgreSQL streaming replication.
  • Perform proactive performance tuning: query and execution plan analysis, index and statistics maintenance, wait and lock analysis, memory and storage configuration, and capacity planning.
  • Manage database security: user and role administration, least‑privilege access, encryption at rest and in transit (e.g., TDE), auditing, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Automate routine DBA tasks (health checks, maintenance jobs, alerting) using T‑SQL, PL/SQL, shell/PowerShell, and Python.
  • Support database migrations, consolidations, and upgrades between cloud IaaS and PaaS platforms, and across cloud providers, with minimal downtime.
  • Provision, configure, and operate Amazon RDS instances (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and Amazon Aurora, including Multi‑AZ deployments, read replicas, parameter and option groups, maintenance windows, and engine version upgrades.
  • Manage RDS backup and recovery (automated backups, manual snapshots, point‑in‑time restore, cross‑region copies) and monitor health and performance using Amazon CloudWatch, Performance Insights, and Enhanced Monitoring.
  • Configure Azure database resilience and continuity features such as zone redundancy, active geo‑replication, auto‑failover groups, long‑term backup retention, and geo‑restore.
  • Optimize PaaS database performance and cost through service tier and compute sizing (vCore, DTU, serverless), Query Store, automatic tuning, and reserved capacity recommendations.
  • Secure PaaS databases using Microsoft Entra ID / AWS IAM authentication, private endpoints and VNet/VPC integration, firewall rules, Microsoft Defender for SQL, auditing, and data masking.
  • Plan and execute migrations to cloud PaaS using Azure Database Migration Service, AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) with Schema Conversion Tool (SCT), and native backup/restore methods.
Data Warehouse & Data Lake Support:
  • Maintain and optimize data warehouses and data lakes in cloud environments (e.g., Azure Synapse Analytics / Microsoft Fabric, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery).
  • Support schema updates, partition management, indexing strategies, and performance improvements.
  • Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across source databases, pipelines, and analytical stores.
  • Monitor storage utilization and implement optimization strategies.
Monitoring, Governance & Compliance:
  • Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for data pipelines, data platforms, and database instances (e.g., Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch, and third‑party tools).
  • Create automated validation checks to ensure data quality and accuracy.
  • Maintain documentation of data architecture, database inventories, workflows, runbooks, and operational procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with client SLAs, internal policies, and security standards.
Reporting & Analytics Support:
  • Troubleshoot data source connectivity and refresh issues.
  • Assist in performance optimization of reporting queries and datasets.
Job Specification: Education:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information

technology, data engineering, or any related field

Professional Certification:
  • AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
  • Oracle Database Administration Certified Professional (OCP)
  • ITIL 4 Foundation
  • MySQL and PostgreSQL certifications (e.g., Oracle MySQL Database Administrator, EDB PostgreSQL) are an advantage
Working Experience:
  • 5–8 years of combined experience in database administration and data engineering, ideally within a managed services or enterprise operations environment
  • Minimum 3 years of hands‑on DBA experience across Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL in cloud‑hosted production environments (IaaS and PaaS)
  • Demonstrable hands‑on experience administering Amazon RDS (including Aurora) and Azure PaaS databases (Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Database for MySQL and PostgreSQL Flexible Server)
  • Strong hands‑on experience with cloud data services (Azure Data Factory, Synapse / Microsoft Fabric, AWS Glue, BigQuery, etc.)
  • Experience supporting multiple clients under SLA‑driven managed services contracts
Knowledge:
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (T‑SQL, PL/SQL, MySQL and PostgreSQL dialects) and scripting languages (Python preferred; PowerShell, Bash).
  • Deep understanding of database internals across the supported platforms: storage engines, transaction isolation, locking and concurrency, indexing, execution plans, and memory management.
  • Strong knowledge of backup/recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery architectures for both IaaS‑hosted and PaaS databases.
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking and security as applied to databases (VNet/VPC, private endpoints, Microsoft Entra ID / AWS IAM, encryption, key management).
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes and data pipeline troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools and incident management / ITSM systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and automation (Terraform, Bicep/ARM, CloudFormation) and CI/CD for database changes is an advantage.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance principles, including ISO 27001 and data residency / cross‑border requirements.
  • Experience working under SLAs and structured support frameworks (ITIL‑based incident, problem, and change management).
Compliance:

Comply with the company’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) and ISO 27001 requirements and actively participate in regular training and audits to ensure continuous alignment with the standard.

  • Embrace a dedication to excellence and actively seek opportunities for improvement and innovation.
  • Contribute to a positive and collaborative environment that encourages effective teamwork and support.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to adapt and achieve shared goals, driving success together.
  • Serve as a role model for peers by embodying the Bespin Motto and upholding the behaviors and ethics that define our organization.
  • Help create a vibrant and inspiring workplace for all employees.

• Great team environment, competitive pay, free onsite parking and overtime opportunities

We offer:


At Dematic, we don't just offer jobs - we offer careers that move with you

  • Fitness Passport – Enjoy discounted access to gyms, pools, and fitness facilities nationwide for you and your family, making it easier and more affordable to stay active

With more than 12,000 employees globally and over 900 employees across Australia and New Zealand, Dematic offers the scale of a global organisation combined with the collaborative culture of a local team. You'll work alongside industry experts on industry-leading projects while being supported to develop your career, expand your skills, and make a genuine impact.


You'll work alongside experienced tradespeople and engineering professionals, gaining valuable exposure to mechanical systems, manufacturing processes and innovative warehouse automation technologies.

This is an opportunity to build practical skills, broaden your experience and develop your career with a global industry leader.

  • Average tenure is 8 years, with 12% internal promotions and transfers annually because we actively invest in developing our people.

HOW TO APPLY



If you're mechanically minded, enjoy hands-on work and are looking for an opportunity to develop your skills within a supportive manufacturing team, we'd love to hear from you! Please click on the ‘Apply for this job’ button and submit your CV. For more information visit:

title: Starlink Country Growth Director (Japan)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

STARLINK COUNTRY GROWTH DIRECTOR (JAPAN)

As the Starlink Country Growth Director, known internally as a Business Development Director, you will lead the strategy and execution for consumer revenue growth and market penetration for Starlink's satellite broadband network within Japan. This role plays a pivotal part in SpaceX's mission to provide high-speed connectivity throughout Japan, enabling underserved populations to access reliable internet for education, work, and entertainment. You will oversee a cross-functional team in a fast-paced, innovative environment, collaborating with product, engineering, and marketing to scale consumer adoption while navigating competitive and regulatory landscapes across Japan.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive go-to-market strategies for consumer broadband services in Japan, including pricing, bundling, and promotional campaigns to maximize subscriber acquisition and retention
  • Take full ownership of consumer growth outcomes, including high growth rates (~10% week over week growth) in Japan, cost optimization, forecasting demand, and supply chain coordination
  • Analyze consumer market trends, competitive intelligence, and user feedback to refine product offerings and enhance the end-to-end customer experience from onboarding to support
  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware (e.g., user terminals) and software features that meet consumer needs for speed, reliability, and affordability across Japan
  • Drive growth initiatives, such as partnerships to broaden distribution channels and accelerate consumer adoption, marketing and advertising efforts, and integration of government subsidy programs in Japan

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or an analytical field
  • 10+ years of experience within telecommunications, broadband, consumer products, or technical industries in Japan
  • Fluency in both spoken and written English and Japanese is essential for this role, as the position involves regular communication and coordination with both our US and Japan based business operations, clients, partners and stakeholders

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of direct people leadership experience in a consumer-facing business
  • 15+ years of experience within telecommunications, broadband, consumer products, or technical industries in Japan
  • Experience working with Japanese retailers in the consumer electronics arena
  • Experience and success selling both consumer electronics products and subscription services at high growth rates
  • Direct e-commerce, direct retail, and partnership experience all desired
  • Experience with various modes of advertising (billboards, television commercials, flyers, etc.)
  • Demonstrated success in consumer sales and product development in Japan, including consumer product sales to expand reach and adoption in rural and underserved areas, as well as marketing/advertising campaigns tailored for Japanese cultural and linguistic context
  • Expertise in data analytics for consumer insights and performance optimization
  • Leadership experience in fast-paced, startup-like cultures with a focus on innovation and cross-functional collaboration
  • Familiarity with supply chain management for consumer hardware and Japan logistics

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to travel, up 50%+ of time within Japan and across APAC as needed
  • Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed
  • Please note that the hiring entity for the role will be under X Corp. Japan

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Operations Supervisor
description:
About the job

Operations Supervisor


The Brink’s Company (NYSE:BCO) is a leading global provider of cash and valuables management, digital retail solutions, and ATM managed services. Our customers include financial institutions, retailers, government agencies, mints, jewelers, and other commercial operations. Our network of operations in 51 countries serves customers in more than 100 countries.


We believe in building partnerships that secure commerce and doing that requires fostering an engaged culture that values people with diverse backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives. We build a sense of belonging, so all employees feel respected, safe, and valued, and we provide equal opportunity to participate and grow.


We are seeking an accomplished and dynamic Operations Supervisor to join our team in Toronto. In this role, you will play a critical part in Operations, contributing to our ongoing success and strategic goals. As part of the Outside Operations Team, you will be responsible for overseeing various lines of business (ARM/ATM/CIT, Vault, Safe & Key, and Brinks Safe Products) at their assigned location. With an emphasis on team leadership (Union and Non-Union) and process improvement, this incumbent will ensure proper operating procedures and adherence to safety and security regulations while maximizing profitability and maintaining customer service standards.

Key Responsibilities:


Operations Management

Ensure minimum productivity standards for MAC (Customer Service Response Times) and Cash in Transit (Stops/Hour).

Maintain routes in Ocean and schedule CIT runs out of the branch.

Responsible for daily opening of the vault; check-out & in of liability; vault balancing; provide direction and allocation of resources.


Employee & Labour Relations

Ensure demonstration and promotion of both Company Values and Success Factors

Engage in active communication with all branch employees to promote engagement and well-being.

Ensure grievances are addressed in a timely fashion; make recommendations for disciplinary actions; administration of applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement.

Ensure adequate staffing levels are maintained and scheduling creation and posting.


Customer Service

Respond to customer inquiries as required and assist in finding solutions to any unresolved issues.

Completion of monthly customer SLA reporting.


Security Protocol Enforcement

Compliance with procedures and processes and ensure they are performed in accordance with the CSR/RMS and Regional requirements.


Health & Safety

Promote and ensure a physically and mentally safe working environment through the enforcement of all Health and Safety policies.

Investigate any workplace vehicle accidents or personal injuries in association with Joint Health & Safety Committees, ensuring findings and corrective action are reported and actioned as required.

If acting as a Health and Safety Representative, participate in monthly Health and Safety meetings, and complete building safety inspections and vehicle inspections.

Must complete the company standard Health and Safety training online.


Administration

Record keeping; payroll functions; inventory control, and supply ordering.

Maintain Petty Cash.

Month-end reporting: review billing and provide appropriate approvals.

Invoice processing.

Data entry (internal inventory system).

Selection and interviewing of candidates.


Fleet Maintenance

Technical knowledge and ability to perform minor vehicle repairs and maintenance.

Ensure the fleet is in good working order and that preventative maintenance schedules are following company policy.



Preferred Qualifications:

Excellent organizational and communication skills.

Action-oriented, able to maintain composure under pressure.

Sound working knowledge of PC applications (Microsoft Office), including on a mobile device.

Able to manage conflicts and make accurate, logical decisions.

Able to set targets, establish priorities, and meet goals.

Can effectively recruit, hire, and train staff as needed.

Ability to obtain a firearm licence.

Must be able to work flex hours, as required, including days, evenings, and weekends.


Qualifications

title: MANAGER PLANT IT & APPLICATIONS
location: Vedanta Sesa Goa Plant, Goa, India
description:
MANAGER PLANT IT & APPLICATIONS


Summary

We are seeking a seasoned professional to lead the strategic oversight and operational execution of IT systems within our manufacturing or mining facility. In this pivotal role, the successful candidate will serve as the primary liaison between technical infrastructure and business operations, ensuring the seamless functionality of critical enterprise applications. This position is essential for maintaining high availability of production planning and logistics systems, driving digital transformation initiatives, and aligning technology solutions with the broader organizational goals of efficiency and productivity. The role demands a deep understanding of the unique challenges faced in industrial environments and the ability to manage complex IT landscapes that support core business processes.

Responsibilities

  • Provide expert-level support, maintenance, and troubleshooting for SAP applications, with a specific focus on Production Planning (PP) and Logistics modules to ensure uninterrupted business operations.
  • Oversee the end-to-end management of IT infrastructure and daily operational activities, guaranteeing system reliability and security across the plant environment.
  • Facilitate the integration of various plant applications with central ERP systems to optimize data flow and process automation.
  • Cultivate and manage relationships with key stakeholders, external vendors, and service providers to ensure service level agreements are met and value is maximized.
  • Drive the implementation and optimization of Logistics ITMS applications to enhance supply chain visibility and operational efficiency.
  • Leverage industry-specific knowledge of manufacturing or mining sectors to tailor IT strategies that address sector-specific operational challenges.
  • Lead technical teams in the resolution of complex system issues, minimizing downtime and ensuring rapid recovery of critical services.

Requirements

Requirements:
  • Possess a robust background in IT Services, with 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in managing IT operations within industrial settings.
  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in SAP Application Support, specifically in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to Production Planning and Logistics modules.
  • Exhibit proven expertise in managing IT infrastructure and overseeing daily operational workflows in a high-stakes environment.
  • Have a strong track record of successfully integrating plant-level applications with enterprise-wide systems.
  • Bring prior work experience within the Manufacturing or Mining industries, with a clear understanding of their unique operational demands.
  • Display exceptional skills in stakeholder engagement and vendor management, capable of negotiating contracts and driving collaborative partnerships.
  • Show competence in deploying and managing Logistics ITMS solutions to support complex supply chain networks.

title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description:
About Us

Ocado Technology builds the systems behind some of the world’s most advanced grocery fulfilment: the Hive grid, thousands of bots, robotic picking and automated frame loading, all run by software our Product & Engineering teams write every day. More and more of that software is now built with AI.

That makes finance here far from routine. Cloud and AI are among our fastest-moving costs, and how we capitalise engineering time directly shapes our P&L. Decisions made by engineering leaders this quarter show up in our cash flow next quarter. We want someone who’ll help make those decisions, not just report on them.

Are you our person? You’re curious about how things work, commercially sharp, and happy to challenge the way things are done when you can see a better way. You can juggle competing priorities and build trust at every level, from engineers to VPs. And you’re comfortable with AI: Claude is an official member of the team here, and you’ll work alongside it every day.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll report to the Head of Finance and have real autonomy. We’ll give you the problem, not a checklist. You’ll use AI as a core part of how you work: building tools, automating reporting and analysing data so your time goes on insight, not reconciliations. In this team, building a tracker in Claude or querying data yourself in Looker is normal. You will partner with: Product & Engineering VPs and leaders, Procurement, Treasury, Group Accounting, the Shared Service Centre, and Commercial Finance colleagues across Ocado.

The exact mix will flex with your experience, your interests and the team’s priorities, but you’ll be working across:

  • The P&E cost base: Partnering Product & Engineering leaders on budgets, outlooks and month-end, and helping them understand what drives their costs and where the opportunities are.
  • Technology spend: Getting ahead of some of our fastest-moving costs, such as cloud, software and AI, and helping the business balance P&L impact against cash.
  • Investment and accounting judgement: Making sure we treat engineering investment correctly, from capex and capitalisation to how costs are allocated across the business.
  • Decision support: Turning messy questions into short, clear recommendations for senior finance and technology leaders.
  • How finance works: Building tools, automating processes and finding better ways of doing things, and shaping the team as it evolves

About you

  • Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent) with 2+ years post-qualification experience including time in commercial finance or business partnering
  • Confidence to take the lead: you set your own priorities, chase answers down and drive work through to a decision without waiting to be asked
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your work, with examples of something you’ve automated, built or rethought
  • Strong modelling, budgeting and forecasting skills, and a solid grasp of P&L, capex and cash
  • The ability to explain technical costs in plain English to engineers and finance leaders alike, and to challenge constructively
  • Curiosity about how technology businesses work. Experience with cloud costs, capitalisation of development spend or SaaS/tech finance is a plus, not a requirement

What we offer

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

  • Time to recharge:
    25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
  • Health & wellbeing:
    Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.
  • Family-first policies:
    22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave
  • Financial support:
    Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.
  • Commuter perks:
    Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
  • Exclusive discounts:
    15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).

title: Product Manager
description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

We are looking for a Product Manager – Resource Management to own and deliver the platform capability that enables Production Operations to plan, allocate, utilise, and optimise resources across WPP’s global production ecosystem.

This role sits within Enterprise Technology and is responsible for the evolution of the Resource Management platform capability, ensuring resource demand, capacity visibility, allocation, utilisation monitoring and workforce management capabilities can be delivered consistently across Production Operations.

The platform estate under this role is predominantly SaaS-based. The role will work closely with platform vendors, configurators, Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, Operations and Delivery teams to ensure resource management capability is implemented effectively and evolves in line with Production Operations priorities.

The role is focused on delivering and evolving platform capability that enables Production Operations to manage resource visibility, planning, allocation, utilisation and optimisation consistently at scale. It is not responsible for defining workforce planning or utilisation models, but for delivering the platform capability that enables those models to operate successfully.

What you'll be doing:

KRA 1: Team Leadership

  • Own the Resource Management platform roadmap, backlog and delivery priorities across Production Operations.

KRA 2: Strategic Contribution

  • Shape platform capability to improve resource visibility, utilisation, capacity planning and operational efficiency.

KRA 3: Stakeholder Management & First-Line Enablement

  • Partner with Product, Operations, Architecture, Engineering, Finance, Reporting and Delivery teams to support adoption and delivery.

KRA 4: Platform Delivery, Vendor Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Manage SaaS vendors, integrations and releases to keep Resource Management capability scalable and aligned to business priorities.

Platform Ownership & Roadmap

  • Own the Resource Management platform roadmap and backlog.
  • Prioritise platform capability investment in line with Production Operations priorities.
  • Balance operational demand, platform sustainability, vendor capabilities, and long-term platform evolution.
  • Act as the primary Product Owner for the Resource Management platform ecosystem.
  • Maximise value from Resource Management platform investment.

Delivery & Implementation

  • Translate agreed business and product requirements into epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies and delivery priorities.
  • Own delivery of Resource Management capability across SaaS platforms and associated integrations.
  • Work closely with configurators, engineering teams and platform vendors to implement capability effectively.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, supportable and aligned to agreed Product requirements.
  • Support testing, validation, adoption and rollout activities.
  • Ensure platform capability is delivered consistently and predictably.

Resource Platform Capability

  • Deliver platform capability supporting:
    • resource planning
    • capacity visibility
    • allocation workflows
    • utilisation visibility
    • scheduling
    • workforce management
    • resource analytics
